domains.name: property
domains.description: Core operational domain and master registry for all real estate assets — commercial, residential, and mixed-use properties, buildings, land parcels, units, and spaces. Owns physical attributes (GLA, NLA, SQF/SQM, FAR), building specifications, GIS coordinates, zoning classifications, COO status, LEED/BREEAM certifications, BIM references, title information, and ownership hierarchy. Single source of truth for every asset the enterprise owns, manages, or brokers.
domains.references: RESO Data Dictionary, ISO 55000 Asset Management

products.name: asset
products.description: Master registry and single source of truth for every real estate asset the enterprise owns, manages, or brokers — the root anchor for the entire property domain. Each record represents one distinct property (commercial, residential, or mixed-use). Captures canonical identity: asset class (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, land, hospitality, self-storage), portfolio assignment, legal entity ownership, acquisition date, disposition date, asset status (active, disposed, under development, held for sale), GIS coordinates (latitude/longitude), legal description, APN (Assessor Parcel Number), FIPS code, market/submarket classification, and BIM model reference. All other property-domain products reference this entity as their parent.
products.reference: RESO Property Resource / Yardi Voyager Property Master

products.name: building
products.description: Physical building structure record associated with a real estate asset. One asset may contain multiple buildings (e.g., campus, mixed-use development). Captures building name, year built/renovated, floors above and below grade, total GLA/NLA (SQF and SQM), building class (A/B/C), construction type, structural system, building status (operational, under construction, demolished), COO number and date, fire suppression type, elevator count, parking stalls, and BIM reference. SSOT for building-level sustainability certifications (LEED level/date, BREEAM rating, ENERGY STAR score, WELL, FITWEL) with certifying body, certification number, expiration, and ESG reporting flags. SSOT for building amenity inventory (fitness, parking, F&B, conference, outdoor, technology, security) with capacity, hours, ADA compliance, and fee details. SSOT for floor plan records (as-built, current, proposed) with area breakdowns, load factors, and CAD/BIM file references. The comprehensive physical structure record and single source of truth for all building attributes, certifications, amenities, and floor plans in the portfolio.

attributes.name: cam_area_sqf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Area Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Square footage of this space that is allocated to the CAM pool. May differ from total rentable area when only a portion of the space is CAM-eligible (e.g., a partially shared corridor). Used in CAM charge calculations and annual CAM reconciliation.
attributes.references: BOMA International — CAM Reconciliation Standards; Yardi Voyager — CAM Module

attributes.name: cam_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this space is included in the Common Area Maintenance (CAM) pool for charge-back calculations to tenants. True for common corridors, lobbies, and shared amenities; False for exclusively demised tenant spaces. Drives CAM reconciliation in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: BOMA International — CAM Reconciliation Standards; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: ceiling_height_ft
attributes.description: Clear ceiling height of the space measured in feet from finished floor to finished ceiling. A key physical specification influencing tenant suitability (e.g., data centers require raised floors and high ceilings), TI design, and HVAC system sizing.
attributes.references: BOMA International; Appraisal Institute — Property Inspection Standards

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Physical condition and fit-out state of the space at the time of listing or inspection. 'Shell' = bare concrete/structure only; 'Warm Shell' = HVAC and electrical roughed in; 'Plug and Play' = fully furnished and wired; 'Full Fit Out' = custom tenant improvements complete; 'As Is' = existing condition without landlord work.
attributes.references: BOMA International; CoStar Suite — Space Condition Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this space record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and SOX financial controls for publicly traded REITs.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: effective_rent_psf
attributes.description: Net effective rent per square foot after accounting for free rent periods, TI allowances, and other concessions. Used in Argus Enterprise cash flow modeling and investment analysis to reflect true economic rent versus face rent.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute; IVSC

attributes.name: electrical_capacity_amps
attributes.description: Dedicated electrical capacity allocated to this space in amperes. Critical for tenant fit-out planning, data center and lab space leasing, and building infrastructure load management.
attributes.references: BOMA International; National Electrical Code (NEC)

attributes.name: energy_star_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this space qualifies for ENERGY STAR certification based on energy performance benchmarks. Supports ESG reporting, green lease provisions, and EPA ENERGY STAR portfolio benchmarking.
attributes.references: EPA — ENERGY STAR Program; U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED; ESG Reporting Standards

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Numeric floor level on which the space is located within the building. Negative values represent below-grade levels (e.g., -1 for basement). Used for floor plan mapping, elevator zoning, and emergency egress planning.
attributes.references: BOMA International — Office Building Standard

attributes.name: floor_plan_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or URL pointing to the architectural floor plan drawing for this space, typically stored in Procore or a document management system. Supports TI space planning, BIM coordination, and tenant improvement design reviews.
attributes.references: Procore — Document Control; BIM (Building Information Modeling) Standards

attributes.name: hvac_zone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Zone
attributes.description: HVAC zone designation for this space as configured in the building management system and Building Engines. Determines which HVAC unit serves the space, supports after-hours HVAC billing, and drives preventive maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Facility Operations; ASHRAE Standards

attributes.name: is_contiguous
attributes.description: Indicates whether this space is physically contiguous with adjacent spaces, enabling combination into a larger demised unit for a single tenant. Critical for large-block leasing strategies and tenant expansion rights.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite — Space Availability

attributes.name: is_subdivisible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this space can be physically subdivided into smaller demised units to accommodate multiple tenants or co-working configurations. Supports leasing flexibility analysis and TI space planning.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: last_occupied_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent tenant vacated or the space was last in active occupancy. Used to calculate vacancy duration, assess market re-leasing timelines, and trigger preventive maintenance inspections in Building Engines.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: leed_certification_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Level
attributes.description: LEED certification level applicable to this space or the building section it occupies, as awarded by the U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC). Drives ESG reporting, green premium rent analysis, and sustainability compliance disclosures for publicly traded REITs.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Certification; SEC — ESG Disclosure; SOX

attributes.name: load_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of rentable area to usable area (rentable_area_sqf / usable_area_sqf), also known as the add-on factor or loss factor. Quantifies the tenant's proportionate share of common areas. A load factor of 1.15 means 15% of the rentable area is common space. Critical for NLA/GLA reconciliation and lease negotiation.
attributes.references: BOMA International — Office Building Standard; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: max_occupancy
attributes.description: Maximum number of persons permitted to occupy the space simultaneously as determined by the Certificate of Occupancy (COO) and local fire/building codes. Used for OSHA compliance, emergency planning, and co-working capacity management.
attributes.references: OSHA — Building Safety; U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); International Building Code

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, leasing remarks, or special conditions associated with the space (e.g., 'Column intrusion on north wall', 'Dedicated fiber riser access', 'Requires landlord approval for signage'). Used by property managers and leasing agents.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Space/Unit Module

attributes.name: occupancy_class
attributes.description: Building quality classification of the space (Class A, B, or C) per BOMA/CoStar standards. Influences asking rent benchmarks, tenant profile targeting, and portfolio reporting in CoStar Suite and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: BOMA International; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: pro_rata_share
attributes.description: Tenant's proportionate share of the building's total rentable area, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Used to allocate CAM charges, operating expenses, and real estate taxes under NNN and modified gross lease structures.
attributes.references: BOMA International — Office Building Standard; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: rentable_area_sqf
attributes.description: Rentable area of the space measured in square feet per BOMA standards, inclusive of the tenant's pro-rata share of common areas. This is the basis for rent calculation, CAM charge allocation, and GLA reconciliation in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: BOMA International — Office Building Standard; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: rentable_area_sqm
attributes.description: Rentable area of the space measured in square meters for international portfolio reporting and IFRS 16 compliance. Maintained in parallel with SQF for cross-border asset comparisons.
attributes.references: IVSC — International Valuation Standards; IFRS 16

attributes.name: space_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the space (e.g., 'Executive Conference Room', 'North Lobby', 'Parking Bay 12'). Used in tenant communications, floor plan references, and facility operations.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Space Registry; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: space_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier assigned to the space within the building, as recorded in Yardi Voyager and Building Engines (e.g., '101A', 'B-204', 'LOBBY-1'). Used for physical wayfinding, work order routing, and tenant service requests.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Space/Unit Module; Building Engines — Space Registry

attributes.name: space_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the space indicating its operational availability. 'available' = ready to lease; 'occupied' = active tenant; 'under_build_out' = TI construction in progress; 'offline' = temporarily out of service; 'reserved' = held for a prospect or pending deal; 'decommissioned' = permanently removed from inventory.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Space/Unit Module; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: space_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the space's functional use within the building. Drives CAM eligibility, GLA/NLA inclusion rules, and TI planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: private_office|conference_room|common_corridor|lobby|mechanical_room|parking_bay|storage|retail_unit|coworking_bay|restroom — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BOMA International — Office Building Standard; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ti_allowance_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Improvement (TI) Allowance Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Landlord-funded Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance per square foot offered for this space to cover fit-out construction costs. A key lease concession tracked in Yardi Voyager and DocuSign CLM during lease negotiation and execution.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager — TI Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this space record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: usable_area_sqf
attributes.description: Usable area of the space in square feet, representing the area exclusively occupied by the tenant excluding common areas. Used alongside rentable area to compute the load factor and NLA reconciliation.
attributes.references: BOMA International — Office Building Standard; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: usable_area_sqm
attributes.description: Usable area of the space in square meters. Used for international lease administration, IFRS 16 right-of-use asset calculations, and cross-border portfolio benchmarking.
attributes.references: IVSC — International Valuation Standards; IFRS 16

attributes.name: yardi_space_code
attributes.description: Native space identifier as assigned in Yardi Voyager Property Management system. Used for system-of-record reconciliation, data lineage tracking, and integration with Yardi AR/AP and lease administration modules.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Space/Unit Module

products.name: address
products.description: Standardized physical address record for properties, buildings, parcels, and units. Captures address line 1, address line 2, city, county, state/province, postal code, country, USPS standardization status, geocode latitude, geocode longitude, geocode accuracy level, MSA (Metropolitan Statistical Area) code, submarket name, neighborhood name, and address validation timestamp. Supports GIS integration, market analysis, and regulatory reporting. One asset or building may have multiple addresses (e.g., corner properties with multiple street frontages).
products.reference: USPS Address Standardization / GIS Geocoding Standard

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each standardized address record in the enterprise property address registry. Serves as the primary key for all address-related joins across the property domain.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) — Data Dictionary

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Country reference is required for international portfolio management, regulatory jurisdiction determination, foreign ownership compliance, and GDPR applicability assessment. country_code on address is
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: geographic_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.geographic_hierarchy. Business justification: Addresses are located within geographic market hierarchies used for market analysis, portfolio geographic roll-up, and investment strategy segmentation. msa_name and submarket_name on address are deno
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: address_source
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this address record was originally sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking, conflict resolution during ETL, and audit trail requirements. Values correspond to enterprise operational systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: yardi|mri|costar|manual|usps|gis|procore — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Data Lineage Requirements; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose within the enterprise. Primary indicates the main physical address; mailing is the postal delivery address; legal is the address of record for title and regulatory filings; billing is used for invoicing; secondary captures additional frontages for corner properties.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; ALTA Title Standards

attributes.name: carrier_route
attributes.description: USPS carrier route code identifying the specific mail carrier delivery route for the address. Used for bulk mail processing, address quality validation, and USPS CASS (Coding Accuracy Support System) certification.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Carrier Route Codes; USPS CASS Certification

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: U.S. Census Bureau census tract code for the address location. Used for HUD regulatory reporting, Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) compliance, demographic analysis, and opportunity zone identification for tax-advantaged investment reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau — Census Tract Definitions; HUD Reporting Requirements; SEC REIT Disclosure

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Municipality or city name in which the property address is located. Used for market segmentation, submarket analysis, and regulatory reporting. Aligned with USPS city name standardization.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: congressional_district
attributes.description: U.S. Congressional district designation for the address location. Used for government affairs tracking, lobbying activity reporting, and compliance with federal housing and development programs administered at the district level.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau — Congressional District Boundaries; HUD

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name in which the property is located. Required for property tax assessment, title searches, and regulatory compliance reporting to HUD and local jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ALTA — Title Standards; HUD Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage, and SOX financial controls for publicly traded REITs.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: delivery_point_barcode
attributes.description: USPS-assigned Delivery Point Barcode (DPBC) for the address, consisting of the ZIP+4 code plus a two-digit delivery point code. Confirms mail deliverability and is used for bulk mail operations and address quality scoring.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Delivery Point Validation (DPV)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address record became or becomes effective for the associated property. Used for bi-temporal data management, historical address tracking, and compliance with FASB ASC 842 and IFRS 16 lease accounting address change requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this address record ceases to be effective. Null indicates the address is open-ended with no planned expiry. Supports bi-temporal address history management and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code uniquely identifying the state and county of the address (first two digits = state, last three = county). Required for government regulatory reporting, HUD submissions, and geographic data integration with federal datasets.
attributes.references: NIST FIPS Publication 6-4 — Counties and Equivalent Entities; HUD Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: flood_zone_code
attributes.description: FEMA National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) flood zone designation for the address (e.g., AE, X, VE). Required for property insurance underwriting, lender due diligence, environmental compliance reporting, and disclosure obligations under HUD and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: FEMA — National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP); EPA Environmental Compliance; HUD Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded latitude/longitude coordinates. Rooftop indicates exact building-level precision; parcel_centroid is parcel-level; street_interpolated is estimated from street range; zip_centroid and city_centroid are approximate. Critical for GIS analysis quality assessment.
attributes.references: GIS Standards; CoStar Suite GIS Integration; ISO 19111 — Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: geocode_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the latitude and longitude coordinates were last geocoded or re-geocoded for this address. Supports GIS data freshness monitoring and triggers re-geocoding workflows when coordinates are stale relative to address changes.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 — Spatial Referencing; GIS Standards; CoStar Suite GIS Integration

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address record is currently active and in use. False indicates the address has been superseded, retired, or invalidated (e.g., due to a street renaming, rezoning, or property demolition). Supports soft-delete patterns in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the primary address for the associated property or building. True when this is the main address used for all official correspondence, title records, and regulatory filings. A property may have multiple addresses (e.g., corner properties with multiple street frontages); only one should be flagged as primary.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; ALTA Title Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: WGS 84 decimal degree latitude coordinate of the property address, ranging from -90 to +90. Derived from geocoding the standardized address. Supports GIS integration, spatial analysis, proximity searches, and market boundary delineation.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 — Geographic Point Location; GIS Standards; CoStar Suite GIS Integration

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including house/building number and street name. Represents the first line of the standardized postal address as defined by USPS or local postal authority. Sourced from Yardi Voyager property address fields.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line capturing suite, floor, unit, building name, or additional directional information not captured in address line 1. Common for multi-tenant commercial buildings with multiple street frontages or suite designations.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: WGS 84 decimal degree longitude coordinate of the property address, ranging from -180 to +180. Derived from geocoding the standardized address. Supports GIS integration, spatial analysis, proximity searches, and market boundary delineation.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 — Geographic Point Location; GIS Standards; CoStar Suite GIS Integration

attributes.name: msa_code
attributes.description: U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) five-digit code identifying the Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA) in which the property is located. Used for market-level performance benchmarking, CoStar market analytics, and investment portfolio geographic classification.
attributes.references: U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) — Metropolitan Statistical Area Definitions; CoStar Suite Market Analytics

attributes.name: neighborhood_name
attributes.description: Recognized neighborhood or district name within the city or submarket (e.g., SoHo, Buckhead, River North). Supports hyper-local market analysis, tenant demand mapping, and broker price opinion (BPO) comparables selection.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; NAR Neighborhood Data Standards; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional address-related context, exceptions, or clarifications not accommodated by structured fields (e.g., building access instructions, address disambiguation notes for corner properties, or historical address change explanations).
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: opportunity_zone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address falls within a federally designated Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ) as defined under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017. True enables investment advisory teams to identify tax-advantaged investment opportunities and report to investors on QOZ portfolio exposure.
attributes.references: IRS — Qualified Opportunity Zone Regulations (IRC Section 1400Z); SEC REIT Disclosure

attributes.name: plus4_code
attributes.description: Four-digit USPS ZIP+4 extension code that narrows the delivery area to a specific block face, building, or floor. Enhances address precision for mail delivery and is required for USPS bulk mailing discounts and DPV validation.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: USPS ZIP code or ZIP+4 code for domestic US addresses, or equivalent postal code for international properties. Supports mail delivery, market area delineation, and GIS-based spatial analysis.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this address record in the originating source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager property address ID, MRI address key, CoStar property address code). Enables cross-system reconciliation and ETL lineage tracing.
attributes.references: SOX — Data Lineage; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-2 state or province code (e.g., CA, NY, TX) in which the property is located. Used for state-level regulatory compliance, tax reporting, and portfolio geographic segmentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: tax_parcel_number
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number (APN) or tax parcel identification number assigned by the county assessor's office. Links the address to property tax records, title searches, and ALTA surveys. Used in Yardi Voyager fixed asset and property tax modules.
attributes.references: ALTA — American Land Title Association Standards; County Assessor Records

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles). Used for scheduling property inspections, maintenance work orders in Building Engines, lease commencement date calculations, and multi-timezone portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ISO 8601

attributes.name: transit_score
attributes.description: Transit Score rating (0–100) for the address location measuring access to public transportation. Used in tenant demand analysis, property valuation inputs, and ESG reporting on sustainable location attributes for LEED and BREEAM certifications.
attributes.references: Walk Score — Transit Score Methodology; CoStar Suite; U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED Location Credits

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was last modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: usps_standardized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been standardized according to USPS Publication 28 postal addressing standards. True means the address conforms to USPS format and has passed DPV validation. Used for mail deliverability and regulatory reporting quality assurance.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current USPS or third-party address standardization and validation status. Validated indicates the address has been confirmed against the USPS Delivery Point Validation (DPV) database. Failed indicates the address could not be matched. Corrected indicates the address was auto-corrected during standardization.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Delivery Point Validation (DPV); RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address was last validated or re-validated against USPS DPV or a third-party address verification service. Used to assess address data freshness and trigger re-validation workflows when the timestamp exceeds a defined staleness threshold.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — DPV; Enterprise Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: walk_score
attributes.description: Walk Score rating (0–100) for the address location measuring pedestrian accessibility to amenities. Used in tenant demand analysis, property marketing, and investment advisory scoring for commercial and residential assets. Sourced from Walk Score API or CoStar.
attributes.references: Walk Score Methodology; CoStar Suite — Location Analytics; NAR Location Scoring

attributes.name: zoning_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the local government authority (municipality, county, or special district) with zoning jurisdiction over the address. Critical for development feasibility, permitting, and regulatory compliance tracking in Procore and SAP S/4HANA project systems.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI) — Zoning Standards; Local Municipal Codes

products.name: property_ownership_interest
products.description: Records the ownership interest structure for each real estate asset — capturing who owns what percentage of each property and under what legal structure. Supports complex ownership arrangements including joint ventures, tenancy-in-common (TIC), REIT structures, and fund ownership. Captures owner entity reference, ownership percentage, ownership type (fee simple, leasehold, ground lease, easement), legal entity name, legal entity type (LLC, LP, REIT, individual), acquisition date, disposition date, ownership status (active, transferred, dissolved), and title vesting language. Bridges the property domain to the owner domain.
products.reference: ALTA Title Policy / SNDA Agreement / SEC REIT Disclosure

attributes.name: property_ownership_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ownership interest record in the property ownership interest registry. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property asset for which this ownership interest is recorded. Links the ownership interest to the property master registry.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Equity contributions, allocated debt amounts, and preferred return calculations on ownership interests require a currency reference for multi-currency fund consolidation and investor capital account r
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (LLC, LP, REIT, trust, individual) through which the ownership interest is held. Supports multi-entity ownership structures including joint ventures and fund ownership.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 — Consolidation; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the owner entity holding this ownership interest. Bridges the property domain to the owner domain.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: tenure_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.tenure_type. Business justification: Tenure type (freehold, leasehold, fee simple, ground lease) on ownership interests is required for title insurance policy selection, CMBS eligibility, REIT compliance, and SNDA requirement determinati
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: title_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.title_record. Business justification: An ownership interest in a real estate asset is legally evidenced by a title record (deed, title policy). property_ownership_interest currently has title_policy_number and deed_reference_number as str
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The total purchase price or cost basis allocated to this ownership interest at the time of acquisition, in the reporting currency. Used for depreciation, gain/loss on sale, and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) tracking in Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 — Property Plant and Equipment; IRS Publication 946; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ownership interest was acquired or the title was vested. Used for holding period calculations, capital gains tax determination, and depreciation schedules under FASB ASC 360.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 — Property Plant and Equipment; IRS Publication 946; ALTA

attributes.name: allocated_debt_amount
attributes.description: The portion of property-level debt (mortgage, CMBS, or other financing) allocated to this ownership interest based on the ownership percentage. Used for Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio calculations and Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) reporting in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 — Debt; SEC Regulation S-X; CMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ownership interest record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404 — Financial Reporting Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: deed_reference_number
attributes.description: The recorded deed book and page number or instrument number from the county recorder's office that evidences this ownership interest. Critical for title chain of custody and legal due diligence.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); County Recorder Standards

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ownership interest was disposed of, transferred, or relinquished. Null if the interest is currently active. Used for gain/loss on sale calculations and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 — Property Plant and Equipment; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: distribution_priority
attributes.description: The numeric priority rank of this ownership interest in the waterfall distribution structure (1 = highest priority). Determines the order in which distributions are made among multiple interest holders in joint ventures and fund structures.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI) — Joint Venture Structuring Guidelines; FASB ASC 323

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ownership interest record becomes legally effective and binding. May differ from acquisition date in cases of retroactive title corrections or delayed closing settlements.
attributes.references: ALTA; American Bar Association — Real Property Section

attributes.name: encumbrance_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of any liens, mortgages, easements, covenants, or other encumbrances affecting this ownership interest. Sourced from ALTA title search results and legal due diligence documentation.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Uniform Commercial Code (UCC)

attributes.name: equity_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The total equity capital contributed by the owner entity for this ownership interest, net of debt financing. Used for Return on Investment (ROI), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations in Argus Enterprise and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323 — Equity Method Investments; IVSC; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ownership interest is scheduled to expire or terminate, applicable for leasehold interests, ground leases, and time-limited easements. Null for fee simple and perpetual interests.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Leases; IFRS 16 Leases; ALTA

attributes.name: interest_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number or code assigned to this ownership interest record, as tracked in Yardi Voyager or MRI Software. Used for cross-system reconciliation and title documentation.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets Module

attributes.name: is_controlling_interest
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ownership interest constitutes a controlling interest in the property or owning entity, triggering consolidation requirements under FASB ASC 810. True if controlling; False if non-controlling (minority interest).

attributes.name: is_managing_member

attributes.name: ownership_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, legal annotations, or special conditions associated with this ownership interest record, such as pending litigation, regulatory restrictions, or investor-specific terms not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total ownership interest held by the owner entity in this property, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 50.0000 for 50%). attributes.references: FASB ASC 323 — Equity Method Investments; SEC Regulation S-X; IVSC

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ownership interest record. attributes.name: ownership_structure
attributes.description: The legal and organizational structure under which the ownership interest is held. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sole_ownership|joint_venture|tic|reit|fund|partnership|trust — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC — REIT Regulations; FASB ASC 323 — Equity Method Investments; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: The annual preferred return rate (expressed as a percentage) to which this ownership interest is entitled before residual distributions are made to other interest holders. Common in joint venture and fund structures. Used in waterfall distribution modeling in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; Urban Land Institute (ULI) — Joint Venture Structuring Guidelines

attributes.name: recording_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The county, parish, or municipality where the deed or title instrument for this ownership interest is recorded. Determines applicable property law, transfer taxes, and regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: snda_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement (SNDA) Status
attributes.description: The execution status of the Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement (SNDA) associated with this ownership interest, which governs the relationship between the lender, owner, and tenants in the event of foreclosure.

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: source_system_record_code

attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: title_company_name

attributes.name: title_policy_number

attributes.name: title_vesting_language

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_flag

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: voting_rights_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of voting rights held by this ownership interest, which may differ from the economic ownership percentage in certain joint venture or preferred equity structures. Used for consolidation analysis under FASB ASC 810.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 — Consolidation; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302

products.name: title_record
products.description: Title, deed, and encumbrance registry for each real estate asset — the single source of truth for chain of title, all recorded encumbrances, and title insurance details. Stores deed type (warranty, quitclaim, grant, special warranty), deed book and page reference, recording date and number, county recorder jurisdiction, title company, policy number, policy type (ALTA owner, ALTA lender), policy amount, effective date, and title status (clear, encumbered, in dispute). SSOT for all encumbrances recorded against the asset: liens (mortgage lien, mechanics lien, tax lien), easements, deed restrictions, CC&Rs, rights-of-way, and ground lease encumbrances — with recording details, priority position, grantor/grantee, encumbrance amounts, maturity dates, release dates, and encumbrance status (active, released, expired, disputed). Critical for transaction due diligence, lender underwriting, SNDA management, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: chain_of_title_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative summarizing the historical sequence of ownership transfers and any notable gaps, breaks, or anomalies identified in the chain of title examination. Critical for transaction due diligence.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: county_recorder_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the county or local government jurisdiction where the deed and title instruments are recorded. Determines the applicable recording laws, fees, and public record access procedures.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); HUD

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this title record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 30; ISO 55000

attributes.name: deed_book
attributes.description: Official deed book number or volume identifier as recorded in the county recorder's office. Used in conjunction with deed_page to locate the physical or digital deed instrument in public records.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: deed_page
attributes.description: Official deed page number within the deed book as recorded in the county recorder's office. Combined with deed_book provides the precise public record locator for the deed instrument.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the encumbrance recorded against the property, such as the outstanding principal of a mortgage lien, the amount of a mechanics lien claim, or the assessed amount of a tax lien. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); FASB ASC 842; SEC; SOX

attributes.name: encumbrance_grantee
attributes.description: Legal name of the party receiving the benefit of the encumbrance (e.g., lender receiving a mortgage lien, utility company receiving an easement). Used for lien holder identification and release coordination.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: encumbrance_grantor
attributes.description: Legal name of the party granting the encumbrance (e.g., property owner granting an easement, borrower granting a mortgage lien). Used for due diligence and lien release tracking.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: encumbrance_maturity_date
attributes.description: Date on which the encumbrance is scheduled to mature or expire by its own terms (e.g., loan maturity date for a mortgage lien, expiration date for a temporary easement). Null for perpetual encumbrances.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: encumbrance_recording_date
attributes.description: Date on which the encumbrance instrument was officially recorded with the county recorder. Establishes the legal priority position of the encumbrance relative to other recorded interests.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: encumbrance_recording_number
attributes.description: Official instrument number assigned by the county recorder when the encumbrance instrument (lien, easement, restriction) was recorded. Used to locate the encumbrance in public records.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: encumbrance_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the encumbrance was formally released, discharged, or satisfied and the release instrument was recorded. Null if the encumbrance remains active. Used to confirm clear title status.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: encumbrance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the encumbrance recorded against the property title. Active indicates the encumbrance is in force; released indicates it has been formally discharged; expired indicates it lapsed by its own terms; disputed indicates it is subject to legal challenge.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: encumbrance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the encumbrance recorded against the property title. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mortgage_lien|mechanics_lien|tax_lien|easement|deed_restriction|ccr|right_of_way|ground_lease|judgment_lien|lis_pendens — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR); HUD

attributes.name: environmental_lien_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an environmental lien or notice of environmental action has been recorded against the property by the EPA or a state environmental agency. Critical for acquisition due diligence and ESG compliance.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA); American Land Title Association (ALTA); ESG reporting standards

attributes.name: grantee_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the party receiving title (buyer or transferee) as recorded on the deed instrument. Identifies the current or incoming owner of record for chain of title purposes.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the party conveying title (seller or transferor) as recorded on the deed instrument. Critical for chain of title verification and due diligence.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the property as it appears on the recorded deed, including metes and bounds, lot and block, or government survey description. Required for title examination and conveyancing.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: lis_pendens_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lis pendens (notice of pending litigation) has been recorded against the property. A lis pendens clouds title and must be resolved prior to any sale or refinancing.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: policy_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of coverage provided under the title insurance policy, typically equal to the purchase price (owner's policy) or loan amount (lender's policy). Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); FASB ASC 842; SEC

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the title insurance policy became effective, typically the date of closing or recording. Establishes the coverage commencement date for claims purposes.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: policy_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the title insurance policy expires or is no longer in force. Null for perpetual owner's policies. Populated for lender policies tied to loan maturity.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Unique policy number assigned by the title insurance company for the title insurance policy covering this property. Used for claims filing, policy retrieval, and underwriting reference.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the title insurance policy per American Land Title Association (ALTA) standards. Distinguishes between owner's policies protecting the buyer and lender's policies protecting the mortgagee.

attributes.name: priority_position

attributes.name: recording_date

attributes.name: recording_number
attributes.description: Official instrument or document number assigned by the county recorder at the time of deed recordation. Unique identifier within the recorder's jurisdiction for this recorded instrument.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: snda_on_file

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (USPS standard) for the jurisdiction in which the property and title record are located. Used for regulatory compliance and jurisdictional routing.

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent ALTA/NSPS land title survey conducted for the property. Used to assess the currency of boundary and encumbrance information relative to current conditions.

attributes.name: survey_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current ALTA/NSPS land title survey is on file for this property. Surveys are required for commercial transactions and lender underwriting to identify boundary issues, encroachments, and easement locations.

attributes.name: title_company

attributes.name: title_examination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent title examination or title search was completed by the title company or attorney. Indicates the currency of the title status and chain of title review.

attributes.name: title_examiner
attributes.description: Name of the attorney, title officer, or title company representative who conducted the most recent title examination. Used for accountability and follow-up on title defects.

attributes.name: title_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned title or certificate number issued by the county recorder or land registry authority. Serves as the official public record identifier for this title.

attributes.name: title_opinion_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal attorney's title opinion letter is on file for this property. Title opinions are required by certain lenders and in states where attorney title opinions substitute for title insurance.

attributes.name: title_status
attributes.description: Current status of the title indicating whether ownership is unencumbered and marketable. attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this title record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 30; ISO 55000

products.name: inspection
products.description: Physical property and building inspection records capturing scheduled and ad-hoc inspections for due diligence, regulatory compliance, insurance requirements, and condition assessment. Captures inspection type (property condition assessment, fire safety, elevator, HVAC, environmental Phase I/II, ADA compliance, roof, structural, seismic), inspection date, inspector name, inspector company, inspection status (scheduled, in progress, completed, failed), overall condition rating (1-5 scale), deficiency count, critical deficiency flag, estimated remediation cost, report document reference, next scheduled inspection date, and regulatory authority (OSHA, EPA, local fire marshal). Distinct from maintenance work orders — inspections are formal assessments that may trigger work orders but are not repair events themselves.
