attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this certification expires and requires renewal or recertification. Null if the certification does not expire. Drives compliance monitoring workflows.

attributes.name: is_esg_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is included in the enterprise ESG reporting and investor disclosures (GRESB, GRI, SASB). Typically true for ACTIVE certifications on reportable buildings.

attributes.name: recertification_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which recertification process should be initiated to avoid lapse. Typically 90-180 days before expiry_date. Drives proactive compliance workflows.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this certification record. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: well_certification_level
attributes.description: WELL Building Standard certification level awarded by the International WELL Building Institute (IWBI). Increasingly required by institutional tenants and ESG-focused investors. [Moved from building: This attribute in the building table represents a specific WELL certification level, which is one instance of a sustainability certification. It should be modeled as a record in the building_certification association (with sustainability_rating_id pointing to the WELL rating level) rather than a dedicated column. This allows the building to hold multiple WELL certifications over time (e.g., recertification at a higher level) and treats WELL consistently with other certification schemes.]
attributes.references: International WELL Building Institute (IWBI); SEC ESG Disclosure Requirements

products.name: allocation
products.description: This association product represents the contractual allocation of parking spaces to lease agreements. It captures the number of spaces reserved for each tenant under their lease, the applicable monthly rate, and the effective period of the allocation. Each record links one parking facility to one lease agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this parking entitlement.. Existence Justification: In real estate lease administration, a single parking facility serves multiple tenants across different lease agreements, and a single lease agreement can allocate parking spaces from multiple facilities (e.g., surface lot + garage, or multiple buildings in a campus). The business actively manages parking allocations as contractual entitlements, tracking the number of spaces, negotiated rates, effective periods, and reservation status per tenant-per-facility. This is an operational relationship that lease administrators create, modify, and terminate as part of lease execution and amendment processes.

attributes.name: allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for this parking allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to lease.agreement.agreement_id identifying the lease agreement under which parking is allocated

attributes.name: parking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to property.parking.parking_id identifying the parking facility from which spaces are allocated

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this parking allocation (Active, Suspended, Terminated, Pending). Drives billing and access control.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this parking allocation becomes effective. May align with lease commencement or be a later amendment date. Corresponds to effective_date from detection data.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this parking allocation expires or terminates. May align with lease expiration or be earlier if parking is released. Corresponds to expiry_date from detection data.

attributes.name: monthly_rate
attributes.description: Monthly rental rate per space charged to the tenant under this allocation. May differ from facility standard rates due to lease negotiation. Corresponds to monthly_rate from detection data.

attributes.name: reserved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated spaces are reserved (assigned to specific tenant) or unreserved (first-come, first-served from tenant pool). Drives space assignment and access control. Corresponds to reserved_flag from detection data.

attributes.name: spaces_allocated
attributes.description: Number of parking spaces allocated to this lease agreement from this parking facility. Corresponds to parking_spaces_allocated from detection data.

products.name: space_campaign_inclusion
products.description: This association product represents the marketing inclusion relationship between a leasable space and a marketing campaign. It captures the time-bounded participation of a specific space in a campaign, including the asking rent at the time of marketing, the space's status during the campaign period, and its priority within the campaign's portfolio of marketed spaces. Each record links one space to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this marketing relationship.. Existence Justification: In commercial real estate marketing operations, a single leasable space can be simultaneously marketed across multiple campaigns (e.g., broker outreach, digital advertising, open house events, MLS syndication), and each campaign typically promotes multiple available spaces across the portfolio. Marketing teams actively manage which spaces are included in which campaigns, tracking inclusion dates, the asking rent being advertised, marketing status per space-campaign combination, and priority rankings to allocate budget and creative prominence.

attributes.name: space_campaign_inclusion_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this space-campaign inclusion record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign in which this space is being promoted
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: property_space_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Space Campaign Inclusion - Property Space Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific leasable space or common area being marketed in this campaign
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocated_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the campaign's total budget allocated specifically to marketing this space. Used when campaign budgets are distributed across spaces based on size, priority, or market conditions.

attributes.name: asking_rent_psf_at_inclusion
attributes.description: The asking rent per square foot for this space at the time it was included in the campaign. Captured at inclusion time because asking rent may change during long-running campaigns, and marketing performance must be evaluated against the rent being advertised.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this space-campaign inclusion record was created. Used for audit and data lineage.

attributes.name: impression_count
attributes.description: The number of ad impressions or views attributed to this space within this campaign. Relevant for digital campaigns where space-level impression tracking is available via UTM parameters or listing IDs.

attributes.name: inclusion_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this space was removed from the campaign or the campaign concluded for this space. May differ from campaign.actual_end_date if spaces are added/removed mid-campaign.

attributes.name: inclusion_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this space was added to the campaign and began being actively marketed. Used to calculate campaign duration per space and align with lead attribution windows.

attributes.name: lead_count
attributes.description: The number of qualified leads generated for this specific space through this campaign. Aggregated from CRM lead records where campaign_id and space_id match. Used for space-level campaign ROI analysis.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The relative priority or prominence of this space within the campaign's portfolio of marketed spaces. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to allocate budget, determine creative placement order, and prioritize lead routing when multiple spaces match prospect criteria.

attributes.name: space_marketing_status
attributes.description: The marketing status of this space within this specific campaign. Drives whether the space continues to appear in campaign creative and lead routing. Values: active (currently being marketed), paused (temporarily suspended), leased (space leased during campaign), withdrawn (removed from campaign).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this space-campaign inclusion record was last modified. Used for incremental ETL and change tracking.

products.name: deal_asset
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a specific asset within an investment deal pipeline. It captures the underwriting, due diligence, and allocation details that exist only in the context of a specific asset being evaluated or transacted within a specific deal. Each record links one asset to one investment deal with attributes such as allocated underwritten value, due diligence status, allocation percentage, and asset-specific deal roles (e.g., anchor asset, portfolio filler, value-add component).. Existence Justification: In real estate investment operations, a single asset can appear in multiple competing deal scenarios simultaneously (e.g., multiple bidders, different portfolio configurations, disposition vs. hold analysis), and portfolio acquisition deals routinely involve multiple assets under a single transaction structure. Investment teams actively manage the deal-asset relationship by tracking per-asset underwritten values, due diligence findings, allocation percentages, and strategic roles (anchor vs. filler) that exist only in the deal context.

attributes.name: deal_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each deal-asset association record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the real estate asset included in this investment deal
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: investment_deal_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deal Asset - Investment Deal Pipeline Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the investment deal pipeline record
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: acquisition_priority
attributes.description: The investment team's priority or preference for including this asset in the final transaction. In portfolio deals, some assets may be must-haves (anchor assets), while others are optional or even undesirable. This attribute guides negotiation strategy and deal structuring.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total deal value or equity allocation attributed to this specific asset within the deal. Used in portfolio acquisitions where the purchase price or equity is allocated across multiple assets. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3500 = 35%). Sum of allocation_percentage across all assets in a deal should equal 1.0000.

attributes.name: asset_specific_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any conditions, contingencies, or special terms that apply specifically to this asset within the deal. Examples: 'Subject to tenant lease renewal', 'Requires environmental remediation', 'Seller to complete deferred maintenance'. These conditions are deal-context-specific.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deal-asset association record was created in the system. Audit trail for when the asset was added to the deal pipeline.

attributes.name: dd_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which due diligence for this specific asset within this deal was completed or cleared. Null if DD is not yet complete. Used to track deal timeline and readiness for IC submission.

attributes.name: deal_role
attributes.description: The strategic role or classification of this specific asset within the investment deal structure. Indicates whether the asset is the primary anchor (e.g., flagship property in a portfolio acquisition), a portfolio filler, a value-add opportunity, or another strategic designation. This attribute exists only in the context of the deal and varies by deal.

attributes.name: due_diligence_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Due Diligence Status for Asset in Deal
attributes.description: The current status of due diligence activities specific to this asset within this deal. Tracks whether DD is not started, in progress, has identified issues, has been cleared, waived by IC, or has surfaced deal-breaker issues. This status is deal-specific because the same asset may have different DD outcomes in different deal contexts or timeframes.

attributes.name: included_in_ic_memo
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset was explicitly included in the Investment Committee memo for this deal. In some portfolio deals, certain assets may be excluded from IC review or presented separately. True = included in IC memo, False = excluded or presented separately.

attributes.name: underwritten_value_allocated
attributes.description: The portion of the total underwritten deal value allocated to this specific asset. In portfolio deals, the total underwritten_value from investment_deal is broken down per asset. This represents the Asset Manager's valuation of this individual asset within the deal context. Currency matches the deal currency.

attributes.name: updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this deal-asset association record. Audit trail for tracking changes to allocation, DD status, or other deal-asset attributes.

products.name: asset_audit_scope
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of specific real estate assets within formal audit engagement scopes. It captures the operational reality that audit engagements cover multiple properties across the portfolio, and individual assets are subject to multiple audit engagements over time (annual audits, acquisition due diligence, disposition audits, regulatory examinations). Each record links one asset to one audit engagement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit scope inclusion — the reason the asset was selected for review, the risk rating assigned to that asset within this particular engagement, the number of findings specific to that asset, and the date the asset was formally included in scope.. Existence Justification: In real estate audit operations, audit engagements routinely cover multiple properties across the portfolio (portfolio-wide SOX audits, regulatory examinations, internal control reviews), and individual assets are subject to multiple audit engagements over time (annual financial audits, acquisition due diligence audits, disposition audits, ESG audits, regulatory examinations). The business actively manages audit scope as an operational process — compliance teams define which assets are in scope for each engagement, assign asset-specific risk ratings, track asset-specific findings, and allocate auditor resources at the asset level within each engagement.

attributes.name: asset_audit_scope_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for this asset-audit scope inclusion record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the real estate asset included in the audit engagement scope.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset Audit Scope - Audit Engagement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the audit engagement that includes this asset in its scope.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: asset_risk_rating
attributes.description: The risk rating assigned to this specific asset within the context of this particular audit engagement. The same asset may have different risk ratings across different audit engagements depending on audit focus, timing, and asset circumstances. This is relationship-specific data that belongs to the asset-audit association, not to the asset itself (which may have a separate enterprise risk rating) or the audit engagement (which has an overall engagement risk rating).

attributes.name: auditor_assigned
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the specific auditor or audit team member assigned to review this asset within the engagement. While the engagement has a lead_auditor_name, individual assets within the scope may be assigned to different team members. This is relationship-specific assignment data.

attributes.name: fieldwork_hours
attributes.description: Total number of auditor hours spent on fieldwork activities specific to this asset within this engagement. Enables asset-level effort tracking and cost allocation. This is relationship-specific quantitative data that belongs to the association.

attributes.name: findings_count_for_asset
attributes.description: The number of audit findings identified that are specific to this asset within this audit engagement. This is relationship-specific data — the audit engagement has a total_findings_count across all assets, but this attribute captures findings attributable to this particular asset within this particular audit. Essential for asset-level audit performance tracking and risk management.

attributes.name: included_date
attributes.description: The date on which this asset was formally added to the audit engagement scope. Captures the operational event of scope definition. May differ from the audit engagement fieldwork_start_date if scope was defined earlier or if assets were added mid-engagement. This is relationship-specific temporal data that belongs to the association.

attributes.name: scope_inclusion_reason
attributes.description: The business rationale for including this specific asset in this audit engagement scope. Captures why the asset was selected for review — risk-based selection, regulatory requirement, management request, prior findings follow-up, acquisition due diligence, disposition review, material asset threshold, random sampling, geographic coverage, or asset class coverage. This attribute exists only in the context of the asset-audit relationship and cannot belong to either the asset or the audit engagement alone.

attributes.name: scope_status
attributes.description: The current status of audit activities for this specific asset within this engagement. Tracks progression from planned inclusion through fieldwork completion and findings issuance. Allows for asset-level status tracking within an engagement where different assets may be at different stages of review.

attributes.name: crm_prospect_code

attributes.name: dependent_count

attributes.name: fair_housing_protected_class_flag

attributes.name: has_pets

attributes.name: hoa_fee_amount

attributes.name: language_preference

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method

attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CAN-SPAM Act; Yardi Voyager Tenant Management

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Total number of occupants residing in the household, including adults, dependents, and co-signers. Used for HUD fair housing compliance, occupancy standard enforcement, and unit sizing analytics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Management; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to lease.agreement. Business justification: Lease underwriting and ASC 842 risk assessment require tracing the credit profile used to approve a specific lease. Asset managers and credit committees need this link for portfolio risk reporting and

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant whose credit and financial qualification is captured in this profile. Links the credit profile to the authoritative tenant master record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Tenant Master; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: adverse_action_date
attributes.description: Date on which the adverse action notice was sent to the tenant. Required for FCRA compliance tracking and regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD

attributes.name: adverse_action_notice_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action notice was issued to the tenant following a declined or conditioned underwriting decision, as required by the Fair Credit Reporting Act. True = adverse action notice sent. Critical for FCRA compliance.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD; NAR

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant provided written authorization for the credit check. Establishes the legal basis for the credit inquiry under FCRA and GDPR consent requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: authorization_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the signed credit check authorization document stored in DocuSign CLM or the document management system. Supports audit trail and FCRA/GDPR compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: bankruptcy_chapter
attributes.description: Type of bankruptcy filing (e.g., Chapter 7 liquidation, Chapter 11 reorganization, Chapter 13 repayment plan). Relevant for commercial tenants where Chapter 11 reorganization may indicate ongoing business viability.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SEC — REIT reporting; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: bankruptcy_discharge_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant's bankruptcy was discharged, if applicable. Used to assess the elapsed time since discharge and determine eligibility under leasing underwriting policies that impose waiting periods post-bankruptcy.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has a bankruptcy filing on record as reported by the credit bureau. True = bankruptcy history present. Used as a disqualifying or conditional factor in leasing underwriting decisions.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842; NAR

attributes.name: bureau_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party credit bureau that provided the credit report and score used for leasing underwriting. Supports multi-bureau comparison and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: bureau_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned reference number returned by the credit bureau (e.g., Equifax, Experian, TransUnion) for the credit inquiry. Used to trace the report back to the originating bureau pull for audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: collections_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding balance across all accounts in collections as reported by the credit bureau. Provides a quantitative measure of the tenant's delinquent debt exposure for underwriting risk assessment.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); NAR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: collections_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has one or more accounts in collections as reported by the credit bureau. True = active or recent collections present. Used as a risk factor in leasing underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); NAR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit profile record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail start point for the credit qualification lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has provided explicit written authorization for the credit bureau check to be performed. True = authorization obtained. Required for FCRA compliance before initiating any credit inquiry.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7; NAR

attributes.name: credit_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant authorized and the credit bureau check was performed. Establishes the temporal validity window of the credit report for leasing underwriting purposes.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which income, deposit, and financial qualification amounts on this credit profile are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency portfolio operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score returned by the credit bureau at the time of the credit check. Typically ranges from 300 to 850 for consumer (FICO/VantageScore) or equivalent commercial scoring range. Used as the primary quantitative input for leasing underwriting decisions.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_score_model
attributes.description: Scoring model used by the credit bureau to generate the credit score (e.g., FICO 8, VantageScore 3.0). Required for accurate interpretation of the score range and underwriting thresholds.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_tier
attributes.description: Internal credit tier assigned based on the credit score and underwriting criteria. Tier A represents the highest creditworthiness; Tier F represents the lowest. Used to determine lease approval conditions, security deposit multipliers, and guarantor requirements.
attributes.references: NAR; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; MRI Software — Residential Management

attributes.name: dti_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the tenant's total monthly debt obligations to gross monthly income, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3500 = 35%). A key underwriting metric used to assess the tenant's ability to service rent obligations alongside existing debt. Aligns with DTI as defined in common real estate financial qualification standards.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; NAR; CFPB Ability-to-Repay standards

attributes.name: eviction_count
attributes.description: Total number of prior eviction records identified for the tenant during the screening process. Provides granularity beyond the binary eviction flag for risk tiering and underwriting policy application.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD; NAR

attributes.name: guarantor_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a personal or corporate guarantor is required as a condition of lease approval based on the tenant's credit profile assessment. True = guarantor required. Drives lease structuring and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: income_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the tenant's income during the credit qualification process. Supports audit trail and underwriting documentation requirements.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; NAR; FCRA

attributes.name: income_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the income verification process for the tenant. 'verified' indicates income has been confirmed via pay stubs, tax returns, or bank statements; 'unverified' indicates income was self-reported without documentation; 'pending' indicates verification is in progress; 'waived' indicates verification was waived per leasing policy.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; NAR

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the credit profile record. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: monthly_gross_income
attributes.description: Tenant's verified gross monthly income in the operating currency, as submitted and validated during the credit qualification process. Used as the denominator in DTI calculation and the income-to-rent ratio assessment.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: outstanding_judgments_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has outstanding civil judgments (e.g., unpaid court-ordered debts) as identified in the credit or public records check. True = outstanding judgments present. A significant risk factor in leasing underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); NAR; HUD

attributes.name: prior_eviction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has a prior eviction record as identified through the credit check or tenant screening process. True = prior eviction on record. A critical risk indicator in residential and commercial leasing underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD; NAR; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit profile record. 'active' indicates the profile is valid for underwriting; 'expired' indicates the review expiry date has passed; 'pending' indicates the credit check is in progress; 'withdrawn' indicates the tenant withdrew consent; 'under_review' indicates a dispute or re-evaluation is in progress.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: recommended_max_rent

attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act — Timely Decision Requirements; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; FCRA Adverse Action Notice

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the application was declined. Required for FCRA adverse action notices and Fair Housing compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_income|poor_credit|criminal_history|incomplete_docs|rental_history|guarantor_declined|unit_unavailable|policy_violation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) — Adverse Action Notice; HUD Fair Housing Act; GDPR Article 22

attributes.name: dti_ratio
attributes.description: The Debt-to-Income Ratio (DTI) calculated during the screening process, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.35 = 35%). Measures the applicant's total monthly debt obligations relative to gross monthly income. Key underwriting metric for residential applications.
attributes.references: HUD Underwriting Guidelines; CFPB Mortgage Ability-to-Repay Rule; Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The non-refundable application processing fee charged to the applicant at submission. Covers credit screening, background check, and administrative processing costs. Tracked in Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Accounts Receivable; HUD Fair Housing Act — Fee Disclosure Requirements; State Landlord-Tenant Laws

attributes.name: fee_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application processing fee has been received and confirmed. Applications with unpaid fees may be placed on hold pending payment confirmation in Yardi Voyager AR.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Accounts Receivable; HUD Fair Housing Act

attributes.name: financial_docs_checklist
attributes.description: Structured checklist of financial documents submitted by the applicant as part of the qualification package. Tracks submission status of required documents such as bank statements, tax returns, pay stubs, audited financials, and corporate financial statements. Stored as a serialized status string (e.g., 'bank_statements:Y|tax_returns:Y|pay_stubs:N').
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM — Document Control; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: free_rent_months_requested
attributes.description: Number of rent-free months requested by the applicant as a lease incentive concession. Common in commercial leasing during tenant fit-out periods. Impacts EGI (Effective Gross Income) and NOI calculations in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Lease Incentives; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; NAR Commercial Lease Standards

attributes.name: guarantor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a personal or corporate guarantor is required as a condition of application approval, typically triggered when the applicant's credit score or income does not meet minimum standalone qualification thresholds.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; HUD Fair Housing Act; NAR Commercial Lease Standards

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application pertains to a commercial or residential portfolio, driving applicable screening criteria, regulatory requirements, and lease structures.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; MRI Software — Residential Management; HUD Regulations

attributes.name: proposed_base_rent_monthly
attributes.description: The monthly base rent amount proposed by the applicant in the application. Represents the gross base rent before CAM charges, operating expense pass-throughs, or percentage rent adjustments. Used in deal pipeline valuation and NOI (Net Operating Income) forecasting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Lease Payments; IFRS 16 Leases; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: proposed_lease_end_date
attributes.description: The applicant's requested lease expiry date. Drives WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) calculations, portfolio planning, and WALE (Weighted Average Lease Expiry) reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Lease Term; IFRS 16 Leases; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: proposed_lease_start_date
attributes.description: The applicant's requested lease commencement date. Used in scheduling unit availability, coordinating tenant improvement (TI) work, and planning lease execution timelines.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Lease Commencement; IFRS 16 Leases; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: proposed_lease_term_months
attributes.description: The total duration of the proposed lease in months as requested by the applicant. Used for WALT analysis, lease expiry scheduling, and investment portfolio modeling in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Lease Term Definition; IFRS 16 Leases; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: proposed_rent_psf
attributes.description: The proposed annual rent rate expressed on a Per Square Foot (PSF) basis. Standard commercial real estate pricing metric used for market comparables (CMA), CoStar benchmarking, and deal negotiation.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite — Comparable Lease Data; NAR Commercial Standards; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: reference_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the landlord and personal reference verification process. Completed: all required references contacted and verified; Pending: references not yet contacted; Not Required: waived per leasing policy (e.g., corporate tenant with established credit).
attributes.references: NAR Code of Ethics; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; HUD Fair Housing Act

attributes.name: requested_gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requested Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet
attributes.description: The total Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in square feet (SQF) requested by the applicant. For commercial tenants, this drives PSF (Per Square Foot) rent calculations, CAM (Common Area Maintenance) allocations, and space planning.
attributes.references: BOMA International — GLA Measurement Standards; RESO Data Dictionary; NAR Commercial Standards

attributes.name: requested_nla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requested Net Leasable Area (NLA) in Square Feet
attributes.description: The Net Leasable Area (NLA) in square feet requested by the applicant, excluding common areas and structural elements. Used for net rent calculations and space efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: BOMA International — NLA Measurement Standards; RESO Data Dictionary; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The security deposit amount required as a condition of application approval, typically expressed as a multiple of monthly base rent. Tracked in Yardi Voyager for trust accounting and state-mandated security deposit compliance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Accounts Receivable; State Landlord-Tenant Security Deposit Laws; HUD Regulations

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the tenancy application was originated. Online Portal: self-service web application; Broker Referral: submitted via a licensed broker; Direct Inquiry: direct contact with leasing team; MLS (Multiple Listing Service): originated from MLS listing; Walk-in: in-person inquiry; Corporate Relocation: employer-sponsored relocation program.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Brokerage Activity Tracking; CoStar Suite — Market Research; NAR MLS Standards

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the tenancy application was formally submitted by the applicant. Represents the principal business event date for the application lifecycle.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: ti_allowance_requested
attributes.description: The Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance amount requested by the applicant for fit-out or renovation of the premises. A key commercial lease negotiation term tracked in the deal pipeline and CAPEX planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Lease Incentives; Procore — Construction Project Management; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the application record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: yardi_application_ref
attributes.description: The native application record identifier from Yardi Voyager Lease Administration module. Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record for audit and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Data Lineage

products.name: tenant_occupancy
products.description: Active and historical occupancy record linking a tenant to a specific property unit or premises for a defined period. Captures occupancy start date, end date, occupancy type (primary, sublease, holdover, license), actual occupied area (SQF/SQM), certificate of occupancy reference, move-in and move-out inspection dates, key handover date, occupancy status, and vacate reason code. Serves as the SSOT for physical possession across the entire portfolio — both current and historical — distinct from the legal lease agreement owned by the lease domain. Supports tenant lifecycle analytics, re-leasing decisions, reference checks, and portfolio occupancy reporting.
products.reference: Yardi Voyager Unit Occupancy / MRI Occupancy Record

attributes.description: The number of physical access cards or digital access credentials issued to the tenant for the occupied premises. Used for building security management, key control audits, and move-out reconciliation.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The real estate asset class of the occupied property. Determines applicable lease structures, CAM (Common Area Maintenance) obligations, and industry benchmarking comparables. attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this occupancy record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The timestamp from which this version of the occupancy record is considered current and valid in the silver layer. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 history management and point-in-time portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The timestamp until which this version of the occupancy record is considered current and valid. Null indicates the current active version. Supports SCD Type 2 history management and historical portfolio occupancy reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant vacated or is scheduled to vacate the premises. Nullable for active occupancies with no confirmed end date. Used for WALE (Weighted Average Lease Expiry) calculations and re-leasing pipeline planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: The floor or level within the building on which the occupied premises are located. Supports building operations, emergency evacuation planning, and space utilisation analytics. Stored as STRING to accommodate designations such as 'G', 'B1', 'M', 'PH'.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Facility Operations; OSHA; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: holdover_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant transitioned into holdover status, i.e., the day after the original lease or occupancy end date. Populated only when is_holdover is True. Used to calculate holdover duration and associated penalty rent periods.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: is_holdover
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the tenant is currently in holdover status — continuing to occupy the premises after the lease expiry date without a new or renewed lease agreement. Triggers holdover rent calculations and legal notification workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: is_sublease
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this occupancy record represents a sublease arrangement where the occupying tenant is not the primary leaseholder. Supports sublease tracking, consent management, and NNN (Triple Net Lease) obligation pass-through analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: key_handover_date
attributes.description: The date on which physical keys, access cards, or digital access credentials were formally handed over to the tenant at commencement, or returned by the tenant at vacation. Critical for establishing the precise moment of physical possession transfer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; Building Engines

attributes.name: move_in_condition_rating
attributes.description: Standardised rating of the premises condition at the time of tenant move-in, as recorded during the move-in inspection. Establishes the baseline for dilapidations assessment at move-out and supports deposit reconciliation.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: move_in_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pre-occupancy condition inspection of the premises was conducted. Establishes the baseline condition of the unit at the time of handover to the tenant, supporting deposit reconciliation and maintenance liability determination.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: move_out_condition_rating
attributes.description: Standardised rating of the premises condition at the time of tenant move-out, as recorded during the move-out inspection. Compared against move_in_condition_rating to determine dilapidations liability and deposit deduction amounts.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: move_out_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the post-occupancy condition inspection of the premises was conducted upon tenant vacation. Used to assess dilapidations, damage beyond fair wear and tear, and to support deposit deduction decisions.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or contextual information related to this occupancy record that is not captured by structured fields. Used by property managers for reference checks, tenant lifecycle documentation, and re-leasing intelligence.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; Building Engines

attributes.name: num_occupants
attributes.description: The total number of individuals or employees physically occupying the premises. Used for density analysis, building services planning, HVAC (Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning) load calculations, and ESG (Environmental Social and Governance) reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA — Building Safety; LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design); Building Engines

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the occupancy record. 'active' indicates the tenant is in physical possession; 'vacated' indicates the tenant has surrendered possession; 'pending_handover' indicates keys have not yet been formally exchanged; 'holdover' indicates possession continues beyond the agreed end date; 'terminated' indicates the occupancy was ended early; 'scheduled' indicates a future occupancy not yet commenced.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Occupancy Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: occupancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of physical possession. 'primary' indicates the main lease-backed occupancy; 'sublease' indicates a sub-tenant arrangement; 'holdover' indicates continued possession after lease expiry without a new agreement; 'license' indicates a short-term or non-exclusive right to occupy; 'co_occupancy' indicates shared possession; 'temporary' indicates a short-term or interim arrangement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: occupied_area_sqf
attributes.description: The actual net leasable area (NLA) physically occupied by the tenant, measured in square feet (SQF). May differ from the leased area if partial occupation, expansion, or contraction has occurred. Used for PSF (Per Square Foot) analytics and portfolio occupancy rate calculations.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); BOMA International — Floor Measurement Standards

attributes.name: occupied_area_sqm
attributes.description: The actual net leasable area (NLA) physically occupied by the tenant, measured in square metres (SQM). Supports international portfolio reporting and compliance with IFRS 16 disclosures for non-US properties.
attributes.references: IFRS 16; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); ISO 55000

attributes.name: parking_bays_allocated
attributes.description: The number of parking bays or spaces allocated to the tenant as part of the occupancy arrangement. Supports facility operations planning, parking revenue tracking, and tenant service management.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; Building Engines

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this occupancy record relates to a commercial or residential property. Drives applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., ASC 842 vs residential tenancy law), reporting structures, and tenant lifecycle management processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR); HUD

attributes.name: premises_identifier
attributes.description: The human-readable identifier of the specific suite, unit, or premises being occupied (e.g., 'Suite 1201', 'Unit 4B', 'Bay 3'). Complements the unit_id system reference with the operational label used in correspondence and building directories.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Unit/Space Master; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ref_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this occupancy record, used in correspondence, inspection reports, and operational systems such as Yardi Voyager and Building Engines. Distinct from the system-generated primary key.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Occupancy Administration; Building Engines

attributes.name: scheduled_vacate_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed or operationally planned date by which the tenant is expected to vacate the premises. May differ from the actual end_date if the tenant vacates early or holds over. Used for re-leasing planning and portfolio vacancy forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this occupancy record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this occupancy record in the originating operational system (e.g., Yardi Voyager occupancy ID, MRI occupancy code). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; Yardi Voyager; MRI Software

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant took physical possession of the premises. This is the actual commencement of occupancy, which may differ from the lease commencement date due to fit-out periods, early access, or delayed handover.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: ti_completed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether all agreed Tenant Improvement (TI) works were completed prior to or during the occupancy commencement. Supports CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) tracking, lease incentive accounting under ASC 842/IFRS 16, and handover readiness confirmation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Procore — Construction Management

attributes.name: ti_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which all Tenant Improvement (TI) works were formally completed and signed off. Used to reconcile TI allowance disbursements, confirm lease commencement triggers, and support CAPEX project close-out in Procore.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Procore — Construction Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this occupancy record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: vacate_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code indicating the reason the tenant vacated the premises. Supports tenant lifecycle analytics, re-leasing strategy, and churn analysis. attributes.name: vacate_reason_notes

products.description: Guarantor record for tenants requiring a co-signer or financial guarantor on a lease — common in residential tenancies for students/first-time renters and for corporate tenants with insufficient credit history or foreign entities. attributes.name: adverse_action_notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the adverse action notice was issued to the applicant. Must be documented for FCRA compliance. Null if adverse_action_required is false or notice has not yet been sent.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 615; Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

attributes.name: adverse_action_reason_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of standardized reason codes provided on the adverse action notice explaining the basis for denial or conditional approval (e.g., insufficient income, derogatory credit history, prior eviction). Required by FCRA Section 615 for consumer-report-based decisions.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 615; Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

attributes.name: adverse_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action notice is required to be issued to the applicant based on the screening result. Triggered when a consumer report (credit, criminal, eviction) contributed to a denial or conditional approval decision, as mandated by FCRA Section 615.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 615; Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

attributes.name: applicant_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether written authorization was obtained from the applicant prior to initiating the background screening, as required by FCRA Section 604(b). A prerequisite for any consumer report pull.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 604(b); GDPR Article 6; California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)

attributes.name: applicant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subject being screened. Distinguishes between individual residential applicants, corporate entities, guarantors, and co-applicants, each of which may require different check types and criteria.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which all screening checks were completed and the final composite result was returned by the vendor. Used to measure vendor turnaround time and determine report validity window.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant provided written authorization for the background screening. Required for FCRA compliance documentation and GDPR lawful basis records.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 604(b); GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the screening record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail start point and supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: credit_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the credit bureau check component of the screening. Reflects whether the applicant's credit profile meets the property's minimum credit qualification criteria. Note: detailed credit data is stored in tenant.credit_profile.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FCRA Section 604; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: credit_score_at_screening
attributes.description: Credit score returned by the screening vendor at the time of this specific screening event. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for audit and adverse action documentation purposes, independent of the ongoing credit profile record.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FCRA Section 609; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: criminal_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the criminal background check component of the screening. A review_required result indicates records were found that require individualized assessment per HUD guidance before an adverse action decision is made.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Criminal History Guidance (2016); Fair Housing Act

attributes.name: criminal_check_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the criminal background check performed. Indicates whether the search covered county, state, national, or international criminal records databases, which affects the comprehensiveness of the result.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: criteria_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the standardized screening criteria policy applied to this screening event. Ensures consistent, documented criteria enforcement across all applications and supports fair housing audit trails.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the screening fee amount (e.g., USD, CAD). Supports multi-currency portfolio operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: employment_verification_result
attributes.description: Result of the employment verification check confirming the applicant's current employer, employment status, and income. Supports income-to-rent ratio qualification and FCRA-compliant underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: eviction_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the eviction history database search. Captures whether prior eviction filings or judgments were found. A fail or review_required result is a key risk indicator in the underwriting decision.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: fair_housing_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this screening result was flagged for individualized fair housing review, typically triggered when criminal history or other protected-class-adjacent findings require case-by-case assessment per HUD guidance before an adverse action decision.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; HUD Criminal History Guidance (2016); Fair Housing Amendments Act

attributes.name: fcra_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all FCRA procedural requirements were met for this screening event, including permissible purpose documentation, applicant disclosure, authorization, and adverse action notice (if applicable). Critical for regulatory audit and litigation defense.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Federal Trade Commission (FTC); Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount charged to the applicant or property for the screening services. Tracked for accounts receivable reconciliation and to ensure compliance with state-level limits on application/screening fees.
attributes.references: State Tenant Protection Laws; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: identity_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the applicant's identity during the screening process. Captures whether SSN, ITIN, government-issued ID, or passport was used, supporting FCRA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: identity_verification_result
attributes.description: Result of the identity verification check, including SSN/ITIN validation and government-issued ID confirmation. A fail or unable-to-verify result typically blocks lease approval and may trigger adverse action.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); USA PATRIOT Act; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: income_to_rent_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the applicant's verified gross monthly income to the proposed monthly rent, calculated at the time of screening. Typically a minimum of 2.5x–3x is required. Used as a primary qualification criterion.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines; Company Underwriting Policy

attributes.name: individualized_assessment_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether an individualized assessment was performed for this applicant prior to an adverse action based on criminal history, as required by HUD guidance to avoid disparate impact under the Fair Housing Act.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; HUD Criminal History Guidance (2016); Fair Housing Amendments Act

attributes.name: landlord_reference_count
attributes.description: Number of prior landlord references contacted and verified during the screening process. Supports audit documentation of reference check thoroughness.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Company Screening Policy

attributes.name: landlord_reference_result
attributes.description: Result of the prior landlord reference check, verifying rental payment history, lease compliance, and tenancy conduct with previous landlords. A key qualitative input to the overall screening determination.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the reviewer to document observations, exceptions, individualized assessment findings, or other context relevant to the screening determination. Supports audit trail and fair housing compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines

attributes.name: overall_result
attributes.description: Composite pass/fail determination across all screening check types performed. A conditional pass may indicate approval subject to additional conditions such as a co-signer or increased security deposit. Drives the underwriting decision in the application workflow.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the screening was conducted for a residential (B2C) or commercial (B2B) tenancy application. Determines applicable screening criteria, fair housing rules, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this screening order, typically issued by the screening vendor (e.g., RentPrep, TransUnion SmartMove) upon order submission. Used for vendor reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: report_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the screening report is considered stale and a new screening must be ordered before a lease can be executed. Typically 30–90 days from completion date per company policy and FCRA guidelines.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Company Screening Policy

attributes.name: report_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or storage reference to the full screening report document returned by the vendor. Access is restricted to authorized personnel. Supports document retrieval for adverse action, audit, and underwriting review.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 5; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the screening order was submitted to the vendor. Establishes the start of the screening timeline and is used to calculate turnaround time and report expiry.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorized reviewer completed their assessment of the screening results and recorded the qualification determination. Part of the audit trail for the application decision.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: screening_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the screening order. Tracks progression from initial request through vendor processing to final determination. Drives workflow routing in the application qualification process.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: sex_offender_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the national sex offender registry (NSOPW) check. A fail result requires individualized assessment and documented adverse action notice per FCRA and HUD fair housing guidance before denial.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Sex Offender Public Website (NSOPW); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the screening record. Tracks changes to screening status, results, or compliance flags throughout the screening lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vendor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party background screening service provider used to conduct the checks (e.g., RentPrep, TransUnion SmartMove, Experian RentBureau, CoreLogic SafeRent). Required for FCRA adverse action notices and vendor audit trails.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 607; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: vendor_order_code
attributes.description: Unique order or transaction identifier assigned by the screening vendor system for this specific screening request. Used for vendor portal reconciliation, dispute resolution, and FCRA reinvestigation requests.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 611

attributes.name: prior_screening_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on screening (prior_screening_id)

domains.name: lease
domains.description: Governs the full lifecycle of lease agreements — LOIs, executed leases, amendments, renewals, and terminations. Owns lease terms (NNN, gross, modified gross), TI allowances, CAM schedules, rent escalation clauses, WALT/WALE metrics, SNDA agreements, and renewal options. Authoritative source for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lease accounting data including lease classification, measurement, and disclosure.
domains.references: FASB ASC 842, IFRS 16, RESO Data Dictionary

products.name: lease_agreement
products.description: Master record for every executed lease agreement across commercial and residential portfolios. Captures lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross, full-service, ground), commencement and expiration dates, base rent, rent escalation structure, security deposit terms, TI allowance, CAM obligations, permitted use, holdover provisions, and key lease abstract data (critical dates, exclusivity, co-tenancy, assignment/subletting rights, insurance requirements). Stores WALT/WALE metrics, ASC 842/IFRS 16 classification (operating vs. finance), right-of-use asset value, lease liability, and discount rate. Authoritative SSOT for all lease terms. Sourced from Yardi Voyager Lease Administration and MRI Lease Management modules. Links to property, tenant, and owner domains via FK.

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id

attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: asset_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Every executed lease agreement is owned by a leasing agent or asset manager — this drives commission calculations, portfolio responsibility reporting, and performance reviews. Real estate operators un

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Each lease agreement is executed by a specific landlord legal entity. Required for ASC 842/IFRS 16 entity-level ROU asset and lease liability reporting, REIT compliance, and entity-level financial sta
