attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant party who is the lessee under this agreement. Links to the tenant domain master record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Lease Management

attributes.name: assignment_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant is contractually permitted to assign the lease to a third party, subject to landlord consent conditions. Relevant for M&A transactions and corporate restructurings.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: base_rent_monthly
attributes.description: The contractual monthly base rent amount payable by the tenant, expressed in the agreement currency. Excludes CAM charges, taxes, and insurance. Core input for NOI and EGI calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: base_rent_psf_annual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Base Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Annual base rent expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis. Industry-standard metric used for market comparisons, CMA analysis, and CoStar benchmarking.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: cam_annual_budget
attributes.description: The annual budgeted Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charge allocated to this lease. Used for NNN and modified gross leases to estimate tenant's pro-rata share of operating expenses.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: cam_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The annual date on which CAM charges are reconciled against actual operating expenses and adjustments are billed or credited to the tenant.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: co_tenancy_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a co-tenancy clause allowing the tenant to reduce rent or terminate the lease if anchor tenants or a minimum occupancy threshold at the property is not maintained.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lease term begins and the tenant's right to use the premises commences. Used as the ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lease commencement date for right-of-use asset and lease liability measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the lease agreement record was first created in the source system (Yardi Voyager or MRI). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate used to discount future lease payments to present value for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 measurement. Typically the implicit rate in the lease or the lessee's incremental borrowing rate (IBR), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 = 4.5%).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains an exclusivity clause restricting the landlord from leasing space to competing tenants within the same property. Common in retail leases.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all parties signed and the lease agreement became legally binding. Sourced from DocuSign CLM execution records.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The contractual date on which the lease term ends. Used for WALT/WALE calculations, renewal option tracking, and ASC 842 lease term determination. Null for month-to-month leases.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: free_rent_months
attributes.description: The number of months of rent abatement (free rent) granted to the tenant at lease commencement or during the lease term. Recognized as a lease incentive under ASC 842 and amortized over the lease term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: holdover_rent_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base rent if the tenant remains in occupancy beyond the lease expiration date without executing a renewal (holdover tenancy). Typically 1.25 to 1.50 (125%–150% of base rent).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: insurance_required_amount
attributes.description: The minimum general liability insurance coverage amount the tenant is contractually required to maintain and name the landlord as an additional insured, as specified in the lease abstract.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; OSHA; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the lease agreement record was most recently updated in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change data capture in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: lease_classification
attributes.description: ASC 842 / IFRS 16 accounting classification of the lease as either an operating lease or a finance lease (capital lease). Determines balance sheet treatment, amortization method, and income statement presentation for the lessee.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC

attributes.name: lease_liability
attributes.description: The present value of future lease payments recognized as a liability on the balance sheet at lease commencement under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Decreases as lease payments are made over the lease term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC

attributes.name: lease_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the lease agreement, as recorded in Yardi Voyager or MRI. Used for cross-system reference and tenant-facing communications.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Lease Management

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease agreement. Drives ASC 842 / IFRS 16 recognition, billing activation, and portfolio reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|executed|active|expired|terminated|holdover — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: The total contractual lease term expressed in months from commencement to expiration. Used for WALT/WALE calculations, Argus Enterprise cash flow modeling, and portfolio duration analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: leased_area_sqft
attributes.description: The net leasable area (NLA) in square feet covered by this lease agreement. Used for PSF rent calculations, CAM pro-rata share computation, and GLA occupancy reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); BOMA International

attributes.name: loi_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Letter of Intent (LOI) was signed by the prospective tenant, marking the formal start of lease negotiation. Sourced from Salesforce CRM deal pipeline records.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: permitted_use
attributes.description: The contractually defined purpose for which the tenant is permitted to use the leased premises (e.g., 'retail clothing store', 'general office use', 'restaurant and bar'). Restricts tenant operations and is a key lease abstract field.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement belongs to the commercial or residential portfolio, driving applicable regulatory frameworks (ASC 842 vs. residential tenancy law) and reporting hierarchies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; HUD

attributes.name: pro_rata_share
attributes.description: The tenant's proportionate share of the building's total rentable area, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Used to allocate CAM, tax, and insurance charges in NNN and modified gross leases.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; BOMA International

attributes.name: renewal_option_count
attributes.description: The number of renewal options available to the tenant under the lease agreement. Each option typically specifies a term length and rent determination method.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: renewal_option_exercised
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has formally exercised a renewal option under this lease agreement. True when the renewal notice has been received and acknowledged by the landlord.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: renewal_option_term_months
attributes.description: The duration in months of each renewal option period available to the tenant. Used in ASC 842 lease term assessment to determine if renewal options are reasonably certain to be exercised.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: rent_commencement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant's obligation to pay base rent begins. May differ from the lease commencement date due to free-rent periods or tenant improvement construction periods.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: rent_escalation_rate
attributes.description: The percentage or fixed amount by which base rent escalates per the rent_escalation_type. Expressed as a decimal for percentage types (e.g., 0.0300 = 3%). Null when escalation type is none or CPI-linked.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: rent_escalation_type
attributes.description: Method by which base rent increases over the lease term. Fixed percent applies a set annual percentage increase. CPI ties escalation to the Consumer Price Index. Fixed amount adds a set dollar increment. None indicates flat rent for the full term.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: rou_asset_value
attributes.description: The initial measurement of the right-of-use (ROU) asset recognized on the balance sheet at lease commencement under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Equals the present value of future lease payments plus initial direct costs and prepaid rent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The total security deposit held by the landlord as collateral against tenant default or damage. Tracked for AR reconciliation and return obligations upon lease expiration.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: snda_executed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Agreement Executed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination, Non-Disturbance, and Attornment (SNDA) agreement has been executed between the tenant, landlord, and lender. Required by most commercial mortgage lenders to protect tenant occupancy rights in foreclosure.
attributes.references: ALTA; DocuSign CLM; CMBS standards

attributes.name: subletting_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant is contractually permitted to sublet all or part of the leased premises to a subtenant, subject to landlord consent conditions specified in the lease.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: termination_option_date
attributes.description: The contractual date on or before which the tenant may exercise an early termination option, if such a right exists in the lease. Null if no early termination option is granted.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: termination_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The contractual fee or penalty payable by the tenant upon exercising an early termination option. Factored into ASC 842 lease term assessment and lease liability measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: ti_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The total Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance granted by the landlord to fund tenant fit-out or renovation of the leased premises. Capitalized under FASB ASC 842 lease incentive accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; Procore

products.name: loi
products.description: Letter of Intent record capturing pre-lease negotiation terms between landlord and prospective tenant. Stores proposed rent PSF, proposed lease term, TI allowance offer, free-rent period, exclusivity window, expiration date, deal status (draft, submitted, accepted, rejected, expired), and the responsible leasing agent. Sourced from Salesforce CRM deal pipeline and DocuSign CLM. Precedes the executed lease agreement in the lease lifecycle.

attributes.name: cpi_floor_percent
attributes.description: Minimum percentage increase in rent guaranteed under a CPI-linked reset mechanism for the renewal term. Protects the landlord from rent reduction in deflationary environments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this renewal option record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: exercise_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the tenant formally exercised the renewal option by delivering written notice to the landlord. Null if the option has not yet been exercised.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the renewal option indicating whether the tenant has exercised, waived, allowed to expire, or has yet to act on the option. Drives WALT/WALE forecasting and lease expiry pipeline management.

attributes.name: fixed_renewal_rent_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fixed Renewal Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Pre-agreed base rent rate per square foot (PSF) applicable during the renewal term when the rent reset mechanism is 'fixed'. Null for non-fixed reset mechanisms.

attributes.name: fmv_appraisal_required

attributes.name: fmv_determination_method
attributes.description: Contractual process for determining Fair Market Value (FMV) rent during the renewal term — single appraiser, dual appraiser (each party appoints one), arbitration, or mutual agreement. Applicable only when rent_reset_mechanism is 'fair_market_value'.

attributes.name: free_rent_months

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional contractual nuances, special conditions, or qualifications related to this renewal option that are not captured in structured fields. Sourced from Yardi Voyager lease abstract comments.

attributes.name: notice_deadline_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the tenant must provide written notice of intent to exercise or waive the renewal option. Failure to meet this date typically results in automatic expiry of the option.

attributes.name: notice_period_days

attributes.name: option_end_date
attributes.description: Contractual expiration date of the renewal term if the option is exercised. Represents the last day of the renewed lease period. Critical for WALE (Weighted Average Lease Expiry) pipeline reporting.

attributes.name: option_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal number identifying this renewal option within the lease (e.g., 1st option, 2nd option). Used when a lease contains multiple successive renewal options.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; RESO

attributes.name: option_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code or identifier assigned to this renewal option in the source system (Yardi Voyager lease abstract). Used for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: option_start_date
attributes.description: Contractual commencement date of the renewal term if the option is exercised. Represents the first day of the renewed lease period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: option_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the renewal period expressed in whole months. Provides month-level precision for lease term calculations and ASC 842 / IFRS 16 measurement where fractional years are insufficient.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: option_term_years
attributes.description: Duration of the renewal period in years as stipulated in the lease agreement. Used in WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) and WALE (Weighted Average Lease Expiry) calculations.

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual option embedded in the lease — renewal (new term), extension (continuation), holdover (month-to-month), or purchase option. Determines accounting treatment under ASC 842 / IFRS 16.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: personal_guarantee_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a personal guarantee from the tenant principal is required as a condition of exercising the renewal option. Relevant for credit risk assessment and lease underwriting.

attributes.name: renewal_rent_escalation_rate
attributes.description: Annual rent escalation rate (as a percentage) applicable within the renewal term when escalation type is 'fixed_percent'. Used in Argus Enterprise DCF cash flow modeling for the renewal period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: renewal_rent_escalation_type
attributes.description: Type of annual rent escalation clause applicable within the renewal term — fixed percentage, CPI-linked, fixed dollar amount per year, or no escalation. Distinct from the initial rent reset mechanism.

attributes.name: rent_reset_mechanism
attributes.description: Method by which the base rent is determined for the renewal term. Options include fixed (predetermined amount), CPI (Consumer Price Index-linked), fair market value (FMV appraisal), negotiated, or stepped escalation. Drives Argus Enterprise cash flow modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: snda_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) agreement is required from the lender as a condition of the tenant exercising this renewal option.
attributes.references: NAR; RESO; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: ti_allowance_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Improvement (TI) Allowance Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Landlord-funded Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance per square foot (PSF) granted to the tenant upon exercise of the renewal option. Represents capital commitment by the landlord for the renewal term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; RESO

attributes.name: ti_allowance_total
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance committed by the landlord for the renewal term. Calculated as TI PSF multiplied by the leased area, or specified as a lump sum in the lease abstract.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this renewal option record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the abstracted renewal option terms were independently verified against the executed lease document by a second reviewer. Supports dual-control lease abstract quality standards.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; SOX

attributes.description: The last date on which this rent step period is in effect. The next step's effective_start_date should immediately follow. Null for open-ended final steps.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rent step period begins and the corresponding base rent amount becomes billable to the tenant. Aligns with the lease commencement or escalation trigger date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: escalation_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar increment added to the prior step's base rent to arrive at this step's base rent. Used when escalation_type is 'fixed_step' with a dollar-denominated increase rather than a percentage. Null for percentage or CPI escalations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: escalation_rate
attributes.description: The escalation rate applied to derive this step's rent from the prior step. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0300 = 3.00%). Applicable when escalation_type is 'fixed_step' (percentage) or 'cpi'. Null for fixed-dollar steps or percentage-of-sales.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: escalation_type
attributes.description: The mechanism by which rent increases from one step to the next. 'fixed_step' = predetermined dollar or percentage increase; 'cpi' = Consumer Price Index-linked; 'percentage_of_sales' = percentage rent tied to tenant gross sales; 'market_review' = reset to fair market value; 'none' = flat rent with no escalation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: free_rent_months
attributes.description: The number of months of rent abatement granted to the tenant within this step period. Used to quantify the total concession value for ASC 842 straight-line rent amortization and Argus Enterprise cash flow modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days after the payment due date before a late fee is assessed. Defined in the lease agreement and used by Yardi Voyager to trigger arrears events and late charge calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_free_rent_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rent step period is a free-rent (rent abatement) period during which no base rent is payable by the tenant. True = free-rent period; False = normal rent-paying period. Critical for ASC 842 straight-line rent calculation over the full lease term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: late_fee_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the overdue rent balance to calculate the late payment fee after the grace period expires. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00%). Null if a flat late fee amount applies instead.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; State Landlord-Tenant Law

attributes.name: lease_classification
attributes.description: The accounting classification of the lease under ASC 842 (lessee perspective) or IFRS 16. 'operating' = operating lease with straight-line expense recognition; 'finance' = finance/capital lease with front-loaded expense recognition. Drives balance sheet treatment and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20; IFRS 16.62; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: lease_liability_amount
attributes.description: The present value of remaining lease payments attributable to this rent step period under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Represents the lessee's financial obligation for this step. Required for balance sheet disclosure and debt covenant compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-30; IFRS 16.26; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: leased_area_sqft
attributes.description: The net leasable area (NLA) in square feet covered by this rent schedule step. Used to derive rent_psf and to validate rent amounts against market benchmarks in CoStar Suite.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; BOMA International; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for lease administrators to record contextual notes about this rent step, such as negotiated concession rationale, amendment history, or special billing instructions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: payment_due_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rent Payment Due Day of Month
attributes.description: The day of the month on which rent payment is due (e.g., 1 = first of the month). Used to generate AR billing schedules in Yardi Voyager and to calculate late payment penalties.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which base rent payments are due from the tenant under this rent step. Drives accounts receivable billing cycle in Yardi Voyager and cash flow timing in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: percentage_rent_breakpoint
attributes.description: The gross sales threshold above which percentage rent becomes payable by the tenant. Applicable when escalation_type is 'percentage_of_sales'. Typically calculated as base_rent_amount divided by the percentage rent rate. Null for non-percentage-of-sales leases.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; ICSC; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: percentage_rent_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of tenant gross sales above the breakpoint that is payable as additional rent. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0600 = 6.00%). Common in retail leases. Null for non-percentage-of-sales leases.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; ICSC; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: rent_psf
attributes.description: Base rent expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) annual basis for this rent step period. Calculated as annual_rent_amount divided by the leased area in square feet. Standard CRE benchmarking metric used in CoStar comparable analysis.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Suite; NAR

attributes.name: rou_asset_amount
attributes.description: The right-of-use (ROU) asset value attributable to this rent step period under ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lessee accounting. Represents the present value of lease payments allocated to this step. Required for balance sheet disclosure and fixed asset register in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-30; IFRS 16.22; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this rent schedule row, as assigned in the source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager or MRI Software). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit tracing.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this rent schedule row. 'active' indicates the current billing period; 'future' indicates an upcoming step; 'expired' indicates a past step; 'superseded' indicates replaced by an amendment; 'cancelled' indicates voided.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this rent schedule row was sourced. 'yardi' = Yardi Voyager; 'mri' = MRI Software; 'argus' = Argus Enterprise; 'manual' = manually entered in the data platform.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; MRI Software; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier for this rent schedule row in the originating source system (e.g., Yardi charge code + period key). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental load deduplication in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; MRI Software; Databricks Lakehouse

attributes.name: step_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential integer ordering this rent step within the lease agreement's full escalation schedule. Step 1 is the initial rent period; subsequent steps represent each escalation event.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: straight_line_rent_adjustment
attributes.description: The difference between the straight-line rent amount and the cash base rent amount for this step period. A positive value indicates deferred rent (cash < straight-line); a negative value indicates prepaid rent. Required for ASC 842 deferred rent liability/asset tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: straight_line_rent_amount
attributes.description: The ASC 842 / IFRS 16 straight-line rent amount for this step period, representing the equal monthly recognition amount calculated by spreading total lease payments evenly over the lease term. Used for GAAP/IFRS income statement recognition, distinct from cash rent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.36; Yardi Voyager General Ledger

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rent schedule record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for incremental processing, change data capture, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

products.name: cam_schedule
products.description: Annual CAM (Common Area Maintenance) reconciliation record comparing estimated CAM charges billed to tenants against actual operating expenses incurred. Captures reconciliation year, estimated CAM per lease, actual CAM allocated, gross-up factor, tenant pro-rata share, reconciliation variance, credit or additional charge due, and reconciliation status. Sourced from Yardi Voyager CAM module. Critical for NNN and modified gross lease portfolios.

attributes.name: cam_schedule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cam_schedule

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which the leased premises are located. Used to aggregate CAM reconciliations at the building or campus level.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Management Module; RESO

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.building. Business justification: CAM reconciliation is performed at the building level — building operating expenses are pooled and allocated to tenants. For multi-building assets, building-level CAM pools and reconciliation reports

attributes.name: currency_code_id

attributes.name: financial_period_close_id

Linking cam_schedule to financial_period_close enables period-close checklist tracking of CAM reconciliation status — a

attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration Module

attributes.name: premium_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.premium. Business justification: Commercial real estate CAM reconciliations include insurance premiums as a recoverable operating expense billed to tenants. Linking cam_schedule to the specific insurance premium enables precise CAM a

attributes.name: reference_lease_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.lease_type. Business justification: CAM reconciliation applicability and methodology (gross-up, exclusions, admin fee) are determined by lease type. NNN leases have full CAM pass-through while gross leases do not. Lease type reference i

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant entity responsible for paying CAM charges under the lease. Supports tenant-level CAM exposure reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable Module; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: valuation_tax_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.tax_assessment. Business justification: CAM Tax Reconciliation process: NNN/modified gross lease CAM reconciliations include actual property tax as a recoverable expense. Property accountants must reference the specific tax_assessment for t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_cam_gross
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Gross Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Operating Expense
attributes.description: Total actual gross operating expenses incurred at the property level for the reconciliation period, before application of the gross-up factor or tenant pro-rata share. Sourced from the property general ledger via Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager General Ledger; RESO

attributes.name: actual_cam_grossed_up
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Grossed-Up Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Expense
attributes.description: Actual CAM operating expenses after application of the gross-up factor. Represents the normalized total expense pool used as the basis for tenant pro-rata share allocation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO

attributes.name: actual_cam_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Actual CAM charge allocated to the tenant expressed on a per-square-foot basis (PSF). Calculated as tenant_cam_allocated divided by tenant_nla_sqft. Key metric for portfolio benchmarking and market comparisons.
attributes.references: RESO; CoStar Suite; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: admin_fee_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Administration Fee Amount
attributes.description: Calculated dollar amount of the landlord's administrative fee included in the tenant's CAM allocation for the reconciliation period. Derived from admin_fee_rate applied to the eligible CAM expense pool.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: admin_fee_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Administration Fee Rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate charged by the landlord as an administrative or management fee on top of actual CAM expenses, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%). Permitted under many NNN leases. Null if no admin fee applies.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: audit_right_exercised
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant CAM Audit Right Exercised Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has exercised their contractual right to audit the landlord's CAM expense records for the reconciliation period. True if an audit has been formally requested or conducted.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: building_gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Building Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Total Gross Leasable Area of the building in square feet used as the denominator for pro-rata share calculation. May differ from total building area if certain areas are excluded per lease terms.
attributes.references: RESO; BOMA International; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: cam_cap_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Cap Applied Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CAM increase cap was triggered and applied during this reconciliation period. True if the calculated CAM increase exceeded the cap and was limited accordingly.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_cap_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Annual Increase Cap Rate
attributes.description: Maximum annual percentage increase in CAM charges permitted under the lease, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5% cap). Limits the tenant's CAM exposure year-over-year. Null if no cap applies.
attributes.references: RESO; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_cap_savings
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Cap Savings Amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount by which the tenant's CAM charge was reduced due to the application of the CAM cap. Represents the difference between the uncapped allocated amount and the capped amount billed. Zero if cap was not applied.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_cap_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the CAM increase cap is cumulative (unused cap carries forward to future years) or non-cumulative (cap resets each year). Determines how the cap is applied in multi-year reconciliations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; RESO; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_exclusions_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of operating expense line items excluded from the CAM pool per lease terms (e.g., capital expenditures, management fees above a threshold, leasing commissions). Reduces the gross CAM expense pool before tenant allocation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; RESO

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CAM reconciliation record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX and FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: credit_or_charge_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAM Credit or Additional Charge Amount
attributes.description: Net monetary amount due to or from the tenant as a result of the CAM reconciliation. A positive value represents an additional charge invoiced to the tenant; a negative value represents a credit applied to the tenant's account. Drives the AR billing or credit memo in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; SOX

attributes.name: credit_or_charge_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reconciliation outcome results in an additional charge to the tenant, a credit to the tenant, or a zero-balance settlement. Drives downstream AR and billing workflow routing in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has formally disputed the CAM reconciliation statement. True if a dispute has been raised; False if no dispute exists. Triggers dispute management workflow.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the tenant's stated reason for disputing the CAM reconciliation, as recorded by the property manager. Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: dispute_resolved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAM reconciliation dispute was formally resolved between landlord and tenant. Null if no dispute exists or dispute is still open.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimated_cam_annual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Annual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: Total estimated CAM charges billed to the tenant over the reconciliation year, based on the budgeted CAM rate established at lease commencement or annual budget cycle. Represents the sum of monthly estimated CAM payments collected from the tenant.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO

attributes.name: estimated_cam_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Estimated annual CAM charge expressed on a per-square-foot basis (PSF). Calculated as estimated_cam_annual divided by tenant_nla_sqft. Used for benchmarking and lease comparison analytics.
attributes.references: RESO; CoStar Suite; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: grossup_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to actual CAM expenses to normalize costs to a fully occupied building (typically to 90–100% occupancy). Ensures tenants pay their fair share of variable operating costs regardless of actual vacancy. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.05 for a 5% gross-up).
attributes.references: RESO; NAR; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for property manager or asset manager annotations regarding the CAM reconciliation, including explanations of unusual variances, exclusion justifications, or tenant communication summaries.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the additional CAM charge (if any) must be paid by the tenant, or by which the landlord must issue a credit. Drives AR billing and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant's additional CAM payment was received and applied in Yardi Voyager. Null if no additional charge was due or payment has not yet been received.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: prior_year_estimated_cam
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year Estimated Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: Total estimated CAM charges billed to the tenant in the immediately preceding reconciliation year. Used for year-over-year variance analysis and CAM cap calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this CAM reconciliation record as assigned by Yardi Voyager (e.g., CAMREC-2024-00123). Used in tenant correspondence, audit trails, and billing statements.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the CAM reconciliation period. Defines the boundary of actual operating expenses included in the reconciliation calculation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start
attributes.description: First day of the CAM reconciliation period. May differ from the calendar year start for leases with non-standard fiscal periods or mid-year commencement dates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: reconciliation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAM reconciliation statement was formally delivered to the tenant. Triggers the tenant's review and dispute window as defined in the lease.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the CAM reconciliation record. Tracks progression from initial draft through tenant review, finalization, dispute resolution, and settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|finalized|disputed|settled|voided — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance
attributes.description: Difference between the tenant's allocated actual CAM charge and the estimated CAM billed during the reconciliation period (tenant_cam_allocated minus estimated_cam_annual). A positive value indicates an underpayment (additional charge due from tenant); a negative value indicates an overpayment (credit due to tenant).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; SOX; RESO

attributes.name: reconciliation_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2024) for which actual CAM operating expenses are being reconciled against estimated billings. Defines the reconciliation period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: tenant_cam_allocated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Allocated Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: Actual CAM expense allocated to this specific tenant, calculated as the grossed-up actual CAM multiplied by the tenant's pro-rata share. This is the amount the tenant is contractually obligated to pay for the reconciliation period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO

attributes.name: tenant_nla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Net Leasable Area (NLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: The tenant's Net Leasable Area in square feet as defined in the lease and used for pro-rata share calculation. Captures the measurement basis for CAM allocation at the time of reconciliation.
attributes.references: RESO; BOMA International; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: tenant_prorata_share
attributes.description: The tenant's proportionate share of total building CAM expenses, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.12500 = 12.5%). Typically calculated as the tenant's Net Leasable Area (NLA) divided by the total building NLA or Gross Leasable Area (GLA), as defined in the lease.
attributes.references: RESO; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: tenant_response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the tenant must respond to or dispute the CAM reconciliation statement, as stipulated in the lease agreement. Typically 30–90 days after the reconciliation statement is sent.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; RESO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CAM reconciliation record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks the latest state change for audit and change-data-capture purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: yardi_cam_batch_code
attributes.description: Source system batch identifier assigned by Yardi Voyager when the CAM reconciliation was processed or posted. Supports data lineage tracing back to the originating system batch run.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; SOX

Sourced from Yardi Voyager budgeting module. Feeds monthly CAM billing prior to annual reconciliation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.tax_assessment. Business justification: CAM Tax Budgeting process: annual CAM estimates for NNN leases use the prior year tax assessment as the basis for projecting the tax component of estimated CAM charges. Property managers reference the

attributes.name: admin_fee_pct
attributes.description: The landlord's administrative or management fee percentage added to the CAM expense pool, as permitted by the lease (e.g., 15.0000 = 15% of controllable expenses). Represents the property management overhead charge passed through to tenants.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the property manager or asset manager who approved this CAM estimate for issuance. Supports internal controls and SOX compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CAM estimate was formally approved by the authorized property manager or asset manager. Required for SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which estimated CAM charges are billed to the tenant as specified in the lease. Determines how the annual estimate is divided into installment amounts for AR billing.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_psf_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Per Square Foot (PSF) Rate
attributes.description: The estimated CAM charge expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) annual basis. Calculated as estimated_annual_cam divided by tenant_nla_sqft. Used for benchmarking, lease negotiations, and market comparisons.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; BOMA Standards; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: cap_base_year
attributes.description: The reference year against which CAM cap calculations are measured when cap_type is 'base_year'. The base year's CAM amount serves as the floor for cap computations in subsequent years.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: cap_rate_pct
attributes.description: The maximum annual percentage increase in controllable CAM charges permitted under the lease cap provision (e.g., 5.0000 = 5%). Null if cap_type is 'none'. Used to calculate the capped CAM amount when actual expenses exceed the cap threshold.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: cap_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether a CAM expense cap applies to this tenant's estimate and the type of cap structure. Cumulative caps allow unused cap room to carry forward; non-cumulative caps reset annually; base-year caps limit increases relative to a base year. Drives cap calculation logic.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this CAM estimate record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: estimate_basis
attributes.description: The methodology used to derive the estimated total operating expenses. Indicates whether the estimate was built from prior year actuals, the current year approved budget, a blended approach, or a management projection. Critical for audit and reconciliation transparency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Budgeting and Forecasting; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimate_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to this CAM estimate record, typically generated by Yardi Voyager. Used in tenant correspondence, billing statements, and audit trails.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module

attributes.name: estimate_period_end
attributes.description: The last date of the period covered by this CAM estimate. Defines the boundary for the budgeted operating expense pool and monthly billing cycle.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimate_period_start
attributes.description: The first date of the period covered by this CAM estimate. May differ from the calendar year start if the lease commenced mid-year or if a partial-year estimate is issued.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimate_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the CAM estimate record. Controls whether the estimate is eligible for billing. Transitions: draft → pending_approval → approved → issued. Superseded when a revised estimate replaces it.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module

attributes.name: estimate_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year for which this CAM estimate applies (e.g., 2025). Determines the billing period and is used to match estimates against annual reconciliation actuals.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimated_annual_cam
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Annual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: The tenant's estimated annual CAM charge for the estimate period, calculated as estimated_total_opex multiplied by pro_rata_share_pct, adjusted for any caps, exclusions, or gross-up provisions. This is the total annual amount the tenant is expected to pay.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimated_monthly_cam
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Monthly Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: The monthly CAM installment amount billed to the tenant, derived by dividing the estimated annual CAM charge by the number of billing months in the estimate period. This is the amount posted to the tenant's AR ledger each month prior to annual reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimated_total_opex
attributes.description: The total budgeted operating expenses for the property or CAM pool for the estimate period, before applying tenant pro-rata share. Represents the gross expense pool from which each tenant's share is derived. Expressed in the property's functional currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Budgeting and Forecasting; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: excluded_expense_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of operating expenses excluded from the CAM pool for this tenant's estimate per lease exclusion provisions. Provides transparency into the gross-to-net expense pool adjustment.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: exclusions_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether lease-specific CAM exclusions (e.g., capital expenditures, management fees, ground lease payments, depreciation) have been applied to reduce the expense pool for this tenant's estimate. True = exclusions were applied; False = no exclusions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: first_billing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the first CAM installment under this estimate is scheduled to be billed to the tenant. Marks the start of the billing cycle for this estimate period.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: gross_up_pct
attributes.description: The occupancy gross-up percentage applied to variable operating expenses when the building is not fully occupied (e.g., 95.0000 = 95% occupancy gross-up). Normalizes CAM expenses to a fully-occupied basis to prevent tenants from benefiting from vacancy. Null if no gross-up applies.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annual CAM reconciliation for this estimate period has been completed. True = reconciliation finalized; False = reconciliation pending. Used to filter open estimates in billing and reporting workflows.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Reconciliation Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approved CAM estimate was formally issued or communicated to the tenant. Triggers the start of monthly CAM billing in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for property manager or asset manager annotations regarding this CAM estimate, such as special assumptions, tenant negotiations, or unusual expense items included in the pool.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module

attributes.name: pool_total_gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAM Pool Total Gross Leasable Area (GLA) Square Feet
attributes.description: The total Gross Leasable Area (GLA) of the CAM expense pool (building or defined pool) used as the denominator in the pro-rata share calculation. Captures the denominator at the time the estimate is prepared, which may change year-over-year.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_cam
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year Actual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: The tenant's actual CAM charge from the immediately preceding year, as determined by the annual reconciliation. Used as the baseline when estimate_basis is 'prior_year_actuals' and for year-over-year variance analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: pro_rata_share_pct
attributes.description: The tenant's proportionate share of the CAM expense pool, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Typically calculated as the tenant's Net Leasable Area (NLA) divided by the total leasable area of the building or CAM pool. Sourced from the lease agreement.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; BOMA Standards; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this CAM estimate within the same estimate year and lease. Version 0 is the original estimate; subsequent revisions increment this counter. Enables tracking of mid-year estimate adjustments.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why this estimate was revised (e.g., 'Lease amendment changed NLA', 'Budget reforecast Q2', 'Corrected pro-rata share'). Populated only when revision_number > 0.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this CAM estimate record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer. Typically 'yardi_voyager' for CAM estimates.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tenant_nla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Net Leasable Area (NLA) Square Feet
attributes.description: The net leasable area (NLA) of the tenant's demised premises in square feet as used in the pro-rata share calculation for this estimate period. May differ from the lease NLA if a lease amendment has changed the premises size.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; BOMA Standards; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this CAM estimate record was last modified. Updated on every revision, status change, or data correction. Supports audit trail and change detection in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — CAM Estimate Module; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

products.name: ti_allowance

Sourced from Yardi Voyager and Procore project cost data.

attributes.name: ti_allowance_id

attributes.name: asset_id

attributes.name: capex_project_id

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Tenant improvement allowance disbursements are contingent on building permits and certificates of occupancy. Linking TI allowance to the compliance permit enables milestone-based disbursement tracking
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: TI allowance disbursements are tracked against cost centers for capex budgeting, NOI impact analysis, and ASC 842 lease incentive accounting. The cost_center_code on ti_allowance is a denormalized ref
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: TI allowance budgets, disbursements, and loan structures are denominated in a specific currency. Multi-currency portfolios require validated currency reference for CAPEX tracking, ASC842 lease incenti
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: TI allowance commitments are tracked against capex budgets for property-level capital expenditure planning and budget variance reporting. Real estate asset managers require TI allowance-to-budget link
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the executed lease agreement to which this TI allowance is attached. Links the TI record to its governing lease instrument.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: property_space_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.space. Business justification: TI allowances fund improvements to a specific physical space. Space-level TI tracking, construction scope management, and capex reporting by space require ti_allowance→space. ti_allowance has asset_id
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant entity receiving the TI allowance. Supports tenant-level TI exposure and portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: TI allowance milestone-based disbursement process: each disbursement milestone is triggered by completion of specific construction work orders. Property managers link TI allowance records to the work

attributes.name: allowance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the TI allowance record. Tracks progression from negotiation through full disbursement or expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|active|disbursing|completed|expired|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the TI allowance structure: landlord_work (landlord constructs improvements), tenant_work (tenant constructs with reimbursement), turnkey (landlord delivers finished space), cash_allowance (cash paid to tenant), loan_structured (TI structured as amortizing loan). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: landlord_work|tenant_work|turnkey|cash_allowance|loan_structured — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the landlord representative (Asset Manager or Property Manager) who approved the TI allowance and construction plans.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: approved_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount of TI expenditure formally approved by the landlord against submitted tenant work scopes and contractor bids. May be less than or equal to total_budget_amount.
attributes.references: Procore Project Cost Module; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: asc842_lease_incentive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TI allowance is classified as a lease incentive under FASB ASC 842, requiring recognition as a reduction to the right-of-use asset on the lessee's balance sheet.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Leases; Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB)

attributes.name: construction_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual or projected date on which TI construction work was or is expected to be substantially completed. Triggers final disbursement eligibility.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; COO (Certificate of Occupancy)

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Actual or scheduled date on which TI construction work commenced in the leased premises. Sourced from Procore project schedule.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: coo_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Certificate of Occupancy (COO) was issued by the relevant authority for the TI-improved premises. Often a prerequisite for final TI disbursement.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); OSHA Building Safety; Procore Document Control

attributes.name: disbursed_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount actually paid out by the landlord to the tenant or contractor as TI reimbursement. Represents cash outflow against the TI commitment.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable; FASB ASC 842; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: Method by which TI funds are released to the tenant or contractor: lump_sum (single payment), milestone_based (tied to construction milestones), invoice_reimbursement (per submitted invoices), rent_credit (applied as rent offset), loan_advance (structured as a loan draw). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lump_sum|milestone_based|invoice_reimbursement|rent_credit|loan_advance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: disbursement_milestone_count
attributes.description: Total number of disbursement milestones defined in the TI disbursement schedule. Applicable when disbursement_method is milestone_based.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Procore Project Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the TI allowance becomes binding and eligible for disbursement, typically aligned with lease commencement or a negotiated milestone date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date by which the tenant must complete TI work and submit all disbursement requests. Unused allowance after this date is typically forfeited per lease terms.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_incentive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TI allowance is classified as a lease incentive under IFRS 16, requiring adjustment to the lease liability measurement for international reporting entities.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 — Leases; International Accounting Standards Board (IASB)

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount of TI-related invoices submitted by the tenant or contractor to the landlord for reimbursement. Sourced from Procore and Yardi AP module.
attributes.references: Procore Project Cost Module; Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_loan_structured
attributes.description: Indicates whether the TI allowance is structured as an amortizing loan to the tenant rather than a grant. When true, amortization terms apply and the TI is treated as a lease incentive receivable under ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: landlord_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landlord formally approved the tenant's TI construction plans and budget. Required before disbursement can commence.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: landlord_work_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the improvements to be constructed or funded by the landlord as part of the TI package. Sourced from the lease work letter exhibit.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Procore Document Control

attributes.name: leasable_area_sqft
attributes.description: Net leasable area of the demised premises in square feet used as the basis for calculating the total TI budget from the PSF rate. Sourced from the lease exhibit.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; BOMA International Measurement Standards

attributes.name: lien_waiver_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required lien waivers have been received from contractors and subcontractors prior to the most recent TI disbursement.
attributes.references: ALTA (American Land Title Association); Procore Document Control

attributes.name: lien_waiver_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether lien waivers from contractors and subcontractors are required as a condition of each TI disbursement. Standard risk management practice in commercial real estate construction.
attributes.references: ALTA (American Land Title Association); Urban Land Institute (ULI); OSHA

attributes.name: loan_amortization_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which the TI loan is amortized through rent payments or separate repayment schedule. Applicable only when is_loan_structured is true.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: loan_commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the TI loan amortization begins. Typically aligned with lease commencement or first disbursement date. Applicable only when is_loan_structured is true.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: loan_interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the TI loan balance when the allowance is structured as an amortizing loan. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.065 = 6.5%). Applicable only when is_loan_structured is true.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: milestones_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of disbursement milestones that have been completed and verified to date. Used to track TI disbursement progress against the agreed schedule.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or exceptions related to the TI allowance not captured in structured fields. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or Procore project notes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Procore Project Management

attributes.name: procore_project_code
attributes.description: External project identifier in Procore Construction Management system tracking the TI construction project associated with this allowance. Enables cross-system reconciliation of cost data.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management Module; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TI allowance record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TI allowance record was last modified in the Silver layer data product. Supports change tracking and incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Remaining undisbursed TI allowance balance calculated as total_budget_amount minus disbursed_amount. Represents the landlord's outstanding TI commitment at any point in time.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: tenant_work_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the improvements to be constructed by the tenant using the TI allowance. Defines the boundary between landlord and tenant construction responsibilities.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Procore Document Control

attributes.name: ti_allowance_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the TI allowance record, used in lease exhibits, Procore project references, and Yardi Voyager TI tracking. Format: TIA- followed by alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Procore Project Cost Module

attributes.name: ti_amount_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Improvement (TI) Amount Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: TI allowance expressed as a dollar amount per square foot (PSF) of the leased premises. Standard industry metric used for benchmarking TI generosity across deals and markets.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Urban Land Institute (ULI); CoStar Suite Market Analytics

attributes.name: total_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total negotiated TI allowance budget in the lease currency. Represents the maximum landlord commitment for tenant improvement expenditure as agreed in the lease exhibit.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: work_letter_reference

attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration Module

attributes.name: space_configuration

attributes.name: space_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this demised space as assigned in Yardi Voyager (e.g., suite number, unit number, or space code). Used in lease documents and tenant correspondence.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Unit/Space Master; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: space_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demised space within the lease. Indicates whether the space is actively occupied, vacant, under renovation, or has been surrendered.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Unit Status; ASC 842 Lease Classification

attributes.name: ti_allowance_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Improvement (TI) Allowance Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Landlord-funded Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance per square foot granted for this demised space. Represents the landlord's contribution toward tenant fit-out costs.

attributes.name: ti_allowance_total

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: usable_area_sqf

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant (party) who made this payment. Enables tenant-level payment performance analysis and delinquency tracking.
