attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific leasable unit (suite, floor, or space) within the property to which this payment applies.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: amount_applied
attributes.description: The portion of amount_paid that has been formally applied against the outstanding AR invoice balance. May differ from amount_paid if a portion is held unapplied (e.g., prepayment or overpayment held in suspense).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: amount_due
attributes.description: The gross amount billed to the tenant for the charge type and applied period as stated on the AR invoice. Represents the contractual obligation before any payments, credits, or adjustments are applied.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount received from the tenant in this payment transaction. May be less than amount_due (partial payment) or equal to it (full payment). Core monetary fact for cash collection reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: applied_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the billing period to which this payment is applied (e.g., 2024-01-31 for January rent). Together with applied_period_start_date defines the exact coverage window for the payment.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: applied_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the billing period to which this payment is applied (e.g., 2024-01-01 for January rent). Used for period-level cash collection analysis and ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lease liability amortization reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue or charge category this payment satisfies. 'base_rent' = contractual base rent; 'cam' = Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges; 'security_deposit' = security deposit receipt; 'late_fee' = penalty for late payment; 'ti_reimbursement' = Tenant Improvement (TI) cost reimbursement; 'percentage_rent' = overage rent based on tenant sales. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_rent|cam|security_deposit|late_fee|ti_reimbursement|percentage_rent|parking|utility_reimbursement|insurance_reimbursement|tax_reimbursement|holdover_rent|termination_fee — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number printed on the tenant's paper check, as captured during lockbox or manual receipt processing. Populated only when payment_method is 'check'. Used for bank reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Represents the audit trail creation event for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of calendar days between the due_date and the payment_date. A positive value indicates late payment; zero or negative indicates on-time or early payment. Drives delinquency classification, late fee triggers, and tenant credit scoring.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; NAR

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment funds were deposited into the property's bank account. May differ from payment_date (receipt date) for checks held before deposit or lockbox processing delays. Used for bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SOX

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the tenant was required to remit payment per the lease agreement. Used to calculate days-past-due, trigger late fee assessment, and drive delinquency reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount to the functional reporting currency at the time of receipt. Applicable for multi-currency portfolios. 1.0 for payments already in the functional currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 16; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_delinquent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment was received after the contractual due date (True) or on time (False). Set to True when days_past_due > 0 at the time of receipt. Used for tenant delinquency reporting, arrears event triggering, and portfolio risk dashboards.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; NAR

attributes.name: is_partial_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amount_paid is less than the amount_due for the associated charge (True = partial payment; False = full payment). Partial payments trigger outstanding_balance tracking and may initiate default cure period monitoring.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: late_fee_assessed
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the late fee charged to the tenant as a result of this payment being received after the due date. Calculated per the late fee schedule in the lease agreement. Zero if payment was on time.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: late_fee_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed late fee was waived by the property manager or asset manager (True = waived; False = not waived). Supports exception tracking and tenant relationship management reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the property manager or AR administrator regarding this payment (e.g., tenant dispute context, special arrangement details, partial payment agreement). Supports operational context for collections staff.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: nsf_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment was returned by the bank due to Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) or a similar bank return reason (True = NSF/returned; False = cleared). NSF events trigger reversal of the posted payment and may initiate default proceedings.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: nsf_return_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bank returned the payment due to NSF or other bank return reason. Populated only when nsf_flag is True. Used to calculate the effective delinquency period and trigger corrective AR actions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance on the charge after this payment is applied (amount_due minus amount_applied). A non-zero value indicates a partial payment or delinquency. Used for AR aging and tenant arrears reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the payment was received from the tenant (receipt date). This is the principal real-world business event date used for delinquency calculation, aging analysis, and cash flow reporting. Distinct from the posting date.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used by the tenant to remit payment. 'ach' = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; 'wire' = bank wire transfer; 'check' = paper check; 'credit_card' = card payment; 'lockbox' = bank lockbox processing; 'cash' = physical currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; PCI DSS

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment record within the AR workflow. 'posted' = applied to ledger; 'pending' = received but not yet applied; 'reversed' = corrected/reversed entry; 'voided' = cancelled before posting; 'returned' = NSF or bank return; 'on_hold' = held pending dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the payment was posted to the General Ledger (GL) period. May differ from payment_date due to cut-off timing, bank processing delays, or period-end adjustments. Used for period-close reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable payment reference number assigned by Yardi Voyager AR at the time of receipt posting. Used for tenant remittance matching, bank reconciliation, and audit trail. Corresponds to the Yardi receipt number.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: remittance_reference
attributes.description: The tenant-provided reference or memo field included with the payment remittance (e.g., wire transfer memo, ACH addenda, check memo line). Used to match incoming payments to open AR charges when the reference number is not automatically matched.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment reversal or void was processed in Yardi Voyager AR. Populated only when payment_status is 'reversed' or 'voided'. Used for AR aging recalculation and delinquency reassessment.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SOX

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why a posted payment was reversed or voided. Populated only when payment_status is 'reversed' or 'voided'. Supports audit trail and exception reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SOX

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of amount_paid that has been received but not yet applied to a specific charge or invoice. Held in a suspense or prepayment account until the property manager allocates it. Relevant for tenant overpayment and prepaid rent scenarios.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was last modified in the Silver layer data product (e.g., status change, reversal, correction). Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: yardi_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or deposit batch number in Yardi Voyager under which this payment was grouped for posting. Supports batch-level reconciliation between Yardi AR and bank deposit records.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: yardi_receipt_code
attributes.description: The native receipt or transaction identifier assigned by Yardi Voyager AR at the time of payment posting. Used for source system traceability, reconciliation between the Silver layer and the operational system, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: deposit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the security deposit instrument. Determines the mechanism by which the landlord can draw on the deposit in the event of tenant default or lease-end obligations.

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: The DocuSign envelope identifier for the executed lease or deposit agreement document that governs the security deposit terms. Enables traceability to the signed legal instrument.

attributes.name: held_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount of security deposit currently held by the landlord. May differ from the required amount due to partial receipt, reduction schedules, or applied deductions.

attributes.name: interest_bearing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the security deposit is required by law or contract to accrue interest for the benefit of the tenant. Jurisdictional requirements vary; some states mandate interest-bearing accounts for residential deposits.

attributes.name: loc_amount

attributes.name: loc_auto_renew

attributes.name: loc_expiry_date

attributes.name: loc_issuer_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution (bank) that issued the letter of credit serving as the security deposit instrument. Applicable only when deposit_type is 'letter_of_credit'.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Security Deposit Module; International Chamber of Commerce UCP 600

attributes.name: loc_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number assigned by the issuing bank to the letter of credit. Used for draw requests, renewals, and bank correspondence. Applicable when deposit_type is 'letter_of_credit'.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Security Deposit Module; International Chamber of Commerce UCP 600

attributes.name: next_reduction_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount by which the required security deposit will be reduced on the next scheduled reduction date. Used for cash flow planning and tenant notification.

attributes.name: next_reduction_date
attributes.description: The next scheduled date on which the required security deposit amount is contractually reduced per the deposit reduction schedule. Triggers a review and potential partial return to the tenant.

attributes.name: personal_guarantee_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a personal guarantee from the tenant's principal(s) is required in addition to the security deposit as a condition of the lease. Relevant for credit risk management and lease underwriting.

attributes.name: reduction_schedule_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement includes a contractual schedule for reducing the required security deposit amount over time, typically tied to tenant performance milestones or lease anniversary dates.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: required_amount

attributes.name: unit_id

attributes.name: applicable_breakpoint_amount
attributes.description: The effective breakpoint amount used for this reporting period's percentage rent calculation — either the natural or artificial breakpoint as determined by breakpoint_type. This is the operative threshold against which reported gross sales are compared.

attributes.name: audit_variance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar difference between audited_gross_sales and reported_gross_sales discovered during a landlord audit. Positive value indicates tenant under-reported sales; negative indicates over-reporting. Drives additional billing or credit adjustments.

attributes.name: audited_gross_sales
attributes.description: Gross sales amount as verified or adjusted following a landlord-initiated audit of the tenant's sales records. Populated only when an audit has been completed. May differ from reported_gross_sales if discrepancies are found.

attributes.name: breakpoint_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sales breakpoint is a natural breakpoint (derived as base rent divided by the percentage rate) or an artificial breakpoint (a fixed dollar amount negotiated in the lease regardless of base rent).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this percentage rent record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: dispute_reason

attributes.name: lease_structure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease structure under which percentage rent applies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nnn|gross|modified_gross|net|double_net — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lease_year_number
attributes.description: Sequential lease year (1, 2, 3, …) within the lease term to which this reporting period belongs. Used for annual breakpoint resets and lease-year-based reconciliation cycles.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module

attributes.name: natural_breakpoint_amount
attributes.description: Calculated sales threshold equal to annual base rent divided by the percentage rent rate. Gross sales above this level trigger percentage rent obligations. Applicable when breakpoint_type is 'natural'.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: net_sales_for_calculation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Sales for Percentage Rent Calculation
attributes.description: Gross sales net of contractual exclusions used as the operative sales figure for percentage rent calculation. Equals reported_gross_sales (or audited_gross_sales if audited) minus sales_exclusions_amount.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842; ICSC Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for property managers or lease administrators to record additional context, special circumstances, or follow-up actions related to this percentage rent record (e.g., tenant dispute details, audit findings summary, reconciliation adjustments).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the calculated percentage rent must be paid by the tenant. Typically a fixed number of days after the sales report due date or after the landlord issues the reconciliation statement.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: pct_rent_billed
attributes.description: Actual percentage rent amount invoiced to the tenant for the reporting period. May differ from pct_rent_calculated due to interim billing adjustments, credits applied, or reconciliation true-ups.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: pct_rent_calculated
attributes.description: Calculated overage rent amount due for the reporting period, derived as sales_over_breakpoint multiplied by the applicable percentage_rate (or tiered rates). This is the system-computed obligation before any adjustments or credits.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: pct_rent_collected
attributes.description: Total percentage rent cash received from the tenant for this reporting period. Used to track collection status and outstanding balances against billed amounts.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: percentage_rate
attributes.description: The contractual percentage rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0600 for 6%) applied to gross sales in excess of the applicable breakpoint to calculate overage rent due. Sourced directly from the lease agreement.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards; NAR

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the percentage rent reconciliation for this reporting period was finalized and agreed between landlord and tenant. Marks the transition to 'reconciled' status.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the percentage rent reconciliation process for this reporting period. Tracks the lifecycle from awaiting tenant sales report through final settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending_report|report_received|under_review|reconciled|disputed|audit_initiated|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: reported_gross_sales
attributes.description: Total gross sales amount reported by the tenant for the reporting period as submitted in the tenant's sales report. This is the tenant-declared figure prior to landlord audit or verification. Classified confidential as it contains commercially sensitive tenant revenue data.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; ICSC Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the sales reporting period for which the tenant is required to report gross sales and calculate percentage rent due.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the sales reporting period (monthly, quarterly, or annual) for which the tenant is required to report gross sales and calculate percentage rent due.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the sales reporting period as defined in the lease agreement. Determines how often the tenant must submit gross sales reports and how often percentage rent is calculated.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; NAR Lease Standards

attributes.name: sales_exclusions_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of gross sales items contractually excluded from the percentage rent calculation per the lease (e.g., sales tax collected, returns and allowances, employee discounts, internet sales if excluded). Reduces the gross sales base for breakpoint comparison.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards; NAR

attributes.name: sales_over_breakpoint
attributes.description: The amount by which net_sales_for_calculation exceeds the applicable_breakpoint_amount. This is the overage base to which the percentage_rate is applied. Zero if net sales do not exceed the breakpoint.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: sales_report_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the tenant must submit their gross sales report for the reporting period as specified in the lease agreement. Used for compliance tracking and late notice generation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards; NAR

attributes.name: sales_report_late
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant's gross sales report was received after the contractual due date. True when sales_report_received_date exceeds sales_report_due_date or when the report has not been received by the due date.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: sales_report_received_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the tenant's gross sales report was received by the landlord or property manager. Compared against sales_report_due_date to identify late submissions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: tiered_rate_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease specifies multiple tiered percentage rates applied to different bands of gross sales above the breakpoint (e.g., 5% on first $500K over breakpoint, 6% on next $500K). When True, rate tiers are managed in a related reference structure.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; ICSC Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this percentage rent record in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000

attributes.name: yardi_pct_rent_ref
attributes.description: Source system reference code from Yardi Voyager percentage rent module uniquely identifying this record in the operational system of record. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to translate lease amounts from the lease currency to the functional currency as of the measurement date. Equals 1.0 when both currencies are the same.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IAS 21

attributes.name: interest_expense
attributes.description: Interest accrued on the lease liability during the period using the effective interest method at the incremental borrowing rate or implicit rate. Recognised in the income statement for finance leases; included in operating lease cost for operating leases under ASC 842.

attributes.name: lease_classification

attributes.name: lease_incentive_received

attributes.name: lease_liability_closing_balance

attributes.name: lease_liability_opening_balance
attributes.description: Present value of remaining lease payments at the beginning of the accounting period, before current-period interest accrual and principal repayment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50; IFRS 16 paragraph 53

attributes.name: lease_liability_remeasurement
attributes.description: Adjustment to the lease liability resulting from a lease modification, change in lease term, change in variable payments indexed to a rate, or reassessment of a purchase/extension option. Positive = increase; negative = decrease.

attributes.name: maturity_year1_payments

attributes.name: maturity_year2_to5_payments

attributes.name: modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accounting entry was triggered by a lease modification event (e.g., extension, scope change, rent renegotiation) requiring remeasurement of the ROU asset and lease liability.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp

attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-15-3; IFRS 16 paragraphs 5, 15

attributes.name: principal_repayment
attributes.description: Cash payment applied to reduce the lease liability principal during the period, representing the financing portion of the lease payment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-5; IFRS 16 paragraph 26

attributes.name: rou_asset_additions
attributes.description: Increases to the ROU asset during the period from new lease commencements, lease modifications that increase scope, or remeasurements that increase the lease liability.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; IFRS 16 paragraph 39

attributes.name: rou_asset_amortisation
attributes.description: Current-period amortisation charge applied to the ROU asset. For finance leases, amortised on a straight-line basis over the shorter of the lease term or useful life; for operating leases, the plug to achieve straight-line rent expense.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 31

'operating' means the sublessor recognizes lease income on a straight-line basis; 'finance' means the sublessor derecognizes the underlying asset and recognizes a net investment in the sublease.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-14; FASB ASC 842-30

attributes.name: cam_amount_annual
attributes.description: Estimated annual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges payable by the subtenant. Relevant for NNN and modified gross sublease structures. Used for total occupancy cost analysis.
attributes.references: NAR; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CAM standard

attributes.name: cam_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges are applicable to the subtenant under the sublease terms. When true, CAM reconciliation obligations flow through from the head lease.
attributes.references: NAR; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CAM standard

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sublease term begins and the subtenant takes possession of the subleased premises. Used as the effective start date for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lessor accounting measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.87

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sublease record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: discount_rate_percent
attributes.description: The interest rate used to discount future sublease payments for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 net investment measurement. Typically the rate implicit in the sublease or the sublessor's incremental borrowing rate.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.63

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the DocuSign CLM envelope containing the executed sublease agreement and all associated documents. Enables direct retrieval of the signed sublease document from the contract management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: early_termination_option
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublease contains an early termination clause allowing either party to terminate the sublease before the scheduled expiration date. Affects ASC 842 lease term determination and WALE calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-55; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sublease agreement was fully executed (signed by all parties) via DocuSign CLM or physical signature. Marks the legally binding commencement of the sublease contract.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; NAR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the sublease term ends. Must not extend beyond the head lease expiration date. Critical for WALT/WALE calculations and portfolio expiry scheduling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.87; WALE metric

attributes.name: free_rent_months
attributes.description: Number of months of rent abatement granted to the subtenant at the commencement of the sublease. Affects straight-line rent recognition under ASC 842 operating sublease accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent jurisdiction) whose laws govern the sublease agreement. Relevant for dispute resolution, regulatory compliance, and legal enforceability analysis.
attributes.references: NAR; HUD; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: head_lease_rent_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Head Lease Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: The sublessor's rent obligation under the head lease expressed on a PSF basis for the subleased area. Used to calculate profit or loss on sublease relative to the head lease rent obligation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; NOI metric; PSF metric

attributes.name: ifrs16_sublease_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the sublease under IFRS 16 from the intermediate lessor's perspective. Classification is based on the right-of-use (ROU) asset arising from the head lease, not the underlying asset. 'finance' requires recognition of a net investment in the sublease.
attributes.references: IFRS 16.87; IASB IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: landlord_consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the landlord formally granted written consent to the sublease arrangement. Required for sublease validity where landlord consent is mandated by the head lease.
attributes.references: NAR; DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: landlord_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the head lease requires the landlord's written consent before the sublease can be executed. Derived from the head lease assignment and subletting clause.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: landlord_consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the landlord's consent process for the sublease. 'not_required' indicates the head lease permits subletting without consent; 'conditional' indicates consent granted subject to specific conditions.
attributes.references: NAR; DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: net_investment_in_sublease
attributes.description: Present value of future sublease payments plus any unguaranteed residual value, recognized on the balance sheet for finance subleases under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Applicable only when asc842_sublease_classification or ifrs16_sublease_classification is 'finance'.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-30-30; IFRS 16.67

attributes.name: profit_loss_on_sublease
attributes.description: Net financial position of the sublease relative to the head lease rent obligation for the subleased area. Positive value indicates sublease rent exceeds head lease cost (profit); negative value indicates a loss position. Calculated as sublease rent minus allocated head lease rent for the sublet area.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; IFRS 16.87; NOI metric

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the sublease agreement as recorded in Yardi Voyager or DocuSign CLM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and document retrieval.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: renewal_option_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublease includes a renewal option allowing the subtenant to extend the sublease term. Relevant for WALT/WALE calculations and ASC 842 lease term reassessment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-55; IFRS 16; WALT/WALE metric

attributes.name: rent_annual
attributes.description: Total annual base rent payable by the subtenant to the sublessor under the sublease agreement. Used for NOI analysis, profit/loss on sublease calculations, and ASC 842 lessor income recognition.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; IFRS 16.87; NOI metric

attributes.name: rent_escalation_rate
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate applied to base rent escalation where escalation type is 'fixed' or 'stepped'. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 = 3%). Used for cash flow modeling in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; Argus Enterprise; IFRS 16

attributes.name: rent_escalation_type
attributes.description: Method by which sublease base rent increases over the sublease term. 'fixed' applies a fixed percentage; 'cpi' ties escalation to the Consumer Price Index; 'fmv' resets to fair market value; 'stepped' uses pre-agreed step-up amounts; 'none' indicates flat rent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: rent_monthly
attributes.description: Monthly base rent payable by the subtenant. Derived from the annual rent schedule but stored explicitly for billing and cash flow forecasting in Yardi Voyager AR.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: rent_psf
attributes.description: Annual base rent expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis for the subleased area. Key metric for market benchmarking against CoStar comparable lease data and head lease PSF comparison.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); PSF metric

attributes.name: rou_asset_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the head lease Right-of-Use (ROU) asset allocated to the subleased area for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 intermediate lessor accounting. Used to determine the carrying amount of the net investment in a finance sublease or the ROU asset derecognition amount.

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Cash security deposit collected from the subtenant at sublease commencement. Held by the sublessor as collateral against subtenant default. Tracked separately from head lease security deposit obligations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; NAR

attributes.name: sublease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sublease agreement. 'draft' indicates the sublease is being negotiated; 'pending_consent' indicates awaiting landlord approval; 'active' indicates the sublease is in force; 'expired' indicates the term has ended; 'terminated' indicates early termination; 'holdover' indicates the subtenant remains in possession beyond the sublease expiry.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: sublease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sublease arrangement. 'full_assignment' transfers all rights and obligations of the head lease; 'partial_sublease' sublets only a portion of the demised premises; 'master_sublease' covers an entire building or multi-unit portfolio; 'short_term_sublease' is a temporary arrangement typically under 12 months.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20; IFRS 16.87; NAR

attributes.name: sublet_area_sqft
attributes.description: The net leasable area (NLA) in square feet being subleased to the subtenant. May be less than the total demised premises area under the head lease for partial subleases. Used for PSF rent calculations and GLA reporting.
attributes.references: BOMA International; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); NLA/GLA standards

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the sublease in months, calculated from commencement to expiration. Used for WALT/WALE analysis and ASC 842 lease term determination.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; WALT/WALE metric; IFRS 16

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the sublease record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: yardi_sublease_ref
attributes.description: Internal reference code assigned to the sublease record in Yardi Voyager Lease Administration. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

products.name: ground_lease
products.description: Master record for ground lease arrangements where the landowner leases land to a developer or tenant who constructs improvements. Captures ground lease term (often 50–99 years), ground rent, rent escalation schedule, reversion rights, leasehold financing provisions, subordination terms (subordinated vs. unsubordinated), ground lessor/lessee identities, and improvement ownership at reversion. Sourced from Yardi Voyager and DocuSign CLM. Modeled as a distinct product due to unique legal structure, ultra-long duration, leasehold financing implications, and separate valuation methodology.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the land parcel or property subject to the ground lease arrangement.

attributes.name: lessor_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the landowner (ground lessor) who retains fee simple ownership of the land and leases it to the lessee.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio_asset. Business justification: Ground leases are fundamental encumbrances affecting portfolio asset leasehold valuation, NAV calculation, financing eligibility, and exit strategy. Investment teams must identify which portfolio asse
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reference_lease_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.lease_type. Business justification: Ground leases have specific lease type classifications (ground lease, leasehold) that drive ASC842/IFRS16 classification, ROU asset measurement, and leasehold financing eligibility. Domain experts exp

Business justification: Ground leases are subject to land use regulations, environmental obligations, and development requirements. Compliance teams must link ground leases to governing regulatory obligations for development

attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: tenure_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.tenure_type. Business justification: Ground leases create leasehold interests with specific tenure types affecting financing eligibility, CMBS qualification, and title insurance requirements. reference.tenure_type has ground_lease_applic
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: abstracted_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the lease administrator or analyst who performed the lease abstraction. Supports audit trail and quality control for lease data governance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: abstracted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ground lease was formally abstracted by the lease administration team, capturing key economic and legal terms into the data system.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: annual_ground_rent
attributes.description: Annual base ground rent payable by the lessee to the lessor under the current rent period. Expressed in the lease currency. Foundational input for NOI, DCF, and leasehold valuation models.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute; IVSC

attributes.name: asc842_lease_classification
attributes.description: Lease classification under FASB ASC 842 (finance lease or operating lease) as determined by the lessee's accounting team. Ground leases with ultra-long terms typically qualify as finance leases. Drives ROU asset and lease liability recognition.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SEC reporting requirements for publicly traded REITs

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ground lease term begins and the lessee takes possession of the land. Establishes the start of the lease term for rent, escalation, and ASC 842/IFRS 16 measurement purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: cpi_base_index
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Base Index Value
attributes.description: Base CPI index value at lease commencement or last rent reset, used to calculate CPI-linked rent escalations. Applicable when rent_escalation_type is 'cpi' or 'hybrid'.
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: cpi_cap_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Escalation Cap Percent
attributes.description: Maximum percentage cap on CPI-linked rent escalation per review period, protecting the lessee from excessive rent increases. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ground lease record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: development_completion_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the lessee must complete construction of improvements on the leased land, where a development obligation exists. Null if no development obligation is specified.
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: development_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ground lease imposes a contractual obligation on the lessee to construct improvements on the land within a specified timeframe. Failure to develop may trigger default provisions.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Discount rate used to calculate the present value of future ground rent payments for ASC 842/IFRS 16 lease liability measurement. Typically the lessee's incremental borrowing rate (IBR) or the rate implicit in the lease. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 = 4.50%).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the DocuSign CLM envelope containing the executed ground lease agreement and all amendments. Enables direct retrieval of the signed document from the contract management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ground lease agreement was fully executed (signed by all parties). Establishes the binding contract date, which may differ from the commencement date.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which the ground lease term ends and the land (along with all improvements) reverts to the lessor, absent renewal. Drives WALT/WALE calculations and reversion planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: fmv_reset_frequency_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Market Value (FMV) Rent Reset Frequency (Years)
attributes.description: Frequency in years at which ground rent is reset to fair market value, applicable when rent_escalation_type is 'fmv_reset'. Typically every 20–25 years in long-term ground leases.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or jurisdiction identifier) whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the ground lease agreement.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_classification
attributes.description: Lease classification under IASB IFRS 16 for entities reporting under international accounting standards. Determines lessee balance sheet treatment of the right-of-use (ROU) asset and lease liability.
attributes.references: IASB IFRS 16; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC)

attributes.name: improvement_ownership
attributes.description: Specifies who owns the improvements (buildings and structures) constructed on the leased land during the term and at reversion. Typically improvements revert to the lessor at lease expiry, which is a key valuation and financing consideration.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: land_area_sqft
attributes.description: Total area of the leased land parcel in square feet (SQF). Used for rent PSF calculations, FAR analysis, and valuation benchmarking.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: lease_liability_value
attributes.description: Present value of future ground rent obligations recognized as a lease liability on the lessee's balance sheet under ASC 842 or IFRS 16 at the measurement date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC reporting requirements

attributes.name: lease_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the ground lease agreement, as recorded in Yardi Voyager and DocuSign CLM. Used for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ground lease agreement, tracking progression from drafting through execution, active operation, and eventual expiry or termination.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: leasehold_financing_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessee is contractually permitted to encumber the leasehold interest with a mortgage or other financing instrument. Critical for lender underwriting and SNDA structuring.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; CMBS underwriting standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: lender_cure_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ground lease grants the lessee's leasehold lender the right to cure lessee defaults before the lessor may terminate the lease. Essential for leasehold mortgage bankability.
attributes.references: CMBS underwriting standards; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: new_lease_on_termination
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Lease on Termination Right Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ground lease contains a provision obligating the lessor to enter into a new ground lease with the leasehold lender upon termination of the original lease due to lessee default. A key bankability criterion for CMBS lenders.
attributes.references: CMBS underwriting standards; Appraisal Institute; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: next_rent_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of the next ground rent review or escalation event. Used for proactive lease administration and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: original_term_years
attributes.description: Total original contractual term of the ground lease in years, typically ranging from 50 to 99 years. Used for valuation, leasehold financing underwriting, and ASC 842/IFRS 16 lease classification.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute; IVSC

attributes.name: permitted_use
attributes.description: Description of the permitted use of the leased land as specified in the ground lease agreement (e.g., commercial office development, mixed-use residential, hotel). Restricts the lessee's development and operational activities.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: remaining_term_years
attributes.description: Number of years remaining on the ground lease as of the record's last update date. Critical for leasehold mortgage underwriting, valuation, and WALT/WALE reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: renewal_option_term_years
attributes.description: Duration in years of each renewal option period. Combined with renewal_options_count to determine maximum potential lease term for valuation and ASC 842/IFRS 16 lease term assessment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: renewal_options_count
attributes.description: Total number of renewal option periods available to the lessee under the ground lease. Each option extends the lease term and affects WALT/WALE and ASC 842 reasonably-certain assessments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: rent_escalation_interval_years
attributes.description: Number of years between each ground rent escalation event (e.g., every 5 or 10 years). Used to schedule rent review dates and model future cash flows in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: rent_escalation_rate
attributes.description: Fixed percentage rate applied to ground rent escalation when rent_escalation_type is 'fixed' or 'percentage'. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 = 3%). Null when escalation is CPI or FMV-based.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: rent_escalation_type
attributes.description: Mechanism by which ground rent escalates over the lease term. Options include fixed step-up, CPI-linked, fair market value (FMV) reset, percentage of revenue, hybrid, or no escalation. Drives rent forecasting and DCF modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: reversion_rights_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the lessor's reversion rights at lease expiry, including conditions for improvement transfer, demolition obligations, and any compensation provisions.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: rou_asset_value
attributes.description: Carrying value of the right-of-use asset recognized on the lessee's balance sheet under ASC 842 or IFRS 16 at the measurement date. Represents the present value of future ground rent payments plus initial direct costs.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC reporting requirements

attributes.name: snda_executed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Agreement Executed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination, Non-Disturbance, and Attornment (SNDA) agreement has been executed between the ground lessor, lessee, and leasehold lender. Required for leasehold mortgage bankability.
attributes.references: CMBS underwriting standards; FASB ASC 842; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the ground lease record in the Silver Layer. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: yardi_lease_code
attributes.description: Unique lease code assigned to the ground lease record in Yardi Voyager Lease Administration module. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

products.name: guaranty
products.description: Tracks lease guaranty and guarantor obligations for commercial lease agreements. Critical for landlord credit risk management on commercial leases where tenant creditworthiness depends on a third-party guarantee. Sourced from DocuSign CLM and Yardi Voyager.

attributes.name: abstracted_by

attributes.name: abstracted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty terms were abstracted from the executed document and entered into the data system. Used for data quality auditing and lease administration workflow tracking.

attributes.name: amount_recovered
