attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: burn_down_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guaranty includes a contractual burn-down schedule under which the guaranteed amount reduces over time as the tenant demonstrates satisfactory lease performance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: burn_down_interval_months
attributes.description: Frequency in months at which the guaranteed amount is reduced per the burn-down schedule (e.g., 12 for annual reductions). Null if burn-down is not applicable.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: burn_down_reduction_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount by which the guaranteed exposure is reduced at each burn-down interval. Used when the burn-down is amount-based rather than percentage-based.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: burn_down_reduction_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original guaranteed amount by which exposure is reduced at each burn-down interval. Used when the burn-down is percentage-based rather than fixed-amount-based. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: burn_down_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty burn-down schedule commences. Typically tied to a lease anniversary or a performance milestone such as rent payment history.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guaranty record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: credit_risk_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit risk classification assigned to the guarantor based on financial statement review, credit bureau data, and underwriting analysis. Drives portfolio-level credit risk reporting and reserve calculations.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SEC; SOX

attributes.name: current_guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: Present outstanding guaranteed amount after applying any burn-down reductions, partial releases, or enforcement recoveries. Reflects the landlord's current credit risk exposure under this guaranty.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the DocuSign CLM envelope containing the executed guaranty instrument. Enables direct retrieval of the signed document from the contract lifecycle management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the guaranty obligation becomes operative and enforceable. May differ from execution date if the guaranty contains a deferred commencement provision.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: enforcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landlord formally initiated enforcement action against the guarantor (e.g., date of demand letter or filing of legal claim).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: enforcement_status
attributes.description: Current status of any enforcement action taken against the guarantor. 'demand_issued' indicates a formal demand letter has been sent; 'litigation' indicates legal proceedings are active; 'recovered' indicates full or partial recovery has been achieved.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty instrument was fully executed (all parties signed). This is the principal business event date establishing the guaranty as legally binding.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty obligation terminates by its own terms, independent of lease expiry. Null for guaranties that run co-terminus with the lease or until full performance.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: financial_covenant_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guaranty requires the guarantor to maintain specified financial covenants (e.g., minimum net worth, minimum liquidity ratio, maximum leverage). Critical for ongoing credit risk monitoring.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SOX; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: financial_statement_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency at which the guarantor must deliver financial statements to the landlord for covenant compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SOX

attributes.name: good_guy_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of advance written notice the tenant must provide to the landlord to trigger the good-guy guaranty release clause. Applicable only when guaranty_type is 'good_guy'.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: good_guy_vacate_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the tenant vacated the premises and surrendered possession, triggering the good-guy guaranty release. Populated upon confirmed surrender.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent jurisdiction code) specifying the governing law under which the guaranty instrument is interpreted and enforced. Critical for legal enforcement strategy.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); ALTA

attributes.name: guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary exposure covered by the guaranty at inception. For full guaranties, this equals the total lease obligation value; for limited guaranties, this is the capped dollar amount. Expressed in the lease currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: guaranteed_months
attributes.description: Number of months of lease obligations covered by the guaranty. Used for limited and rolling guaranty types where exposure is defined by a time window rather than a fixed dollar amount.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: guarantor_legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the guarantor as stated in the executed guaranty instrument. For corporate guarantors, this is the registered entity name; for individuals, the full legal name as on government-issued ID.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; GDPR Article 4; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: guarantor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantor entity. 'individual' is a natural person; 'corporate_parent' is the tenant's parent company; 'affiliate' is a related entity; 'third_party_entity' is an unrelated corporate guarantor; 'personal' is a principal/owner of the tenant entity providing a personal guarantee.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: guaranty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the guaranty obligation. 'active' indicates the guaranty is in force; 'burned_down' indicates the guaranteed amount has been reduced per schedule; 'enforced' indicates a claim has been made against the guarantor; 'released' indicates the landlord has formally discharged the guarantor.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: guaranty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guaranty structure. 'full' covers all lease obligations for the full term; 'limited' caps exposure by amount or period; 'good_guy' releases guarantor upon tenant vacating and providing notice; 'rolling' covers a fixed rolling window of rent; 'springing' activates only upon a defined trigger event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full|limited|good_guy|rolling|springing|burn_down|completion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: last_financial_statement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently received guarantor financial statement. Used to track compliance with financial reporting covenants and assess current creditworthiness.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; SOX

attributes.name: min_net_worth_covenant
attributes.description: Minimum net worth the guarantor must maintain throughout the guaranty term as a financial covenant condition. Breach of this threshold may constitute a guaranty default or trigger a springing guaranty.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SOX; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, enforcement history narrative, or legal counsel observations regarding this guaranty that do not fit structured fields.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: personal_guarantee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guaranty is a personal guarantee provided by an individual (principal, officer, or owner of the tenant entity) as opposed to a corporate or entity guarantee. Drives different enforcement and credit risk treatment.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the guaranty instrument, typically assigned by DocuSign CLM or Yardi Voyager at execution. Used for cross-system reconciliation and legal document referencing.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landlord formally released the guarantor from all obligations under the guaranty instrument. Populated when guaranty_status transitions to 'released'.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: release_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the formal release of the guarantor. Tracks whether release was triggered by lease expiry, early termination, good-guy clause activation, full burn-down, landlord waiver, or lease assignment to a creditworthy assignee.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: springing_trigger_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the condition(s) that activate a springing guaranty (e.g., tenant credit rating downgrade below investment grade, tenant default on another obligation, change of control). Applicable only when guaranty_type is 'springing'.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this guaranty record in the Silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: yardi_guaranty_ref
attributes.description: Source system reference identifier for this guaranty record in Yardi Voyager. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: replaced_guaranty_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on guaranty (replaced_guaranty_id)

products.name: meter_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between lease agreements and energy meters in sub-metered commercial properties. It captures utility cost allocation, billing responsibility, and CAM reconciliation data. Each record links one lease agreement to one energy meter with allocation percentages, billing periods, and utility type classifications that exist only in the context of this relationship. Supports tenant utility billing, CAM reconciliation, and ESG reporting workflows.. Existence Justification: In sub-metered commercial real estate, one lease agreement can be responsible for multiple utility meters (e.g., electric, gas, water, HVAC serving the leased suite), and one meter can serve multiple lease agreements in shared spaces (e.g., common area HVAC, shared water meters in multi-tenant buildings). Property managers actively manage meter allocations as a distinct business process, configuring allocation percentages, billing periods, and CAM billable flags when leases are executed and updating them during lease modifications or meter reconfigurations.

attributes.name: meter_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the meter allocation record in the lakehouse. Primary key.

attributes.name: energy_meter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the energy meter allocated to this lease agreement
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lease agreement that has billing responsibility for this meter allocation
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the meter_allocation_pct for this lease. Direct = 100% allocation to single tenant. Pro-Rata = allocated based on tenant's proportionate share. Square Footage = allocated based on leased area. Occupancy = allocated based on headcount or usage patterns. Custom = negotiated allocation per lease terms.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the meter allocation. Active allocations drive utility billing. Inactive allocations are historical. Pending allocations are configured but not yet effective. Disputed allocations are under tenant dispute resolution.

attributes.name: billing_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant's billing responsibility for this meter ends under this allocation. Null for active allocations. Used to close out meter allocations when leases expire or when meter configurations change.

attributes.name: billing_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant's billing responsibility for this meter begins under this allocation. May differ from lease commencement if meter allocation is established mid-term or if utility billing is delayed.

attributes.name: cam_billable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether utility consumption from this meter allocation is billable to the tenant as part of Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges or as a direct utility reimbursement. Drives CAM reconciliation and tenant billing workflows. Determined by lease terms (NNN, gross, modified gross) and meter location (common area vs. demised space).

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meter allocation record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: is_primary_meter
attributes.description: Indicates whether this meter is the primary utility meter for this lease agreement for the given utility type. Used to distinguish main suite meters from supplemental or shared meters. Drives default meter selection in utility billing workflows.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meter allocation record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special allocation terms, tenant disputes, meter configuration changes, or other contextual information relevant to this meter allocation. Used by property managers during CAM reconciliation and tenant billing.

attributes.name: pct
attributes.description: The percentage of meter consumption allocated to this lease agreement, expressed as a decimal (0.0000 to 1.0000). Used for shared meters serving multiple tenants (e.g., common area HVAC, shared water meters). Sum of allocation percentages across all leases for a given meter should equal 1.0 for fully allocated meters.

attributes.name: utility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the utility commodity measured by this meter allocation. Drives cost allocation rules, CAM reconciliation logic, and sustainability reporting. Denormalized from energy_meter.meter_type for query performance in billing workflows.

products.name: regulatory_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the applicability relationship between lease agreements and regulatory obligations. It captures which regulatory obligations apply to which lease agreements, when the obligation became applicable, current compliance status, any exemptions granted, and monitoring requirements. Each record links one lease agreement to one regulatory obligation with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific applicability relationship.. Existence Justification: In real estate operations, a single lease agreement is simultaneously subject to multiple regulatory obligations (rent control, fair housing, ADA accessibility, environmental compliance, zoning, fire safety, etc.). Each regulatory obligation applies to many lease agreements across the portfolio. Compliance teams actively manage these applicability relationships, tracking when each obligation became applicable to each lease, monitoring compliance status, documenting exemptions, and scheduling compliance checks at lease-specific frequencies.

attributes.name: regulatory_applicability_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each lease-regulatory obligation applicability record.

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lease agreement record to which this regulatory obligation applies.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lease Regulatory Applicability - Regulatory Obligation Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory obligation that applies to this lease agreement.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: applicability_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this regulatory obligation ceased to apply to this lease agreement (e.g., due to lease expiration, property sale, exemption granted, or regulation superseded). Null if currently applicable.

attributes.name: applicability_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this regulatory obligation became applicable to this specific lease agreement. May differ from the obligation's general effective_date based on lease commencement, property type, or jurisdiction-specific triggers.

attributes.name: assigned_compliance_officer
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the compliance officer responsible for monitoring this specific lease-obligation applicability relationship.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this lease agreement with respect to this specific regulatory obligation. Tracks whether the lease is meeting the requirements of this obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this applicability record was created in the system.

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why this lease agreement is exempt from this regulatory obligation, if applicable. Includes legal basis, grandfathering provisions, or jurisdictional exclusions. Null if no exemption applies.

attributes.name: last_compliance_check_date
attributes.description: The date on which compliance with this obligation was most recently verified for this lease agreement.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which compliance with this obligation must be monitored for this specific lease agreement. May differ from the obligation's general renewal_frequency based on risk level, property type, or lease terms.

attributes.name: next_compliance_check_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next compliance verification must be completed for this lease-obligation combination.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding the applicability of this obligation to this lease, including special circumstances, remediation plans, or audit findings.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this applicability record was last updated.

products.name: enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between lease agreements and compliance programs. It captures the operational reality that a single lease agreement can be enrolled in multiple compliance programs simultaneously (e.g., affordable housing, rent stabilization, LIHTC, green lease certification), and each compliance program covers many lease agreements across the portfolio. Each record links one lease agreement to one compliance program with enrollment-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, including enrollment dates, compliance status, program-specific scores, review schedules, and exemption flags tracked by compliance teams for regulatory reporting and program management.. Existence Justification: In real estate compliance operations, lease agreements are routinely enrolled in multiple compliance programs simultaneously—a single affordable housing lease may be enrolled in HUD Fair Housing, local rent stabilization, LIHTC tax credit, and green lease certification programs at the same time. Each compliance program covers hundreds or thousands of lease agreements across the portfolio. Compliance teams actively manage these enrollments as operational records, tracking enrollment dates, program-specific compliance scores, review schedules, exemptions, and status changes for regulatory reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lease compliance program enrollment record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the enrollment association.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance program in which the lease agreement is enrolled
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lease agreement enrolled in the compliance program
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lease agreement was formally enrolled into the compliance program. Used for program eligibility verification, compliance period calculations, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease enrollment in the compliance program. Values: active (enrolled and compliant), suspended (temporarily non-compliant), terminated (enrollment ended), pending (enrollment in process), exempt (granted exemption). Drives compliance reporting and remediation workflows.

attributes.name: exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease agreement has been granted a formal exemption from certain requirements of this compliance program. TRUE indicates exemption granted (with details typically stored in linked exemption documentation). Used for regulatory reporting and compliance scoring adjustments.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent compliance review or audit of this lease agreement under this compliance program was completed. Used for compliance history tracking and review frequency monitoring.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit of this lease agreement under this specific compliance program. Used for compliance calendar management and proactive monitoring. Distinct from program-level next_review_date which applies to the program as a whole.

attributes.name: program_compliance_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing this specific lease agreement's compliance posture within this specific compliance program. Calculated based on program-specific requirements, assessment results, and remediation status. Distinct from the program-level overall_compliance_score which aggregates across all enrolled leases.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease agreement's enrollment in this compliance program was formally terminated or expired. NULL for active enrollments. Used for historical compliance reporting and program lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Categorical or narrative explanation for why the enrollment was terminated (e.g., lease expired, program requirements no longer applicable, voluntary withdrawal, non-compliance). NULL for active enrollments.

products.name: cam_charge_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between annual CAM reconciliations and individual billable maintenance charges. It captures how specific maintenance charges are included in tenant CAM reconciliation calculations, including the allocation method applied, the pro-rata share used for this specific charge-to-reconciliation pairing, the reconciliation year context, charge inclusion status, and any dispute flags. Each record links one CAM reconciliation to one billable charge with allocation-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship. Critical for CAM audit trails and tenant dispute resolution.. Existence Justification: In real estate CAM reconciliation operations, one annual CAM reconciliation aggregates many individual billable maintenance charges (HVAC repairs, janitorial services, landscaping, etc.) into the tenant's annual expense calculation. Simultaneously, a single billable maintenance charge can be allocated across multiple tenant CAM reconciliations when the charge is part of a shared CAM pool serving multiple tenants in the same building. Property accountants actively manage these allocations, tracking which charges are included in which reconciliations, with what allocation method, pro-rata share, and inclusion status.

attributes.name: cam_charge_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this CAM charge allocation record

attributes.name: billable_charge_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cam Charge Allocation - Maintenance Charge Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific billable maintenance charge being included in this CAM reconciliation
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: cam_schedule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cam Charge Allocation - Lease Cam Reconciliation Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the annual CAM reconciliation record for which this charge is being allocated
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of this charge allocated to this specific tenant reconciliation after applying the pro-rata share and allocation method. Calculated value stored for audit trail and performance.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate this specific charge to the tenant in this reconciliation context. May differ from the general CAM pool allocation method if this is a direct charge or special allocation.

attributes.name: charge_inclusion_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether this charge is included in the final reconciliation calculation. Tracks workflow state from initial inclusion through tenant dispute resolution.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has disputed the inclusion or allocation of this specific charge in this reconciliation. Used to track dispute resolution workflow.

attributes.name: dispute_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing tenant dispute details, property manager response, and resolution outcome for this specific charge allocation.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: If charge_inclusion_status is Excluded, captures the business reason (e.g., 'Capital improvement per lease exclusion', 'Tenant-specific charge', 'Outside reconciliation period').

attributes.name: inclusion_date
attributes.description: Date on which this charge was included in the CAM reconciliation calculation. Used for audit trail and to track when charges were added during reconciliation preparation.

attributes.name: pro_rata_share_applied
attributes.description: The specific pro-rata share percentage applied to this charge for this reconciliation. May differ from the tenant's general pro-rata share if this charge uses a different allocation basis (e.g., HVAC allocated by conditioned space rather than NLA).

attributes.name: reconciliation_year
attributes.description: The reconciliation year context for this allocation. Denormalized from cam_schedule for query performance and to support charges that may be allocated to multiple years (e.g., a December charge split across two reconciliation periods).

products.name: underwriting_input
products.description: This association product represents the underwriting input relationship between executed or comparable lease agreements and development pro forma financial models. It captures which leases inform which pro forma scenarios, the role each lease plays in the underwriting (anchor pre-lease, comparable, in-place for value-add), and the specific financial assumptions derived from each lease. Each record links one lease agreement to one pro forma with attributes that exist only in the context of this underwriting relationship. Critical for investment committee due diligence, lender underwriting packages, and audit trails showing how pro forma rent and occupancy assumptions were derived.. Existence Justification: In real estate development underwriting, a single pro forma scenario references multiple lease agreements as inputs (anchor pre-leases that drive NOI projections, comparable leases that establish market rent benchmarks, and in-place leases for value-add acquisitions). Conversely, a single executed or comparable lease can inform multiple pro forma scenarios across different projects, sensitivity cases (base/upside/downside), or pro forma versions as assumptions evolve. Investment committees and lenders require audit trails showing which leases informed which assumptions, making this a managed operational relationship, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: underwriting_input_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this underwriting input relationship record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lease agreement record that serves as an underwriting input for the pro forma. References the authoritative lease record in the lease domain.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: proforma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the development pro forma record that consumes this lease as an underwriting input. References the financial feasibility model in the development domain.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: assumption_type
attributes.description: The pro forma scenario type for which this lease serves as an input. Base case uses executed leases and conservative comps. Upside scenarios may use aggressive comps or speculative pre-leases. Downside scenarios stress-test with lower comps. Sensitivity scenarios model lease-up risk.

attributes.name: input_date
attributes.description: The date on which this lease was added as an underwriting input to the pro forma. Tracks the evolution of pro forma assumptions as new leases are executed or new comps are identified. Critical for audit trails showing when key assumptions changed.

attributes.name: input_status
attributes.description: The current status of this underwriting input. Active inputs are currently used in pro forma calculations. Superseded inputs were replaced by newer leases or comps but retained for audit history. Excluded inputs were removed due to lease termination, tenant default, or determination that the comp is no longer relevant.

attributes.name: lease_role
attributes.description: The role this lease agreement plays in the pro forma underwriting. Anchor pre-leases drive stabilized NOI projections and lender confidence. Comparable leases establish market rent benchmarks. In-place leases represent existing cash flow for value-add or acquisition pro formas. Shadow anchors are signed LOIs not yet executed. Credit tenant comps validate cap rate assumptions.

attributes.name: occupancy_assumption_pct
attributes.description: The stabilized occupancy percentage assumption informed by this lease. For anchor pre-leases, contributes to committed occupancy. For in-place leases, reflects current occupancy. For comparables, informs market occupancy benchmarks. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 for 95% occupancy).

attributes.name: rent_assumption_psf
attributes.description: The annual rent per square foot assumption derived from this lease and applied to the pro forma revenue projection. For anchor pre-leases, this is the contracted base_rent_psf_annual. For comparables, this may be adjusted for location, tenant credit, lease term, or TI differences. Expressed in USD per square foot per year.

attributes.name: underwriter_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the underwriting team explaining why this lease was selected as an input, any adjustments made to derive assumptions, and any caveats or risks associated with relying on this lease. Critical for investment committee due diligence and lender underwriting packages.

products.name: lease_representation
products.description: This association product represents the brokerage representation relationship between a lease agreement and a broker. It captures which brokers represented which parties in a lease transaction, their commission arrangements, and their specific role in the deal. Each record links one lease agreement to one broker with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific representation engagement.. Existence Justification: In real estate brokerage operations, a single lease agreement routinely involves multiple brokers representing different parties (landlord-side broker, tenant-side broker, and potentially co-brokers on either side). Each broker handles many lease agreements throughout their career. The business actively manages these representation relationships as distinct operational records, tracking each broker's side, commission split, role, and payment status for every deal.

attributes.name: lease_representation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lease_representation

attributes.name: brokerage_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broker who provided representation services in this lease transaction.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lease agreement that this broker represented a party in.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: representation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this broker representation record in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: The total commission amount earned by this broker for this specific lease representation, calculated based on commission_split_pct and the total lease commission. Contributes to the broker's GCI metrics.

attributes.name: commission_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the commission for this representation was paid to the broker. Used for cash flow tracking and commission reconciliation.

attributes.name: commission_split_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the total lease commission allocated to this specific broker for this representation. Used for commission calculation and GCI tracking. Sum of all commission_split_pct values for a given agreement_id should equal 100% (or the agreed split structure).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this broker's representation engagement became effective for this lease transaction. Typically the date the broker engagement letter was signed or the listing agreement was executed.

attributes.name: engagement_letter_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal broker engagement letter or representation agreement was signed for this specific lease transaction. Required for compliance and commission dispute resolution.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The specific role this broker played in the lease transaction. Lead broker is the primary relationship owner, co-broker shares responsibility, junior agent assists under supervision, referral agent provided the lead but did not execute the transaction.

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: Indicates which party the broker represented in this lease transaction. Landlord-side brokers represent the lessor, tenant-side brokers represent the lessee, dual agency represents both (where legally permitted), and co-broker indicates multiple brokers on the same side.

products.name: collateral_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the collateral assignment relationship between lease agreements and debt facilities in real estate finance. It captures the legal and operational assignment of lease rents as collateral security for debt instruments. Each record links one lease agreement to one debt facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this collateral relationship, including assignment dates, recording status, lender consent requirements, and subordination hierarchy.. Existence Justification: In commercial real estate finance, a single debt facility is routinely collateralized by multiple lease agreements (assignment of rents across all tenants on a property or portfolio), and a single lease agreement can be assigned as collateral to multiple debt facilities simultaneously (e.g., senior mortgage + mezzanine debt, or across refinancing events where subordination agreements preserve junior lender positions). Lenders actively manage these collateral assignments as distinct operational records with legal recording requirements, subordination hierarchies, consent workflows, and collateral coverage calculations.

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_id

products.name: coverage_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the insurance coverage requirement relationship between lease agreements and insurance policies. It captures the specific insurance compliance obligations that each lease agreement imposes, and tracks which policies satisfy those requirements. Each record links one lease agreement to one insurance policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship, including the type of coverage required by the lease, the minimum coverage limits mandated, compliance status, and verification dates.. Existence Justification: In real estate lease administration, a single lease agreement routinely requires multiple types of insurance coverage (general liability, property, workers compensation, umbrella, and specialty coverages like flood or terrorism), and each of these requirements may be satisfied by a different policy. Conversely, a single blanket insurance policy—particularly master property policies or portfolio-wide general liability policies—commonly covers multiple lease agreements across a property portfolio. Lease administrators actively manage this many-to-many relationship by tracking compliance status, verifying coverage limits against lease requirements, maintaining certificates of insurance, and monitoring expiration dates for each lease-policy pairing.

attributes.name: arms_length_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deed transfer was conducted as an arm's-length transaction between unrelated parties acting in their own self-interest. Non-arm's-length transfers (e.g., family transfers, related-party transactions) are excluded from comparable sales analysis and CAP rate benchmarking.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: Official deed book or liber number assigned by the county recorder where the deed instrument is physically or digitally filed. Used in conjunction with page number for precise title search reference.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the real estate transaction closed, funds were disbursed, and possession transferred. Typically the same as or immediately preceding the recording date. Used for financial period recognition under FASB ASC 606 and for REIT reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) — REIT Reporting; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary consideration (purchase price) stated on the deed instrument, representing the gross sale price paid by the grantee to the grantor. Used as the basis for transfer tax calculation, CAP rate analysis, and PSF pricing benchmarks. May differ from assessed value.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: costar_comp_code
attributes.description: CoStar Suite comparable sale record identifier linked to this deed transfer. Enables integration with CoStar's commercial real estate analytics platform for PSF benchmarking, CAP rate analysis, and market trend reporting.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction where the property is located (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international portfolio management and FIRPTA foreign seller withholding compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — FIRPTA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deed transfer record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: deed_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deed instrument conveying ownership. Warranty deeds provide full title guarantees; quitclaim deeds convey only the grantor's interest without warranty; trustee deeds arise from foreclosure or trust sales; special warranty deeds limit the grantor's warranty to the period of their ownership. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warranty|special_warranty|quitclaim|trustee|grant|bargain_and_sale|sheriff|tax — promote to reference product if additional types required]
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Uniform Commercial Code (UCC); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Official document number assigned by the county recorder or registrar of deeds upon recording. Used as the primary external reference for title searches and ALTA title commitments.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: earnest_money_amount
attributes.description: Amount of earnest money deposit paid by the buyer (grantee) at the time of the purchase agreement execution, applied toward the consideration at closing. Tracked for deal economics reconciliation and escrow management.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: exchange_1031_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deed transfer is part of a tax-deferred like-kind exchange under IRC Section 1031. When true, the transaction is subject to strict identification and exchange period deadlines and requires qualified intermediary documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — IRC Section 1031; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grantor signed and executed the deed instrument, which may precede the recording date. Relevant for determining the effective date of conveyance and for 1031 exchange identification period calculations.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — IRC Section 1031; American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: foreclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deed transfer resulted from a foreclosure proceeding (e.g., sheriff's deed, trustee's deed upon sale). Distinct from REO flag — foreclosure flag marks the transfer event itself, while REO flag marks lender-owned status.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: grantee_entity_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the grantee. Used for ownership structure analysis, REIT compliance reporting, and AML/KYC beneficial ownership tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|llc|trust|partnership|government|reit|estate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) — REIT Reporting; FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Rule; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: grantee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the grantee (buyer/transferee) as it appears on the recorded deed instrument. May be an individual, corporation, trust, LLC, REIT, or other legal entity. Used for ownership records and investor reporting.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: grantor_entity_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the grantor. Determines applicable transfer tax exemptions, 1031 exchange eligibility, and FIRPTA withholding requirements for foreign sellers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|llc|trust|partnership|government|reit|estate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — FIRPTA; IRC Section 1031; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: Sequential instrument or reception number assigned by the recorder's office at the time of recording, distinct from the document number in jurisdictions that use both. Provides an alternative lookup key for title searches.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the real property as it appears on the recorded deed, including metes and bounds, lot and block, or government survey description. Defines the exact parcel boundaries conveyed and is required for ALTA title insurance commitments.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio at the time of the deed transfer, calculated as the mortgage loan amount divided by the consideration amount. Key underwriting metric for CMBS, RMBS, and lender risk assessment. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 = 75%).
attributes.references: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA); CMBS/RMBS Underwriting Standards; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: mls_transaction_code
attributes.description: Transaction identifier from the Multiple Listing Service (MLS) system associated with this deed transfer. Enables cross-referencing with MLS comparable sales data and CoStar Suite for market analytics and CMA reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR) — MLS Policy

attributes.name: mortgage_amount
attributes.description: Principal amount of the mortgage or deed of trust loan recorded concurrently with the deed transfer. Used for LTV calculation, DSCR analysis, and CMBS/RMBS portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA); FASB ASC 310; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: notary_commission_expiry
attributes.description: Expiration date of the notary public's commission at the time of deed execution. Validates that the notarization was performed by a duly commissioned notary, which is required for deed recordability.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); State Notary Statutes

attributes.name: notary_name
attributes.description: Name of the notary public who acknowledged the grantor's signature on the deed instrument. Required for deed validity in most US jurisdictions and referenced in ALTA title review.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); State Notary Statutes

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Page number within the deed book where the recorded deed instrument begins. Together with book number, provides the complete recorder's reference citation for chain-of-title research.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: price_per_sqf
attributes.description: Sale price expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis, calculated as consideration amount divided by the property's gross leasable area (GLA) or building area. Key metric for comparable sales analysis (CMA), CoStar benchmarking, and investment underwriting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deed was officially recorded with the county recorder or registrar of deeds. This date establishes constructive notice of the ownership transfer and is the legally operative date for title chain-of-title purposes.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee paid to the county recorder or registrar of deeds for the official recording of the deed instrument. Included in closing cost reconciliation and CAPEX tracking for acquisition cost basis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 805 Business Combinations

attributes.name: recording_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the county, parish, or municipality where the deed was recorded (e.g., 'Los Angeles County, CA'). Determines applicable transfer tax rates, recording requirements, and the governing recorder's office for title searches.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: reo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deed transfer involves a Real Estate Owned (REO) property — real property acquired by a lender through foreclosure. REO transactions require special handling for CMBS reporting and distressed asset analytics.
attributes.references: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this deed transfer record was ingested (e.g., Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, Argus Enterprise, CoStar Suite, or manual entry). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Data Lineage; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state (or equivalent jurisdiction) code where the property is located and the deed was recorded. Used for state-level transfer tax calculation, regulatory compliance, and geographic portfolio segmentation.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: title_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the title insurance company or title agency that conducted the closing, issued the ALTA title commitment, and facilitated the deed recording. Used for vendor management and title claim tracking.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deed transfer. Pending indicates the deed has been executed but not yet submitted for recording; Recorded confirms the county recorder has accepted and stamped the instrument; Rejected indicates the recorder returned the deed for correction; Voided indicates the transfer was rescinded prior to recording.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total real estate transfer tax (also known as deed tax, documentary stamp tax, or conveyance tax) paid at closing, as recorded on the deed or closing statement. Calculated based on consideration amount and applicable state/county tax rates. Required for SOX financial controls and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); State Revenue Authorities; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the ownership transfer. Sale indicates a market-rate conveyance; Gift and Inheritance indicate non-monetary transfers; Exchange covers 1031 like-kind exchanges; Intra-entity covers transfers between related legal entities; Court Order covers judicial transfers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sale|gift|inheritance|foreclosure|exchange|intra_entity|court_order|partition — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deed transfer record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: vesting_type
attributes.description: Form of title vesting under which the grantee takes ownership (e.g., sole ownership, joint tenancy with right of survivorship, tenancy in common, community property, trust, or entity ownership). Determines ownership rights, survivorship, and disposition requirements.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: amortization_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months over which the loan principal is amortized for payment calculation purposes. May differ from the loan term for balloon loans.

attributes.name: amortization_type
attributes.description: Describes the repayment structure of the loan — fully amortizing (principal and interest), interest-only (IO), partial interest-only period followed by amortization, or balloon payment at maturity.

attributes.name: annual_debt_service
attributes.description: Total annual principal and interest payment obligation under the loan. Used as the denominator in DSCR calculations and for NOI/cash flow analysis in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: collateral_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the collateral pledged to secure the loan, including property address, legal description, or portfolio of properties for cross-collateralized loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: commitment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lender issued a formal loan commitment letter, binding the lender to provide financing subject to conditions precedent. Key milestone in the transaction timeline.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financing record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Ratio of the property's Net Operating Income (NOI) to annual debt service obligations at origination. A DSCR below 1.0 indicates insufficient income to cover debt payments; critical for CMBS underwriting and covenant compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards; SEC; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: escrow_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender requires the borrower to maintain an escrow account for property taxes, insurance, and/or capital reserves as a condition of the loan.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; HUD; RESPA

attributes.name: escrow_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Total amount held in escrow reserve accounts (taxes, insurance, capital reserves) as required by the lender at the time of reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; HUD; RESPA; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: extension_option_count
attributes.description: Number of extension options available to the borrower to extend the loan maturity beyond the initial term, subject to conditions. Common in bridge and construction loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: extension_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of each extension option available to the borrower. Multiplied by extension_option_count to determine maximum extended loan term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: financing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the financing arrangement. Tracks progression from initial commitment through funding, assumption of existing debt, full payoff, or cancellation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Yardi Voyager Debt Module

attributes.name: first_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first scheduled debt service payment (principal and/or interest) is due under the loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Yardi Voyager Debt Module

attributes.name: funding_date
attributes.description: Date on which loan proceeds were disbursed to the borrower or escrow at closing. May differ from origination date for construction loans with draw schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: index_rate_type
attributes.description: Benchmark interest rate index to which the floating rate is pegged for ARM or floating-rate loans (e.g., SOFR, Prime, Treasury). Null for fixed-rate instruments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Federal Reserve; ISDA

attributes.name: interest_only_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months at the start of the loan term during which only interest payments are required, with no principal amortization. Applicable to IO and partial-IO loan structures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applicable to the loan at origination, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.065 = 6.5%). For ARM loans, this represents the initial rate; see also spread and index fields.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; FASB ASC 842; Federal Reserve Regulation Z

attributes.name: is_assumption
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financing record represents the assumption of existing seller debt rather than new origination. True when the buyer assumes the seller's existing loan at closing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lending institution, bank, insurance company, debt fund, or government agency providing the financing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: lien_position
attributes.description: Priority position of the lender's lien on the collateral property. First lien has senior claim; mezzanine and subordinate positions carry higher risk and typically higher rates.
attributes.references: ALTA; FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Original principal amount of the loan at origination or assumption, expressed in the transaction currency. Used in LTV, DSCR, and debt service calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; IVSC; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned loan reference number issued by the lender or servicer, used for cross-referencing with lender systems and CMBS/RMBS reporting.
attributes.references: CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: loan_term_months
attributes.description: Contractual duration of the loan from origination to maturity date, expressed in months. Distinct from amortization period for balloon and IO structures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Yardi Voyager Debt Module

attributes.name: loan_to_cost_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the loan amount to the total project cost, used primarily for construction and development financing to assess lender exposure relative to total development spend.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Procore; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: loan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the financing instrument by structure and purpose (e.g., ARM, FRM, CMBS, bridge, construction, mezzanine, CMBS, RMBS, HUD, SBA 504). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ARM|FRM|CMBS|RMBS|bridge|construction|mezzanine|HUD|SBA_504|hard_money — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards; HUD; SEC

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the loan amount to the appraised or purchase value of the property at origination, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.65 = 65% LTV). Key underwriting metric for lenders and investors.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Appraisal Institute; IVSC; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Contractual date on which the outstanding loan balance is due in full. Critical for refinancing planning, portfolio management, and WALE/WALT analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise; MRI Software

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the loan was formally originated and the loan agreement was executed. Serves as the start date for interest accrual and amortization schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: origination_fee_amount
attributes.description: Upfront fee charged by the lender at loan origination, expressed as a dollar amount. Included in closing cost analysis and CAPEX tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: origination_fee_pct
attributes.description: Origination fee expressed as a percentage of the loan amount (e.g., 0.01 = 1 point). Used alongside the dollar amount for benchmarking and deal economics analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid principal balance of the loan as of the most recent reporting date. Used for portfolio-level debt tracking and DSCR monitoring.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Yardi Voyager Debt Module; MRI Software

attributes.name: pmi_monthly_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) Monthly Premium Amount
attributes.description: Monthly PMI premium amount payable when PMI is required. Null when pmi_required is False.
attributes.references: HUD; Federal Reserve Regulation Z

attributes.name: pmi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) is required for this loan, typically triggered when LTV exceeds 80% on residential transactions.
attributes.references: HUD; Federal Reserve Regulation Z; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_type
attributes.description: Type of prepayment restriction or penalty applicable to the loan. Defeasance and yield maintenance are common in CMBS structures; step-down schedules are typical in agency loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards; SEC

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose of the financing — whether it supports a new acquisition, refinancing of existing debt, construction draw facility, assumption of seller debt, bridge to permanent financing, or equity recapture.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise; MRI Software

attributes.name: rate_spread
attributes.description: Margin or spread added to the benchmark index rate to determine the all-in floating interest rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0225 = 225 basis points). Applicable to ARM and floating-rate loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan carries a fixed rate (FRM), floating/variable rate (ARM), or hybrid structure (fixed for an initial period then floating).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Federal Reserve Regulation Z

attributes.name: recourse_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan is full recourse (lender can pursue borrower assets beyond the collateral), non-recourse (limited to collateral), or partial recourse with carve-outs. Critical for risk assessment and REIT compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SEC; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: servicer_name
attributes.description: Name of the loan servicer responsible for collecting payments and managing the loan on behalf of the lender or CMBS trust, which may differ from the originating lender.
attributes.references: CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards; SEC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this financing record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000
