attributes.name: boot_amount
attributes.description: Total boot received in the exchange — any non-like-kind property or cash received that does not qualify for tax deferral. Includes cash boot (net cash received) and mortgage boot (net debt relief). Boot triggers immediate taxable gain recognition.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(b); IRS Form 8824 Part III; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1

attributes.name: boot_type
attributes.description: Classification of boot received in the exchange: none (fully deferred), cash (net cash received), mortgage_relief (net debt reduction), or mixed (combination of cash and mortgage relief). Determines the nature of taxable gain recognition.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(b); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1; IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this 1031 exchange record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: deferred_gain
attributes.description: The portion of realized gain deferred for tax purposes under IRS Section 1031 — calculated as realized gain minus recognized gain. This deferred gain reduces the tax basis of the replacement property and is recognized upon future disposition.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(d); IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRC Section 1245/1250 recapture

attributes.name: exchange_agreement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal exchange agreement was executed between the taxpayer and the Qualified Intermediary (QI). Must be entered into before the taxpayer transfers the relinquished property to qualify as a valid delayed exchange.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); IRS Form 8824; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: exchange_closing_deadline
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated deadline by which the taxpayer must close on the replacement property — exactly 180 calendar days from the relinquished property closing date (or the due date of the tax return, whichever is earlier). Failure disqualifies the exchange.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(3)(B); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(c)

attributes.name: exchange_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the 1031 exchange transaction, typically assigned by the Qualified Intermediary (QI) or internal deal tracking system. Used for cross-referencing with QI documentation and IRS Form 8824 filings.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824; Yardi Voyager Transaction Module

attributes.name: exchange_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the 1031 exchange transaction. Tracks progression from initiation through identification period, replacement property acquisition, and final IRS compliance determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|identification_period|replacement_pending|completed|failed|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Classification of the 1031 exchange structure: simultaneous (same-day swap), delayed (Starker exchange with QI), reverse (replacement acquired before relinquishment), or improvement/construction (build-to-suit exchange). Determines applicable IRS deadlines and QI escrow requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Revenue Procedure 2000-37 (reverse exchanges); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: form_8824_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 8824 (Like-Kind Exchanges) has been filed with the IRS for this exchange transaction. Required for all 1031 exchanges in the tax year of the relinquished property transfer.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Section 1031; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: form_8824_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which IRS Form 8824 was filed with the IRS for this exchange. Used for compliance tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Section 1031

attributes.name: identification_deadline
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated deadline by which the taxpayer must identify potential replacement properties — exactly 45 calendar days from the relinquished property closing date. Failure to meet this deadline disqualifies the exchange.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(3)(A); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(b)

attributes.name: identification_rule
attributes.description: The IRS identification rule elected by the taxpayer for designating replacement properties: three_property (up to 3 properties regardless of value), two_hundred_percent (any number of properties with combined FMV ≤ 200% of relinquished FMV), or ninety_five_percent (any number if 95% of total FMV is actually acquired).
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(c)(4); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the 1031 exchange was formally initiated, typically the closing date of the relinquished property sale. This date anchors the 45-day identification deadline and 180-day closing deadline under IRS rules.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1

attributes.name: irs_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current IRS compliance determination for the 1031 exchange: pending (exchange in progress), compliant (all IRS requirements met), non_compliant (deadline missed or disqualifying event), or under_review (IRS audit or inquiry in progress).
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: like_kind_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether both the relinquished and replacement properties have been confirmed as qualifying like-kind real property under IRS Section 1031. Must be True for the exchange to qualify for tax deferral.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(1); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(a)-1; IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special circumstances, legal counsel notes, or operational remarks related to the 1031 exchange. Examples include reverse exchange parking arrangements, improvement exchange construction details, or IRS correspondence notes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Transaction Module; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: qi_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account or escrow account number held by the Qualified Intermediary (QI) where exchange proceeds from the relinquished property sale are deposited and held pending acquisition of the replacement property.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: qi_fund_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of exchange proceeds held by the Qualified Intermediary (QI) in escrow. Tracks available funds for replacement property acquisition. Decreases as replacement property closings occur.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); Yardi Voyager GL Module

attributes.name: qi_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Qualified Intermediary (QI) — the independent third party that holds exchange proceeds and facilitates the transfer to prevent constructive receipt by the taxpayer. Required for delayed, reverse, and improvement exchanges.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: realized_gain
attributes.description: Total economic gain realized on the relinquished property sale, calculated as the amount realized (sale price minus selling expenses) less the adjusted tax basis. Represents the total gain before deferral. Reported on IRS Form 8824 Part III.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRC Section 1001; IRS Publication 544

attributes.name: recognized_gain
attributes.description: Portion of the realized gain that is taxable in the current tax year — equal to the lesser of the realized gain or the boot received. If no boot is received, recognized gain is zero. Reported on IRS Form 8824 Part III.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(b); IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRC Section 1001

attributes.name: relinquished_adjusted_basis
attributes.description: The taxpayer's adjusted cost basis in the relinquished property at the time of exchange, accounting for original acquisition cost, capital improvements, and accumulated depreciation. Critical input for deferred gain calculation on IRS Form 8824.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRS Publication 544; IRC Section 1012

attributes.name: relinquished_closing_date
attributes.description: The actual closing/settlement date on which the relinquished property was transferred to the buyer. This is the trigger date for the 45-day and 180-day IRS exchange deadlines.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824 Part I; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: relinquished_mortgage_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding mortgage or debt balance on the relinquished property at the time of closing. Mortgage relief received by the taxpayer is treated as boot received and may trigger taxable gain recognition.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1(c)

attributes.name: relinquished_property_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the relinquished (down-leg) property being exchanged. Captured directly on the exchange record for IRS Form 8824 reporting and audit trail purposes, independent of the property master record.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part I; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: relinquished_sale_price
attributes.description: Gross sale price received for the relinquished property at closing, as reported on the settlement statement. Used as the basis for deferred gain calculation and boot determination on IRS Form 8824.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; FASB ASC 840/842; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: replacement_basis
attributes.description: The carryover tax basis assigned to the replacement property after the exchange, calculated as the replacement property's cost minus the deferred gain. This basis is used for future depreciation calculations and gain recognition upon eventual sale.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(d); IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRS Publication 544

attributes.name: replacement_closing_date
attributes.description: The actual closing/settlement date on which the replacement property was acquired. Must occur on or before the 180-day exchange closing deadline to qualify for tax deferral.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(3)(B); IRS Form 8824 Part II; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: replacement_mortgage_balance
attributes.description: New mortgage or debt assumed on the replacement property at acquisition. Mortgage assumed by the taxpayer offsets boot received from mortgage relief on the relinquished property in the net boot calculation.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1(c)

attributes.name: replacement_property_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the primary replacement (up-leg) property acquired in the exchange. Captured directly on the exchange record for IRS Form 8824 reporting and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part II; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: replacement_property_count
attributes.description: Number of replacement properties formally identified within the 45-day identification period. Must comply with the elected identification rule (e.g., maximum 3 under the three-property rule). Used for IRS compliance validation.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(c); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: replacement_purchase_price
attributes.description: Gross purchase price paid for the replacement property at closing. Must equal or exceed the relinquished property sale price for full gain deferral. Used in boot calculation and IRS Form 8824 Part III reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: selling_expenses
attributes.description: Total transaction costs incurred in selling the relinquished property, including brokerage commissions, title fees, legal fees, and transfer taxes. Reduces the amount realized for gain calculation purposes on IRS Form 8824.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; ALTA Settlement Statement; IRS Publication 544

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The IRS tax year in which the 1031 exchange is reported on Form 8824. Typically the year in which the relinquished property was transferred. Used for tax filing and financial period alignment.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Publication 544; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: taxpayer_ein
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) of the entity executing the exchange. Required for IRS Form 8824 filing and tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Section 6109; GDPR Article 4 (for EU entities)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this 1031 exchange record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data synchronization with source systems (Yardi Voyager, MRI Software).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Transaction Module

attributes.name: disposition_status

attributes.name: foreclosure_date

attributes.name: list_date

attributes.name: list_price

attributes.name: loan_number

attributes.name: loss_severity_amount

attributes.name: loss_severity_pct

attributes.name: ltv_ratio_at_origination
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value ratio at the time of original mortgage origination, providing context for underwriting quality and loss exposure analysis.
attributes.references: OCC Real Estate Lending Standards; FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount

attributes.name: outstanding_loan_balance

attributes.name: price_reduction_count

attributes.name: reo_acquisition_date

attributes.name: repair_cost_estimate

attributes.name: sale_price_psf

attributes.name: title_cleared

attributes.name: earnest_money_due_date

attributes.name: escalation_ceiling_price

attributes.name: escalation_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer contains an escalation clause that automatically increases the offer price above competing offers up to a defined ceiling. Critical for multi-offer scenario management.

attributes.name: escalation_increment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount by which the offer price will automatically escalate above a competing offer when an escalation clause is active. Null when escalation_clause_flag is false.

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: financing_contingency_amount
attributes.description: The maximum loan amount the buyer is seeking to finance. If the buyer cannot secure financing up to this amount, the contingency allows withdrawal without forfeiting earnest money. Supports LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_contingency_days

products.name: escrow_account

Each fund event records date, payee/payor, amount, payment method, reference number, authorization status, and release conditions. Provides a complete audit trail from account opening through final disbursement. Integrates with Yardi Voyager AP/AR for trust account reconciliation.

products.name: sale_attribution
products.description: This association product represents the multi-touch marketing attribution between property sales and marketing campaigns. It captures the contribution of each campaign to a completed property sale, enabling ROI analysis and marketing effectiveness measurement. Each record links one property_sale to one campaign with attribution metrics that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In real estate marketing operations, a single property sale is routinely attributed to multiple marketing campaigns through multi-touch attribution models (e.g., awareness campaign, retargeting campaign, open house promotion, MLS syndication). Conversely, a single campaign drives multiple property sales across its lifecycle. Marketing teams actively manage and analyze these attribution relationships to calculate campaign ROI, optimize budget allocation, and measure marketing effectiveness. This is an operational business process, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: sale_attribution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each property sale to campaign attribution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign receiving attribution credit
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: lead_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead record that connected this campaign to the eventual buyer. Enables tracing attribution back to specific lead generation events.

attributes.name: property_sale_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the property sale transaction being attributed to marketing efforts
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: attributed_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the property sale revenue credited to this campaign, calculated as purchase_price × attribution_weight. Used for campaign ROI calculation. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: attribution_confidence_score
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level (0.00 to 1.00) in the accuracy of this attribution assignment, based on data quality, touchpoint tracking completeness, and model certainty. Lower scores indicate probabilistic attribution.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: The attribution methodology used to calculate attribution_weight for this record. Values: linear (equal credit), time_decay (recency-weighted), position_based (40/20/40), first_touch (100% to first), last_touch (100% to last), custom (proprietary algorithm). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: attribution_weight
attributes.description: Proportional credit assigned to this campaign for the property sale, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1. Sum of all attribution_weight values for a single property_sale_id should equal 1.0 in multi-touch attribution models. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: campaign_role
attributes.description: Classification of the campaign's role in the buyer journey leading to the sale. Values: first_touch (initial awareness), last_touch (final conversion driver), mid_touch (nurture), assist (supporting touchpoint), direct (single-touch attribution). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this attribution record was created in the system, typically after the property sale closed and attribution analysis was performed.

attributes.name: touch_date
attributes.description: Date on which the buyer interacted with this campaign (ad impression, email open, event attendance, listing view). Used for time-decay attribution models and journey timeline reconstruction.

attributes.name: touch_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this campaign touchpoint in the buyer journey leading to the sale (1 = first touch, 2 = second touch, etc.). Used to reconstruct the full marketing journey and apply position-based attribution models. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system process that created this attribution record (e.g., marketing_analytics_etl, user_id_12345).

attributes.name: beneficial_ownership_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of beneficial ownership held by this entity in the associated investment vehicle or property. Used for FinCEN reporting (25% threshold rule), equity distribution calculations, and waterfall modeling. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 = 25%).
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR 1010.230); SEC Regulation D; FASB ASC 323

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the owner record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the authoritative audit trail creation marker for data governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: distribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which investment distributions (income and/or return of capital) are made to the owner entity. Drives cash flow scheduling in Yardi Voyager AR module and investor reporting cycles.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation S-K; REIT distribution requirements (IRC Section 857)

attributes.name: distribution_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for receiving investment distributions. Wire Transfer = international/domestic wire; ACH = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; Check = paper check; DRIP = Distribution Reinvestment Plan (reinvest distributions into additional units).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; NACHA Operating Rules; IRC Section 857

attributes.name: domicile_state
attributes.description: State or province of legal domicile or incorporation for the owner entity. Used for state-level tax compliance, regulatory filings, and jurisdictional reporting. Expressed as ISO 3166-2 subdivision code where applicable.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; IRS Publication 515; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Legal classification of the owner entity. Determines applicable regulatory, tax, and reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|partnership|trust|reit|sovereign_wealth_fund|family_office|joint_venture|llc|government_entity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; FASB ASC 946; IRS Publication 541

attributes.name: esg_mandate_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Mandate Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity has a formal ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) investment mandate requiring portfolio properties to meet specific sustainability criteria (e.g., LEED, BREEAM certifications). True = ESG mandate in place; False = no formal ESG requirement.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; BREEAM; GRESB Real Estate Assessment; SEC ESG Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: fatca_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Status
attributes.description: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act) classification of the owner entity. US Person = US citizen/resident/entity; FFI = Foreign Financial Institution; NFFE = Non-Financial Foreign Entity; Exempt = exempt from FATCA reporting; Unknown = not yet determined. Drives IRS Form W-8/W-9 requirements.
attributes.references: FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); IRS Form W-8BEN-E; OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS)

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence process for the owner entity. Required for AML compliance and investor onboarding. Tracks whether identity verification, beneficial ownership disclosure, and sanctions screening have been completed.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR 1010.230); GDPR Article 6; USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC verification was last successfully completed and approved for this owner entity. Used to track compliance currency and trigger periodic re-verification workflows.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR 1010.230); USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the owner or investor entity as registered with the relevant government authority. For individuals, this is the full legal name; for entities, this is the registered corporate or trust name. Used as the authoritative identity label across all portfolio records.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: 20-character alphanumeric Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code assigned by a GLEIF-accredited Local Operating Unit. Required for institutional investors and publicly traded REITs for regulatory reporting and counterparty identification in financial transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 17442; GLEIF (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation); SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: mailing_address_city
attributes.description: City component of the owner entity's primary mailing address. Used in conjunction with state and postal code for address validation and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the owner entity's primary mailing address. Determines applicable postal regulations, cross-border tax withholding, and FATCA/CRS reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the owner entity's primary mailing address, including street number and street name. Used for legal notices, distribution checks, K-1 tax forms, and investor correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards; ALTA

attributes.name: offboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the owner entity was formally offboarded or terminated from the platform, following full disposition of holdings and settlement of obligations. Null if the owner is still active.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); SOX Section 802

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the owner entity was formally onboarded and activated in the platform, completing all KYC, AML, and documentation requirements. Marks the start of the active relationship lifecycle.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; GDPR Article 5; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the owner entity within the platform. Drives access controls, KYC compliance gating, and operational workflows in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software. Pending = KYC in progress; Active = fully onboarded; Suspended = compliance hold; Inactive = no current holdings; Terminated = relationship ended.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; FinCEN AML/KYC Guidelines; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: owner_class
attributes.description: High-level investor classification used for portfolio segmentation, AUM (Assets Under Management) reporting, and investment advisory targeting. Distinguishes institutional investors from private individuals, public REITs, family offices, and sovereign wealth funds.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); NCREIF; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: politically_exposed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity or its beneficial owners are classified as Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) — individuals who hold or have held prominent public positions. True = PEP identified; False = no PEP association. Triggers enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements under AML regulations.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; USA PATRIOT Act Section 312

attributes.name: preferred_asset_classes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of real estate asset classes preferred by the owner for investment (e.g., office, retail, multifamily, industrial, hospitality, mixed-use). Used for deal matching, investment advisory targeting, and portfolio strategy alignment in Argus Enterprise and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); NCREIF Property Index; MSCI Real Estate

attributes.name: preferred_hold_period_years
attributes.description: Owner's stated preferred investment hold period in years. Used for portfolio strategy alignment, DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) modeling in Argus Enterprise, and WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) matching during acquisition underwriting.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); Appraisal Institute; NCREIF

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for official communications with the owner entity. Used for investor reporting, distribution notices, KYC correspondence, and portal access credentials. Sourced from Yardi Voyager and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the owner entity, stored in E.164 international format. Used for investor relations, KYC verification callbacks, and urgent operational communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: qualified_purchaser_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity qualifies as a qualified purchaser under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (Section 2(a)(51)), typically requiring $5M+ in investments. Determines eligibility for Section 3(c)(7) fund offerings.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940 Section 2(a)(51); SEC Release IC-22597

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or incorporation number issued by the relevant government authority (e.g., Secretary of State, Companies House). Used to verify legal existence and cross-reference with public registries. Applicable to corporations, LLCs, partnerships, and trusts.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; National Association of Realtors (NAR); ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)

attributes.name: risk_tolerance
attributes.description: Owner's stated investment risk tolerance profile, aligned with standard CRE (Commercial Real Estate) investment strategy classifications. Core = low risk/stable income; Core Plus = moderate risk; Value Add = higher risk/repositioning; Opportunistic = highest risk/development. Used in Argus Enterprise for portfolio strategy modeling.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); NCREIF; INREV Investment Style Classification

attributes.name: sanctions_screened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity has been screened against OFAC SDN (Specially Designated Nationals) list, EU sanctions lists, and other applicable sanctions databases. True = screening completed with no match; False = not yet screened or match found requiring review.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; USA PATRIOT Act; EU Sanctions Regulation; FinCEN AML Guidelines

attributes.name: target_cap_rate_pct
attributes.description: Owner's stated target Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) for property acquisitions, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.50 = 5.5%). Used for deal screening and investment underwriting in Argus Enterprise. CAP Rate = NOI / Property Value.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: target_irr_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Percentage
attributes.description: Owner's stated minimum target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) hurdle rate for investment decisions, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.00 = 12%). Used in Argus Enterprise for deal screening, investment committee approvals, and portfolio performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity holds tax-exempt status (e.g., pension funds, endowments, sovereign wealth funds, charitable organizations). True = tax-exempt; False = taxable entity. Affects UBTI (Unrelated Business Taxable Income) calculations and withholding tax obligations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 501(c); IRC Section 892 (sovereign wealth funds); IRS Publication 598

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of tax identification number stored in tax_id. Determines applicable IRS reporting forms and withholding rules. EIN = Employer Identification Number; SSN = Social Security Number; TIN = Tax Identification Number (generic); ITIN = Individual Taxpayer Identification Number.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474)

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the owner entity. For US entities: Employer Identification Number (EIN) for corporations/partnerships or Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals. For non-US entities: equivalent Tax Identification Number (TIN). Used for IRS 1099 reporting, withholding tax, and FATCA compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Operating or trade name (Doing Business As) used by the owner entity in commercial dealings, if different from the legal name. Common for partnerships, family offices, and REITs operating under a brand name.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the owner record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: yardi_entity_code
attributes.description: Source system entity code assigned to this owner in Yardi Voyager. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the silver layer master registry and the Yardi Voyager operational system of record. Enables traceability back to the source.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Data Dictionary; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

products.name: owner_contact
products.description: Contact information records for owner entities — primary and secondary contacts, mailing addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, preferred communication channels, and contact role types (primary, legal, financial, operational). Supports multi-contact hierarchies for institutional owners with multiple authorized representatives.

attributes.name: owner_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each owner contact record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the owner_contact data product.
attributes.references: ISO 11179 — Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: mailing_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Contact mailing country determines GDPR applicability, sanctions screening jurisdiction, and communication compliance requirements. Compliance teams require normalized country reference for cross-bord
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent owner or investor entity (individual, institutional, REIT, JV, or partnership) to whom this contact record belongs. Supports multi-contact hierarchies for institutional owners.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Owner/Investor Entity; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: consent_obtained_date
attributes.description: Date on which explicit consent was obtained from this contact for electronic communications and data processing. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis documentation and CAN-SPAM/TCPA compliance for marketing and investor communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and Article 7; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; CASL

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Type of legal basis or consent obtained for processing and communicating with this contact under GDPR Article 6. Explicit: affirmative opt-in consent. Implied: consent inferred from business relationship. Legitimate_interest: processing based on legitimate business interest. Not_obtained: consent not yet collected.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; ICO Guidance on Consent; CASL

attributes.name: contact_source
attributes.description: Originating system or channel from which this contact record was created or imported. Supports data lineage tracking and master data management reconciliation across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Data Source; MRI Software — Data Origin; Salesforce CRM — Lead Source; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this contact record. Active: contact is current and reachable. Inactive: contact is no longer in use but retained for historical reference. Do_not_contact: contact has opted out or is legally restricted. Pending_verification: contact details awaiting KYC/AML validation. Deceased: individual contact is deceased.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CAN-SPAM Act; Yardi Voyager — Contact Status; NAR Standards

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record represents an individual person (e.g., named representative) or an organizational entity (e.g., law firm, accounting firm) acting on behalf of the owner.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary — Contact Type; NAR Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and GDPR data processing records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30; ISO 8601; Yardi Voyager — Record Audit

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Business unit or department within the owner's organization that this contact represents (e.g., Legal, Finance, Asset Management, Investor Relations, Operations). Supports targeted communication routing for institutional owners.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Department; Yardi Voyager — Contact Record

attributes.name: do_not_contact_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this contact has been flagged as do-not-contact. Applicable when contact_status is 'do_not_contact'. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure and CAN-SPAM opt-out compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 and Article 21; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contact record is considered active and valid for the owner entity. Supports temporal validity tracking for contact records, particularly relevant when contacts change roles or when new authorized representatives are designated.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Effective Date; DocuSign CLM — Agreement Effective Date; ISO 8601

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact record ceases to be active for the owner entity. Null indicates the contact is currently active with no defined end date. Used to manage contact record lifecycle and historical audit trails.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Effective Date; DocuSign CLM — Agreement Expiry; ISO 8601

attributes.name: external_contact_ref
attributes.description: Identifier for this contact record in the originating source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager contact ID, Salesforce CRM contact ID, MRI contact code). Supports cross-system reconciliation and data lineage in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Contact ID; Salesforce CRM — Contact ID; MRI Software — Contact Reference; ISO 8000

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the individual contact person. Applicable when contact_type is 'individual'. Used for personalized correspondence and legal documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; NAR Standards; Yardi Voyager — Contact Person

attributes.name: is_authorized_signatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is authorized to execute legal documents, contracts, and agreements on behalf of the owner entity. Critical for DocuSign CLM workflow routing and lease execution authorization under SNDA and ALTA requirements.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Signatory Authorization; ALTA Standards; SOX Section 302; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: is_kyc_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Know Your Customer (KYC) Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has completed the Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification process as part of investor onboarding. Required for AML compliance and regulatory reporting for REIT investors and institutional owners.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements; SEC Regulation S-ID; FATF Recommendations; HUD Guidelines

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record is designated as the primary point of contact for the owner entity. Only one contact per owner should have this flag set to True. Used to determine default routing for communications and notifications.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Primary Contact Flag; Salesforce CRM — Primary Contact; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Professional title or designation of the individual contact (e.g., Chief Financial Officer, Asset Manager, General Counsel, Investor Relations Director). Supports routing of communications to the appropriate decision-maker.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Title; Yardi Voyager — Contact Record

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current KYC verification for this contact expires and re-verification is required. Supports proactive compliance management and automated re-verification workflow triggers.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements; FATF Recommendations; SEC Regulation S-ID

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC identity verification was completed for this contact. Used to track compliance currency and trigger re-verification workflows when KYC records expire per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements; SEC Regulation S-ID; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the individual contact person. Applicable when contact_type is 'individual'. Used in combination with first_name for full legal name construction.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; NAR Standards; Yardi Voyager — Contact Person

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn professional profile URL for this contact. Used by brokerage and investor relations teams for professional background verification, relationship management, and deal sourcing activities tracked in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Social Profile; GDPR Article 4; NAR Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the mailing address for this contact, typically containing the street number and street name. Used for formal correspondence, legal notices, distribution of financial statements, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards; Yardi Voyager — Contact Address

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the mailing address for this contact, typically containing suite, unit, floor, or building number. Supplements mailing_address_line1 for complete address specification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards; Yardi Voyager — Contact Address

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the mailing address for this contact. Used in conjunction with mailing_state and mailing_postal_code for complete address validation and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards; Yardi Voyager — Contact Address

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or postal code of the mailing address for this contact. Used for mail delivery, geographic segmentation, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards; Yardi Voyager — Contact Address

attributes.name: mailing_state
attributes.description: State, province, or territory of the mailing address for this contact. For US addresses, use the two-letter USPS state abbreviation (e.g., CA, NY, TX). For international addresses, use the appropriate regional subdivision code.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards; ISO 3166-2; Yardi Voyager — Contact Address

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or relationship notes about this contact. Examples include communication preferences, relationship history, or special handling instructions for investor relations. Classified confidential due to potential sensitivity of relationship notes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Contact Notes; Salesforce CRM — Contact Notes; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimization)

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the organization acting as the contact, applicable when contact_type is 'organization' (e.g., law firm, accounting firm, property management company). Also used for the employer/firm name when the contact is an individual representative of an institution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Vendor/Entity Name; MRI Software — Entity Management; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method for receiving communications from the real estate organization. Drives automated notification routing in Yardi Voyager and Salesforce CRM. Options: email (electronic mail), phone (voice call), mail (postal mail), portal (owner/investor portal), fax.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Communication Preferences; Salesforce CRM — Contact Preferences; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: BCP 47 language tag representing the contact's preferred language for communications (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, es-MX, zh-CN). Supports multilingual correspondence for international investors and cross-border real estate transactions.
attributes.references: BCP 47 — Tags for Identifying Languages; IETF RFC 5646; GDPR Article 12

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for this contact. Used for routine correspondence, distribution of financial reports, lease notifications, and investor communications. Governed by GDPR and CAN-SPAM Act for electronic communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; Yardi Voyager — Contact Email; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for this contact in E.164 international format. Used for direct voice communication, urgent notifications, and deal-related discussions. Governed by GDPR and TCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164; TCPA; Yardi Voyager — Contact Phone

attributes.name: primary_phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary phone number indicating the type of line: mobile (cell phone), office (main switchboard), direct (direct dial line), home (residential), or fax. Supports appropriate communication channel selection.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Phone Type; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Functional role of this contact within the owner entity hierarchy. Determines routing of communications: primary (main point of contact), legal (attorney or legal counsel), financial (CFO, accountant, or investor relations), operational (property or asset manager), emergency (24/7 escalation), secondary (backup contact). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|legal|financial|operational|emergency|secondary — promote to reference product if additional roles are needed]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Contact Role; Salesforce CRM — Contact Role; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal salutation or honorific prefix for the individual contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr., Prof.). Used in formal correspondence, legal notices, and investor communications to ensure appropriate professional address.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Contact Salutation; Salesforce CRM — Salutation; NAR Standards

attributes.name: secondary_email
attributes.description: Alternate or backup email address for this contact. Used when primary email is undeliverable or for specific communication types (e.g., legal notices, financial statements). Governed by GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; Yardi Voyager — Contact Email

attributes.name: secondary_phone
attributes.description: Alternate telephone number for this contact in E.164 international format. Used as a backup contact channel or for a different communication type (e.g., mobile vs. office). Governed by GDPR and TCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164; TCPA; Yardi Voyager — Contact Phone

attributes.name: secondary_phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the secondary phone number indicating the type of line: mobile, office, direct, home, or fax. Supports appropriate communication channel selection when primary phone is unavailable.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Phone Type; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix for the individual contact (e.g., Jr., Sr., III, Esq., CPA, CFA). Used in formal legal and financial correspondence to accurately represent the contact's full legal name.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Contact Name; Salesforce CRM — Contact Suffix; NAR Standards

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contact's primary location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Singapore). Used to schedule communications, meetings, and automated notifications at appropriate local times for international investors and cross-border transactions.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Salesforce CRM — Contact Time Zone; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit trail requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30; ISO 8601; Yardi Voyager — Record Audit

products.name: owner_ownership_interest

Central to tracking fractional ownership, JV structures, and REIT unit holdings at the property level. Enables full ownership lifecycle traceability for legal, compliance, and audit purposes.

attributes.name: aml_review_date

attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 10; EU AMLD6 Article 14

attributes.name: cessation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this beneficial ownership interest ceased — i.e., when the individual divested, transferred, or otherwise relinquished the ownership stake or control rights. Null if ownership is still active. Triggers updated CTA filing obligation.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); SEC Rule 13d-1; FATF Recommendation 24

attributes.name: control_basis
attributes.description: The legal or contractual basis through which the beneficial owner exercises control over the reporting entity. Includes equity interest, voting rights, senior officer authority, board control, trust instrument, or contractual arrangement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EQUITY_INTEREST|VOTING_RIGHTS|SENIOR_OFFICER|BOARD_CONTROL|TRUST_CONTROL|CONTRACT|POWER_OF_ATTORNEY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 24; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial owner exercises control directly (holding shares/units in the reporting entity) or indirectly (through intermediate holding entities, trusts, or nominee arrangements). Required for multi-tier holding structure analysis.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 24; SEC Rule 13d-3

attributes.name: country_of_residence
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the beneficial owner's primary country of residence. Used for tax residency determination, FATCA/CRS reporting, and jurisdictional risk classification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; FATCA; OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: cta_exempt_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the reporting entity qualifies for a CTA exemption (e.g., large operating company, SEC-reporting company, regulated financial institution, inactive entity). Populated only when cta_filing_status = EXEMPT.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA) §1.2; 31 CFR Part 1010

attributes.name: cta_filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) report was filed or last updated for this beneficial owner under the Corporate Transparency Act.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); 31 CFR Part 1010

attributes.name: cta_filing_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corporate Transparency Act (CTA) Filing Reference Number
attributes.description: FinCEN-assigned reference number for the Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) report filed under the Corporate Transparency Act. Used to cross-reference regulatory submissions and track filing history.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); 31 CFR Part 1010

attributes.name: cta_filing_status
attributes.description: Status of the FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) report filing under the Corporate Transparency Act for this beneficial owner record. NOT_REQUIRED = entity is exempt; PENDING = filing due; FILED = initial report submitted; UPDATED = updated report filed; EXEMPT = entity qualifies for CTA exemption.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); 31 CFR Part 1010

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the beneficial owner individual. Required for identity verification under FinCEN CTA and AML/KYC onboarding procedures.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 10; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: disclosure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this beneficial owner record is subject to mandatory regulatory disclosure obligations under FinCEN CTA, SEC beneficial ownership rules, or other applicable regulations. Drives compliance workflow routing.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); SEC Rule 13d-1; FATF Recommendation 24

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this beneficial ownership interest became effective — i.e., when the individual first acquired the ownership stake or control rights in the reporting entity. Used for ownership timeline analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); SEC Rule 13d-1; FATF Recommendation 24

attributes.name: full_legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual identified as the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) as it appears on government-issued identification documents. Required for FinCEN CTA and AML/KYC compliance.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); GDPR Article 4; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: intermediate_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the intermediate holding entity (SPV, LLC, trust, or holding company) through which the beneficial owner exercises indirect ownership or control. Populated for indirect ownership structures; null for direct ownership. Critical for multi-tier holding structure mapping.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 24; SEC Rule 13d-3

attributes.name: is_politically_exposed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial owner is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) — a current or former senior government official, state-owned enterprise executive, or immediate family member thereof. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence (EDD) under AML regulations.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: is_senior_officer
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial owner qualifies as a senior officer (CEO, CFO, COO, General Counsel, or equivalent) of the reporting entity, triggering mandatory CTA disclosure regardless of ownership percentage.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA) §2.2(d); SEC Executive Officer Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current KYC verification expires and a periodic refresh is required. Typically set 1–3 years from verification date based on risk tier. Drives automated KYC renewal workflows.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 10; EU AMLD6

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the KYC identity verification process for this beneficial owner. Drives onboarding workflow, investment eligibility, and regulatory compliance gating. PENDING = not yet submitted; IN_REVIEW = under compliance review; VERIFIED = identity confirmed; REJECTED = failed verification; EXPIRED = verification lapsed and requires renewal.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 10; EU AMLD6; NAR Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficial owner's identity was successfully verified and KYC status was set to VERIFIED. Used to calculate KYC refresh due dates and track compliance timelines.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 10; EU AMLD6

attributes.name: national_id_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the government-issued identification document provided by the beneficial owner. Used to flag expired documents requiring re-verification during periodic KYC refresh cycles.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: national_id_issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction that issued the beneficial owner's identification document. Required for FinCEN CTA filing and cross-border AML risk assessment.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Unique number from the government-issued identification document (passport, national ID, driver's license, SSN, or TIN) provided by the beneficial owner. Stored encrypted; used for identity verification and regulatory filing.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 10; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: national_id_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identification document provided by the beneficial owner for identity verification. Acceptable document types per FinCEN CTA include passport, national ID card, driver's license, and tax identification number.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers to record observations, escalation rationale, investigation findings, or other contextual information related to this beneficial owner record. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation)

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficial owner as an individual natural person, trust beneficiary, estate beneficiary, or nominee arrangement. Determines the applicable KYC documentation requirements and regulatory disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 10; NAR Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines

attributes.name: ownership_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the legal agreement (shareholder agreement, partnership agreement, trust deed, or operating agreement) that establishes and evidences the beneficial ownership interest. Links to DocuSign CLM or document management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ALTA; NAR; FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA)

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity interest or voting rights held by this beneficial owner in the reporting entity. FinCEN CTA mandates disclosure for individuals holding 25% or more. Used for UBO threshold screening and regulatory filing.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA) §2.2; FATF Recommendation 24; SEC Beneficial Ownership Rules

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this beneficial ownership record. ACTIVE = ownership interest is current and valid; CEASED = ownership has been divested or transferred; SUSPENDED = ownership rights temporarily restricted; UNDER_REVIEW = record flagged for compliance investigation.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 24; NAR Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines

attributes.name: ownership_threshold_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial owner meets or exceeds the 25% ownership or control threshold mandated by FinCEN CTA for mandatory UBO disclosure. True = threshold met; False = below threshold but tracked for AML purposes.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA) §2.2; FATF Recommendation 24

attributes.name: ownership_tier_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the ownership hierarchy at which this beneficial owner sits (1 = direct ownership, 2 = one intermediate entity, 3 = two intermediate entities, etc.). Used for multi-tier holding structure analysis and UBO chain tracing.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 24

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this beneficial owner record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for regulatory compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; FinCEN Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this beneficial owner record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, audit trails, and triggering updated CTA filings when ownership data changes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA)

attributes.name: residential_address
attributes.description: Full residential address of the beneficial owner as provided during KYC onboarding. Required for FinCEN CTA beneficial ownership reporting and AML identity verification.
attributes.references: FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act (CTA); FATF Recommendation 10; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to the beneficial owner based on AML/KYC risk factors including PEP status, sanctions exposure, jurisdiction risk, ownership complexity, and transaction patterns. Determines the level of due diligence (standard, enhanced) and KYC refresh frequency.
attributes.references: FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; EU AMLD6 Article 18

attributes.name: sanctions_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial owner returned a positive or potential match during sanctions screening against OFAC, EU, UN, or other watchlists. A True value triggers escalation to the compliance team for enhanced due diligence.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Compliance; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; EU AMLD6

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial owner has been screened against OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions list, UN sanctions list, and other applicable watchlists as part of AML/KYC onboarding and periodic review.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Compliance; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; EU AML Directive (AMLD6)

attributes.name: source_of_funds
attributes.description: Declared origin of the specific funds used to acquire the ownership interest in the reporting entity (e.g., bank transfer from operating account, proceeds from property sale, loan facility). Distinct from source of wealth; required for AML transaction monitoring.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; EU AMLD6 Article 13

attributes.name: source_of_wealth
attributes.description: Declared source of the beneficial owner's wealth used to fund the ownership interest (e.g., business income, inheritance, real estate proceeds, investment returns). Required for enhanced due diligence (EDD) on high-risk and PEP-classified beneficial owners.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; EU AMLD6 Article 18

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax Identification Number (TIN) or equivalent tax reference number for the beneficial owner, used for FATCA, OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS), and domestic tax reporting obligations. May be SSN, EIN, or foreign TIN depending on jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FATCA; OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); IRS Form W-9/W-8; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: tax_residency_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the beneficial owner's tax residency jurisdiction. Used for FATCA withholding determination, OECD CRS automatic exchange of information, and cross-border tax compliance.
attributes.references: FATCA; OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the beneficial owner's identity during KYC onboarding. Includes document review (passport/ID scan), biometric verification, third-party database check (credit bureau, government registry), in-person verification, or electronic identity verification (eIDV).
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; EU AMLD6 Article 13

products.name: kyc_profile
products.description: Comprehensive Know Your Customer (KYC) onboarding, due diligence, and compliance lifecycle record for owner and investor entities. Stores identity verification status, AML screening results, PEP flags, sanctions screening status, risk rating, accredited investor certification, and last review date. Includes collected document inventory (passport, articles of incorporation, trust deed, tax certificates) with document type, issuing authority, issue/expiry dates, verification method, verification outcome, and storage references. Tracks compliance lifecycle events including KYC renewal due dates, beneficial ownership re-certification, FATCA/CRS reporting submissions, FIRPTA withholding events, AML re-screening triggers, event outcomes, and responsible parties. Supports regulatory compliance with BSA, FinCEN CTA, GDPR, and SEC requirements. Provides full audit trail for regulatory examinations.
products.reference: FinCEN KYC / BSA / SEC Accredited Investor

attributes.name: incentive_fee_hurdle_rate_pct

attributes.name: incentive_fee_pct

attributes.name: termination_fee_amount

attributes.name: termination_for_cause_flag

products.name: owner_distribution
products.description: SSOT for income and capital distributions made to owners from property operations, including disbursement banking instructions. This is the owner-perspective distribution record, distinct from finance domain GL entries which record the accounting impact. Captures distribution type (NOI, FFO/AFFO, capital gain, return of capital, preferred return), calculation period, gross amount, withholding tax, net disbursement amount, distribution date, payment method, and Yardi GL cross-reference. Also stores owner bank account and disbursement details: bank name, account type, routing number (masked/tokenized), SWIFT/IBAN for international owners, preferred disbursement method, and account verification status. Supports investor reporting, tax K-1 preparation, and AP reconciliation.

attributes.name: distribution_number

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the distribution record. Drives AP workflow, investor portal visibility, and reconciliation processes. Values: pending (calculated, awaiting approval), approved (authorized for payment), disbursed (funds transferred), on_hold (suspended pending review), cancelled (voided before payment), reversed (clawback or correction applied).

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution by economic source. NOI = Net Operating Income distribution; FFO/AFFO = Funds From Operations per NAREIT definition; capital_gain = proceeds from asset disposition; return_of_capital = non-taxable return of invested principal; preferred_return = priority return to preferred equity holders; special = one-time or extraordinary distribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: noi|ffo|affo|capital_gain|return_of_capital|preferred_return|special — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; IRS Publication 550; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled cadence at which distributions are made to this owner from this property or investment entity. Drives distribution calendar planning and investor expectation management.

attributes.name: gross_distribution_amount
attributes.description: Total pre-tax distribution amount calculated for the owner before any withholding tax, fees, or adjustments. Expressed in the distribution currency. Core monetary component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IRS Publication 550; NAREIT FFO White Paper

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) for SEPA or cross-border distributions to international owners. Used in conjunction with SWIFT code for foreign disbursements. Null for domestic payments.

attributes.name: is_foreign_owner
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner is a foreign person or entity subject to FIRPTA withholding and IRS Form 1042-S reporting requirements. True = foreign owner; False = domestic US owner. Drives withholding tax logic and international payment routing.
attributes.references: FIRPTA (IRC Section 1445); IRS Form 1042-S; FATCA

attributes.name: k1_tax_year
attributes.description: The IRS tax year (YYYY) to which this distribution is attributed for Schedule K-1 reporting purposes. Partnerships and REITs must issue K-1s to partners/investors annually. Used for tax package preparation and investor tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065); IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S); REIT Tax Compliance

attributes.name: net_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount transferred to the owner after deducting withholding tax and any other adjustments from the gross distribution amount. This is the cash received by the owner. Core net total of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230; Yardi Voyager AP Module; IRS Schedule K-1

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or investor communication notes related to this distribution. Used by asset managers and AP staff for exception handling and investor inquiries.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The owner's fractional equity stake in the property or investment entity at the time of this distribution, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.250000 = 25%). Used to calculate the owner's pro-rata share of distributable income. Sourced from the ownership agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; SEC Regulation S-K; Internal Ownership Agreement

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement method used to transfer funds to the owner. ACH = Automated Clearing House domestic transfer; wire = domestic wire transfer; check = physical check; swift = international SWIFT wire; iban_transfer = SEPA or IBAN-based international transfer.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; SWIFT Standards; SEPA Regulation

attributes.name: preferred_disbursement_method
attributes.description: The owner's standing preferred method for receiving distributions, as recorded in their disbursement instructions. May differ from the actual payment_method used for a specific distribution if the preferred method was unavailable.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Owner Banking Instructions; Internal Owner Onboarding Policy

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a distribution was reversed or cancelled. Required when distribution_status is 'reversed' or 'cancelled'. Supports audit trail and investor communication.
attributes.references: NACHA Return Codes; Internal Distribution Policy; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: routing_number_token

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount

Tracks CAPEX funding events, equity waterfall inputs, and unfunded commitment drawdowns. Linked to ownership_interest for pro-rata tracking.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (YYYY-MM format) in which this capital contribution is recognized for financial reporting purposes. May differ from contribution_date if the contribution is received near a period boundary.

attributes.name: called_amount
attributes.description: The amount of capital formally called or requested from the investor via a capital call notice. May differ from contribution_amount if the investor funded partially or over-funded. Used to track unfunded commitment drawdown progress.
