attributes.name: capex_category
attributes.description: The CAPEX category that this capital contribution is intended to fund. Acquisition covers property purchase equity; development covers ground-up construction; renovation covers value-add improvements; tenant_improvement covers TI allowances; infrastructure covers building systems and utilities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 — Property, Plant, and Equipment; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: capital_account_balance_after
attributes.description: The investor's capital account balance immediately after this contribution event is applied. Used for equity waterfall inputs, NAV calculations, and investor reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; AICPA Investment Company Guide; Yardi Voyager Capital Account Module

attributes.name: capital_account_balance_before
attributes.description: The investor's capital account balance immediately prior to this contribution event. Provides a point-in-time snapshot for audit trail, reconciliation, and equity waterfall analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; AICPA Investment Company Guide; Yardi Voyager Capital Account Module

attributes.name: capital_call_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the investor was required to fund the capital call per the capital call notice. Used to identify late contributions, calculate default interest, and monitor investor compliance with funding obligations.
attributes.references: ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; FASB ASC 323; Partnership Agreement Terms

attributes.name: capital_call_notice_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the formal capital call notice issued to the investor that triggered this contribution. Links the funding event back to the capital call document for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; FASB ASC 323; DocuSign CLM Contract Reference

attributes.name: contribution_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of capital contributed by the owner or investor in the transaction currency. This is the base monetary amount before any adjustments, fees, or withholdings. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; IFRS 9; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 6-04

attributes.name: contribution_amount_usd
attributes.description: Contribution amount converted to USD at the applicable exchange rate on the contribution date. Used for consolidated portfolio reporting, NAV calculations, and AUM tracking across multi-currency investment vehicles.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: contribution_date
attributes.description: The actual business date on which the capital contribution was received and recorded, i.e., the value date of the equity funding event. Used for equity waterfall calculations and capital account balance updates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; IFRS 9 — Financial Instruments

attributes.name: contribution_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number or code assigned to this capital contribution event, used for cross-referencing with investor notices, capital call letters, and wire instructions. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or MRI Software capital account module.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; Yardi Voyager Capital Account Module

attributes.name: contribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital contribution record. Pending indicates a capital call has been issued but funds not yet received; funded indicates wire confirmed; partially_funded indicates only a portion of the called amount was received; returned indicates capital was returned to investor; cancelled indicates the contribution was voided.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: contribution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the capital contribution. Initial equity is the founding equity injection; capital_call is a drawdown against an unfunded commitment; preferred_equity is a senior equity tranche injection; co_invest is a co-investment alongside a primary fund; return_of_capital is a distribution classified as capital return; additional_equity is a supplemental equity injection post-initial close. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_equity|capital_call|preferred_equity|co_invest|return_of_capital|additional_equity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; Argus Enterprise Investment Analysis

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capital contribution record was first created in the data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for audit trail and data lineage compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; ISO 8000 Data Quality; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: default_interest_amount
attributes.description: The default interest or penalty amount charged to the investor for late funding of a capital call, as specified in the partnership or JV agreement. Applicable only when is_late_funding is True.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; Partnership Agreement Default Interest Provisions; ILPA Best Practices

attributes.name: equity_tier
attributes.description: The equity tranche or tier classification of this capital contribution within the investment vehicle's capital stack. Determines priority in the equity waterfall distribution model (e.g., preferred equity receives distributions before common equity).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 480 — Distinguishing Liabilities from Equity; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: The mechanism or instrument used to fund the capital contribution. Wire transfer and ACH are cash funding methods; in_kind indicates a non-cash asset contribution; debt_conversion indicates conversion of a loan to equity; reinvestment indicates distribution proceeds reinvested as new capital.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; FASB ASC 470 — Debt; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the contribution amount from the transaction currency to USD on the contribution date. Sourced from the reference data FX rate table. A value of 1.0 indicates the contribution is already in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters; ISO 4217

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account code in the chart of accounts to which this capital contribution is posted in the accounting system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Enables reconciliation between the owner domain capital account and the finance domain GL entries.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; SOX Section 404; Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: investor_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investor or owner entity type making the contribution. Determines applicable regulatory reporting requirements, tax treatment, and KYC/AML obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|institutional|reit|jv_entity|partnership|fund|family_office|sovereign_wealth — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FINRA KYC Rules; FASB ASC 946; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: is_late_funding
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital contribution was received after the capital call due date. True if contribution_date is after capital_call_due_date. Used to trigger default interest calculations and investor compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; Partnership Agreement Default Provisions

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contributing investor has completed KYC verification as required by AML regulations prior to this contribution being accepted. True indicates KYC is current and verified; False indicates KYC is pending or expired.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements; GDPR Article 5; SEC Regulation S-ID; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: net_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The net amount of capital credited to the investor's capital account after deducting tax withholdings, default interest charges, or other adjustments from the gross contribution_amount. Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; FIRPTA; Yardi Voyager Capital Account Module; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the asset manager or fund administrator regarding this capital contribution event. May include special conditions, investor instructions, or reconciliation remarks.
attributes.references: Internal Asset Management Operations; Yardi Voyager Notes Module

attributes.name: ownership_pct_after
attributes.description: The investor's pro-rata ownership percentage in the investment vehicle or property immediately after this capital contribution is applied. Reflects any dilution or accretion resulting from the contribution event.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; SEC Regulation S-X; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: ownership_pct_before
attributes.description: The investor's pro-rata ownership percentage in the investment vehicle or property immediately before this capital contribution. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%). Used to track dilution or accretion events.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; SEC Regulation S-X; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: preferred_return_accrual_method
attributes.description: The method by which the preferred return accrues on this capital contribution. Simple interest accrues on the original contribution only; compound accrues on the outstanding balance including accrued return; cumulative_non_compounding tracks unpaid preferred return without compounding.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards; Partnership Agreement Terms

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: The annual preferred return rate (hurdle rate) applicable to this capital contribution, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.08 = 8%). Determines the minimum return threshold before promote/carried interest is earned in the equity waterfall.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this capital contribution record was originated or ingested. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality; SOX Section 404 — Data Lineage and Audit Trail

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager transaction ID, MRI Software capital account entry ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality; SOX Section 404 — Data Lineage; Yardi Voyager; MRI Software

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: The amount withheld from the capital contribution for tax purposes, applicable to foreign investors subject to FIRPTA withholding or other tax withholding obligations. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.
attributes.references: FIRPTA — Foreign Investment in Real Property Tax Act; IRS Publication 515; FASB ASC 740 — Income Taxes

attributes.name: unfunded_commitment_after
attributes.description: The investor's remaining unfunded commitment balance immediately after this capital contribution event is applied. Calculated as unfunded_commitment_before minus contribution_amount. Stored for audit trail and point-in-time reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ILPA Reporting Template; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: unfunded_commitment_before
attributes.description: The investor's remaining unfunded commitment balance immediately prior to this capital contribution event. Used to validate that the called amount does not exceed the outstanding commitment and to track drawdown progress.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ILPA Reporting Template; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capital contribution record was last modified in the data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for audit trail and change tracking compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; ISO 8000 Data Quality; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: use_of_proceeds
attributes.description: Narrative description of the intended use of the contributed capital, as specified in the capital call notice or investment agreement. Examples include property acquisition down payment, construction draw funding, debt paydown, or working capital reserve.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 504 — Use of Proceeds; FASB ASC 323; ILPA Reporting Template

attributes.name: wire_confirmation_ref
attributes.description: The bank wire confirmation number, ACH trace number, or payment reference provided by the investor's financial institution upon funding. Used for reconciliation against bank statements and to confirm receipt of funds.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230 — Statement of Cash Flows; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls

attributes.description: Reference identifier for the ALTA Uniform Settlement Statement (HUD-1 or ALTA Settlement Statement) associated with this transfer. Documents all financial terms, prorations, and closing costs. Used for audit and tax basis calculations.

Represents the agreed purchase price or fair market value of the interest transferred. Used for stamp duty, transfer tax, and capital gains calculations. Null for gift or inheritance transfers.

attributes.name: post_transfer_ownership_pct

attributes.name: recording_date

attributes.name: tax_basis_amount
attributes.description: The transferor's adjusted tax basis in the ownership interest at the time of transfer. Used to compute realized gain or loss for income tax purposes. For 1031 exchanges, the carryover basis is tracked here.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code Section 1031; FASB ASC 740; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: title_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number of the title insurance policy issued to the transferee (owner's policy) or lender (lender's policy) in connection with this transfer. Provides protection against title defects and encumbrances not discovered during due diligence.

attributes.name: transfer_costs_amount
attributes.description: Total transaction costs incurred in executing the ownership transfer, including legal fees, title search fees, recording fees, broker commissions, and due diligence costs. Capitalized as part of the cost basis per FASB ASC 805.

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world effective date on which the ownership interest legally transferred from transferor to transferee. This is the date of record for title and tax purposes, distinct from the agreement execution date.

attributes.name: transfer_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total ownership interest being transferred, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). Enables partial interest transfers within joint-venture and partnership structures. Must be between 0.0001 and 100.0000.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: transfer_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ownership transfer event, used in correspondence, legal documents, and system cross-references. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or MRI Software ownership module.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ownership transfer workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through legal completion. Values: pending (initiated, awaiting documentation), in_review (under legal/compliance review), approved (authorized for execution), completed (title recorded and transfer finalized), cancelled (transfer voided before completion), reversed (completed transfer subsequently unwound).
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 805

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: The total real estate transfer tax, documentary stamp tax, or conveyance tax assessed on the ownership transfer by the applicable jurisdiction. Computed based on consideration amount and local tax rates. Required for tax compliance reporting.

Captures tax year, jurisdiction, tax type, assessed amount, filing status, and SAP S/4HANA tax cross-reference. Supports SOX compliance and SEC reporting for publicly traded REITs.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_county_district

attributes.name: k1_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Partner's or investor's share of depreciation deductions allocated via IRS Schedule K-1. Relevant for REIT FFO (Funds From Operations) and AFFO (Adjusted Funds From Operations) calculations and investor tax planning.

attributes.name: k1_ordinary_income_amount

attributes.description: Partner's or investor's share of ordinary business income allocated via IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) for partnership entities. Applicable for JV entities, limited partnerships, and REIT operating partnerships. Null for non-partnership ownership structures.

attributes.description: Percentage of the child entity's Gross Asset Value (GAV) attributable to the parent entity for consolidated GAV reporting. Supports portfolio-level investment performance analysis.

attributes.name: governing_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the legal agreement (e.g., partnership agreement, JV agreement, shareholder agreement) that establishes and governs this parent-child ownership relationship. Links to DocuSign CLM contract records.

attributes.name: hierarchy_code

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child entity within the ownership hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents a direct subsidiary of the ultimate parent. Enables roll-up reporting of AUM, NAV, and GAV across multi-tier structures.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from the ultimate root entity to the child entity (e.g., '/RootHoldCo/SubHoldCo/SPV-001'). Enables efficient tree traversal and roll-up queries in Databricks without recursive CTEs.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: hierarchy_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for which this hierarchy relationship is defined. A single pair of entities may have multiple hierarchy records serving different purposes (e.g., legal ownership vs. management reporting vs. tax consolidation).

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the parent-child hierarchy relationship. Active indicates the relationship is currently in force; dissolved indicates the child entity has been wound down or the relationship terminated.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: hierarchy_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this hierarchy relationship record, incremented each time the relationship is modified (e.g., ownership percentage change, consolidation method change). Supports temporal versioning and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: is_consolidation_entity
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child entity is included in the parent's consolidated financial statements for regulatory and statutory reporting purposes. True if consolidated; False if excluded (e.g., minority interest below consolidation threshold).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_primary_hierarchy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship represents the primary (canonical) parent-child link for the child entity. A child entity may have multiple hierarchy records (e.g., legal vs. management reporting), but only one is designated primary.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 two-letter state or province code of the sub-national jurisdiction governing this ownership relationship. Used for state-level regulatory filings and tax reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; SEC — REIT Reporting; HUD Regulatory Compliance

attributes.name: minority_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship represents a non-controlling (minority) interest position where the parent holds less than 50% equity or voting rights. Drives non-controlling interest disclosure in consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: nav_attribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the child entity's Net Asset Value (NAV) attributable to the parent entity for consolidated NAV reporting. Used in REIT and fund-of-funds NAV roll-up calculations.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; SEC — REIT Reporting; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, qualifications, or commentary about this ownership hierarchy relationship that cannot be expressed in structured fields (e.g., special voting arrangements, earn-out provisions, pending regulatory approvals).
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: reit_qualifying_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Qualifying Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child entity qualifies as a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) or REIT subsidiary for tax and regulatory purposes. Drives REIT compliance testing and SEC reporting obligations.
attributes.references: SEC — REIT Reporting; IRS REIT Qualification Rules; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership relationship between parent and child entities. Drives consolidation treatment and financial reporting. attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this hierarchy relationship record was sourced (e.g., Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, Argus Enterprise, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: source_system_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this hierarchy relationship record in the originating source system (e.g., Yardi entity tree node ID, MRI entity relationship ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Entity Management; MRI Software Investment Management; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: tax_transparent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child entity is tax-transparent (pass-through) for income tax purposes (e.g., partnership, LLC treated as disregarded entity). Affects tax consolidation and investor-level tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Pass-Through Entity Rules; SEC — REIT Reporting; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy relationship record was last modified in the Silver Layer data product. Used for change detection, incremental processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: variable_interest_entity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child entity qualifies as a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) under FASB ASC 810, requiring consolidation by the primary beneficiary regardless of voting interest percentage.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SOX Financial Controls; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: voting_rights_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of voting rights held by the parent entity in the child entity. May differ from equity ownership percentage in structures with preferred equity, non-voting shares, or dual-class share arrangements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: annual_income_usd

attributes.name: assets_under_management_usd
attributes.description: Total assets under management in US dollars for institutional investors (e.g., registered investment advisers, banks, insurance companies) used to determine Qualified Institutional Buyer (QIB) eligibility under SEC Rule 144A ($100M threshold) or Qualified Purchaser status under the Investment Company Act ($25M threshold for entities).

attributes.name: beneficial_ownership_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether beneficial ownership information has been collected and confirmed for entity investors (e.g., LLCs, partnerships, trusts) as required by FinCEN's Customer Due Diligence Rule. True if beneficial ownership of 25% or more equity interest has been identified and verified; False if not yet confirmed.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR 1010.230); Corporate Transparency Act; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor's accreditation status was formally certified or confirmed by the certifying party. Represents the effective start of the accreditation period. Aligns with SEC Regulation D requirement to verify accredited investor status at the time of sale.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 506(c); SEC Release No. 33-9415

attributes.name: certifying_party_license_number
attributes.description: Professional license or registration number of the certifying party (e.g., CPA license number, bar number for attorneys, CRD number for broker-dealers or RIAs). Used to validate the credentials of the certifying professional and maintain audit documentation.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 506(c); FINRA CRD System; State Bar Association records

attributes.name: certifying_party_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual, firm, or institution that certified or verified the investor's accreditation status (e.g., CPA firm name, law firm name, registered broker-dealer name, registered investment advisor name). Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance under SEC Rule 506(c).
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 506(c); SEC Release No. 33-9415

attributes.name: certifying_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity or professional who certified the investor's accreditation. Determines the regulatory weight and acceptability of the verification under SEC Rule 506(c) requirements for reasonable steps to verify accredited investor status.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 506(c); SEC Release No. 33-9415

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers to record observations, exceptions, escalation notes, or special circumstances related to the investor's accreditation verification process. Confidential — restricted to compliance and legal personnel.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; SOX Section 302; FINRA Rule 5123

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this accreditation record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(e) — storage limitation; ISO 8601

attributes.name: document_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supporting verification document (e.g., CPA letter, attorney letter) expires or becomes stale for regulatory purposes. Typically 90 days from issuance for third-party verification letters under SEC Rule 506(c). Distinct from the accreditation expiry date.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 506(c); SEC Compliance and Disclosure Interpretations

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the primary supporting document used to verify accreditation status (e.g., DocuSign envelope ID, document management system reference, CPA letter reference number). Used to locate the underlying verification document in the document management system.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 506(c); DocuSign CLM; SOX Section 302 — document retention

attributes.name: erisa_plan_assets_usd
attributes.description: Total plan assets in US dollars for ERISA-governed pension or benefit plans, used to determine whether the plan investor qualifies as an accredited investor under SEC Rule 501(a)(1) ($5,000,000 threshold) and to assess ERISA fiduciary obligations and plan asset regulations. Null for non-ERISA investors.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 3(3); SEC Regulation D Rule 501(a)(1); DOL Plan Asset Regulations 29 CFR 2510.3-101

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor's accreditation certification expires and must be renewed or re-verified. Typically 90 days from certification date for Regulation D 506(c) offerings. Null for perpetual or open-ended accreditations where no expiry is mandated.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 506(c); SEC Compliance and Disclosure Interpretations

attributes.name: investments_owned_usd
attributes.description: Total value of investments owned by the investor in US dollars, used to determine Qualified Purchaser eligibility under the Investment Company Act Section 2(a)(51). Threshold is $5,000,000 for individuals and $25,000,000 for entities. Excludes primary residence and property used in business.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act Section 2(a)(51); SEC Release IC-22597

attributes.name: investor_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the investor entity type for accreditation and regulatory purposes. Determines applicable accreditation thresholds and regulatory treatment under SEC Regulation D, Investment Company Act, and ERISA. attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 501(a); Investment Company Act; ERISA Section 3(3); SEC Rule 144A

attributes.name: joint_income_usd
attributes.description: Reported joint annual income of the investor and spouse or spousal equivalent in US dollars, used to assess accredited investor eligibility under the joint income threshold of $300,000 per SEC Rule 501(a)(6). Null for non-joint filings.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 501(a)(6); SEC Release No. 33-9415

attributes.name: knowledgeable_employee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor qualifies as a knowledgeable employee of the fund under Investment Company Act Rule 3c-5, which exempts certain fund employees from the investor count limitations of Sections 3(c)(1) and 3(c)(7). attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence process for the investor as part of the accreditation and onboarding workflow. Passed indicates all KYC checks cleared; Failed indicates disqualifying findings; Pending indicates not yet initiated; In Progress indicates checks underway; Requires Update indicates previously passed but refresh needed.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR 1010.230); Bank Secrecy Act; GDPR Article 6; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: net_worth_usd
attributes.description: Reported net worth of the investor in US dollars at the time of accreditation, excluding the value of the investor's primary residence per SEC Rule 501(a)(5). attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 501(a)(5); Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act Section 413

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic re-verification or review of the investor's accreditation status. Used by compliance teams to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous eligibility for private real estate offerings.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FINRA Rule 5123; SOX Section 302 — internal compliance controls

attributes.name: offering_type

attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rules 506(b) and 506(c); SEC Regulation A+; SEC Regulation Crowdfunding; Securities Act of 1933

attributes.name: politically_exposed_person_flag

PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence requirements under AML regulations.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; FinCEN guidance on PEPs; Bank Secrecy Act; EU 4th Anti-Money Laundering Directive

attributes.name: professional_certification_type

None if accreditation is based on financial thresholds rather than professional credentials.
attributes.references: SEC Release No. 33-10824 (2020 Amendments to Accredited Investor Definition); FINRA licensing requirements

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: renewal_date

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_sent_flag

products.name: owner_representation
products.description: This association product represents the formal representation relationship between property owners/investors and licensed brokers. It captures the engagement terms, exclusivity arrangements, market focus, and relationship lifecycle for each owner-broker pairing. Each record links one owner to one broker with attributes that exist only in the context of this professional representation relationship, used for conflict-of-interest checks, commission tracking, deal assignment, and CRM workflows.. Existence Justification: In real estate brokerage operations, property owners and investors routinely engage multiple brokers across different markets, asset classes, and transaction types (e.g., one broker for multifamily acquisitions in Dallas, another for office dispositions in NYC). Simultaneously, brokers maintain active representation relationships with multiple owner clients, each with distinct engagement terms, exclusivity arrangements, and market focus areas. The business actively manages these representation relationships as formal engagements with lifecycle tracking, conflict-of-interest checks, commission overrides, and CRM workflows.

attributes.name: owner_representation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for owner_representation

attributes.name: brokerage_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the licensed broker or agent providing representation services to the owner
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the property owner or investor entity being represented by the broker
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: commission_override_pct
attributes.description: Owner-specific commission rate override that supersedes the broker's standard commission plan for deals involving this owner. Null if standard commission plan applies.

attributes.name: engagement_source
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the owner-broker relationship was originally established. Used for referral fee tracking and marketing attribution analysis.

attributes.name: exclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this representation relationship grants the broker exclusive rights to represent the owner for transactions within the defined scope (market, asset class, transaction type). Used for conflict checks and commission dispute resolution.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent documented contact or interaction between the broker and owner in this representation relationship. Used for relationship health monitoring and CRM follow-up workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for broker notes regarding the owner relationship, including preferences, communication style, deal history, and other context relevant to this specific owner-broker pairing.

attributes.name: preferred_market
attributes.description: Geographic market area or MSA code where this owner-broker relationship is primarily focused. Used for deal assignment routing and market conflict checks when multiple brokers represent the same owner in different markets.

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the representation relationship was formally terminated or expired. Null for active ongoing relationships.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal representation relationship between the owner and broker was established, typically the effective date of the representation agreement or engagement letter

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the representation relationship. Drives eligibility for deal assignment, commission calculations, and CRM workflows.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the representation arrangement governing the scope and exclusivity of the broker's engagement with the owner. Determines commission entitlement, conflict-of-interest rules, and deal assignment eligibility.

products.name: subscription
products.description: This association product represents the contractual subscription relationship between an owner/investor and a real estate investment fund. It captures the investor's capital commitment, subscription terms, investor classification at the time of subscription, accreditation status verification, and side letter provisions. Each record represents a distinct subscription agreement linking one owner to one fund with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific investment commitment.. Existence Justification: In real estate fund operations, an owner/investor can subscribe to multiple funds (diversification across strategies, vintages, and asset classes), and each fund has multiple Limited Partner investors who have subscribed. Each subscription is a distinct contractual relationship with its own capital commitment, subscription date, investor class, fee terms (potentially customized via side letters), and accreditation verification. Fund administrators actively manage subscriptions as operational entities—tracking capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, K-1 generation, and waterfall calculations at the subscription level.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fund subscription record. Primary key for the subscription association.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the real estate investment fund being subscribed to
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the owner/investor entity who is subscribing to the fund
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Investor's accreditation or qualified purchaser status as verified at the time of subscription. Determines regulatory compliance requirements, investment limits, and disclosure obligations under SEC regulations (Reg D, 3(c)(1), 3(c)(7)).
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D, Investment Company Act Section 3(c)(7)

attributes.name: agreement_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system reference to the executed subscription agreement and related legal documents for this investor-fund relationship.

attributes.name: called_capital
attributes.description: Cumulative capital called from this investor's commitment to date. Sum of all capital call notices issued to this investor. Cannot exceed commitment_amount.

attributes.name: carried_interest_override
attributes.description: Investor-specific carried interest rate that overrides the fund's standard carried_interest_rate, typically negotiated for early or anchor investors. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15.00%). Null if standard fund carry applies.

attributes.name: commitment_amount
attributes.description: Total capital amount committed by the investor to the fund under this subscription agreement. This is the maximum amount the GP can call from this investor. Denominated in the fund's base currency.

attributes.name: distributed_capital
attributes.description: Cumulative capital distributed to this investor to date, including return of capital, preferred return, and profit distributions. Used to calculate investor-level IRR and equity multiple (TVPI).

attributes.name: investor_class
attributes.description: Classification of the investor within the fund structure at the time of subscription. Determines fee terms, distribution priority, voting rights, and reporting requirements. Common classes include institutional vs retail, different fee tiers, or co-investment vehicles.

attributes.name: management_fee_override
attributes.description: Investor-specific management fee rate that overrides the fund's standard management_fee_rate, typically negotiated in a side letter for large institutional commitments. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0150 = 1.50%). Null if standard fund fee applies.

attributes.name: side_letter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription includes a side letter agreement with customized terms, fee arrangements, co-investment rights, information rights, or other investor-specific provisions that deviate from the standard Limited Partnership Agreement.

attributes.name: side_letter_terms
attributes.description: Narrative summary of key side letter provisions for this subscription, including fee discounts, co-investment rights, advisory board seats, information rights, key person provisions, or investment restrictions. Null if side_letter_flag is false.

attributes.name: subscription_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investor executed the subscription agreement and became a Limited Partner in the fund. Used to determine eligibility for distributions, carried interest waterfall calculations, and investor reporting periods.

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription. Active subscriptions are subject to capital calls and distributions. Withdrawn subscriptions were cancelled before final close. Defaulted subscriptions failed to meet capital call obligations. Fully Distributed subscriptions have received all capital back and the fund has terminated.

domains.name: valuation

attributes.name: engagement_fee
attributes.description: The agreed fee payable to the appraisal firm for the engagement, in the engagement currency. Recorded for accounts payable processing in Yardi Voyager and budget tracking against the valuation OPEX budget.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: engagement_letter_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number or DocuSign CLM contract ID for the executed engagement letter between the client and the appraisal firm. Provides legal traceability and supports contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; USPAP Ethics Rule; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: engagement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the appraisal engagement at the time of ordering. Used for cross-referencing with the engagement letter, Argus Enterprise, and Yardi Voyager fixed asset records.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standard 2

attributes.name: firm_name
attributes.description: The name of the external appraisal firm engaged to perform the appraisal. Supports vendor management, conflict-of-interest tracking, and appraiser rotation policies required by lenders and regulators.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; Appraisal Institute; FIRREA Title XI

attributes.name: holding_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years in the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis projection period. Typically 10 years for commercial real estate. Defines the time horizon over which cash flows are modeled in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date the appraiser physically inspected the subject property. Required disclosure in USPAP-compliant reports. For desktop or drive-by appraisals, this field may be null or reflect the date of external observation.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1-2; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: intended_user
attributes.description: The party or parties identified in the engagement letter as the intended user(s) of the appraisal report (e.g., lender name, investment committee, asset manager). USPAP requires explicit identification of intended users to define the scope of work.
attributes.references: USPAP Scope of Work Rule; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: The discount rate at which the net present value of projected cash flows equals zero, as concluded in the DCF analysis. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0850 for 8.50%). Key output metric for investment decision-making and portfolio performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; CFA Institute

attributes.name: ivsc_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appraisal methodology and report comply with International Valuation Standards (IVS) as published by the IVSC. Required for cross-border investment reporting and IFRS-based financial statements.
attributes.references: IVSC International Valuation Standards; IFRS 13; IASB

attributes.name: methodology
attributes.description: The primary valuation methodology applied in the appraisal. Sales Comparison, Income Capitalization (direct CAP rate), Cost Approach, Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Broker Price Opinion (BPO), or Comparative Market Analysis (CMA). USPAP and IVSC require disclosure of methodology in the report.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: The stabilized Net Operating Income used as the primary income input in the income capitalization approach. Calculated as Effective Gross Income (EGI) less operating expenses, excluding debt service and capital expenditures. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; NCREIF

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: The net present value of projected future cash flows discounted at the required rate of return, as output from the DCF model. Positive NPV indicates value creation above the required return threshold. Sourced from Argus Enterprise DCF model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: The intended use of the appraisal report as stated in the engagement letter. Drives the applicable standard of value and methodology selection. Common purposes include financing (LTV/DSCR support), disposition, insurance replacement cost, tax appeal, portfolio review (NAV/GAV), and litigation support.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; IVSC IVS 101; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: report_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the completed appraisal report was delivered to the client or intended user. Used to measure SLA turnaround compliance from engagement date to delivery.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standard 2

attributes.name: report_document_ref
attributes.description: Document management system reference or DocuSign CLM document ID for the final appraisal report deliverable. Enables direct retrieval of the report PDF or narrative document from the document repository.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standard 2

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The format of the appraisal report deliverable. URAR (Uniform Residential Appraisal Report) is the standard Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac form for residential properties. Narrative reports provide full written analysis. Restricted and Summary reports are abbreviated formats per USPAP.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 2; Fannie Mae Form 1004; Freddie Mac Form 70

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: Indicates the hypothetical condition or premise of the concluded value. As-Is reflects current physical and economic condition. As-Stabilized assumes the property reaches stabilized occupancy. As-Complete assumes a development or renovation project is finished.
attributes.references: USPAP; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date the appraisal review was completed by the review appraiser. Tracks the review stage of the appraisal lifecycle and supports SLA measurement for the review turnaround.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the internal or external appraisal review. Approved reports proceed to final use; rejected or revision-required reports are returned to the appraiser. Drives the status lifecycle transition.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute; Lender Review Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_turnaround_days
attributes.description: The contractually agreed maximum number of calendar days from engagement date to report delivery. Used to monitor appraiser performance and manage investment decision timelines.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: terminal_cap_rate
attributes.description: The reversion or terminal capitalization rate applied to the projected NOI at the end of the DCF holding period to estimate the residual/reversion value. Expressed as a decimal. Standard Argus Enterprise DCF model parameter.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the appraisal engagement record was last modified. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and audit trail requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 55000

attributes.name: uspap_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appraisal was performed in compliance with the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) as promulgated by The Appraisal Foundation. Required for federally related transactions under FIRREA.
attributes.references: USPAP; The Appraisal Foundation; FIRREA Title XI

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the concluded value opinion, which may differ from the report delivery date. For retrospective appraisals, this is a historical date. Critical for FASB ASC 820 fair value measurement and IFRS 16 lease accounting purposes.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 101; FASB ASC 820; IFRS 16

attributes.name: value_range_high
attributes.description: The upper bound of the appraiser's value range opinion when a range rather than a point estimate is concluded. Used alongside value_range_low for sensitivity analysis and investment committee reporting.
attributes.references: USPAP; IVSC IVS 104; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: value_range_low
attributes.description: The lower bound of the appraiser's value range opinion when a range rather than a point estimate is concluded. Used in portfolio stress testing and sensitivity analysis in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: USPAP; IVSC IVS 104; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: value_type
attributes.description: The standard of value concluded in the appraisal report. Market Value is the most common; Investment Value reflects a specific investor's criteria; Liquidation Value assumes a forced sale; Insurable Value is used for insurance replacement cost; Assessed Value is used for property tax purposes.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 104; USPAP; FASB ASC 820

products.name: appraiser
products.description: Master registry of certified appraisers and valuation professionals engaged by the firm. Stores Appraisal Institute designation (MAI, SRA, AI-GRS, AI-RRS), state license number, license expiration date, E&O insurance details, firm affiliation, geographic coverage areas, specialization (commercial, residential, industrial, land), IVSC membership flag, and engagement history summary. Distinct from the workforce domain employee record — this covers both internal staff appraisers and external fee appraisers.

attributes.name: appraiser_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the appraiser record in the master registry. Primary key for the valuation.appraiser data product.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ai_designation
attributes.description: Appraisal Institute professional designation held by the appraiser. MAI (Member, Appraisal Institute) is the premier commercial designation; SRA is for residential; AI-GRS and AI-RRS are review designations. Drives assignment eligibility for complex CRE valuations and REIT reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Designation Program; IVSC General Standards

attributes.name: appraiser_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the appraiser is an internal staff appraiser employed by the firm or an external fee appraiser engaged on a per-assignment basis. Drives engagement workflow, payment processing, and compliance oversight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal|external_fee|panel|independent_contractor — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP (Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice)

attributes.name: argus_appraiser_code
attributes.description: Unique appraiser identifier as assigned in Argus Enterprise, the firm's primary valuation and cash flow modeling platform. Used to link appraisal report outputs and DCF model references back to the appraiser master record.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise (Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: average_turnaround_days
attributes.description: Historical average number of calendar days from engagement order to final appraisal report delivery for this appraiser. Used in SLA management and assignment scheduling to meet investment decision timelines.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Argus Enterprise Reporting

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent background check was completed for the appraiser as part of vendor onboarding or periodic re-qualification. Required for all appraisers with access to occupied properties.
attributes.references: OSHA; HUD Vendor Standards; Firm Vendor Management Policy

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any disclosed conflicts of interest, recusal history, or independence exceptions for the appraiser. Reviewed by the Chief Compliance Officer prior to high-value or REIT-related engagements.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; Dodd-Frank Act Section 1472; SOX Section 406

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours
attributes.description: Total continuing education hours completed by the appraiser in the current license renewal cycle. Minimum CE requirements vary by state and license type per Appraiser Qualifications Board (AQB) criteria.
attributes.references: Appraiser Qualifications Board (AQB); USPAP; Appraisal Subcommittee (ASC)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the appraiser record was first created in the master registry. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 404 and GDPR Article 30 records of processing activities.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary professional email address for the appraiser, used for engagement notifications, report delivery, and credential renewal reminders.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the appraiser in the firm's approved panel. Active appraisers are eligible for new assignments; suspended or blacklisted appraisers are blocked from engagement pending review.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; SOX Section 404; USPAP

attributes.name: eo_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage limit in USD of the appraiser's E&O professional liability insurance policy. Minimum coverage thresholds are enforced per firm vendor policy and engagement value tiers.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: eo_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Policy Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the appraiser's E&O insurance policy expires. Automated compliance checks prevent engagement of appraisers with lapsed E&O coverage.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule

attributes.name: eo_insurer_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Insurance Provider Name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability coverage for the appraiser. Required for all external fee appraisers engaged by the firm to mitigate valuation liability risk.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: eo_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the appraiser's Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance. Used for claims processing and vendor compliance verification.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule

attributes.name: firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the appraisal firm or company with which the appraiser is affiliated. For internal staff appraisers, this is the firm's own entity name. For external fee appraisers, this is the name of their employing or contracting firm.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the appraiser, used for CRM correspondence and internal directory lookups.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the appraiser as it appears on their state license and Appraisal Institute credential. Used for engagement letters, appraisal report signatures, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC General Standards

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_metros
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of metropolitan statistical area (MSA) codes or city names representing the appraiser's primary market coverage areas. Supports granular assignment matching below the state level.
attributes.references: U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) MSA Definitions; CoStar Suite Market Definitions

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_states
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes representing the geographic markets in which the appraiser is licensed and operationally active. Used for assignment routing and market coverage gap analysis. Example: 'CA,NV,AZ'.
attributes.references: Appraisal Subcommittee (ASC); USPAP; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: independence_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appraiser has signed and returned the current-year independence and conflict-of-interest declaration. USPAP Ethics Rule and Dodd-Frank Act require appraiser independence from loan production and property transaction parties.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; Dodd-Frank Act Section 1472; FIRREA

attributes.name: ivsc_member_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) Membership Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appraiser holds active membership with the International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC). IVSC membership signals adherence to International Valuation Standards (IVS), which is required for cross-border investment valuations and IFRS 16 / IAS 40 reporting.
attributes.references: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); IFRS 16; IAS 40

attributes.name: last_engagement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently completed valuation engagement performed by this appraiser for the firm. Used to identify dormant panel members and trigger re-qualification reviews for appraisers inactive for more than 24 months.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name of the appraiser, used for sorting, search, and formal correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appraiser's primary state license expires. Automated alerts are triggered 90 and 30 days prior to expiry to prevent engagement of unlicensed appraisers, which would violate FIRREA and USPAP compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FIRREA; Appraisal Subcommittee (ASC); USPAP

attributes.name: license_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appraiser's state license was most recently renewed. Used to track renewal cycle compliance and continuing education (CE) hour requirements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Subcommittee (ASC); USPAP Advisory Opinions

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the primary state in which the appraiser holds their active license or certification. Used to validate geographic assignment eligibility.
attributes.references: Appraisal Subcommittee (ASC); USPAP; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Classification of the appraiser's state license level per the Appraiser Qualifications Board (AQB) criteria. Certified General is required for complex commercial assignments; Certified Residential for residential properties above $400K.
attributes.references: Appraiser Qualifications Board (AQB); FIRREA; USPAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes about the appraiser, including special qualifications, market expertise, engagement preferences, or administrative remarks maintained by the Valuation team.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Firm Valuation Policy

attributes.name: offboarded_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appraiser was removed from the firm's approved panel. Nullable for currently active appraisers. Populated upon voluntary withdrawal, license revocation, or firm-initiated removal.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule; Firm Vendor Management Policy

attributes.name: onboarded_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appraiser was formally onboarded to the firm's approved appraiser panel. Marks the start of the engagement eligibility lifecycle.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Firm Vendor Management Policy

attributes.name: panel_tier
attributes.description: Firm-assigned panel tier classification for the appraiser. Preferred tier appraisers receive priority assignment for complex CRE and REIT portfolio valuations; probationary tier requires enhanced review of all submitted reports.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; SOX Section 404; SEC REIT Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the appraiser, used for scheduling site visits and urgent engagement coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: preferred_fee_usd
attributes.description: Standard or negotiated fee in USD that the appraiser charges per engagement. Used for budgeting valuation costs and vendor payment processing via Accounts Payable (AP). Actual fees may vary by assignment complexity.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule (fee independence); SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Internal quality rating assigned to the appraiser based on report accuracy, USPAP compliance, peer review outcomes, and client feedback. Drives panel tier assignment and preferred appraiser designation for high-value engagements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standards Rule 3 (Review Appraisal); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: specialization
attributes.description: Primary property type specialization of the appraiser. Determines assignment eligibility for specific valuation engagements (e.g., commercial CRE, residential, industrial, land). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|residential|industrial|land|multifamily|hospitality — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC General Standards; USPAP

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued appraiser license or certification number. Required for all federally related transactions under FIRREA. Stored per primary state of licensure; multi-state licenses tracked in a separate coverage table.
attributes.references: FIRREA (Financial Institutions Reform Recovery and Enforcement Act); Appraisal Subcommittee (ASC); USPAP

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) for the appraiser or their firm, required for IRS 1099-NEC reporting for external fee appraisers. Stored encrypted at rest per PCI and SOX data security requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: total_engagements
attributes.description: Cumulative count of completed valuation engagements performed for the firm. Serves as a proxy for experience depth and is used in appraiser performance scoring and panel tier classification. Updated by the engagement history summary process.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the appraiser record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: uspap_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appraiser most recently completed the required 7-hour National USPAP Update Course. Used to calculate the biennial renewal cycle and confirm compliance status.
attributes.references: USPAP; Appraiser Qualifications Board (AQB)

attributes.name: uspap_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appraiser has completed the current biennial USPAP continuing education requirement. Non-compliant appraisers are ineligible for federally related transaction assignments.
attributes.references: USPAP (Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice); Appraisal Qualifications Board (AQB); FIRREA

attributes.name: valuation_methodology
attributes.description: Primary valuation methodology employed by the appraiser. Drives assignment matching for specific engagement types: DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) for investment-grade CRE, BPO (Broker Price Opinion) for distressed assets, CMA (Comparative Market Analysis) for residential. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_comparison|income_capitalization|cost_approach|dcf|bpo|cma — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IVSC General Standards; Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standards Rule 1-2; Argus Enterprise

products.name: appraisal_report
products.description: The formal deliverable output of an appraisal engagement. Stores report format (URAR, narrative, restricted, summary), concluded market value, value date (effective date of value), report date, value type (market value, investment value, liquidation value, insurable value), IVSC standard applied, report file reference (DocuSign CLM document ID), review status, and reviewer sign-off. One appraisal engagement may produce one or more reports (e.g., as-is vs. as-stabilized).

attributes.name: appraisal_report_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the appraisal report record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: appraisal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent appraisal engagement that commissioned this report. One engagement may produce multiple reports (e.g., as-is vs. as-stabilized).
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subject property being appraised, linking to the property master record.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_engagement. attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: The file name, version identifier, or document reference for the Argus Enterprise cash flow model used to support the DCF valuation in this report. Enables traceability back to the source financial model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise (Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: as_is_value
attributes.description: The appraised value of the property in its current physical and economic condition as of the effective date, without consideration of any proposed improvements or stabilization. Commonly used alongside as-stabilized value for development and repositioning assets.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 400 Real Property Interests; USPAP

attributes.name: as_stabilized_value
attributes.description: The prospective appraised value of the property upon reaching stabilized occupancy and income levels, assuming completion of any proposed improvements. Used in development financing and investment underwriting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 400; Argus Enterprise valuation modeling

attributes.name: cap_rate_applied
attributes.description: The overall capitalization rate (CAP rate) applied in the income capitalization approach, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0650 for 6.50%). Derived from comparable sales analysis and market data. Key input for NOI-based valuation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; CoStar Suite market data

attributes.name: concluded_market_value
attributes.description: The appraiser's final concluded value opinion for the subject property as of the effective date, expressed in the report currency. This is the primary quantitative output of the appraisal engagement and is used for investment decisions, financial reporting, and loan underwriting.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 104; USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IASB IFRS 13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this appraisal report record was first created in the Silver Layer data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55000 Asset Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate applied in the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 for 8.00%). Reflects the required rate of return for the investment, incorporating risk and market conditions.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise DCF modeling

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the concluded value opinion is valid (also known as the value date). This is the principal real-world event date for the appraisal and may differ from the report date. Critical for investment decision-making and financial reporting under ASC 842 and IFRS 16.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 101; USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; FASB ASC 820; IASB IFRS 13

attributes.name: extraordinary_assumptions
attributes.description: Narrative description of any extraordinary assumptions made in the appraisal that, if found to be false, could alter the appraiser's opinions or conclusions. Required USPAP disclosure. Examples include assumed lease-up timelines or assumed environmental clearance.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: gross_building_area_sqf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Building Area (GBA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: The total gross building area of the subject property in square feet (SQF) as measured or verified by the appraiser. Used to calculate per-square-foot (PSF) value indicators and compare to market comparables.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; BOMA International Building Measurement Standards; RESO

attributes.name: holding_period_years

attributes.name: hypothetical_conditions
attributes.description: Narrative description of any hypothetical conditions applied in the appraisal that are contrary to known facts but assumed for the purpose of analysis (e.g., assuming a proposed building is complete as of the effective date). Required USPAP disclosure.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appraiser physically inspected the subject property. A desktop or drive-by appraisal may have no inspection date. Required for USPAP compliance certification.

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: The stated purpose for which the appraisal report is intended to be used, as required by USPAP (e.g., mortgage financing, financial reporting, portfolio valuation, acquisition due diligence, estate planning, litigation support). Determines the scope of work and applicable standards.

attributes.name: intended_user
attributes.description: The party or parties identified by the appraiser as the intended user(s) of the appraisal report (e.g., lender name, client organization, REIT investment committee). Required USPAP disclosure. Restricts reliance on the report to named parties.

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: The Internal Rate of Return (IRR) output from the DCF analysis, expressed as a decimal. Represents the annualized rate of return that equates the present value of projected cash flows to the concluded value. Key metric for investment decision-making.

attributes.name: limiting_conditions

attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: The Net Present Value (NPV) output from the DCF analysis, representing the present value of projected future cash flows discounted at the applied discount rate. Supports investment advisory and portfolio management decisions.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute

attributes.name: number_of_comparables

attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standards Rule 1-4; CoStar Suite comparable data

attributes.name: report_date

attributes.name: report_format

attributes.name: report_number

attributes.name: report_scenario
attributes.description: The valuation scenario represented by this report. One engagement may produce multiple scenario reports.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 400; USPAP Advisory Opinion 17

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the appraisal report workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through internal review, approval, client issuance, and potential supersession or withdrawal.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: The current status of the internal or external review process for this appraisal report. Tracks whether a supervisory or desk review has been initiated, completed, approved, or rejected per Appraisal Institute and USPAP Standards Rule 3.

attributes.name: reviewer_sign_off_date

attributes.name: scope_of_work
attributes.description: Description of the type and extent of research and analyses applied in the appraisal assignment, as required by USPAP Scope of Work Rule. Includes data sources consulted, inspection type, and approaches to value considered.
attributes.references: USPAP Scope of Work Rule; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: terminal_cap_rate
attributes.description: The reversion or terminal CAP rate applied to the projected NOI at the end of the DCF holding period to estimate the terminal/residual value of the property. Used in Argus Enterprise DCF models.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: valuation_approach

attributes.name: value_psf

attributes.name: value_type
attributes.description: The basis of value concluded in the report. Market Value is the most common standard; Investment Value reflects a specific investor's criteria; Liquidation Value applies to distressed scenarios; Insurable Value is used for insurance purposes; Assessed Value is used for tax purposes.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 104 Bases of Value; Appraisal Institute; USPAP
