attributes.name: implied_value_psf_low
attributes.business_glossary_term: Implied Value Per Square Foot (PSF) Low
attributes.description: The lower bound of the implied market value per square foot derived from the CAP rate range and prevailing NOI levels for this segment. Provides a sanity-check metric for appraiser CAP rate selections and supports portfolio-level GAV/NAV estimation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: investor_sentiment
attributes.description: The prevailing investor sentiment toward this property type and market segment as reported in the source survey (bullish, neutral, bearish). Provides qualitative market context for investment committee presentations and portfolio strategy discussions.
attributes.references: PwC/Korpacz Real Estate Investor Survey; Urban Land Institute (ULI) Emerging Trends

attributes.name: is_institutional_grade
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benchmark applies specifically to institutional-grade investment properties meeting NCREIF/REIT portfolio standards (True) or to the broader market including non-institutional assets (False). Relevant for REIT portfolio NAV/GAV calculations and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: NCREIF; SEC REIT Reporting; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: is_primary_benchmark
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is designated as the primary (preferred) benchmark for the given property type, asset class, and submarket combination when multiple sources exist for the same period. True = primary benchmark to be used in appraisal validation; False = secondary/supplemental benchmark.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: market_liquidity_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the transaction liquidity in this market segment at the time of the survey (high, moderate, low, illiquid). Informs the reliability weighting of the benchmark and the appropriate discount for illiquidity in investment advisory and REIT portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Urban Land Institute (ULI); NCREIF

attributes.name: ncreif_property_index_code
attributes.description: The NCREIF (National Council of Real Estate Investment Fiduciaries) Property Index segment code corresponding to this benchmark's property type and geographic classification. Enables alignment with NCREIF NPI return benchmarks for institutional investment performance reporting.
attributes.references: NCREIF Property Index (NPI); SEC REIT Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: noi_psf_high
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Operating Income (NOI) Per Square Foot (PSF) High
attributes.description: The upper bound of the surveyed Net Operating Income (NOI) per square foot (PSF) range for this market segment. Used alongside noi_psf_low to bracket NOI assumptions in Argus Enterprise DCF models and appraisal income approach analyses.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; NCREIF

attributes.name: noi_psf_low
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Operating Income (NOI) Per Square Foot (PSF) Low
attributes.description: The lower bound of the surveyed Net Operating Income (NOI) per square foot (PSF) range for this market segment, expressed in the currency per square foot. Used as an input cross-check for DCF models in Argus Enterprise and for validating NOI assumptions in appraisal reports.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; NCREIF

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of transactions, properties, or investor respondents included in the source survey for this specific property type, asset class, and submarket segment. A key indicator of statistical reliability; smaller samples warrant greater caution in appraisal application.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 105; NCREIF

attributes.name: source_organization
attributes.description: The name of the industry research organization or brokerage firm that published the survey from which this benchmark data was sourced (e.g., CoStar, CBRE, JLL, Cushman & Wakefield, NCREIF, PwC/Korpacz). Governs the credibility weighting applied during appraiser CAP rate selection validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CoStar|CBRE|JLL|Cushman & Wakefield|NCREIF|PwC/Korpacz|Marcus & Millichap|Colliers|Avison Young|Green Street — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; CoStar Suite; NCREIF

attributes.name: source_report_name
attributes.description: The formal name of the survey report or publication from which this benchmark data was extracted (e.g., 'CBRE Cap Rate Survey H1 2024', 'PwC Real Estate Investor Survey Q3 2024', 'NCREIF Property Index Q2 2024'). Enables traceability back to the original source document for audit and IVSC compliance.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1

attributes.name: source_report_url
attributes.description: The URL or digital reference link to the original published survey report. Supports audit trail requirements and allows appraisers to access the primary source document when validating CAP rate selections.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the market survey or data collection was conducted or published by the source organization. This is the principal real-world event date for this benchmark record, representing when the CAP rate data was captured from the market.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: survey_frequency
attributes.description: The publication cadence of the source survey (quarterly, semi-annual, annual, monthly). Used to determine the expected expiry_date of each benchmark record and to schedule automated refresh workflows in the data pipeline.
attributes.references: NCREIF; PwC/Korpacz Real Estate Investor Survey; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: survey_methodology
attributes.description: Narrative description of the data collection and analysis methodology used by the source organization to derive the CAP rate benchmarks (e.g., transaction-based, investor survey, broker opinion, hedonic regression). Required for IVSC-compliant methodology metadata and appraiser disclosure in appraisal reports.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; International Valuation Standards Council

attributes.name: total_transaction_volume
attributes.description: The aggregate dollar value of all transactions included in the benchmark dataset for this segment and period, expressed in the currency indicated by currency_code. Provides context for the depth and liquidity of the market segment being benchmarked.
attributes.references: NCREIF; CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: The number of actual closed sale transactions underlying the CAP rate benchmark data for this segment and period, where the source provides transaction-based data. Distinct from sample_size which may include survey respondents. Supports statistical confidence assessment.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; CoStar Suite; NCREIF

attributes.name: trend_basis_points
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAP Rate Trend Basis Points Change
attributes.description: The period-over-period change in the midpoint CAP rate expressed in basis points (bps), where 1 bps = 0.01%. Negative values indicate compression; positive values indicate expansion. Provides a precise quantitative measure of market movement to complement the qualitative trend_direction field.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; NCREIF; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Directional trend of CAP rates in this market segment relative to the prior survey period. Compressing indicates CAP rates are decreasing (values rising); stable indicates no material change; expanding indicates CAP rates are increasing (values falling). Critical context for investment committee presentations and portfolio NAV/GAV assessments.
attributes.references: NCREIF; PwC/Korpacz Real Estate Investor Survey; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this benchmark record was most recently modified, including updates to CAP rate values, status changes, or analyst note revisions. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8000

products.name: nav_calculation
products.description: Net Asset Value (NAV) and Gross Asset Value (GAV) calculation record at the portfolio or fund level. Stores calculation date, portfolio/fund reference, total GAV (sum of market values), total debt outstanding, NAV (GAV minus debt), NAV per unit/share, AFFO adjustment, FFO, methodology (direct capitalization, DCF, third-party appraisal blend), number of properties included, and calculation preparer. Supports REIT financial reporting (SEC), investor reporting, and ASC 820 fair value disclosures.
products.reference: SEC — REIT Reporting; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; NCREIF

attributes.name: affo
attributes.description: Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO) for the reporting period, representing FFO adjusted for recurring capital expenditures, straight-line rent adjustments, and other non-cash items. Considered a more accurate proxy for distributable cash flow than FFO.
attributes.references: NAREIT AFFO Guidance; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: appraisal_coverage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the portfolio GAV supported by independent third-party appraisals in this calculation cycle (e.g., 75.00 means 75% of GAV is appraiser-supported). Relevant for FASB ASC 820 Level 3 disclosure and investor transparency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; SEC Regulation S-X; IVSC General Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this NAV/GAV calculation was formally approved by the designated reviewer or investment committee. Supports SOX control documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the Argus Enterprise cash flow model(s) used as the source for property valuations feeding into this NAV/GAV calculation. Supports audit traceability back to the originating valuation model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; FASB ASC 820 Level 3 documentation requirements

attributes.name: aum
attributes.description: Total Assets Under Management (AUM) for the fund or portfolio as of the calculation date, which may differ from GAV by including non-real-estate assets, cash, and receivables. Used in investment advisory fee calculations and investor reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which the NAV and GAV are calculated. This is the principal business event date — the valuation reference point used in investor reports, REIT filings, and ASC 820 fair value disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; SEC Regulation S-X; IVSC General Standards

attributes.name: calculation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for this NAV/GAV calculation run (e.g., NAV-2024-000123). Used in investor reports, SEC filings, and audit trails to uniquely reference a specific calculation event.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820; IVSC General Standards

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the NAV/GAV calculation record. Controls workflow from initial preparation through review, approval, and publication to investors or regulators. 'Superseded' indicates a revised calculation replaced this one.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: capex_reserve
attributes.description: Estimated capital expenditure (CAPEX) reserve set aside for future property improvements, TI (Tenant Improvements), and major maintenance across the portfolio. Deducted in AFFO calculation and considered in NAV adjustments.
attributes.references: NAREIT AFFO Guidance; FASB ASC 840/842; Argus Enterprise Capital Expenditure Modeling

attributes.name: cash_and_equivalents
attributes.description: Total cash and cash equivalent balances held at the portfolio or fund level as of the calculation date. Included in the NAV bridge as a non-real-estate asset component.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230 Statement of Cash Flows; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NAV calculation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, SOX control documentation, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate (required rate of return) applied in DCF-based property valuations feeding into this NAV calculation. Reflects risk-adjusted cost of capital for the portfolio. Applicable when valuation_methodology is 'dcf' or 'blended'.
attributes.references: IVSC General Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820 Level 3 Inputs

attributes.name: fair_value_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: ASC 820 / IFRS 13 fair value hierarchy classification for the inputs used in this NAV calculation. Level 1 = quoted market prices; Level 2 = observable inputs; Level 3 = unobservable inputs (most common for real estate). Required for SEC and financial statement disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: ffo
attributes.description: Funds From Operations (FFO) for the reporting period, calculated per NAREIT definition as net income plus real estate depreciation and amortization, excluding gains/losses on property sales. Standard REIT performance metric reported to investors and the SEC.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: gross_asset_value
attributes.description: Total Gross Asset Value (GAV) of the portfolio as of the calculation date, representing the sum of all property market values before deducting debt and liabilities. Core output of the NAV model used in REIT reporting, investor communications, and ASC 820 fair value disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IVSC General Standards; SEC Regulation S-X; NAREIT FFO White Paper

attributes.name: is_audited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NAV/GAV calculation has been subject to external audit review (True) or is an unaudited management estimate (False). Relevant for annual REIT financial statement audits and SEC filings.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: is_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NAV calculation has been formally published and communicated to investors or regulators (True) or remains an internal working estimate (False). Controls investor disclosure workflow.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; NAREIT Investor Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this NAV calculation record. Supports change tracking, SOX audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Portfolio-level Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio, calculated as total debt outstanding divided by GAV. Key leverage metric monitored by lenders, investors, and rating agencies for CMBS and REIT credit analysis.
attributes.references: CMBS reporting standards; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X; DSCR/LTV covenant monitoring

attributes.name: methodology_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing key assumptions, methodology choices, significant judgments, and any departures from standard methodology applied in this NAV/GAV calculation. Required for FASB ASC 820 Level 3 disclosure and investor transparency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IVSC General Standards; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: nav_change
attributes.description: Absolute change in NAV from the prior period to the current calculation date (current NAV minus prior NAV). Supports period-over-period performance reporting to investors and the board.
attributes.references: NAREIT NAV Methodology; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Asset Value (NAV) Per Unit / Share
attributes.description: NAV divided by total units or shares outstanding, representing the per-unit intrinsic value of the fund or REIT. Key metric for investor reporting, unit pricing, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: NAREIT NAV Methodology; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820; IFRS 13

attributes.name: net_asset_value
attributes.description: Net Asset Value (NAV) of the portfolio or fund, calculated as GAV minus total debt outstanding minus other liabilities. The primary output metric used in REIT investor reporting, unit pricing, and SEC fair value disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; NAREIT NAV Methodology; SEC Regulation S-X; IVSC General Standards

attributes.name: noi_total
attributes.description: Aggregate Net Operating Income (NOI) across all properties included in this NAV calculation, representing total effective gross income minus operating expenses before debt service. Primary input to direct capitalization and DCF valuation methodologies.
attributes.references: IVSC General Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; NAREIT FFO White Paper; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: other_liabilities
attributes.description: Non-debt liabilities attributable to the portfolio (e.g., deferred revenue, security deposits payable, accrued expenses, lease incentive obligations) deducted from GAV in the NAV calculation. Supports completeness of the NAV bridge.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: prior_nav
attributes.description: NAV from the immediately preceding calculation period, used to compute period-over-period NAV change and growth rate for investor reporting and performance attribution.
attributes.references: NAREIT NAV Methodology; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: property_count
attributes.description: Total count of properties included in this NAV/GAV calculation. Provides a completeness check and supports reconciliation against the portfolio property register in Argus Enterprise or MRI Software.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: The date on which this NAV calculation was formally published and made available to investors or filed with regulators. Null if not yet published.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; NAREIT Investor Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The financial reporting period this NAV calculation corresponds to (e.g., Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Annual, Monthly). Aligns the calculation with the fund's financial reporting calendar for investor and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820; IFRS 13

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year associated with this NAV calculation (e.g., 2024). Used in conjunction with reporting_period to uniquely identify the reporting cycle.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: straight_line_rent_adjustment
attributes.description: Non-cash straight-line rent adjustment applied to AFFO, representing the difference between contractual rent escalations recognized on a straight-line basis under ASC 842 and actual cash rent received. Standard REIT AFFO adjustment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; NAREIT AFFO Guidance; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: third_party_appraiser
attributes.description: Name of the external appraisal firm or certified appraiser (MAI designation, Appraisal Institute member) engaged to provide independent property valuations used in this NAV calculation. Required when valuation_methodology includes third-party appraisal.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC General Standards; FASB ASC 820 Level 3 documentation

attributes.name: total_debt_outstanding
attributes.description: Aggregate outstanding debt balance (mortgages, credit facilities, CMBS, and other borrowings) secured against or attributable to the portfolio as of the calculation date. Deducted from GAV to arrive at NAV.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X; CMBS reporting standards

attributes.name: units_outstanding
attributes.description: Total number of fund units or REIT shares outstanding as of the calculation date. Used as the denominator to compute NAV per unit/share for investor reporting and unit pricing.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; NAREIT FFO White Paper; FASB ASC 260 Earnings Per Share

attributes.name: valuation_methodology
attributes.description: The primary methodology used to determine property market values feeding into the GAV calculation. Options include direct capitalization (applying a CAP rate to NOI), Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), third-party appraisal, a blended approach, or a proprietary NAV model. Aligns with IVSC and FASB ASC 820 fair value hierarchy.
attributes.references: IVSC General Standards; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: weighted_avg_cap_rate
attributes.description: Portfolio-level weighted average CAP rate (Capitalization Rate) applied across all properties in the NAV calculation, weighted by property value. Used to validate the implied GAV against market benchmarks and support investor reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC General Standards; FASB ASC 820; CoStar Suite Market Analytics

attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the appraisal review record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary values in this review record, including original appraised value and reviewer value opinion. Supports multi-currency portfolio reporting for international real estate investments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830; IFRS 21

attributes.name: deficiency_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct deficiencies, errors, or omissions identified in the original appraisal report during the review. A count of zero indicates no deficiencies found. Used for quality scoring and vendor performance management.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute; CMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: deficiency_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the key deficiencies, errors, or omissions identified in the original appraisal report. Includes methodology issues, comparable selection problems, adjustment errors, and USPAP compliance failures. Supports revision requests and vendor feedback.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute AI-GRS

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed appraisal review report was delivered to the client or requesting party. Used for SLA compliance tracking and lender submission deadlines.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; CMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: final_disposition
attributes.description: The final administrative outcome of the appraisal review process, indicating whether the original appraisal is accepted for use, rejected, requires revision, or is conditionally accepted pending corrections. Drives lender approval workflows and CMBS securitization eligibility.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; CMBS underwriting standards; SEC regulations for REIT reporting

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: The stated purpose for which the appraisal review is being performed. Drives the applicable standards, required scope of work, and report format. CMBS underwriting and mortgage lending are the most common intended uses requiring USPAP Standard 3 compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mortgage_lending|cmbs_underwriting|internal_qc|portfolio_reporting|litigation|regulatory_compliance|investment_decision — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; CMBS underwriting standards; SEC regulations

attributes.name: irr_reviewed
attributes.description: The Internal Rate of Return (IRR) output from the DCF analysis in the original appraisal, as reviewed by the appraiser reviewer. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.085 for 8.5%). Reviewer assesses reasonableness against market investor return expectations.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: is_rush_order
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the appraisal review was ordered on an expedited or rush basis, typically commanding a premium fee and reduced turnaround SLA. Used for capacity planning and fee schedule application.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; internal SLA management

attributes.name: ivsc_methodology_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) Methodology Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the original appraisal and the review process comply with IVSC International Valuation Standards. Relevant for cross-border investment portfolios, institutional investors, and REIT financial reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: IVSC International Valuation Standards (IVS); IFRS 13; IASB

attributes.name: market_conditions_adequate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the reviewer assessed the original appraisal's market conditions analysis (supply, demand, absorption, trends) as adequate and current. False indicates the market analysis section requires revision or supplementation.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute; CoStar Suite market analytics

attributes.name: noi_reviewed
attributes.description: The stabilized Net Operating Income (NOI) figure used in the original appraisal's income approach, as reviewed by the appraiser reviewer. Reviewer assesses reasonableness of income and expense assumptions against market data. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: ordered_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appraisal review was formally ordered or commissioned by the client, lender, or internal department. Used for SLA tracking and turnaround time measurement.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; CMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: original_appraisal_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the original appraisal report being reviewed. Critical for assessing whether the appraisal reflects current market conditions and for CMBS underwriting compliance.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 103; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: original_appraisal_firm
attributes.description: Name of the appraisal firm or company that produced the original appraisal report being reviewed. Used for vendor performance tracking and CMBS lender panel management.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: original_appraised_value
attributes.description: The market value opinion stated in the original appraisal report being reviewed. Expressed in the currency indicated by currency_code. Used as the baseline for reviewer agreement or disagreement analysis.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 104; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: original_appraiser_name
attributes.description: Full name of the appraiser who prepared the original appraisal report under review. Retained as a denormalized field for audit trail and USPAP compliance documentation, as the original appraiser may not be in the internal system.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: requester_reference
attributes.description: The client's or lender's own reference number or loan number associated with this appraisal review order. Enables cross-referencing with the requesting party's loan origination or CMBS deal management systems.
attributes.references: CMBS underwriting standards; mortgage lending compliance

attributes.name: review_conclusion
attributes.description: The reviewer's overall conclusion regarding the original appraisal report. 'Agree' indicates the reviewer concurs with the original value and methodology; 'Disagree' indicates material differences; 'Conditional' indicates agreement subject to specific corrections or conditions being met.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute; CMBS underwriting guidelines

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which the appraisal review was performed and the reviewer's opinion was formed. This is the principal business event date, distinct from the order date or report delivery date.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; IVSC IVS 102

attributes.name: review_fee
attributes.description: The fee charged or paid for the appraisal review engagement, expressed in currency_code. Used for accounts receivable, vendor invoice reconciliation, and engagement profitability analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Ethics Rule (fee disclosure)

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the appraisal review engagement, used for cross-referencing with lenders, CMBS underwriters, and internal quality control systems. Typically assigned by the review firm or internal QC department.
attributes.references: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) Standard 3; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the appraisal review workflow, from initial order through completion or cancellation. Drives workflow routing in quality control and lender compliance processes.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the appraisal review methodology performed. Desk review involves analysis of the written report only; field review includes a property inspection; technical review focuses on methodology and calculations; administrative review checks completeness and compliance.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute Review Designation (AI-GRS)

attributes.name: reviewer_designation
attributes.description: Professional designation held by the reviewer as awarded by the Appraisal Institute. MAI (Member Appraisal Institute) and AI-GRS (General Review Specialist) are most common for commercial appraisal reviews. Validates reviewer qualifications for CMBS and institutional lender requirements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standard 3

attributes.name: reviewer_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued appraiser license or certification number of the reviewer. Required for USPAP compliance documentation and lender panel eligibility verification. Must be a Certified General Appraiser license for commercial property reviews.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute; HUD; state appraisal licensing boards

attributes.name: reviewer_license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction in which the reviewer holds their appraiser license or certification. Validates geographic competency for the subject property location per USPAP competency rule.
attributes.references: USPAP Competency Rule; Appraisal Institute; state appraisal licensing boards

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the reviewer's additional observations, qualifications, assumptions, or limiting conditions not captured in structured fields. Supplements the formal review report narrative.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: reviewer_value_opinion
attributes.description: The reviewer's independent market value opinion for the subject property, applicable when a field review is performed and the reviewer develops their own value conclusion. Null for desk reviews where no independent value is developed. Required for CMBS underwriting when the reviewer disagrees with the original appraised value.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute AI-GRS; IVSC IVS 102

attributes.name: scope_of_work
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope of work performed in the appraisal review, including what was reviewed, the extent of the review, and any limitations. Required by USPAP Standard 3 to be disclosed in the review report.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; USPAP Scope of Work Rule; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the appraisal review record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: uspap_standard3_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) Standard 3 Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the appraisal review was conducted in full compliance with USPAP Standard 3 (Appraisal Review). Required for lender compliance, CMBS underwriting, and internal quality control certification. True indicates full compliance; False triggers mandatory remediation workflow.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Foundation; CMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: valuation_approach
attributes.description: The primary valuation approach(es) employed in the original appraisal that were subject to review. Income approach (including DCF) is standard for commercial properties; sales comparison for residential. Reviewer must assess the appropriateness of the approach selected.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: value_variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage difference between the reviewer's value opinion and the original appraised value, calculated as (reviewer_value_opinion - original_appraised_value) / original_appraised_value. Null when no reviewer value opinion is developed. Used to flag material discrepancies requiring escalation per lender guidelines.
attributes.references: CMBS underwriting standards; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 820

products.name: value_history
products.description: Historical valuation record tracking all concluded values for a property over time. Stores property reference, valuation date, concluded value, value type (market value, assessed value, insurance value, book value, investment value), valuation method used, source discriminator (appraisal, BPO, CMA, internal desk review, tax assessment, automated valuation model), appraiser/analyst reference, confidence level, and financial reporting period association. Enables trend analysis, supports ASC 820 fair value hierarchy disclosures (Level 1/2/3), and provides the audit trail for REIT portfolio reporting and investor NAV reconciliation.
products.reference: FASB ASC 820 — Fair Value Measurement; IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: File name or unique identifier of the Argus Enterprise DCF model file used to produce this valuation. Enables direct traceability from the concluded value back to the source cash flow model for audit and reproducibility purposes.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: argus_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Argus Enterprise model file (e.g., v3.2, 2024-Q4) used to produce this valuation. Supports model governance, change tracking, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; SOX Internal Controls; IVSC IVS 103

attributes.name: asc820_level
attributes.description: FASB ASC 820 fair value hierarchy classification for this valuation. Level 1 = quoted prices in active markets; Level 2 = observable inputs other than Level 1; Level 3 = unobservable inputs (most real estate falls here). Mandatory for REIT financial statement disclosures and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; SEC REIT Reporting; IFRS 13

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: The capitalization rate applied in the income capitalization approach, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.065 = 6.5%). Derived from market evidence and used to convert NOI into an indicated value. Key input for investment analysis and portfolio benchmarking.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise Income Approach

attributes.name: concluded_value
attributes.description: The final concluded value amount for the property as determined by the appraiser or analyst. Represents the point estimate of value (market value, assessed value, etc.) in the stated currency. Core monetary fact for NAV reconciliation and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820; IVSC IVS 104; Appraisal Institute USPAP; IFRS 13

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Qualitative confidence level assigned to the concluded value by the appraiser or internal reviewer. High = strong market evidence and data quality; Medium = adequate evidence with some uncertainty; Low = limited market data or significant assumptions. Used for risk weighting in portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 103; Appraisal Institute USPAP; Internal Risk Management Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this valuation history record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for SOX compliance and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate applied in the DCF valuation model, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.075 = 7.5%). Reflects the required rate of return for the investment, incorporating risk, market conditions, and asset-specific factors. Stored for model reproducibility and audit.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise DCF Module; IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this valuation is considered stale and should no longer be used for financial reporting or investment decisions without a refresh. Typically 12 months from the valuation effective date for REIT reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820; SEC REIT Reporting; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: gav
attributes.description: Gross Asset Value of the property as determined in this valuation, representing the total undiluted market value before deducting liabilities. Used in REIT portfolio reporting, NAV calculations, and investor disclosures.
attributes.references: INREV NAV Guidelines; SEC REIT Reporting; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Gross Leasable Area of the property in square feet as measured at the time of this valuation. Used as the denominator for PSF value calculations and for tracking changes in measurable area over time.
attributes.references: BOMA International Measurement Standards; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: hold_period_years
attributes.description: The assumed investment hold period in years used in the DCF valuation model. Typically 5 or 10 years for commercial real estate. Stored as a key Argus Enterprise model assumption for reproducibility.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise DCF Module; IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: The stated intended use of this valuation as declared in the engagement letter. Drives the applicable standard of value and methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial_reporting|loan_collateral|acquisition|disposition|portfolio_review|insurance|tax_appeal|litigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 101; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return output from the DCF valuation model, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.085 = 8.5%). Represents the discount rate at which the NPV of projected cash flows equals zero. Key metric for investment decision-making and portfolio performance reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise DCF Module; CFA Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: market_conditions_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing prevailing market conditions at the valuation effective date, including supply/demand dynamics, comparable transaction activity, and macroeconomic factors. Required USPAP disclosure and supports qualitative analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 103; CoStar Suite Market Research

attributes.name: nav_contribution
attributes.description: This property's contribution to the fund or portfolio Net Asset Value as calculated in this valuation period, after deducting allocated debt and liabilities. Used for investor NAV reconciliation and REIT unit pricing.
attributes.references: INREV NAV Guidelines; SEC REIT Reporting; FASB ASC 820; IFRS 13

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income used as the primary income input in the income capitalization or DCF valuation approach. Represents effective gross income less operating expenses, excluding debt service and capital expenditures. Sourced from Argus Enterprise or Yardi Voyager operating statements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; NCREIF Standards

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: Net Present Value output from the DCF valuation model in the stated currency. Represents the present value of projected future cash flows discounted at the required rate of return. Supports investment advisory and portfolio management decisions.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise DCF Module; CFA Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Physical occupancy rate of the property at the valuation effective date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9250 = 92.50%). Key income approach input affecting NOI and concluded value. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or MRI Software lease data.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Yardi Voyager; MRI Software

attributes.name: prior_concluded_value
attributes.description: The concluded value from the immediately preceding valuation for this property. Stored to enable direct period-over-period value change calculation for investor reporting and NAV reconciliation without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820; REIT Portfolio Reporting; INREV NAV Guidelines

attributes.name: prior_valuation_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the immediately preceding valuation for this property. Stored to facilitate period-over-period value change analysis and trend reporting without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 103; FASB ASC 820; REIT Portfolio Reporting Standards

attributes.name: property_condition
attributes.description: Physical condition of the property as assessed at the time of the valuation inspection. Influences the concluded value and is a required disclosure in USPAP-compliant appraisal reports.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 102

attributes.name: report_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the completed valuation report was delivered to the client or internal stakeholder. Distinct from the valuation effective date. Used for SLA tracking and engagement management.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 103

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the internal reviewer completed their review and approved or rejected this valuation record. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial reporting valuations.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 3; IVSC IVS 103

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the internal reviewer documenting their findings, adjustments requested, or basis for approval. Supports the audit trail and quality control process.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 3

attributes.name: terminal_cap_rate
attributes.description: The reversion or terminal capitalization rate applied at the end of the DCF hold period to estimate the residual/terminal value of the property. Expressed as a decimal. Key Argus Enterprise DCF assumption stored for model audit and sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise DCF Module; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this valuation history record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the last change for audit trail, data lineage, and incremental Silver Layer processing.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world date as of which the concluded value is stated. This is the appraisal effective date, not the report delivery date. Critical for time-series trend analysis and ASC 820 Level 1/2/3 hierarchy disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820; IVSC IVS 104; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Primary methodology applied to derive the concluded value. Sales Comparison = comparable sales analysis; Income Capitalization = direct cap rate applied to NOI; DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) = multi-period cash flow model (Argus Enterprise); Cost Approach = land plus depreciated replacement cost; AVM = automated model; Hybrid = combination of methods. Required for IVSC methodology metadata and ASC 820 Level classification.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 Valuation Approaches; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: valuation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this valuation record, formatted as VAL-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in investor reports, audit trails, and cross-system reconciliation with Argus Enterprise and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation Module; Yardi Voyager; IVSC IVS 103

attributes.name: valuation_source
attributes.description: Source discriminator identifying how the concluded value was derived. Appraisal = certified third-party appraisal; BPO (Broker Price Opinion) = broker-prepared opinion; CMA (Comparative Market Analysis) = agent-prepared analysis; desk_review = internal analyst review; tax_assessment = government assessed value; AVM (Automated Valuation Model) = algorithmic estimate. Drives audit trail and confidence weighting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 101; FASB ASC 820 Level 1/2/3

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this valuation record. Draft = in preparation; under_review = submitted for internal or external review; approved = accepted for financial reporting use; superseded = replaced by a newer valuation; withdrawn = retracted by the appraiser or analyst. Controls which record is the current authoritative value for a property.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 103; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: value_change_pct
attributes.description: Percentage change in concluded value from the prior valuation to the current valuation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 = 3.50% increase). Calculated as (concluded_value - prior_concluded_value) / prior_concluded_value. Stored for reporting efficiency and trend analysis.
attributes.references: REIT Portfolio Reporting; INREV NAV Guidelines; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: value_psf
attributes.description: Concluded value expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis, calculated as concluded_value divided by the property's gross leasable area. Enables cross-property benchmarking and market comparability analysis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite Analytics; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: value_range_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of the concluded value range when the appraiser or analyst expresses value as a range rather than a single point estimate. Used in BPO and CMA contexts and for sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 104

attributes.name: value_range_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of the concluded value range when the appraiser or analyst expresses value as a range rather than a single point estimate. Used in BPO and CMA contexts and for sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 104

attributes.name: value_type
attributes.description: Classification of the basis of value being reported. Distinguishes market value (IVSC IVS 104), assessed value (tax authority), insurance value (replacement cost), book value (GAAP carrying amount), investment value (investor-specific), and liquidation value. Drives how the concluded value is used in financial reporting and investment analysis.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 104 Bases of Value; FASB ASC 820; Appraisal Institute USPAP

products.name: tax_assessment
products.description: Property tax assessment record capturing the assessed value assigned by the taxing authority for ad valorem tax purposes. Stores assessment year, assessed land value, assessed improvement value, total assessed value, assessment ratio, effective tax rate, annual tax liability, taxing jurisdiction, assessment notice date, appeal deadline, and appeal status. Distinct from market value appraisals — assessed value often differs materially from market value and drives property tax expense (a key OPEX component in NOI calculations).

attributes.name: abatement_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of any tax abatement granted by the taxing authority (e.g., development incentive abatement, payment-in-lieu-of-taxes (PILOT) arrangement). Distinct from exemptions; abatements are typically time-limited incentives tied to development agreements.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: abatement_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which any tax abatement arrangement expires, after which the full tax liability applies. Critical for long-term cash flow modeling in Argus Enterprise and investment underwriting — abatement burn-off materially impacts NOI (Net Operating Income) projections.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: appeal_deadline
attributes.description: Statutory deadline by which a formal appeal of the assessed value must be filed with the taxing authority. Critical compliance date tracked in Yardi Voyager and DocuSign CLM for deadline management.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 450 Contingencies

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal appeal was submitted to the taxing authority or appeals board. Null if no appeal has been filed. Used for tracking appeal timelines and legal deadlines.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450 Contingencies; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the taxing authority or appeals board issued a final decision on the appeal. Null if appeal is still pending. Triggers revised tax liability calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450 Contingencies

attributes.name: appeal_settled_value
attributes.description: Final assessed value agreed upon or ordered as a result of the appeal process. Null if appeal is pending or not filed. Replaces the original assessed value for tax liability calculation upon resolution.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC Valuation Standards; FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any formal appeal filed against this assessment. Tracks the appeal lifecycle from filing through final determination. Informs contingent liability disclosures under FASB ASC 450. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_appealed|appeal_filed|hearing_scheduled|decision_pending|appeal_granted|appeal_denied — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450 Contingencies; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: appeal_target_value
attributes.description: The assessed value the property owner is seeking through the appeal process. Represents the owner's position on fair assessed value, typically supported by an independent appraisal or BPO (Broker Price Opinion). Used to quantify potential tax savings from a successful appeal.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC Valuation Standards; FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Argus Enterprise cash flow model in which this tax assessment's OPEX (Operating Expenditure) is incorporated. Enables traceability between the assessed tax expense and the DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) valuation model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: assessed_improvement_value
attributes.description: Dollar value assigned by the taxing authority to the building and structural improvements on the property, exclusive of land. Drives depreciation analysis and CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) planning in Argus Enterprise models.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: assessed_land_value
attributes.description: Dollar value assigned by the taxing authority to the land component of the property, exclusive of improvements. Used in land vs. improvement allocation analysis and depreciation studies. Sourced from Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned unique identifier issued by the taxing authority for this assessment record. Used for correspondence, appeals, and cross-referencing with the assessor's office. Sourced from Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets module.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: assessment_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of assessed value to estimated market value as applied by the taxing jurisdiction (e.g., 0.80 = 80% of market value). Varies by jurisdiction and property class. Used to back-calculate implied market value from assessed value for investment analysis.
attributes.references: International Association of Assessing Officers (IAAO); Appraisal Institute; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the tax assessment record. Tracks progression from preliminary notice through certification, appeal, and final determination. Drives workflow in Yardi Voyager property accounting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 450 Contingencies

attributes.name: assessment_year
attributes.description: The tax year (calendar year) for which this assessment applies. Drives annual property tax expense calculations and year-over-year valuation trend analysis. Critical for NOI (Net Operating Income) OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: assessor_contact
attributes.description: Phone number or contact detail for the assessor's office. Used for inquiry and appeal coordination. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the government assessor or assessment office responsible for this assessment. Used for correspondence, appeal filings, and audit documentation.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax assessment record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The effective property tax rate expressed as a decimal percentage of the total assessed value (e.g., 0.0125 = 1.25%). Accounts for all applicable levies across overlapping jurisdictions. Used in NOI (Net Operating Income) modeling and CAP Rate (Capitalization Rate) analysis in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: exemption_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of tax exemptions applied to this assessment (e.g., homestead exemption, REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust) exemption, historic preservation, enterprise zone). Reduces the taxable assessed value or gross tax liability.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); SEC — for publicly traded REITs; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: exemption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary tax exemption applied to this assessment. Determines eligibility criteria and renewal requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: homestead|senior|veteran|nonprofit|historic|enterprise_zone|reit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); SEC — for publicly traded REITs

attributes.name: gross_annual_tax
attributes.description: Gross annual property tax liability before application of any exemptions, abatements, or credits. Computed from assessed value and millage rate. Key OPEX (Operating Expenditure) component in NOI (Net Operating Income) calculations and Argus Enterprise cash flow models.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; IVSC Valuation Standards; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: implied_market_value
attributes.description: Estimated market value implied by the taxing authority's assessment, calculated as total assessed value divided by the assessment ratio. Provides a reference point for comparing assessed value against independent appraisals and Argus Enterprise DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) valuations.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: installment_count
attributes.description: Number of installment payments into which the annual tax liability is divided (e.g., 1 = lump sum, 2 = semi-annual, 4 = quarterly). Determines AP (Accounts Payable) payment scheduling and cash flow timing in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable

attributes.name: is_nnn_tenant_recoverable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property tax expense is recoverable from tenants under NNN (Triple Net Lease) or modified gross lease structures. True = tax is passed through to tenants as a CAM (Common Area Maintenance) or operating expense recovery; False = landlord bears the tax expense. Critical for EGI (Effective Gross Income) and NOI (Net Operating Income) modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; IASB IFRS 16 Leases; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the taxing authority by governmental level. Properties may have multiple overlapping jurisdictions; this field identifies the type for each assessment record.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: millage_rate
attributes.description: The tax rate expressed in mills (dollars of tax per $1,000 of assessed value) levied by the taxing jurisdiction. Multiplied by the assessed value to compute the gross annual tax liability before exemptions.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: net_annual_tax
attributes.description: Net annual property tax liability after deducting all exemptions, abatements, and credits from the gross tax. This is the actual cash tax expense recorded in Yardi Voyager GL (General Ledger) and reported as a property OPEX (Operating Expenditure) line item in NOI (Net Operating Income) statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; FASB ASC 740; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date the taxing authority issued the official assessment notice to the property owner. Establishes the start of the appeal window and triggers internal review processes.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the property tax payment must be remitted to the taxing authority to avoid penalties and interest. Drives AP (Accounts Payable) scheduling in Yardi Voyager and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable; FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: prior_year_assessed_value
attributes.description: Total assessed value from the immediately preceding tax year. Enables year-over-year change analysis and supports appeal arguments based on disproportionate value increases. Used in Argus Enterprise cash flow modeling.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: property_class_code
attributes.description: Assessor's classification code for the property type (e.g., residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural). Determines applicable assessment methodology, exemption eligibility, and tax rate schedule.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); International Association of Assessing Officers (IAAO)

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the internal reviewer documenting assessment analysis, appeal rationale, comparable evidence, or instructions for the AP (Accounts Payable) team. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act).
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: tax_bill_number
attributes.description: Official tax bill number issued by the taxing authority for the annual tax payment. Used for AP (Accounts Payable) invoice matching in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA to ensure accurate tax remittance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: tax_psf
attributes.description: Annual net property tax liability expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis. Enables benchmarking across properties of different sizes and is a standard metric in NNN (Triple Net Lease) lease analysis and CAM (Common Area Maintenance) reconciliations.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: total_assessed_value
attributes.description: Total assessed value of the property as determined by the taxing authority, representing the sum of assessed land value and assessed improvement value. This is the ad valorem tax base and is typically distinct from market value. Key input to NOI (Net Operating Income) OPEX calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute; International Association of Assessing Officers (IAAO)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax assessment record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks revisions from appeal outcomes, value corrections, or payment status updates. Required for SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: yardi_property_code
attributes.description: Property code as assigned in Yardi Voyager, the system of record for property accounting and tax expense tracking. Enables direct reconciliation between this Silver Layer record and the source system's tax ledger entries.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Management System

Supports OPEX management and NOI optimization.

attributes.name: actual_tax_savings
attributes.description: The realized annual property tax reduction achieved upon settlement or adjudication, calculated from the difference between the original assessed value and the settled value at the applicable tax rate. Key metric for OPEX management and NOI reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SOX Financial Controls; Internal NOI Reporting

attributes.name: appeal_grounds
attributes.description: The legal or factual basis on which the appeal is filed. Common grounds include overassessment (value exceeds market value), unequal assessment (assessed at higher ratio than comparable properties), exemption eligibility, improper property classification, or clerical error. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overassessment|unequal_assessment|exemption|improper_classification|clerical_error|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State Property Tax Statutes; IAAO (International Association of Assessing Officers) Standards

attributes.name: appeal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional narrative, strategic commentary, or case-specific details relevant to the tax appeal. May include assessor communications, negotiation notes, or special circumstances affecting the appeal strategy.
attributes.references: Internal Asset Management Documentation Standards

attributes.name: appeal_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned or internally generated reference number for the tax appeal, used for correspondence with the taxing authority or assessment appeal board. Serves as the business identifier for tracking and reporting.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Local Taxing Authority Filing Standards

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome of the resolved appeal: value reduced (appellant prevailed), value upheld (taxing authority prevailed), partially reduced (compromise), withdrawn (appellant withdrew), or dismissed (procedural dismissal). Populated upon closure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450 Contingency Resolution; SOX Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax appeal, tracking progression from initial filing through resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|pending_hearing|settled|adjudicated|withdrawn|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450 Contingencies; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: appeal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the appeal by procedural level: informal (administrative review), formal (board of equalization or assessment appeal board), or judicial (court proceeding). Determines the legal process and cost implications.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Assessment Appeal Statutes

attributes.name: appealed_value
attributes.description: The property value asserted by the appellant in the appeal filing, representing the owner's or advisor's opinion of the correct assessed value. Typically supported by an independent appraisal or BPO.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standards; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: appraisal_fee
attributes.description: Fee paid to the appraiser or valuation professional for preparing the independent opinion of value submitted as evidence in the appeal. Included in total appeal cost for net savings analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Fee Standards; Internal OPEX Reporting

attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Argus Enterprise DCF or cash flow model used to support the valuation opinion submitted in the appeal. Enables traceability between the appeal record and the underlying valuation model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC DCF Methodology

attributes.name: assessment_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of the assessed value to the estimated market value as applied by the taxing authority (e.g., 0.80 = 80% of market value). Used in unequal assessment appeals to demonstrate inequitable treatment relative to comparable properties.
attributes.references: IAAO Assessment Ratio Standards; State Equalization Rate Guidelines

attributes.name: cap_rate_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) Used in Appeal
attributes.description: The Capitalization Rate (CAP rate) applied in the income capitalization approach to derive the opinion of value submitted in the appeal. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.065 = 6.5%). Sourced from market evidence and appraiser analysis.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 Income Capitalization; Appraisal Institute CAP Rate Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: comparable_sales_count
attributes.description: Number of comparable property sales used as evidence to support the opinion of value in the appeal. Indicates the depth of market evidence presented to the assessment authority.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 Sales Comparison Approach; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the tax appeal record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: deadline_date
attributes.description: The statutory deadline by which the appeal must be filed with the taxing authority. Critical for compliance tracking to avoid forfeiture of appeal rights due to missed deadlines.
attributes.references: State Property Tax Statutes; NAR Property Tax Appeal Guidelines

attributes.name: estimated_tax_savings
attributes.description: Projected annual property tax reduction if the appeal is successful, calculated based on the difference between the original assessed value and the appealed value multiplied by the applicable tax rate. Supports OPEX forecasting and NOI optimization analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; Internal OPEX/NOI Reporting Standards

attributes.name: exemption_type
attributes.description: The type of property tax exemption being claimed as grounds for the appeal, if applicable (e.g., nonprofit, government, historic preservation, agricultural, REIT-related). Null if the appeal is not exemption-based. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nonprofit|government|historic_preservation|agricultural|reit|low_income_housing|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS REIT Exemption Rules; HUD Affordable Housing Tax Exemptions; State Tax Exemption Statutes

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal tax appeal was filed with the taxing authority or assessment appeal board. This is the principal business event date for the appeal lifecycle.
attributes.references: Local Taxing Authority Filing Deadlines; FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: hearing_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date of the formal hearing before the assessment appeal board, board of equalization, or court. Null if the appeal is resolved prior to hearing through informal settlement.
attributes.references: State Assessment Appeal Statutes; NAR Property Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: is_multi_year_appeal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appeal covers multiple tax years simultaneously (True) or a single tax year (False). Multi-year appeals have greater financial impact and require additional disclosure under FASB ASC 450.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450 Contingencies; SOX Multi-Period Disclosure

attributes.name: legal_counsel_name
attributes.description: Name of the law firm or attorney representing the property owner in the tax appeal proceeding. Required for judicial appeals and formal hearings. Supports legal cost tracking and matter management.
attributes.references: SOX Legal Contingency Disclosure; Internal Legal Matter Management

attributes.name: legal_counsel_reference
attributes.description: The matter number, case reference, or engagement code assigned by the legal counsel or law firm managing the tax appeal. Used for cross-referencing with the legal matter management system.
attributes.references: SOX Legal Contingency Disclosure; DocuSign CLM Contract Reference

attributes.name: legal_fees_incurred
attributes.description: Total legal fees and professional costs incurred in prosecuting the tax appeal, including attorney fees, expert witness fees, and filing costs. Used for net tax savings calculation and OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SOX Financial Controls; Internal OPEX Reporting

attributes.name: noi_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Operating Income (NOI) Used in Appeal
attributes.description: The Net Operating Income (NOI) figure submitted as evidence in income-capitalization-based appeals. Represents the property's stabilized annual income less operating expenses, used to derive value via the CAP rate approach.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 Income Approach; Argus Enterprise Valuation Model; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: opinion_of_value
attributes.description: The independent market value opinion submitted as evidence in support of the appeal, typically derived from a formal appraisal, BPO, or CMA. May differ from the appealed value if a range or alternative methodology is used.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 105 Valuation Approaches

attributes.name: original_assessed_value
attributes.description: The assessed value of the property as determined by the taxing authority prior to the appeal. This is the baseline value being challenged and is used to calculate potential tax savings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: property_class
attributes.description: The property classification as recognized by the taxing authority for assessment purposes. Determines the applicable assessment ratio, tax rate, and exemption eligibility. May differ from the internal property type classification.
attributes.references: IAAO Property Classification Standards; Local Assessor Classification Codes

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The amount of property tax refund or credit due to the property owner as a result of a successful appeal, covering overpaid taxes for the appealed tax year(s). Impacts AR and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SAP S/4HANA AR Module; Internal Finance Reporting

attributes.name: refund_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax refund or credit was received from the taxing authority following a successful appeal. Used for cash flow reconciliation and AR tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SAP S/4HANA AR Module

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal was fully resolved, whether by settlement, adjudication, withdrawal, or administrative closure. Marks the end of the appeal lifecycle.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SOX Contingent Liability Disclosure

attributes.name: settled_value
attributes.description: The final assessed value agreed upon through settlement negotiations or determined by adjudication. Populated upon resolution of the appeal. Used to calculate actual tax savings achieved.
