products.name: nav_appraisal_input
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a specific appraisal report in a Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation. It captures which appraisals were used as valuation inputs for portfolio-level NAV calculations, the specific value drawn from each appraisal, the weight assigned to that appraisal in the aggregation, and whether adjustments were applied. Each record links one NAV calculation to one appraisal with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, supporting REIT financial reporting, investor transparency, and ASC 820 fair value hierarchy disclosures.. Existence Justification: In real estate investment management, NAV calculations are portfolio-level aggregations that draw on multiple individual property appraisals as valuation inputs. One NAV calculation incorporates many appraisals (across multiple properties in the portfolio), and one appraisal can be used in multiple NAV calculations over time (e.g., quarterly NAV runs for the same fund, or NAV calculations for multiple funds that own the same property). The business actively manages this relationship through valuation committees that select which appraisals to include, assign weights, and apply adjustments.

attributes.name: nav_appraisal_input_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each NAV appraisal input record.

attributes.name: appraisal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the appraisal report used as an input to the NAV calculation.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analyst or asset manager who linked this appraisal to the NAV calculation.

attributes.name: valuation_nav_calculation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Nav Appraisal Input - Valuation Nav Calculation Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the NAV calculation that consumed this appraisal as an input.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for any value adjustment applied, supporting audit trail and investor reporting transparency.

attributes.name: appraisal_weight_pct
attributes.description: The percentage weight assigned to this appraisal in the portfolio-level GAV aggregation. Used when multiple appraisals for the same property or when blending appraisal and internal valuations.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NAV appraisal input record was created.

attributes.name: effective_date_used
attributes.description: The value date (effective date) of the appraisal that was used in this NAV calculation. Typically matches appraisal.value_date but captured here to support audit trail and temporal alignment.

attributes.name: inclusion_status
attributes.description: Status of this appraisal input in the NAV calculation workflow. Included = fully incorporated, Excluded = not used, Partial = used with adjustments, Under Review = pending valuation committee approval.

attributes.name: is_most_recent_appraisal
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this appraisal was the most recent available appraisal for the subject property at the time of the NAV calculation. Supports ASC 820 Level 2/3 input recency requirements.

attributes.name: value_adjustment_applied
attributes.description: Any adjustment (positive or negative) applied to the appraisal's concluded value before inclusion in the NAV. Common adjustments include time decay, market condition changes, or reconciliation to internal models.

attributes.name: value_used_in_nav
attributes.description: The specific concluded value from the appraisal report that was incorporated into the NAV calculation. May differ from the appraisal's concluded_market_value if adjustments or a value range was used.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the entitlement application was formally submitted to the governing jurisdiction. Marks the start of the regulatory review clock and is used for tracking processing timelines.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: as_built_far
attributes.description: The actual FAR of the completed development as measured upon construction completion. Compared against total allowable FAR to confirm final FAR compliance. Populated post-construction.

attributes.name: base_far_allowance
attributes.description: The baseline Floor Area Ratio (FAR) permitted by the zoning district without any bonus mechanisms. Represents the ratio of total building floor area to the gross site area as established by the applicable zoning ordinance.

attributes.name: bonus_far
attributes.description: Additional FAR allowance earned through bonus mechanisms such as affordable housing inclusion, open space dedication, transit proximity, or public amenity contributions. Added to the base FAR to derive total allowable FAR.

attributes.name: bonus_far_mechanism
attributes.description: The specific incentive mechanism through which bonus FAR was earned (e.g., affordable housing set-aside, open space dedication, transit proximity, public amenity). Determines the conditions and obligations attached to the bonus FAR grant.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: conditions_of_approval
attributes.description: Narrative description of the conditions, mitigation measures, or obligations imposed by the regulatory authority as part of the entitlement approval. May include infrastructure dedications, design requirements, operational restrictions, or monitoring obligations.

attributes.name: counsel

attributes.name: entitlement_number

attributes.name: entitlement_status

attributes.name: environmental_review_status

attributes.name: environmental_review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental review conducted for this entitlement under applicable environmental law (e.g., CEQA, NEPA). Determines the level of environmental analysis required and the associated public review process.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved entitlement expires if construction or required actions have not commenced. Entitlements typically carry a vesting period; expiration triggers re-application requirements.

attributes.name: far_compliance_status

attributes.name: hearing_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the planning commission or board hearing at which this entitlement application is reviewed and decided. Critical for project scheduling and stakeholder notification.

attributes.description: General plan or comprehensive plan land use designation for the subject parcel (e.g., 'High Density Residential', 'Regional Commercial', 'Mixed Use — Urban Center'). Establishes the long-range planning framework within which zoning and entitlements must be consistent.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: max_building_height_ft
attributes.description: Maximum permitted building height in feet as established by the applicable zoning ordinance or as approved through the entitlement process. A key development constraint tracked for compliance.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: max_density_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of residential dwelling units permitted on the subject parcel under the applicable zoning ordinance or as approved through the entitlement. Applicable to residential and mixed-use developments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or supplementary information related to the entitlement that does not fit into structured fields. Used by project managers and entitlement teams for operational notes.

attributes.name: proposed_building_height_ft
attributes.description: Proposed building height in feet as submitted in the entitlement application. Must not exceed the maximum permitted height unless a height variance has been approved.

attributes.name: proposed_far
attributes.description: The FAR proposed by the development project as submitted in the entitlement application. Calculated as proposed gross floor area divided by gross site area. Must not exceed total allowable FAR for compliance.

attributes.name: proposed_gross_floor_area_sqf

attributes.name: proposed_units

attributes.name: regulatory_authority

attributes.name: site_area_sqf
attributes.description: Gross area of the subject development parcel in square feet (SQF). Used as the denominator in FAR calculations and for density limit assessments.

attributes.name: total_allowable_far
attributes.description: The maximum permitted FAR for the subject parcel, calculated as the sum of base FAR allowance and any approved bonus FAR. Represents the regulatory ceiling for building density on the site.

attributes.name: esg_requirements

attributes.name: final_completion_date

attributes.name: general_liability_limit

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_per_day

attributes.name: minority_business_required

attributes.name: notice_to_proceed_date

attributes.name: original_contract_value

attributes.name: payment_bond_amount

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_required

attributes.name: procore_contract_reference

attributes.name: retainage_release_threshold

attributes.name: revised_contract_value

attributes.name: scope_of_work

products.name: construction_budget
products.description: Tracks the approved CAPEX budget for each development project at both summary and cost-code-level detail. Summary level captures original budget, approved budget, current budget (including approved change orders), committed costs, actual costs to date, forecast at completion, and variance by category (hard costs, soft costs, land, financing, contingency). Line-item level captures individual cost codes (CSI division or custom WBS element), cost category, original and revised budget amounts, committed and actual spend, and remaining budget per line. Enables CAPEX draw schedule management, cost control, variance analysis, and investor reporting. Aligned with Procore budget module and SAP S/4HANA project systems for source-system integration.

attributes.description: Dollar value of materials and equipment presently stored on-site or in bonded storage but not yet incorporated into the work (Column F on AIA G703). Subject to lender approval and may require stored materials agreement.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; Construction Loan Administration

attributes.name: net_payment_due
attributes.description: Net amount due to the contractor for this draw request (total_earned_less_retainage minus previous_payments). Corresponds to 'Current Payment Due' on AIA G702. This is the amount requested for disbursement.
attributes.references: AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment

attributes.name: original_contract_amount
attributes.description: The original executed contract sum as stated in the construction contract before any approved change orders. Corresponds to the 'Original Contract Sum' field on AIA G702. Used as the baseline for tracking contract value changes.
attributes.references: AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment; FASB ASC 840/842

attributes.name: owner_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the property owner or owner's representative formally approved this draw request for submission to the construction lender.
attributes.references: AIA G702; Construction Loan Administration Best Practices

attributes.name: owner_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the owner's review and approval of this draw request. Owner approval is required before lender disbursement can be initiated.
attributes.references: AIA G702; Construction Loan Administration Best Practices

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Overall percentage of the contract work completed to date, calculated as total_earned_to_date divided by revised_contract_amount. Corresponds to Column H on AIA G703. Critical metric for lender draw approval and construction loan monitoring.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; Construction Loan Administration

attributes.name: previous_payments
attributes.description: Total amount of all prior certified payments made to the contractor under this contract. Corresponds to 'Less Previous Certificates for Payment' on AIA G702. Used to calculate the current net payment due.
attributes.references: AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment

attributes.name: procore_draw_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier for this draw request record within Procore Construction Management system. Used for system-of-record traceability and data lineage from the source operational system.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: retainage_rate
attributes.description: Contractual retainage percentage applied to earned value for this draw (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%). May be reduced at substantial completion milestones per contract terms. Stored as a decimal fraction.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions; State Prompt Payment Acts

attributes.name: retainage_withheld_current
attributes.description: Retainage amount withheld from the current period's earned value. Corresponds to Column J on AIA G703. Calculated as the applicable retainage percentage applied to current period work completed.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; State Prompt Payment Acts

attributes.name: retainage_withheld_previous
attributes.description: Cumulative retainage withheld from all prior draw requests. Corresponds to Column I on AIA G703. Retainage is a percentage of earned value held back by the owner as security for contract completion.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; State Prompt Payment Acts

attributes.name: revised_contract_amount
attributes.description: Current contract sum including all approved change orders (original_contract_amount + approved_change_order_amount). Corresponds to 'Contract Sum to Date' on AIA G702. Represents the total authorized contract value at time of this draw.
attributes.references: AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment

attributes.name: scheduled_value
attributes.description: Total scheduled value of all work items in the Schedule of Values (AIA G703) for this contract as of this draw. Represents the total value of work to be performed under the contract.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; Schedule of Values

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor formally submitted this draw request / pay application to the owner or construction manager for review and approval.
attributes.references: AIA G702; Construction Loan Administration Best Practices

attributes.name: title_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the title company completed its review and issued clearance (or noted exceptions) for this draw request.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: title_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the title company's review of lien waivers and title endorsement for this draw. Title company clearance confirms no mechanic's liens have been filed and is typically required by the lender before disbursement.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; Construction Loan Administration

attributes.name: total_earned_less_retainage
attributes.description: Net amount earned to date after deducting total retainage withheld (total_earned_to_date minus total_retainage_withheld). Corresponds to Column L on AIA G703. Represents the contractor's net certified entitlement.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet

attributes.name: total_earned_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative total amount earned to date including work completed in all prior periods, work completed in the current period, and materials presently stored (work_completed_previous + work_completed_current + materials_stored). Corresponds to Column G on AIA G703.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet

attributes.name: total_retainage_withheld
attributes.description: Total cumulative retainage withheld to date across all draw requests including current period (retainage_withheld_previous + retainage_withheld_current). Corresponds to Column K on AIA G703.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this draw request record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: waiver_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount covered by the lien waiver, representing the value of work and materials for which lien rights are being released. Should correspond to the net payment due or disbursed amount.
attributes.references: State Mechanic's Lien Laws; ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: waiver_document_reference
attributes.description: Document storage reference (URL, document management system path, or DocuSign envelope ID) for the executed lien waiver document associated with this draw. Enables retrieval for lender and title company review.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Procore Document Control

attributes.name: waiver_execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lien waiver was signed and executed by the contractor or subcontractor. Required for lien waiver validity and title company review.
attributes.references: State Mechanic's Lien Laws; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: waiver_through_date
attributes.description: The date through which the lien waiver releases lien rights. Typically corresponds to the billing period end date. Ensures lien rights are waived for all work included in this draw.
attributes.references: State Mechanic's Lien Laws; ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: waiver_type
attributes.description: Type of lien waiver associated with this draw request per California Civil Code §8132-8138 or equivalent state standards. Conditional waivers are effective upon receipt of payment; unconditional waivers are effective immediately. Progress waivers cover partial work; final waivers cover all work through contract completion.
attributes.references: California Civil Code §8132-8138; State Mechanic's Lien Laws; ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: work_completed_current
attributes.description: Dollar value of work completed during the current billing period only (Column E on AIA G703). Represents the incremental progress achieved in this draw cycle.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet

attributes.name: work_completed_previous
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar value of work completed and certified in all prior draw requests (Column D on AIA G703). Used to calculate incremental work completed in the current billing period.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet

attributes.name: baseline_finish_date
attributes.description: The originally approved project completion date from the baseline schedule. Serves as the contractual reference for substantial completion and COO issuance milestones.

attributes.name: baseline_start_date
attributes.description: The originally approved project start date from the baseline schedule. Used as the reference point for schedule variance analysis and SPI calculation throughout the project lifecycle.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: capex_draw_schedule_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this project schedule to the associated CAPEX draw schedule in the finance system (Yardi or SAP S/4HANA). Enables alignment of construction milestone completion with capital draw requests to lenders.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; CAPEX — Capital Expenditure; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this project schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: critical_path_activity_count
attributes.description: Number of activities on the critical path (total float = 0 or negative) in the current schedule. Used to assess schedule complexity and focus project management attention on critical activities.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK CPM; Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: current_finish_date
attributes.description: The current forecast or actual project completion date from the latest schedule update. Used for investor milestone reporting and CAPEX draw schedule alignment.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: current_start_date
attributes.description: The current forecast or actual project start date reflecting the latest approved schedule update. May differ from baseline_start_date due to approved schedule changes.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: data_date
attributes.description: The as-of date through which actual progress has been recorded in this schedule update (also called the status date or time-now date in CPM scheduling). All forecast dates are projected forward from this date.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK; Primavera P6

attributes.name: external_schedule_file_ref
attributes.description: Path or URI to the native scheduling software file (e.g., Primavera P6 .xer or MS Project .mpp) stored in the document management system or cloud storage. Enables drill-back to the source schedule file.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: far_approved
attributes.description: The approved Floor Area Ratio for the development project as granted by the zoning authority. Used to verify that the construction schedule aligns with the approved development envelope and FAR compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FAR — Floor Area Ratio; Local Zoning Authority; ULI Development Best Practices

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the schedule was last updated with progress data or revised logic. Indicates the currency of the schedule information for reporting and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: milestone_actual_date
attributes.description: The date on which the milestone was actually achieved. Null if the milestone has not yet been completed. Populated upon milestone completion and used for as-built schedule records and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; COO Issuance — Certificate of Occupancy

attributes.name: milestone_forecast_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for milestone achievement based on the latest schedule update. Reflects schedule changes, delays, or acceleration. Used for investor milestone updates and CAPEX draw schedule alignment.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Name of the key project milestone tracked in this schedule record (e.g., 'Entitlement Approval', 'Groundbreaking', 'Foundation Pour', 'Topping Out', 'Substantial Completion', 'COO Issuance'). Supports milestone-level reporting to investors and lenders.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; ULI Development Best Practices

attributes.name: milestone_planned_date
attributes.description: The baseline-approved planned date for this milestone as established in the original project schedule. Used as the reference for milestone variance calculation and investor commitment tracking.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: milestone_predecessor_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of schedule activity or milestone IDs that must be completed before this milestone can begin, representing predecessor relationships in the CPM network. Supports critical path analysis and dependency visualization.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK CPM; Procore Construction and Development Project Management; Primavera P6

attributes.name: milestone_responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or role of the party accountable for achieving this milestone (e.g., General Contractor, Owner's Representative, Architect, Civil Engineer, Municipality). Used for accountability tracking and escalation management.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; OSHA Building Safety

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current completion status of the milestone: not_started, in_progress, completed, delayed (past forecast date without completion), or at_risk (forecast date within risk threshold). Drives milestone dashboard RAG status reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; ULI Development Best Practices

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the milestone per real estate development lifecycle: entitlement_approval, groundbreaking, foundation_pour, topping_out, substantial_completion, or coo_issuance (Certificate of Occupancy). Enables cross-project milestone benchmarking.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; ULI Development Best Practices; COO — Certificate of Occupancy

attributes.name: milestone_variance_days
attributes.description: Variance in calendar days between the milestone forecast (or actual) date and the milestone planned date. Positive value indicates delay; negative indicates early completion. Reported to investors and lenders as a key development performance indicator.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Overall schedule percent complete as of the data date, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Derived from the CPM schedule and reported to investors and lenders as a key construction progress indicator.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: procore_project_reference
attributes.description: The native project identifier from Procore Construction Management system. Used as the system-of-record cross-reference key for reconciling schedule data ingested from Procore into the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: schedule_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this schedule version was formally approved by the authorized party. Establishes the effective date of the baseline or revised schedule for contractual and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the project schedule (e.g., 'Phase 1 Baseline Schedule Rev 3'). Used for display in dashboards and investor milestone reports.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: schedule_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative accompanying the schedule update, describing key changes, delays, recovery actions, and risk items. Submitted with each schedule update to the owner and lender as part of the monthly construction report.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; Lender Construction Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the schedule document, used in Procore and cross-referenced in investor reports and construction contracts. Follows the pattern SCH-{ProjectCode}.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the schedule record: draft (under preparation), approved (formally accepted), active (in use for progress tracking), superseded (replaced by a newer version), or archived (historical record only).
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule version: baseline (original approved plan), current (live working schedule), recovery (corrective re-plan), what_if (scenario analysis), or as_built (post-completion record). Drives which schedule is used for SPI and variance reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK 7th Edition

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Difference in calendar days between the current finish date and the baseline finish date (current_finish_date minus baseline_finish_date). Positive value indicates delay; negative indicates ahead of schedule. Key metric for construction oversight reporting.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Earned Value Management; Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the schedule (e.g., 'B0' for baseline, 'R1', 'R2' for revisions). Tracks schedule evolution through the project lifecycle per CPM scheduling best practices.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; Project Management Institute (PMI) PMBOK

attributes.name: scheduling_software
attributes.description: CPM scheduling application used to produce this schedule (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project). Required for interoperability and file format management when importing schedule data into Procore or the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: spi
attributes.description: Schedule Performance Index from Earned Value Management: ratio of earned value to planned value (EV/PV). SPI < 1.0 indicates the project is behind schedule; SPI > 1.0 indicates ahead of schedule. Key metric for lender and investor reporting.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Earned Value Management; Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: total_activity_count
attributes.description: Total number of schedule activities (tasks) in this schedule version. Used to assess schedule density and compliance with owner-required schedule specifications.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: total_float_days
attributes.description: Total float (slack) of the project's critical path in calendar days as of the data date. Negative total float indicates the project is behind the contractual completion date. Critical for schedule risk assessment.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK; Primavera P6 CPM Scheduling; Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: update_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually required or agreed frequency at which the schedule is updated with progress data: weekly, bi_weekly, monthly, or milestone_driven. Governs the cadence of schedule submissions to the owner and lender.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; Construction Contract Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this project schedule record was last modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

products.name: project_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between dev_project and employee. It captures the staffing and role allocation of workforce personnel to real estate development projects. Each record links one development project to one employee with attributes that define their role, allocation percentage, tenure, and primary contact status on that specific project. Supports project staffing reports, CAPEX labor allocation tracking, and multi-project resource management.. Existence Justification: In real estate development operations, a single project requires a cross-functional team with multiple employees serving in distinct roles (Project Manager, Development Analyst, Legal Counsel, Finance Lead, Construction Manager), and individual employees—especially senior staff—work across multiple concurrent projects with varying allocation percentages. The business actively manages these assignments, tracking role, allocation percentage, tenure, and primary contact designation for each employee-project pairing. This is an operational staffing process, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this project assignment. Values: Active (currently staffed), On Hold (temporarily suspended), Completed (project phase or assignment ended normally), Terminated (assignment ended prematurely). Governs active resource counts and capacity planning.

products.name: project_broker_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the engagement contract between a development project and a licensed broker. It captures the specific role, transaction type, commission arrangement, and engagement period for each broker working on a development project. Each record links one development project to one broker with attributes that exist only in the context of this professional engagement relationship.. Existence Justification: In real estate development, a single development project engages multiple brokers across different phases and transaction types (e.g., one broker for land acquisition, another for lease-up, a third for disposition). Conversely, a successful broker works on multiple development projects simultaneously or over their career. Each engagement is a distinct business contract with its own role, commission terms, engagement period, and performance targets.

attributes.references: LPA Standard Terms; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: investment_strategy
attributes.description: Risk-return strategy classification of the fund per industry convention. Core strategies target stabilized assets with lower risk; opportunistic strategies target higher-risk, higher-return repositioning or development. Drives benchmark selection and performance attribution in Argus Enterprise and MRI Software.
attributes.references: National Council of Real Estate Investment Fiduciaries (NCREIF); Urban Land Institute (ULI) Strategy Classification

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual management fee charged by the GP to the fund, expressed as a decimal of the fee basis (e.g., 0.0150 = 1.50% of committed capital). Sourced from LPA terms and tracked in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; LPA Standard Terms; SEC Form ADV Part 2A

attributes.name: max_deal_size
attributes.description: Maximum individual asset or transaction size (in base currency) that the fund is mandated to consider for investment. Prevents over-concentration in a single asset and ensures portfolio diversification per LPA guidelines.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; ULI Investment Mandate Standards

attributes.name: min_deal_size
attributes.description: Minimum individual asset or transaction size (in base currency) that the fund is mandated to consider for investment. Ensures portfolio concentration and operational efficiency thresholds are maintained.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; ULI Investment Mandate Standards

attributes.name: nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value (NAV) of the fund as of the most recent valuation date, calculated as total assets minus total liabilities, expressed in the fund's base currency. Primary metric for open-end fund unit pricing and investor redemption calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: preferred_return_hurdle
attributes.description: Minimum annualized return rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%) that must be distributed to Limited Partners (LPs) before the General Partner (GP) is entitled to receive carried interest. Also known as the hurdle rate or preferred return.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; LPA Standard Terms; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the fund produces and distributes financial and performance reports to Limited Partners (LPs). Drives reporting calendar in MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Form N-CEN; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: target_aum
attributes.description: Target total Assets Under Management (AUM) the fund intends to reach at full deployment, expressed in the fund's base currency. Used in fundraising materials, investor presentations, and portfolio planning in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV Part 1A; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Target equity multiple (TVPI — Total Value to Paid-In) the fund aims to return to investors, expressed as a ratio (e.g., 1.80 = 1.8x). Represents total distributions plus residual NAV divided by total called capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; NCREIF PREA; CFA Institute GIPS Standards

attributes.name: target_irr
attributes.description: Target net Internal Rate of Return (IRR) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1200 = 12.00%) that the fund aims to deliver to investors over its life. Used in fund marketing materials, LP reporting, and performance benchmarking in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS Standards; NCREIF PREA; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: target_leverage_max
attributes.description: Maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio permitted under the fund's investment mandate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.65 = 65%). Defines the upper bound of the fund's leverage range. Exceeding this threshold may trigger LP notification requirements.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; NCREIF PREA; Basel III

attributes.name: target_leverage_min
attributes.description: Minimum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio permitted under the fund's investment mandate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.40 = 40%). Defines the lower bound of the fund's leverage range for portfolio construction and risk management.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; NCREIF PREA; Basel III (applicable to fund-level credit facilities)

attributes.name: term_years
attributes.description: Contractual life of the fund in years from inception to scheduled termination, as defined in the Limited Partnership Agreement (LPA) or fund prospectus. Null for open-end funds with no fixed term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-2; LPA Standard Terms

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date on which the fund is dissolved and all assets are liquidated and distributed to investors. Null for open-end or perpetual-life funds. Drives WALT and WALE calculations for portfolio wind-down planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-14; ULI Fund Lifecycle Framework

attributes.name: total_commitments
attributes.description: Aggregate capital committed by all Limited Partners (LPs) to the fund as of the final close, expressed in the fund's base currency. Represents the maximum capital available for investment and fee calculation basis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form D; LPA Standard Terms

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal appraisal or valuation of the fund's portfolio used to calculate NAV and GAV. Typically quarterly for institutional funds. Sourced from Argus Enterprise valuation models.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement

Serves as the SSOT for portfolio-level identity and strategy. Sourced from MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.

Portfolio-level obligation tracking drives compliance calendars, responsible departmen

attributes.name: benchmark_index
attributes.description: The market index or peer benchmark against which portfolio performance (IRR, TWR, total return) is measured (e.g., NCREIF NPI, MSCI Real Estate Index, FTSE NAREIT All Equity REITs Index).
attributes.references: NCREIF; MSCI Real Estate; FTSE NAREIT; GIPS Performance Standards

attributes.name: called_capital
attributes.description: Total equity capital drawn down (called) from investors and deployed into portfolio assets as of the most recent reporting date. Used to calculate remaining uncalled capital and deployment pace.
attributes.references: ILPA Capital Call Standards; SEC Investment Advisers Act; MRI Software

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate
attributes.description: General partner's carried interest (promote) rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.20 = 20%) representing the share of profits above the preferred return. Core economic term in fund waterfall and partnership agreements.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; ILPA Principles; IRS Carried Interest Rules; MRI Software

attributes.name: committed_capital
attributes.description: Total equity capital formally committed by investors to the portfolio as of the most recent reporting date. Distinct from called/deployed capital. Tracks fundraising progress against target fund size.
attributes.references: SEC Form D; ILPA Capital Call Standards; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the portfolio master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management per SOX and GDPR requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: distribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which income distributions (dividends, preferred returns) are made to investors from portfolio cash flows. Governs investor cash flow expectations and treasury planning.
attributes.references: SEC REIT Distribution Requirements; INREV Distribution Guidelines; MRI Software

attributes.name: ffo_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portfolio reports Funds From Operations (FFO) and Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO) per NAREIT standards. Applicable primarily to REIT-structured portfolios for SEC and investor reporting.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC REIT Reporting; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the portfolio was established and began accepting capital commitments or acquiring assets. Used as the baseline for IRR, TWR, and performance period calculations.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards); CFA Institute

attributes.name: leverage_policy
attributes.description: Portfolio-level leverage policy classification governing the use of debt financing. Unleveraged = no debt; Low = LTV <30%; Moderate = LTV 30-60%; High = LTV >60%. Aligns with investment strategy and risk mandate.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; SEC Investment Advisers Act; MRI Software

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual asset management fee rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0100 = 1.00% of AUM or GAV) charged by the investment manager. Disclosed in fund offering documents and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; INREV Fee Guidelines; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: open_end_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the portfolio is structured as an open-end fund allowing ongoing investor subscriptions and redemptions (True) versus a closed-end fund with a fixed capital raise and defined term (False).
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act; INREV Fund Structures; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: portfolio_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the portfolio used in investor reporting, Argus Enterprise, MRI Software, and regulatory filings. Unique across all portfolios.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; RESO Data Standards

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the investment portfolio as used in investor communications, fund documents, and management reporting (e.g., 'Core Office Fund III', 'Diversified Income REIT Portfolio').
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: portfolio_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the portfolio. Active = fully operational; Inactive = temporarily not deploying capital; Winding Down = in liquidation/disposition phase; Closed = fully liquidated; Pending Launch = pre-inception setup; Suspended = operations halted pending review.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SEC Fund Lifecycle Reporting

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Investment strategy classification of the portfolio reflecting risk-return profile. Core = stabilized low-risk assets; Core Plus = modest value enhancement; Value Add = repositioning required; Opportunistic = highest risk/return; Diversified = multi-sector; Sector Specific = single property type focus; Debt = mortgage/CMBS/RMBS instruments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|core_plus|value_add|opportunistic|diversified|sector_specific|debt — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCREIF ODCE Classification; ULI Investment Strategy Framework; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: Annualized preferred return rate (hurdle rate) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%) that must be paid to limited partners before the general partner participates in carried interest. Core term in fund waterfall structures.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; ILPA Private Equity Principles; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this portfolio record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary sources are MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: sox_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portfolio is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) internal control requirements, applicable to publicly traded REITs and entities with SEC reporting obligations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; SEC Reporting Requirements; SAP S/4HANA Financial Controls

attributes.name: target_aum
attributes.description: Target total Assets Under Management (AUM) for the portfolio representing the aggregate market value of all real estate assets managed on behalf of investors. Used for fee calculation and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; INREV AUM Guidelines; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: target_cap_rate
attributes.description: Target portfolio-level Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%) representing the expected NOI yield on asset value. Used for acquisition underwriting and portfolio valuation benchmarking.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Target equity multiple (EM) representing the total expected return of invested capital as a ratio (e.g., 1.80x means $1.80 returned per $1.00 invested). Complements IRR as a return metric in investor presentations.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; GIPS Performance Standards; ULI Investment Metrics

attributes.name: target_fund_size
attributes.description: Total target equity capital raise for the portfolio/fund expressed in the reporting currency. Represents the maximum committed capital the fund intends to raise from investors. Used for capital deployment planning.
attributes.references: SEC Form D; INREV Fund Reporting; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: target_gav
attributes.description: Target Gross Asset Value (GAV) representing the total undiscounted market value of all assets in the portfolio at full deployment, before deducting liabilities. Used for capital raising targets and AUM reporting.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; INREV NAV Guidelines

attributes.name: target_irr
attributes.description: Target annualized Internal Rate of Return (IRR) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0850 = 8.50%) representing the expected return on invested equity over the portfolio's life. Primary performance hurdle for investor commitments.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; GIPS Performance Standards; CFA Institute IRR Methodology

attributes.name: target_ltv
attributes.description: Target portfolio-level Loan-to-Value Ratio (LTV) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.60 = 60%) representing the maximum leverage policy for the portfolio. Governs debt capacity and risk management guidelines.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; DSCR Guidelines; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: target_nav
attributes.description: Target Net Asset Value (NAV) representing the portfolio's equity value after deducting all liabilities from GAV. Key metric for open-end fund unit pricing, investor redemptions, and performance reporting.
attributes.references: INREV NAV Guidelines; FASB ASC 946; Argus Enterprise; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: target_noi
attributes.description: Target annual Net Operating Income (NOI) for the portfolio representing total revenue less operating expenses before debt service and capital expenditures. Core income metric for CAP rate valuation and DSCR analysis.
attributes.references: NCREIF NOI Definition; Argus Enterprise; Yardi Voyager NOI Reporting

attributes.name: target_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Target portfolio-level physical occupancy rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 = 95%) representing the proportion of Net Leasable Area (NLA) that is leased and occupied. Core operational KPI for income forecasting.
attributes.references: NCREIF Occupancy Standards; Yardi Voyager; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: target_wale
attributes.description: Target Weighted Average Lease Expiry (WALE) in years representing the income-weighted average time until lease expiry across all portfolio assets. Distinct from WALT as it measures time to expiry rather than total term.
attributes.references: RESO Lease Standards; Argus Enterprise; INREV Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: target_walt
attributes.description: Target Weighted Average Lease Term (WALT) in years representing the income-weighted average remaining lease duration across all portfolio assets. Key metric for income stability and refinancing risk assessment.
attributes.references: RESO Lease Standards; Argus Enterprise; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which the portfolio is fully wound down and closed. Null for open-ended portfolios. Used for fund lifecycle management and investor distribution planning.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SEC Fund Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the portfolio master record. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance for investment management records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; MRI Software Audit Trail

attributes.name: valuation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which independent or internal valuations are conducted for portfolio assets to update NAV and GAV. Quarterly is standard for institutional funds; monthly for open-end funds with frequent redemptions.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; INREV Valuation Guidelines; Argus Enterprise; SEC

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Primary valuation methodology applied to assets within this portfolio for NAV and GAV calculations. DCF = Discounted Cash Flow; Direct Capitalization = NOI/CAP Rate; Sales Comparison = comparable transactions; Cost Approach = replacement cost; NAV Based = for fund-of-funds.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 820
