attributes.name: called_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital that has been drawn down (called) from investors to fund investments and pay vehicle expenses, expressed in the vehicle's base currency. Also referred to as 'contributed capital' or 'paid-in capital'. The difference between committed and called capital represents uncalled commitments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of profits allocated to the General Partner (GP) as performance compensation after the preferred return hurdle has been met, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 20.0000 = 20%). Also known as the 'carry' or 'promote'. A critical economic term in the LP Agreement governing the vehicle.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1061 (Carried Interest); FASB ASC 946; SEC Form ADV

attributes.name: committed_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital formally committed by all investors (LPs and GP) to the investment vehicle as of the most recent capital call or closing, expressed in the vehicle's base currency. Represents legally binding commitments, not yet necessarily drawn capital. Key metric for AUM reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form ADV; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investment vehicle record was first created in the lakehouse data platform. Represents the data ingestion audit trail timestamp, not the vehicle's legal formation date. Used for data lineage, audit, and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investment vehicle was legally dissolved and deregistered with the jurisdiction of formation. Null for active vehicles. Used to track the full lifecycle of the vehicle for historical reporting and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SEC Form D/A; State Corporate Dissolution Requirements

attributes.name: final_closing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investment vehicle completed its final capital raise and closed to new investors. Marks the end of the fundraising period and the start of the investment period clock. Null for open-ended vehicles or vehicles still in fundraising.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investment vehicle was legally formed and its organizational documents (e.g., LP Agreement, LLC Operating Agreement) were executed and filed with the relevant jurisdiction. Used to calculate vehicle age and track regulatory filing deadlines.
attributes.references: SEC Form D; State Corporate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: fund_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party fund administrator responsible for maintaining the vehicle's books and records, processing capital calls and distributions, and preparing investor statements (e.g., 'SS&C Technologies', 'Citco Fund Services'). A key operational service provider for the vehicle.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Form ADV; Investment Advisers Act of 1940

attributes.name: gp_entity_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the General Partner (GP) entity responsible for managing the investment vehicle, making investment decisions, and bearing unlimited liability. Applicable to LP and JV structures. Sourced from the vehicle's organizational documents.
attributes.references: Uniform Limited Partnership Act; SEC Form D; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: gp_ownership_pct
attributes.description: Percentage ownership interest held by the General Partner (GP) in the investment vehicle, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 1.0000 = 1%). Typically ranges from 0.01% to 5% in institutional real estate fund structures. Used for waterfall distribution calculations and financial consolidation under FASB ASC 810.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SEC Form D; Uniform Limited Partnership Act

attributes.name: investment_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vehicle's investment period expires, after which the GP may no longer make new investments (only manage and dispose of existing assets). Typically 3-5 years from the final closing date for closed-end funds. A critical milestone tracked in MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: investment_strategy
attributes.description: Risk-return investment strategy classification of the vehicle as defined by the Urban Land Institute (ULI) and NCREIF frameworks. Drives expected return profiles, leverage targets, and asset selection criteria used in Argus Enterprise portfolio modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|core_plus|value_add|opportunistic|debt|distressed|diversified — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI) Investment Strategy Framework; NCREIF Property Index

attributes.name: is_co_investment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle is a co-investment structure, where select investors participate alongside the main fund in a specific asset or transaction on a deal-by-deal basis, typically with reduced or no management fees and carried interest. Distinguishes co-investment vehicles from main fund vehicles.
attributes.references: ILPA Co-Investment Guidelines; SEC Form ADV; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: is_open_ended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investment vehicle is open-ended (allowing ongoing subscriptions and redemptions, e.g., a core open-end fund) as opposed to closed-ended (fixed capital raise with a defined term). Drives NAV calculation frequency, liquidity management, and redemption queue reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; NCREIF Open-End Diversified Core Equity (ODCE) Index; MRI Software

attributes.name: is_reit_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investment vehicle has elected and qualifies for Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) tax status under IRC Section 856. REIT-qualified vehicles must distribute at least 90% of taxable income and meet asset and income tests. Drives FFO/AFFO reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IRC Section 856-860 (REIT Qualification); SEC Reporting Requirements; NAREIT FFO White Paper

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier assigned to the investment vehicle by a Local Operating Unit (LOU). Required for regulatory reporting by publicly traded REITs and entities subject to SEC, CFTC, or EMIR reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 17442; SEC Reporting Requirements; GLEIF Global LEI System

attributes.name: lp_ownership_pct
attributes.description: Aggregate percentage ownership interest held by all Limited Partners (LPs) in the investment vehicle, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 99.0000 = 99%). Complements gp_ownership_pct; the sum of GP and LP ownership percentages must equal 100%. Used for distribution waterfall modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; Uniform Limited Partnership Act; SEC Form D

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual management fee charged by the General Partner or investment manager as a percentage of committed or invested capital, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 1.5000 = 1.5%). Reduces net returns to Limited Partners and is a key term in the investment management agreement.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV; FASB ASC 946; Investment Advisers Act of 1940

attributes.name: nav_calculation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the Net Asset Value (NAV) of the investment vehicle is formally calculated and reported to investors. Open-ended vehicles typically calculate NAV quarterly or monthly; publicly traded REITs calculate daily. Drives valuation and reporting workflows in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards; NCREIF Valuation Guidelines

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: Annual preferred return (hurdle rate) percentage promised to Limited Partners (LPs) before the General Partner (GP) participates in profits, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 8.0000 = 8%). A key term in the investment vehicle's waterfall distribution structure. Sourced from the LP Agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; Argus Enterprise Investment Analysis; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the investment vehicle's regulatory filings with applicable authorities (e.g., SEC Form D for Regulation D exempt offerings, SEC Form S-11 for REIT registrations). 'exempt' indicates the vehicle relies on a Regulation D or other exemption from full registration.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; Securities Act of 1933; Investment Company Act of 1940

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the investment vehicle's financial statements and investor reports are presented. May differ from currency_code (base currency) for multi-currency vehicles that report in a functional currency different from their investment currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: sec_filing_number
attributes.description: SEC-assigned filing number for the investment vehicle's regulatory filing (e.g., Form D accession number '0001234567-21-000001'). Used to cross-reference SEC EDGAR filings for compliance and investor due diligence purposes. Null for vehicles not subject to SEC filing requirements.
attributes.references: SEC EDGAR; Securities Act of 1933; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Target equity multiple (total value to paid-in capital ratio, TVPI) promised to investors, expressed as a multiplier (e.g., 1.8000 = 1.8x). Represents the total expected return of invested capital including distributions and residual value. Complements target_irr_rate as a performance objective.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; Argus Enterprise Investment Analysis; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: target_equity_raise_amount
attributes.description: Total equity capital the investment vehicle is targeting to raise from investors, expressed in the vehicle's base currency. Used to track fundraising progress and determine when the vehicle reaches its hard cap. Sourced from the Private Placement Memorandum (PPM).
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: target_irr_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Rate
attributes.description: Target net Internal Rate of Return (IRR) promised to investors in the vehicle's offering documents, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 12.0000 = 12%). Represents the annualized return objective after fees and carried interest. Used as the primary performance benchmark in Argus Enterprise modeling.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise Investment Analysis; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: target_leverage_ratio
attributes.description: Target Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio for the investment vehicle, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 60.0000 = 60% LTV). Defines the vehicle's intended use of debt financing relative to asset values. A key risk parameter monitored by asset managers and lenders. Sourced from the vehicle's investment guidelines.
attributes.references: NCREIF Leverage Guidelines; Argus Enterprise Investment Analysis; CMBS Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Federal income tax classification of the investment vehicle. Determines how income, gains, and losses flow through to investors. Pass-through entities (LPs, LLCs) allocate income directly to partners/members; REITs must distribute 90%+ of taxable income; C-Corps are subject to entity-level taxation.
attributes.references: IRS Revenue Ruling; IRC Section 856 (REIT Qualification); FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: term_years
attributes.description: Contractual term of the investment vehicle in years as specified in the LP Agreement or organizational documents (e.g., 10 years for a typical closed-end real estate fund). Determines the expected investment horizon and wind-down timeline. Extensions may be permitted subject to LP consent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; Uniform Limited Partnership Act; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investment vehicle record was most recently updated in the lakehouse data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Internal Data Governance Policy; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Short internal alphanumeric code used to identify the vehicle across operational systems such as MRI Software, Argus Enterprise, and Yardi Voyager GL. Serves as the business key for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: vehicle_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the investment vehicle as registered with the relevant jurisdiction (e.g., 'Apex Real Estate Fund II, LP', 'Meridian CRE Trust 2021-A'). Used as the primary human-readable identifier across reporting and investor communications.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FASB ASC 946 Financial Services — Investment Companies

attributes.name: vehicle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investment vehicle. 'active' indicates the vehicle is operational and deploying or managing capital; 'winding_down' indicates the vehicle is in the process of liquidating assets and returning capital to investors; 'closed' indicates the vehicle has been fully wound down and dissolved.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Legal structural classification of the investment vehicle. Determines governance, tax treatment, and regulatory obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LLC|LP|JV|SMA|REIT|CMBS_Trust|RMBS_Trust|C_Corp|GP_Entity|Co_Investment|Partnership — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form D; IRS Entity Classification Regulations

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the investment vehicle made its first investment or held its first capital closing. Used as the primary benchmark grouping for performance comparison against peer funds of the same vintage in Cambridge Associates, Preqin, and NCREIF benchmarks.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; Cambridge Associates Real Estate Benchmark; NCREIF

products.name: investor
products.description: SSOT for institutional and individual investor identities participating in real estate funds and portfolios. Captures investor legal name, investor type (institutional, HNWI, family office, pension fund, sovereign wealth fund, endowment, retail), KYC/AML status, accreditation status, domicile country, tax identification, preferred currency, investor tier, relationship manager, onboarding date, and investor status. Distinct from the owner domain (which tracks property ownership) — this entity tracks capital contributors to investment vehicles.
products.reference: Limited Partner / Investor — ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: investor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the investor record in the real estate investment platform. Primary key for the investor entity.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: domicile_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Investor domicile country drives FATCA/CRS classification, AML risk rating, foreign ownership restriction checks, and withholding tax rate determination — all mandatory for KYC/AML compliance and tax
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal relationship manager (Asset Manager or Investment Advisor) assigned to manage the investor relationship. Drives CRM activity tracking in Salesforce, reporting accountability, and investor communication routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Investment Advisory Policy

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Investors are domiciled in specific jurisdictions affecting tax treatment, AML requirements, and regulatory filings. Jurisdiction linkage is essential for FATCA/CRS classification, cross-border compli
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.market_segment. Business justification: Investor investment strategy (core, value-add, opportunistic) maps to market_segment for fund-investor mandate matching, co-investment screening, and investor relations reporting on strategy alignment
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Investor preferred currency drives distribution payment processing, capital account statement generation, and FX conversion for multi-currency fund distributions. Role-prefixed to distinguish from oth
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Investors are subject to regulatory obligations (FATCA, CRS, AML/KYC). Linking investor to applicable regulatory obligations supports KYC/AML compliance workflows, investor onboarding, and ongoing reg
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: target_property_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.property_type. Business justification: Investor mandate specifies target property type for deal matching, co-investment eligibility screening, and fund-investor mandate alignment reporting used in investor relations and capital raising.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accreditation_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investor's accreditation verification expires. Accreditation must be re-verified periodically to maintain eligibility for private placement investments under SEC Regulation D. Drives compliance monitoring and investor eligibility gating.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 501; Investment Company Act of 1940

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Regulatory accreditation classification of the investor under SEC Regulation D. Accredited investors meet income or net worth thresholds permitting participation in private placements. Qualified purchaser status permits investment in 3(c)(7) funds. Critical for fund eligibility gating and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 501; Investment Company Act of 1940 Section 3(c)(7)

attributes.name: aml_status
attributes.description: Current Anti-Money Laundering (AML) screening status for the investor. Cleared indicates the investor has passed sanctions screening and adverse media checks. Flagged indicates a potential match requiring enhanced due diligence. Mandatory for regulatory compliance under FinCEN and FATF guidelines.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: co_investment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor is eligible to participate in co-investment opportunities alongside the fund. Co-investment rights are typically granted to anchor investors and platinum-tier relationships. True enables the investor to receive co-investment deal flow notifications and participate in direct deal allocations.
attributes.references: Investment Advisers Act of 1940; Internal Investment Advisory Policy

attributes.name: committed_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital amount formally committed by the investor to real estate funds or investment vehicles, expressed in the investor's preferred currency. Represents the contractual obligation to fund capital calls up to this amount. Core metric for AUM (Assets Under Management) calculation and fund capacity management in MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investor Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investor record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the audit trail creation event. Used for data lineage, compliance audit trails, and SOX financial controls reporting.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: crs_classification
attributes.description: OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS) entity classification for automatic exchange of financial account information between tax authorities. Reportable Person indicates the investor's account information must be reported to their country of tax residency. Drives annual CRS reporting obligations.
attributes.references: OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: distribution_bank_account_ref
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the investor's designated bank account for distribution wire transfers and capital return payments. Full account details are stored in the secure payment vault; this field holds only the reference token. Used by Yardi Voyager AP module for distribution processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; GDPR Article 9; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: distribution_preference
attributes.description: Investor's preferred frequency and method for receiving investment distributions (income and return of capital). Quarterly is most common for real estate funds. Reinvest indicates the investor elects to reinvest distributions into additional fund units. Drives distribution waterfall processing in MRI Software and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investor Module; Yardi Voyager; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: esg_mandate_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Mandate Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has a formal ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) investment mandate requiring portfolio companies and assets to meet defined sustainability criteria. True triggers ESG screening in deal sourcing and LEED/BREEAM certification requirements in asset selection.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; BREEAM; SEC ESG Disclosure Rules; ULI ESG Framework

attributes.name: fatca_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Classification
attributes.description: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act) entity classification for the investor. Determines US withholding tax obligations and IRS reporting requirements. US Person classification triggers Form W-9 requirements. Foreign Financial Institution (FFI) classification requires GIIN registration. NFFE (Non-Financial Foreign Entity) requires beneficial ownership disclosure.
attributes.references: FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); IRS Form W-8BEN-E; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: investment_horizon_years
attributes.description: Investor's preferred investment hold period expressed in years. Drives fund structure matching (open-end vs. closed-end funds), asset disposition timing, and WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) alignment in portfolio construction. Typical real estate investment horizons range from 3 to 10+ years.
attributes.references: NCREIF; ULI Investment Strategy Framework; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: investor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the investor upon onboarding. Used across MRI Software, Yardi Voyager, and Argus Enterprise to reference the investor in capital accounts, distribution statements, and fund reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); MRI Software Investor Module

attributes.name: investor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investor record. Active indicates the investor is in good standing with capital deployed. Pending indicates onboarding in progress. Suspended indicates a hold due to KYC/AML review. Redeemed indicates full capital withdrawal. Closed indicates the investor relationship has been formally terminated.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FINRA KYC Rules; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: investor_tier
attributes.description: Relationship tier classification assigned to the investor based on committed capital, strategic importance, and relationship depth. Drives fee schedule application, co-investment priority access, reporting frequency, and relationship manager assignment. Platinum typically denotes anchor investors with largest AUM commitments.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Advisory Policy; ULI Best Practices

attributes.name: investor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investor by entity category. Drives regulatory treatment, reporting obligations, and fee structures. Institutional includes insurance companies, banks, and asset managers. HNWI (High Net Worth Individual) denotes qualifying individuals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: institutional|hnwi|family_office|pension_fund|sovereign_wealth_fund|endowment|retail|reit|fund_of_funds — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; Investment Advisers Act of 1940; FINRA Rule 4512

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation expires and renewal is required. Triggers automated alerts for re-verification workflows. Investors with expired KYC may be restricted from participating in new capital calls or fund subscriptions.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence process for the investor. Approved indicates all identity verification and background checks have been completed satisfactorily. Expired indicates KYC documentation has lapsed and requires renewal. Drives onboarding gates and capital call eligibility.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the investor as registered with regulatory authorities. For institutional investors, this is the registered entity name; for individuals, the full legal name as on government-issued identification. Used for KYC/AML compliance, subscription agreements, and capital account statements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SEC Regulation D; FINRA KYC Rules

attributes.name: minimum_investment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum capital amount the investor is willing to deploy per investment vehicle or fund subscription. Used during fund structuring and deal allocation to ensure investment sizing meets investor thresholds. Expressed in the investor's preferred currency.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; Investment Advisers Act of 1940; MRI Software

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investor completed the onboarding process and was formally admitted as an investor in the platform. Marks the start of the investor relationship lifecycle. Used for WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) equivalent calculations in investor tenure analytics and anniversary-based reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investor Module

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor or any beneficial owner is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) under AML regulations. PEP status requires enhanced due diligence (EDD) and senior management approval for onboarding. True indicates PEP status confirmed; False indicates no PEP association identified.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for investor communications including capital call notices, distribution notices, quarterly reports, and K-1 tax documents. Must be a valid, monitored email address per investor subscription agreement requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SEC Regulation D; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the investor organization. For individual investors, this is the investor themselves. For institutional investors, this is the designated relationship contact (e.g., portfolio manager, treasurer, or investment officer) responsible for fund communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the investor's designated contact. Used for urgent communications, capital call confirmations, and relationship management outreach. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: registered_address_city
attributes.description: City of the investor's registered legal address. Used in conjunction with registered address fields for KYC verification, regulatory correspondence, and tax document delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: registered_address_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the investor's registered legal address country. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, sanctions screening, and tax treaty application.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the investor's registered legal address. Used for regulatory correspondence, K-1 mailing, subscription agreement execution, and AML/KYC address verification. For institutional investors, this is the registered office address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IRS Publication 515; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: sanctions_screened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has been screened against applicable sanctions lists including OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and UN Security Council Sanctions List. True indicates screening has been completed. Must be True before capital can be accepted from the investor.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: side_letter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has a side letter agreement with the fund manager granting special terms, rights, or concessions beyond the standard limited partnership agreement (LPA). Side letters may include MFN (Most Favored Nation) clauses, reduced management fees, enhanced reporting rights, or co-investment priority. True triggers side letter terms application in fee and distribution calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; Investment Advisers Act of 1940; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: source_of_funds
attributes.description: Declared source of the investor's capital being deployed into real estate investments. Required for AML compliance to verify the legitimacy of invested capital. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating_income|asset_sale|inheritance|pension_fund|endowment_corpus|debt_financing|equity_raise|insurance_reserves|sovereign_allocation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Investor's target equity multiple (total distributions divided by total invested capital) for real estate investments. A multiple of 2.0x means the investor expects to receive twice their invested capital over the investment hold period. Used in Argus Enterprise for investment screening and portfolio performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; NCREIF

attributes.name: target_irr_max
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Maximum
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable Internal Rate of Return (IRR) threshold expressed as a decimal percentage. Defines the upper bound of the investor's risk-return appetite. Investors with low IRR maximums typically prefer core or core-plus strategies. Used alongside target_irr_min to define the investor's return corridor in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute Standards

attributes.name: target_irr_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Minimum
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable Internal Rate of Return (IRR) threshold expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%). Represents the investor's stated return hurdle below which investment opportunities are not considered. Used in Argus Enterprise for deal screening and portfolio matching against investor mandates.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute Standards

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax identification number provided. EIN (Employer Identification Number) for US entities, SSN (Social Security Number) for US individuals, ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number) for non-resident individuals, Foreign TIN for non-US entities, GIIN (Global Intermediary Identification Number) for FATCA-registered entities.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474)

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the investor. For US entities, this is the EIN (Employer Identification Number) or SSN (Social Security Number). For non-US entities, the equivalent national tax registration number. Used for IRS Form K-1 issuance, FATCA reporting, and withholding tax calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: tax_residency_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the investor's country of tax residency, which may differ from domicile country. Used for CRS (Common Reporting Standard) automatic exchange of information and applicable withholding tax treaty determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); FATCA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the investor record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, audit trail maintenance, and detecting stale KYC/AML data.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

products.description: Records the formal capital commitment made by an investor to a fund or investment vehicle. Tracks the lifecycle from LOI through full deployment. Sourced from MRI Software Investment Management.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross total capital amount the investor has committed to the fund or investment vehicle, expressed in the commitment currency. Represents the investor's maximum obligation under the subscription agreement. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: aum_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The portion of this commitment that contributes to the fund's reported Assets Under Management (AUM) figure, which may differ from the total commitment amount based on fund accounting policies and deployment stage.

attributes.name: called_capital_amount

attributes.name: capital_call_schedule_type

attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Standards

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate

attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards; SEC Form ADV

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The fund closing date at which this commitment was accepted. Funds may have multiple closes (first close, second close, final close); this identifies which close the investor participated in.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fund Reporting Standards

attributes.name: co_investment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commitment is a co-investment alongside the main fund vehicle (True) or a standard fund commitment (False). Co-investments typically carry different fee structures and governance rights.

attributes.name: commitment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor formally committed capital to the fund, typically the date the subscription agreement or LOI was executed. Serves as the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category).
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: commitment_number

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capital commitment from LOI through full deployment. Tracks progression: pending (LOI received), executed (subscription agreement signed), funded (capital fully called and received), defaulted (investor failed to meet capital call), cancelled (commitment withdrawn), transferred (commitment assigned to another investor). attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capital commitment record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: default_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor defaulted on a capital call obligation. Populated only when commitment_status is 'defaulted'. Triggers default remedies per the limited partnership agreement.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: distributed_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital returned to the investor through distributions (return of capital, realized gains, income distributions) against this commitment to date. Used in DPI (Distributions to Paid-In) calculations.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: erisa_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor's assets are subject to ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act) regulations. ERISA investors trigger plan asset rules and fiduciary obligations for the fund manager.
attributes.references: ERISA; U.S. Department of Labor; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: first_call_date
attributes.description: The date of the first capital call issued against this commitment. Marks the beginning of the capital deployment phase and triggers the investment period clock.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Standards

attributes.name: fund_term_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled termination date of the fund, representing the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for the commitment's binding period. After this date, the fund is expected to be wound down and all capital returned.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; SEC Form ADV

attributes.name: investment_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund's investment period expires, after which no new capital calls may be issued for new investments (only follow-on investments and fund expenses). Critical for uncalled capital management.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fund Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: loi_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Letter of Intent (LOI) that preceded the formal subscription agreement. Tracks the initial non-binding expression of interest in the commitment lifecycle.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; NAR Transaction Standards

attributes.name: management_fee_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which the management fee is calculated for this commitment — committed capital (during investment period), invested capital (post-investment period), NAV (Net Asset Value), or GAV (Gross Asset Value).
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: The annual management fee rate applicable to this commitment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0150 for 1.5%). Typically charged on committed or invested capital depending on fund terms.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards; SEC Form ADV

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, or investor-specific terms associated with this commitment that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: The annual preferred return (hurdle rate) percentage applicable to this commitment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 for 8%). The fund manager earns carried interest only after this return threshold is met for the investor.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: recallable_distributions_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of distributions made to the investor that are subject to recall (clawback) for future capital calls, per the fund's limited partnership agreement. Affects the effective uncalled capital balance.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: side_letter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commitment is accompanied by a side letter granting the investor special rights, terms, or concessions beyond the standard limited partnership agreement (e.g., MFN rights, fee discounts, reporting preferences).
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Side Letter Principles

attributes.name: side_letter_reference
attributes.description: Document reference identifier for the executed side letter associated with this commitment. Populated only when side_letter_flag is True. Links to DocuSign CLM for document retrieval.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Side Letter Principles

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by MRI Software Investment Management for this commitment record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: subscription_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the executed subscription agreement that formalizes the investor's capital commitment. Links to the DocuSign CLM contract lifecycle management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor is a tax-exempt entity (e.g., pension fund, endowment, sovereign wealth fund) for purposes of UBTI (Unrelated Business Taxable Income) and withholding tax calculations on distributions.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 598; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: total_capital_calls_count
attributes.description: The total number of capital calls that have been issued against this commitment to date. Used for tracking deployment pace and investor notification history.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The date on which this commitment was transferred to a new investor via secondary market transaction. Populated only when commitment_status is 'transferred'.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Secondary Transaction Guidelines

attributes.name: uncalled_capital_amount
attributes.description: Remaining capital not yet called from the investor, calculated as commitment_amount minus called_capital_amount. Represents the investor's dry powder — capital committed but not yet deployed. Critical for fund liquidity and deployment planning.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capital commitment record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, data lineage, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; MRI Software Investment Management

products.name: capital_call
products.description: Transactional record of each capital call notice issued to investors, requesting funded capital from committed but uncalled amounts. Captures call number, call date, call amount, call percentage of commitment, due date, purpose (acquisition, capex, fees, reserves), funding status, actual funded amount, shortfall amount, default flag, and wire transfer reference. Linked to commitment and fund. Supports LP capital account reconciliation and fund cash management. Sourced from MRI Software.
products.reference: Capital Call Notice — ILPA Reporting Template

attributes.name: capital_call_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each capital call notice record. Primary key for the capital_call data product.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific property or asset being acquired or improved with the called capital, where applicable. Supports property-level capital deployment tracking and CAPEX reporting.

attributes.name: commitment_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Capital call proceeds are coded to cost centers for GL posting and fund-level expense tracking. Fund accountants require this mapping to generate accurate journal entries and NOI reports when capital

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Capital call currency is required for wire instruction generation, FX conversion in multi-currency funds, and investor notice preparation — a core fund administration operational process.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment fund or vehicle (REIT, partnership, CMBS/RMBS) issuing this capital call. Supports fund-level cash management and LP capital account reconciliation.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: investment_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.investment_deal. Business justification: A capital call may be issued to fund a specific investment deal. The capital_call table has call_purpose and investment_purpose_description fields indicating the call may be for a specific acquisition
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the limited partner (LP) or investor entity to whom this capital call notice is issued. Supports investor-level capital account tracking.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capital call notice was formally approved for issuance by authorized fund management. Supports SOX internal control audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for the capital call notice prior to issuance. Tracks whether the call has been reviewed and authorized by fund management per SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: call_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount of capital being called from the investor in this notice. Represents the base monetary demand before any adjustments. Denominated in the fund's base currency.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: call_date
attributes.description: The date on which the capital call notice was formally issued to the investor. Represents the principal business event date for the call. Used for LP capital account reconciliation and fund cash flow scheduling.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946 Investment Companies; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: call_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential identifier for the capital call notice, typically formatted as CC-YYYY-NNNN. Used in investor communications, wire transfer instructions, and LP capital account statements.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: call_percentage
attributes.description: The capital call amount expressed as a percentage of the investor's total committed capital. Enables proportional analysis across LPs with different commitment sizes. Calculated as call_amount / total_commitment * 100.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: call_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for which the called capital will be deployed. Drives fund accounting allocation and investor reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acquisition|capex|fees|reserves|debt_repayment|operating_expenses|recapitalization|distribution_recallable — promote to reference product if additional values required]
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: call_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal number of this capital call within the fund's overall capital call program (e.g., 1st call, 2nd call). Supports WALT/WALE-style weighted average analysis and fund deployment tracking.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: call_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capital call notice. Tracks progression from issuance through funding or default. Supports fund cash management and LP default monitoring.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: call_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital call by its structural nature. Distinguishes initial drawdowns from follow-on calls, recallable distributions, bridge financing calls, and supplemental calls. Supports fund accounting and investor reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital call record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: cumulative_called_amount
attributes.description: Total capital called from this investor across all capital calls to date including this call. Supports LP capital account balance tracking and uncalled capital calculation. Denominated in currency_code.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: default_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor was formally declared in default for failure to fund this capital call. Null if not in default. Triggers LPA default penalty provisions and investor remediation processes.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the investor must fund the called capital. Typically 10–15 business days from call_date per fund LPA terms. Drives default flag logic and wire transfer scheduling.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: funded_amount
attributes.description: Actual dollar amount received from the investor in response to this capital call. May be less than call_amount in partial funding scenarios. Used for LP capital account reconciliation and shortfall calculation.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: funded_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor's wire transfer or funding was received and confirmed. Null if not yet funded. Used for cash management reconciliation and default determination.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: interest_on_late_payment
attributes.description: Annual interest rate (as a percentage) charged on unfunded capital call amounts past the due date, per the fund's LPA default provisions. Used to calculate default penalty amounts for LP capital account adjustments.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: investment_purpose_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific investment or expenditure for which the called capital will be used (e.g., acquisition of 123 Main St, CAPEX for HVAC replacement). Included in investor notice for transparency.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has defaulted on this capital call by failing to fund by the due date. True triggers default penalty provisions per the fund's Limited Partnership Agreement (LPA).
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: is_recallable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital called in this notice is recallable (i.e., previously distributed capital being recalled for reinvestment per LPA terms). Affects LP capital account treatment and AFFO/FFO reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, special instructions, or contextual information related to this capital call. May include investor-specific wiring instructions or fund manager annotations.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: notice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the capital call notice was delivered to the investor. Supports investor communication compliance and audit trail per fund LPA requirements.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: notice_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the capital call notice was formally dispatched to the investor via the designated communication channel (email, DocuSign CLM, investor portal). Supports investor communication audit trail.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; DocuSign CLM; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of penalty or interest charged to the investor for late or non-payment of this capital call, per LPA default provisions. Null if no default. Supports LP capital account reconciliation.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: shortfall_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount by which the investor's funded amount falls short of the called amount (call_amount minus funded_amount). Zero if fully funded. Drives default flag and remediation workflows.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Original record identifier from MRI Software Investment Management module for this capital call. Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: total_commitment_amount
attributes.description: The investor's total committed capital to the fund at the time of this capital call. Provides context for call_percentage calculation and LP capital account reconciliation. Denominated in currency_code.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Capital Call Best Practices

attributes.name: uncalled_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Remaining committed but uncalled capital available from this investor after this call (total_commitment_amount minus cumulative_called_amount). Key metric for fund deployment planning and AUM reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital call record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage for the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: wire_reference
attributes.description: Bank wire transfer reference number or confirmation code associated with the investor's funding of this capital call. Used for treasury reconciliation and audit trail. Sourced from MRI Software or bank confirmation.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SOX Financial Controls

Supports FFO/AFFO reporting and investor waterfall calculations. Sourced from MRI Software and Yardi Voyager.

attributes.description: Reference to the investor (institutional or individual) receiving this distribution. Supports investor waterfall calculations and investor-level reporting.

attributes.name: affo_component_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO) Component Amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross distribution attributable to Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO), which further adjusts FFO for recurring capital expenditures (CAPEX), straight-line rent adjustments, and tenant improvement (TI) amortization. Supports AFFO payout ratio analysis.
attributes.references: NAREIT AFFO Guidelines; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software

attributes.name: amount_per_unit
attributes.description: The distribution amount expressed on a per-unit or per-share basis (gross distribution divided by total units/shares outstanding). Key metric for investor comparison, NAV calculations, and REIT dividend-per-share reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form 10-K REIT Reporting; NCREIF; MRI Software

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the distribution was formally approved by the authorized fund manager or investment committee. Part of the SOX-compliant approval workflow and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Workflow

attributes.name: capital_gain_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross distribution classified as long-term or short-term capital gain, arising from property dispositions or asset sales within the fund. Reported on IRS Form 1099-DIV Box 2a for investor tax purposes.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1(h); IRS Form 1099-DIV; FASB ASC 946; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: carried_interest_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the distribution representing carried interest (promote) paid to the general partner or fund manager after the preferred return hurdle has been met. Subject to IRC Section 1061 three-year holding period rules.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1061; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this distribution record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund manager or board formally declared this distribution. Required for REIT compliance reporting and investor disclosure under SEC regulations.
attributes.references: SEC Form 8-K; IRC Section 857; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: distribution_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the distribution is made to investors. This is the payment date as declared by the fund, used for FFO/AFFO reporting, investor waterfall calculations, and tax reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form 1099-DIV; IRS Publication 550; MRI Software

attributes.name: distribution_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this distribution event, typically assigned by the fund administrator or property management system (e.g., DIST-2024-Q3-0042). Used for investor statements, audit trails, and reconciliation with MRI Software and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Distribution Module; MRI Software

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the distribution record. Tracks workflow from initial calculation through approval, payment, and any post-payment reversals or cancellations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution by its economic and tax character. Determines investor tax treatment and waterfall priority. Return of capital reduces cost basis; ordinary income and capital gain are taxable; preferred return and carried interest relate to fund waterfall mechanics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: return_of_capital|ordinary_income|capital_gain|preferred_return|carried_interest|qualified_dividend|non_qualified_dividend — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 550; IRC Section 1(h); FASB ASC 946; SEC Form 1099-DIV; NCREIF

attributes.name: ex_distribution_date
attributes.description: The date on or after which a new investor purchasing units/shares is no longer entitled to receive the declared distribution. Used in secondary market trading and investor entitlement calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; FINRA Rules; REIT distribution mechanics

attributes.name: ffo_component_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross distribution attributable to Funds From Operations (FFO) as defined by NAREIT. Supports FFO-based investor reporting and REIT performance benchmarking. FFO excludes depreciation and gains/losses on property sales.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled cadence at which distributions are made from the fund to investors. Drives investor cash flow forecasting and WALT/WALE-aligned income modeling. Special distributions are one-time events outside the regular schedule.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross distribution amount payable to the investor before any withholding tax deductions. Expressed in the fund's base currency. Core component of the monetary triplet for investor waterfall and FFO/AFFO reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IFRS 9; SEC Form 1099-DIV; MRI Software; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: k1_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether an IRS Schedule K-1 (Partner's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits) has been issued to the investor for this distribution period. Applicable to partnership and LLC fund structures. Supports tax compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065); IRC Section 702; MRI Software Tax Module

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The actual net amount paid to the investor after deducting withholding tax from the gross distribution amount (gross_amount minus withholding_tax_amount). This is the cash received by the investor.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IRS Publication 550; MRI Software; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or explanatory remarks about this distribution (e.g., reason for special distribution, adjustment rationale, investor-specific notes). Sourced from MRI Software and Yardi Voyager memo fields.
attributes.references: MRI Software; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The investor's percentage ownership interest in the fund or investment vehicle as of the record date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Used for waterfall allocation and pro-rata distribution calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the net distribution amount is remitted to the investor. ACH and wire transfer are most common for institutional investors; DRIP (Dividend Reinvestment Plan) reinvests the distribution; offset applies the distribution against outstanding investor obligations.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; MRI Software Investor Portal; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The bank or payment system reference number (ACH trace number, wire confirmation number, check number) associated with the actual remittance of the net distribution to the investor. Used for payment reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Yardi Voyager AP Module; MRI Software

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the income or performance period for which this distribution is being made. Together with period_start_date, defines the measurement window for FFO/AFFO and NOI attribution.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; MRI Software

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the income or performance period for which this distribution is being made. Used to align distributions with the corresponding NOI, FFO, or AFFO reporting period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; MRI Software

attributes.name: preferred_return_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the distribution representing the preferred return (hurdle rate) paid to limited partners or preferred equity investors before carried interest or promote is allocated to the general partner. Core component of waterfall calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: record_date
attributes.description: The date on which an investor must be on record as a unit/shareholder to be eligible to receive this distribution. Critical for REIT dividend eligibility and investor entitlement calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; FASB ASC 946; REIT distribution rules under IRC Section 857

attributes.name: reinvestment_elected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has elected to reinvest this distribution through a Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRIP) rather than receive cash. When True, the net distribution amount is used to purchase additional units/shares at the current NAV.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC DRIP Rules; MRI Software Investor Portal

attributes.name: reinvestment_price_per_unit
attributes.description: The NAV or price per unit at which the reinvested distribution was used to purchase additional units under the DRIP. Establishes the cost basis for the newly acquired units for tax purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IRS Cost Basis Rules; SEC DRIP Rules; MRI Software

attributes.name: reinvestment_units
attributes.description: The number of additional fund units or shares purchased through the DRIP reinvestment of this distribution. Populated only when reinvestment_elected is True. Used to update the investor's unit holding balance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC DRIP Rules; MRI Software Investor Portal

attributes.name: return_of_capital_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross distribution classified as return of capital (ROC), which is non-taxable but reduces the investor's cost basis in the investment. Critical for investor tax reporting via IRS Form 1099-DIV Box 3.
attributes.references: IRC Section 301; IRS Form 1099-DIV; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Tax Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this distribution record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Yardi Voyager Distribution Module; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this distribution in the originating source system (MRI Software or Yardi Voyager). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: MRI Software; Yardi Voyager; Databricks Delta Lake Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal tax year to which this distribution is attributed for investor tax reporting purposes (e.g., IRS Form 1099-DIV, Schedule K-1 for partnerships). May differ from the distribution_date year for year-end distributions.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 550; IRC Section 857; IRS Form 1099-DIV; IRS Schedule K-1

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: The number of fund units, shares, or partnership interest units held by the investor as of the record date, used to calculate the investor's pro-rata share of the total distribution.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investor Portal; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this distribution record was last modified in the data platform (Silver layer). Tracks post-creation amendments such as reversals, corrections, or status changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the gross distribution at source, as required by applicable tax regulations (e.g., FIRPTA for foreign investors, backup withholding). Reduces gross amount to arrive at net distribution.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1445 (FIRPTA); IRS Publication 515; FATCA; MRI Software Tax Module

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable withholding tax rate applied to this distribution, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.300000 = 30%). Rate varies by investor tax residency, treaty status, and distribution type (FIRPTA, backup withholding, treaty-reduced rates).
attributes.references: IRC Section 1445 (FIRPTA); IRS Publication 515; US Tax Treaty Network; FATCA

products.name: portfolio_asset
products.description: Association entity linking a property asset to an investment portfolio, capturing the investment-specific attributes of that holding. Records acquisition cost, acquisition date, current book value, appraised value, ownership percentage, hold strategy (core hold, value-add, disposition target), target exit date, allocated debt, equity invested, unrealized gain/loss, and asset manager assignment. Distinct from the property domain master record — this entity captures the investment lens on each asset within a portfolio context. Cross-references property_id from the property domain.
products.reference: Portfolio Holding / Asset Allocation — NCREIF Property Index

attributes.name: portfolio_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the portfolio asset record. Primary key for this association entity linking a property asset to an investment portfolio.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Cross-domain reference to the property master record in the property domain. Identifies the physical real estate asset being held within this portfolio. This entity captures the investment lens; the property domain holds the physical master record.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: compliance_assessment_id

attributes.name: debt_instrument_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned Asset Manager (AM) responsible for overseeing this holding's performance, strategy execution, and reporting within the portfolio.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (SPV, LLC, partnership) that holds title to this property asset within the portfolio structure. Required for entity-level financial consolidation, tax reporting, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: policy_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio to which this asset belongs. Links the asset holding to its parent portfolio vehicle (REIT, fund, partnership, etc.).
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: property_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.property_type. Business justification: Portfolio asset class maps to property type for NCREIF sector allocation reporting, benchmark attribution, cap rate benchmarking, and investment mandate compliance monitoring at the asset level.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
