attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sustainability_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.sustainability_rating. Business justification: Portfolio asset ESG rating maps to sustainability rating scheme (LEED, BREEAM, ENERGY STAR) for GRESB asset-level scoring, green financing eligibility, and ESG investor disclosure reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: valuation_tax_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.tax_assessment. Business justification: Property tax is a major operating expense directly impacting NOI and asset valuation. Portfolio asset management requires tracking the current tax assessment to model hold/sell decisions and budget pr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total all-in cost to acquire the property asset, including purchase price, transaction costs, due diligence fees, and closing costs. Represents the initial cost basis for book value tracking, depreciation, and gain/loss calculations. Denominated in the portfolio's functional currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the property asset was acquired and added to the investment portfolio. Used as the holding period start date for IRR calculations, depreciation schedules, and capital gains tax computations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 805 Business Combinations; IFRS 3; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: acquisition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing key details about the acquisition rationale, deal structure, special conditions, or investment thesis for this asset. Used by asset managers and investment committees for context and historical reference.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: actual_exit_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the asset was disposed of or transferred out of the portfolio. Populated upon disposition completion. Used for realized IRR calculations, hold period reporting, and fund performance attribution.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; NCREIF Performance Reporting

attributes.name: allocated_debt
attributes.description: Total debt financing allocated to this asset holding, including mortgage debt, mezzanine financing, and any other encumbrances. Used for LTV ratio monitoring, DSCR calculations, and portfolio leverage reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; CMBS/RMBS reporting standards

attributes.name: appraised_value
attributes.description: Most recent third-party or internal appraised market value of the property asset. Used for GAV/NAV calculations, LTV covenant monitoring, investor reporting, and REIT compliance. Should be updated at minimum annually per institutional standards.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset within the portfolio. Drives workflow routing for asset reviews, disposition approvals, and reporting inclusion. 'active' = currently held and performing; 'under_review' = strategic review in progress; 'disposition_pending' = approved for sale; 'disposed' = sold/transferred out; 'on_hold' = temporarily suspended from active management.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: capex_budget
attributes.description: Total approved Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) budget allocated to this asset for the current hold period, including planned improvements, repositioning costs, and major capital repairs. Used for value-add strategy tracking and return-on-investment analysis.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Yardi Voyager — Budgeting and Forecasting; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: capex_spent_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) actually spent on this asset from acquisition date through the most recent reporting period. Compared against capex_budget to monitor capital deployment progress and cost control.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the property asset is located. Required for international portfolio reporting, foreign currency translation, and cross-border regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; IFRS 21

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this portfolio asset record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset on the portfolio's books after accumulated depreciation and any impairment charges. Used for balance sheet reporting, NAV calculations, and GAAP/IFRS financial statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; MRI Software — Property Accounting; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: disposition_price
attributes.description: Gross sale price received upon disposition of the asset from the portfolio. Populated when asset_status = 'disposed'. Used for realized gain/loss calculation, IRR computation, and fund performance reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; FASB ASC 360; NCREIF

attributes.name: equity_invested
attributes.description: Total equity capital deployed into this asset by the portfolio, net of debt financing. Used as the denominator in equity multiple and ROI calculations, and for tracking capital deployment against fund commitments.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; MRI Software — Investment Management; NCREIF

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Primary geographic market or submarket designation for this asset (e.g., 'Manhattan Midtown', 'Los Angeles CBD', 'Chicago O'Hare Submarket'). Used for market-level portfolio concentration analysis, benchmarking, and CoStar market reporting.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite — Market Research; NCREIF Market Classification; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Total Gross Leasable Area (GLA) of the property asset measured in square feet (SQF). Used for PSF rent analysis, portfolio size reporting, and benchmarking against market comparables. Sourced from the property domain master record.
attributes.references: BOMA International Measurement Standards; RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: hold_strategy
attributes.description: Investment hold strategy assigned to this asset within the portfolio. Determines capital allocation priorities, return expectations, and exit planning. 'core_hold' = long-term stabilized income; 'value_add' = active repositioning for value creation; 'opportunistic' = higher-risk/return transformation; 'disposition_target' = approved for near-term sale; 'development' = ground-up or major redevelopment.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Urban Land Institute (ULI); MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: in_place_noi
attributes.description: Current annualized Net Operating Income (NOI) generated by the asset based on in-place leases and operating expenses. Used for CAP rate derivation, DSCR monitoring, and portfolio income reporting. Sourced from Yardi Voyager NOI statements.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — General Ledger; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; NCREIF

attributes.name: investment_risk_profile
attributes.description: Risk-return classification of this asset holding per institutional investment framework. Distinct from hold_strategy — this reflects the underwriting risk tier used for investor disclosure, fund mandate compliance, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Urban Land Institute (ULI); SEC — REIT Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: is_encumbered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is subject to debt financing, liens, or other encumbrances (True) or is unencumbered (False). Used for portfolio leverage analysis, lender reporting, and unencumbered asset pool tracking for REIT compliance.
attributes.references: SEC — REIT Disclosure; FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: is_joint_venture
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is held through a joint venture or co-investment structure (True) or is wholly owned by the portfolio (False). Drives proportional consolidation logic and joint venture reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323 Equity Method; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Current physical occupancy rate of the property asset expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9200 = 92.00%). Key operational KPI for income stability assessment, lender covenant compliance, and portfolio performance dashboards.
attributes.references: NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Portfolio's percentage ownership interest in the property asset, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75.00%). Critical for proportional consolidation of NOI, GAV, debt, and equity in fund-level reporting. Supports joint venture and co-investment structures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier or reference code from the originating operational system of record (e.g., Argus Enterprise asset ID, MRI Software property code, Yardi Voyager property ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; MRI Software; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: stabilized_noi
attributes.description: Projected stabilized Net Operating Income (NOI) upon completion of the asset's business plan (lease-up, repositioning, or value-add program). Used in exit valuation modeling, IRR projections, and investment committee reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: target_cap_rate
attributes.description: Underwritten target Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) at acquisition, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%). Represents the expected NOI yield on the asset value used in the investment thesis and exit pricing assumptions.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute; NCREIF

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Underwritten target equity multiple (total distributions + residual value divided by equity invested) for this asset at acquisition. Expressed as a ratio (e.g., 1.8500 = 1.85x). Used alongside target_irr for investment committee approval and performance tracking.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; CFA Institute; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: target_exit_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date for disposition or exit of this asset from the portfolio. Used in hold period analysis, IRR projections, fund lifecycle planning, and WALT/WALE reporting. Nullable for open-ended core holds.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: target_irr
attributes.description: Underwritten target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for this asset at the time of acquisition, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1200 = 12.00%). Represents the return threshold used in investment committee approval and ongoing performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; CFA Institute; NCREIF

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Difference between the current appraised value (adjusted for ownership percentage) and the current book value, representing the mark-to-market unrealized gain or loss on this holding. Positive = unrealized gain; negative = unrealized loss. Key input for NAV reporting and investor performance statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IFRS 13; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this portfolio asset record was most recently updated. Used for change detection, incremental data loads, and audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

products.name: fund_performance
products.description: Period-level investment performance and valuation record for a fund — the operational SSOT for how a fund performed and was valued in a given measurement period. Captures period dates, period type (quarterly, annual, trailing-12, since-inception), gross/net IRR, equity multiple (MOIC), NPV, DPI, RVPI, TVPI, TWR, MWR, benchmark return, alpha, GAV (sum of appraised values), NAV (GAV minus liabilities), NAV per unit/share, units outstanding, premium/discount to NAV, AUM, total revenue, NOI, FFO, AFFO, OPEX, CAPEX, leverage ratio, NAV calculation methodology, auditor sign-off status, and period status (open, closed, audited). Supports REIT reporting, investor redemption pricing, SEC filings, and ILPA reporting standards. Sourced from Argus Enterprise and MRI Software.
products.reference: Fund Performance Record — GIPS, INREV Guidelines, NCREIF PREA

attributes.name: fund_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fund performance record. Primary key for this period-level investment performance and valuation record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Fund performance report internal approval by a named employee (Fund Controller, CFO) is required before LP distribution and regulatory filing. Real estate fund managers track the internal approver sep

This is a standard fund-level performance attribution

attributes.name: financial_period_close_id

Period close status gates publication of fund performance metrics

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment fund (REIT, partnership, private equity fund, CMBS/RMBS vehicle) for which this performance record is captured.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Fund performance data drives regulatory filings (Form PF, AIFMD Annex IV, GRESB submissions). Linking performance records to regulatory filings is required for compliance tracking, filing deadline man

attributes.name: valuation_nav_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.nav_calculation. Business justification: Fund performance reporting is directly derived from the formal NAV calculation. LP reporting, auditor sign-off, and INREV/NCREIF compliance require tracing fund-level NAV, GAV, and nav_per_unit back t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: waterfall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.waterfall. Business justification: Fund performance reporting — particularly FFO/AFFO, distribution per unit, and NAV calculations — is governed by the applicable waterfall structure. The waterfall determines how returns are allocated
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: affo
attributes.description: Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO) for the measurement period — FFO adjusted for recurring capital expenditures (CAPEX), straight-line rent adjustments, and other non-cash items. Considered a more accurate proxy for distributable cash flow than FFO.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: alpha
attributes.description: The fund's excess return over the benchmark return for the measurement period (TWR minus benchmark_return). Positive alpha indicates outperformance; negative alpha indicates underperformance relative to the benchmark.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm that reviewed or signed off on this performance period (e.g., 'Deloitte', 'PwC', 'KPMG', 'Ernst & Young'). Required for SEC filings and investor transparency.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; PCAOB Standards

attributes.name: auditor_signoff_status
attributes.description: The external auditor's sign-off status for this performance period. 'not_required' for interim periods; 'pending' for annual periods awaiting audit; 'signed_off' for unqualified audit opinion; 'qualified' or 'adverse' for modified opinions. Required for SOX and SEC compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; PCAOB Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: aum
attributes.description: Total Assets Under Management (AUM) for the fund as of the period end date. May differ from GAV when leverage is included or when AUM is defined per the fund's limited partnership agreement. Used for management fee calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV; ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: benchmark_name
attributes.description: The name of the benchmark index used for performance comparison (e.g., 'NCREIF ODCE', 'MSCI US REIT Index', 'FTSE NAREIT All Equity REITs'). Provides context for interpreting benchmark_return and alpha.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; NCREIF; MSCI Real Estate Index

attributes.name: benchmark_return
attributes.description: The return of the designated benchmark index (e.g., NCREIF ODCE, MSCI Real Estate, S&P 500) for the same measurement period. Used to compute alpha and assess relative fund performance.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; NCREIF; MSCI Real Estate Index

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: The weighted average Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) applied across the fund's portfolio for the period — NOI divided by GAV. A key real estate valuation metric used in Argus Enterprise models and investor reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC — IVS 105; NAREIT; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: capex
attributes.description: Total Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) incurred by the fund's portfolio during the measurement period, including Tenant Improvement (TI) allowances, building improvements, and major repairs that extend asset life.
attributes.references: NAREIT; FASB ASC 840/842; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund performance record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate or hurdle rate applied in the fund's DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) valuation models for the period, expressed as a decimal. Used to compute NPV and to assess whether the fund is meeting its return threshold.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC — IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: distribution_per_unit
attributes.description: Cash distribution declared or paid per fund unit or share during the measurement period. Used for investor yield calculations, REIT dividend reporting, and AFFO payout ratio analysis.
attributes.references: NAREIT; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.description: Distributions to Paid-In Capital (DPI) ratio — total cumulative distributions paid to investors divided by total paid-in capital. Measures the realized return component. A DPI of 1.0 means investors have received back their full invested capital in cash.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: equity_multiple
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equity Multiple (MOIC — Multiple on Invested Capital)
attributes.description: The ratio of total value (realized distributions plus unrealized NAV) to total invested capital, also known as Multiple on Invested Capital (MOIC). A value of 1.75 means investors have received or hold 1.75x their invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: ffo
attributes.description: Funds From Operations (FFO) for the measurement period — net income plus real estate depreciation and amortization, adjusted for gains/losses on property sales. The NAREIT-defined primary earnings metric for REITs, used in lieu of GAAP net income.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: gav
attributes.description: Gross Asset Value (GAV) of the fund as of the period end date — the sum of appraised market values of all properties and investments held by the fund, before deducting liabilities. Sourced from Argus Enterprise appraisal models.
attributes.references: IVSC — IVS 105; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 820; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: gross_irr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Internal Rate of Return (Gross IRR)
attributes.description: The annualized gross Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for the fund over the measurement period, before management fees and carried interest. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1250 = 12.50%). Core metric for ILPA and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: leverage_ratio
attributes.description: The fund's leverage ratio as of the period end date, typically expressed as total debt divided by GAV (Loan-to-Value / LTV). Monitors compliance with fund-level debt covenants and risk parameters.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Form N-2; FASB ASC 946; Lender Covenant Agreements

attributes.name: mwr
attributes.description: Money-Weighted Return (MWR) for the measurement period, reflecting the actual investor experience including the timing and magnitude of capital calls and distributions. Equivalent to the period IRR from the investor's perspective.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value (NAV) of the fund as of the period end date — GAV minus total liabilities. The primary valuation basis for investor redemptions, unit pricing, and REIT reporting. Sourced from MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IVSC; SEC Form N-2; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: nav_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the NAV for this period. 'independent_appraisal' uses third-party Appraisal Institute-certified appraisers; 'internal_valuation' uses Argus Enterprise DCF models; 'broker_opinion' uses Broker Price Opinion (BPO); 'automated_valuation' uses AVM models; 'hybrid' combines methods.
attributes.references: IVSC — IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Asset Value Per Unit/Share (NAV per Unit)
attributes.description: NAV divided by total units or shares outstanding as of the period end date. The per-unit pricing basis for investor subscriptions, redemptions, and REIT share pricing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-2; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: net_irr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Internal Rate of Return (Net IRR)
attributes.description: The annualized net Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for the fund over the measurement period, after deducting management fees, carried interest, and fund expenses. Primary investor-facing performance metric.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income (NOI) of the fund's underlying real estate portfolio for the measurement period — total revenue minus operating expenses, before debt service, depreciation, and income taxes. Core metric for real estate valuation and CAP rate analysis.
attributes.references: NAREIT; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 946; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: Net Present Value (NPV) of the fund's projected cash flows discounted at the fund's hurdle rate or discount rate as of the period end date. Sourced from Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC — IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: opex
attributes.description: Total Operating Expenditure (OPEX) of the fund's underlying portfolio for the measurement period, including property management fees, insurance, utilities, repairs, and Common Area Maintenance (CAM) costs.
attributes.references: NAREIT; FASB ASC 946; Yardi Voyager — General Ledger

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the measurement period for which fund performance metrics are reported (e.g., 2024-03-31 for Q1 2024).
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the measurement period for which fund performance metrics are reported (e.g., 2024-01-01 for Q1 2024).
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle state of the performance record. 'open' indicates the period is still accumulating data; 'closed' indicates the period is finalized; 'audited' indicates external auditor sign-off has been received; 'restated' indicates a prior-period correction has been applied.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the measurement period horizon. Drives how IRR, TWR, and benchmark comparisons are interpreted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monthly|quarterly|annual|trailing_12|since_inception — promote to reference product if additional period types are required]
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards) — CFA Institute

attributes.name: premium_discount_to_nav
attributes.description: The percentage premium or discount at which the fund's market price or transaction price trades relative to its NAV per unit. Positive values indicate a premium; negative values indicate a discount. Critical for publicly traded REITs and closed-end funds.
attributes.references: SEC Form N-2; FASB ASC 946; NAREIT

attributes.name: rvpi
attributes.description: Residual Value to Paid-In Capital (RVPI) ratio — the current NAV of unrealized investments divided by total paid-in capital. Measures the unrealized return component. RVPI + DPI = TVPI.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The originating system record identifier from Argus Enterprise or MRI Software from which this performance record was sourced (e.g., Argus portfolio report ID or MRI period close reference). Supports data lineage and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: total_distributions
attributes.description: Total cash distributions paid to all fund investors during the measurement period. Feeds into DPI calculation and is a key component of ILPA cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; NAREIT; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: total_liabilities
attributes.description: Total outstanding liabilities of the fund as of the period end date, including mortgage debt, credit facilities, accrued fees, and other obligations. NAV = GAV minus total_liabilities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IFRS 16; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: total_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the fund's underlying properties and investments during the measurement period, including Gross Rental Income (GRI), interest income, and other operating income. Sourced from MRI Software property accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; NAREIT FFO White Paper; MRI Software — Property Accounting

attributes.name: tvpi
attributes.description: Total Value to Paid-In Capital (TVPI) ratio — the sum of DPI and RVPI. Represents the total value created per dollar of invested capital, combining both realized and unrealized returns.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: twr
attributes.description: Time-Weighted Return (TWR) for the measurement period, eliminating the distorting effects of external cash flows (capital calls and distributions). The GIPS-compliant return metric for comparing fund manager performance against benchmarks.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: units_outstanding
attributes.description: Total number of fund units or shares outstanding as of the period end date. Used to compute NAV per unit and to track dilution from new subscriptions or reduction from redemptions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund performance record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, restatement detection, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The specific date as of which the fund's GAV and NAV were determined. May differ from period_end_date if appraisals are conducted on a lag (e.g., appraisal as of December 31 reported in February).
attributes.references: IVSC — IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820

products.name: asset_performance
products.description: Period-level performance, valuation, and DCF modeling record for an individual portfolio asset. Captures actual results (NOI, EGI, PGI, vacancy rate, CAP rate, cash-on-cash return, unlevered/levered IRR, NPV, DSCR, LTV, total return, OPEX PSF, revenue PSF, occupancy rate, WALT, WALE) and DCF model parameters (model version, discount rate, hold period, projected NOI by year, projected growth rates, exit CAP rate, terminal value, sensitivity scenario). Enables asset-level attribution, scenario analysis, and roll-up to portfolio and fund performance. SSOT for investment-oriented asset analytics. Sourced from Argus Enterprise and Yardi Voyager.
products.reference: Asset-Level Performance — NCREIF Property Index, MSCI Real Estate

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.noi_statement. Business justification: Asset-level performance metrics (cap rate, NOI, DSCR, occupancy) are sourced directly from finalized NOI statements. Real estate asset managers require this link to trace performance calculations back

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: appraised_value
attributes.description: Most recent third-party or internal appraised market value of the asset as of the performance period. Used for CAP rate calculation, LTV computation, and NAV/GAV reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; USPAP; Argus Enterprise — Valuation

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this asset performance record was formally approved and finalized by the authorized asset manager or investment officer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Capitalization rate for the asset during the period, calculated as NOI divided by current market value. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%). Primary valuation and benchmarking metric for income-producing real estate.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Valuation

attributes.name: capex
attributes.description: Capital expenditures incurred on the asset during the period including tenant improvements (TI), leasing commissions, and building capital improvements. Distinct from OPEX; impacts cash-on-cash return and levered IRR.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; NCREIF; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: cash_on_cash_return
attributes.description: Annual pre-tax cash flow divided by total equity invested in the asset. Expressed as a decimal. Measures the actual cash income earned on the equity invested, before considering appreciation or leverage effects.
attributes.references: NCREIF; ULI; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset performance record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this performance record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. Primary sources are Argus Enterprise and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; ISO 55000 Data Governance

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted discount rate applied in the DCF model to calculate NPV and present value of projected cash flows. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0750 = 7.50%). Reflects required rate of return for the investment strategy.
attributes.references: CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Ratio of NOI to total debt service (principal and interest) for the period. A DSCR above 1.0 indicates the property generates sufficient income to cover debt obligations. Critical metric for lenders and CMBS compliance.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; FASB; Yardi Voyager — Accounts Payable

attributes.name: egi
attributes.description: Actual gross income collected during the period after deducting vacancy and credit loss from PGI. EGI = PGI minus vacancy and credit loss. Core revenue metric for property-level performance.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Appraisal Institute; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: exit_cap_rate
attributes.description: Projected CAP rate applied to the terminal year NOI to calculate the asset's residual/terminal value at the end of the hold period. Expressed as a decimal. Key assumption in DCF terminal value calculation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; Argus Enterprise — Valuation

attributes.name: hold_period_years
attributes.description: Projected investment hold period in years as modeled in the DCF analysis. Determines the time horizon over which cash flows are projected and the terminal value is calculated.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; ULI

attributes.name: levered_irr
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return calculated on the asset's equity cash flows after accounting for debt financing. Expressed as a decimal. Reflects the return to equity investors after leverage effects.
attributes.references: NCREIF; CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of outstanding debt to current appraised or market value of the asset. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65%). Key leverage metric for lenders, CMBS covenants, and portfolio risk management.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; FASB; Federal Reserve Guidance

attributes.name: nla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Leasable Area in Square Feet (NLA SQF)
attributes.description: Net leasable area of the property in square feet as of the performance period. Used as the denominator for PSF metrics (OPEX PSF, revenue PSF) and occupancy calculations.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income for the period calculated as EGI minus operating expenses. Primary measure of a property's income-generating ability before debt service and capital expenditures. SSOT metric for investment performance.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 842; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: Net Present Value of the asset's projected cash flows discounted at the model's discount rate. Positive NPV indicates value creation above the required return threshold. Sourced from Argus Enterprise DCF model.
attributes.references: CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of total leasable area that is occupied and generating income during the performance period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9150 = 91.50%). Core leasing performance indicator.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: operating_expenses
attributes.description: Total property-level operating expenditures for the period including property management fees, insurance, taxes, utilities, repairs, and CAM costs. Excludes debt service and capital expenditures.
attributes.references: NCREIF; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager — General Ledger

attributes.name: opex_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Expense Per Square Foot (OPEX PSF)
attributes.description: Total operating expenses divided by the property's net leasable area in square feet. Expressed as currency per square foot (PSF). Enables cross-property benchmarking of operating efficiency.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: performance_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the reporting period for which this asset performance record is calculated. Together with performance_period_start_date defines the measurement window.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: performance_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the reporting period for which this asset performance record is calculated. Used to define the measurement window for NOI, EGI, occupancy, and other period-level metrics.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this asset performance record. Draft indicates in-progress calculation; preliminary is unaudited; final is approved; restated reflects post-close corrections; archived is superseded.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the performance measurement period. Determines whether the record represents a monthly, quarterly, annual, trailing 12-month, or year-to-date snapshot.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting; ULI Best Practices

attributes.name: pgi
attributes.description: Total scheduled rental income assuming 100% occupancy at market or contracted rents for the period. Represents the theoretical maximum revenue before vacancy and credit loss deductions. Sourced from Yardi Voyager rent rolls.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Appraisal Institute; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: projected_noi_growth_rate
attributes.description: Annual NOI growth rate assumption applied in the DCF model for projecting future cash flows. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 = 3.00%). Reflects rent escalation, occupancy improvement, and expense management assumptions.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; NCREIF

attributes.name: revenue_psf
attributes.description: Effective gross income divided by the property's net leasable area in square feet. Expressed as currency per square foot (PSF). Benchmarks revenue productivity across the portfolio.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: sensitivity_scenario
attributes.description: DCF sensitivity scenario label for this performance record. Base is the primary underwriting case; upside reflects optimistic assumptions; downside reflects conservative assumptions; stress reflects severe adverse conditions.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; ULI; NCREIF

attributes.name: terminal_value
attributes.description: Projected residual value of the asset at the end of the DCF hold period, calculated as terminal year NOI divided by exit CAP rate. Represents the expected sale proceeds at disposition.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; CFA Institute

attributes.name: total_return
attributes.description: Total investment return for the period combining income return (NOI yield) and capital appreciation return. Expressed as a decimal. NCREIF-standard metric for benchmarking against property indices.
attributes.references: NCREIF Property Index (NPI); CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: unlevered_irr
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return calculated on the asset's cash flows before debt financing (unlevered/all-equity basis). Expressed as a decimal. Measures the intrinsic return of the asset independent of capital structure.
attributes.references: NCREIF; CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset performance record was last modified. Tracks restatements, corrections, and updates to performance data throughout the record lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vacancy_credit_loss
attributes.description: Deduction from PGI representing income lost due to vacant units and uncollectable rents during the period. Used to derive EGI from PGI.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: vacancy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of total leasable area that is unoccupied during the performance period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0850 = 8.50%). Inverse of occupancy rate; key driver of EGI and NOI.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: wale
attributes.description: Weighted average date on which leases across the asset expire, weighted by rental income or NLA. Expressed as a date. Indicates the point in time when the portfolio faces significant re-leasing risk.
attributes.references: RESO; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Lease Management

attributes.name: walt
attributes.description: Weighted average remaining lease term across all occupied tenants, weighted by rental income or NLA. Expressed in years. Measures lease duration risk and income security of the asset.
attributes.references: RESO; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Lease Management

products.name: debt_facility
products.description: Master record for debt financing instruments secured against investment assets or portfolios — mortgage loans, construction loans, bridge loans, mezzanine debt, CMBS/RMBS, and credit facilities. Captures lender, facility type, principal amounts, interest rate terms, maturity, amortization, LTV, collateral references, recourse type, facility status, and full covenant details: covenant type (LTV, DSCR, occupancy, NOI, debt yield), threshold values, measurement frequency, last measured values, compliance status (compliant, waiver, breach), cure periods, and lender notification requirements. SSOT for investment-level debt instruments and covenant compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: covenant_compliance_status

attributes.name: covenant_dscr_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) Covenant Threshold

attributes.name: covenant_ltv_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum LTV ratio permitted under the loan covenant, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75%). Breach triggers lender notification and potential cure obligations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Underwriting Standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: covenant_measurement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial covenants (LTV, DSCR, occupancy) are tested and reported to the lender.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement

attributes.name: covenant_occupancy_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum physical occupancy rate required under the loan covenant, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.85 for 85%). Measured against GLA or NLA depending on loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this debt facility record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: cure_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the borrower has to remedy a covenant breach before the lender may declare an event of default. Defined in the loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Ratio of Net Operating Income (NOI) to total annual debt service (principal and interest). Measures the property's ability to cover debt obligations. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.25). Key covenant and underwriting metric.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Appraisal Institute; CMBS Underwriting Standards; HUD

attributes.name: extended_maturity_date
attributes.description: Maturity date after exercise of extension options, if applicable. Null if no extension has been exercised or no extension option exists.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Loan Tracking

attributes.name: extension_options_count
attributes.description: Number of extension options available to the borrower to extend the maturity date, subject to conditions (e.g., no event of default, minimum DSCR). Common in bridge and construction loans.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Loan Tracking; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: extension_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of each extension option. Multiplied by extension_options_count to determine maximum extended term.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Loan Tracking; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name for the debt facility (e.g., 'One Market Plaza Senior Mortgage', 'Portfolio Bridge Facility 2024'). Used for identification in reporting and dashboards.
attributes.references: Internal Naming Convention; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: facility_number
attributes.description: Externally-known loan or facility reference number assigned by the lender or originating system. Used for lender correspondence, CMBS reporting, and covenant tracking.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Debt Management Module; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the debt facility. Drives covenant monitoring workflows, reporting inclusion, and asset management alerts.

attributes.name: structure_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this waterfall structure, as referenced in fund legal documents and MRI Software. Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: structure_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing this waterfall distribution structure, typically derived from the fund legal agreement (e.g., 'Fund III American Waterfall — Class A').

attributes.name: tier1_gp_split_rate
attributes.description: The GP's proportionate share of distributions within Tier 1, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0 for 0% GP in a return-of-capital tier). Must sum to 1.0 with tier1_lp_split_rate.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier1_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the first distribution tier (e.g., 'Return of Capital', 'Preferred Return'). Used in investor reporting and distribution notices.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier1_lp_split_rate
attributes.description: The LP's proportionate share of distributions within Tier 1, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0 for 100% LP in a return-of-capital tier).
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier1_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative distribution threshold amount (in fund currency) that must be reached before distributions cascade to Tier 2. For return-of-capital tiers, this equals total LP committed capital plus recallable amounts.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: tier2_gp_split_rate
attributes.description: The GP's proportionate share of distributions within Tier 2, expressed as a decimal. Must sum to 1.0 with tier2_lp_split_rate.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier2_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the second distribution tier (e.g., 'Preferred Return / Hurdle', 'Accrued Preferred Return'). Used in investor reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier2_lp_split_rate
attributes.description: The LP's proportionate share of distributions within Tier 2, expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier2_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative distribution threshold amount (in fund currency) that must be reached before distributions cascade to Tier 3. For preferred return tiers, this equals LP capital plus accrued preferred return.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: tier3_gp_split_rate
attributes.description: The GP's proportionate share of distributions within Tier 3, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0 for 100% GP during a full catch-up tier). Must sum to 1.0 with tier3_lp_split_rate.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier3_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the third distribution tier (e.g., 'GP Catch-Up', 'Catch-Up Allocation'). Used in investor reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier3_lp_split_rate
attributes.description: The LP's proportionate share of distributions within Tier 3, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0 for 0% LP during a full GP catch-up tier).
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier3_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative distribution threshold amount (in fund currency) that must be reached before distributions cascade to Tier 4. For GP catch-up tiers, this equals the amount at which the GP has received its full proportionate share of profits.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: tier4_gp_split_rate
attributes.description: The GP's proportionate share of residual distributions within Tier 4 (the carried interest tier), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.20 for an 80/20 split). Must sum to 1.0 with tier4_lp_split_rate.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles; IRC Section 1061

attributes.name: tier4_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the fourth (residual) distribution tier (e.g., 'Residual Profit Split', 'Carried Interest Tier'). Used in investor reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: tier4_lp_split_rate
attributes.description: The LP's proportionate share of residual distributions within Tier 4 (the carried interest tier), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.80 for an 80/20 split).
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles; IRC Section 1061

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Total number of distribution tiers defined in this waterfall structure (e.g., 4 tiers: return of capital, preferred return, GP catch-up, residual split). Drives validation of the waterfall_tier child records.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this waterfall structure record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; MRI Software — Investment Management Module

attributes.name: waterfall_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this waterfall structure. 'Active' indicates it governs current distributions; 'superseded' indicates it has been replaced by a newer version; 'draft' indicates it is under review; 'terminated' indicates the fund has wound down.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management Module; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: waterfall_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the waterfall follows an American (deal-by-deal) or European (whole-fund) distribution model. American waterfalls allow GP carried interest after each deal; European waterfalls require full LP capital return before GP carry.
attributes.references: ILPA Principles; SEC — Investment Adviser Act; MRI Software — Investment Management Module

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: waterfall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.waterfall. Business justification: Investor capital account statements are calculated according to the applicable waterfall structure — the preferred return accrual, carried interest allocation, and profit splits all derive from the wa
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allocated_income_loss
attributes.description: Net income or loss allocated to this investor's capital account during the period per the fund's partnership agreement waterfall and allocation methodology. Positive values represent income allocation; negative values represent loss allocation.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IRS Schedule K-1; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: beginning_capital_balance
attributes.description: Investor's capital account balance at the start of the statement period, equal to the ending balance of the immediately preceding period. Serves as the opening balance for the period's capital account roll-forward reconciliation.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: capital_contributions
attributes.description: Total capital contributed by the investor during the statement period in response to capital calls. Includes funded amounts from all capital calls settled within the period. Increases the capital account balance.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: capital_distributions
attributes.description: Total distributions returned to the investor during the statement period, including return of capital, realized gains, and income distributions. Decreases the capital account balance. Reported as a positive number representing cash out to the investor.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: carried_interest_allocated
attributes.description: Performance-based carried interest (carry) allocated to the general partner and charged against this investor's capital account during the period, per the fund's waterfall provisions. Typically triggered after the preferred return hurdle is met.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital account statement record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cumulative_contributions
attributes.description: Total capital contributed by the investor from fund inception through the end of the statement period. Used for IRR calculation, return-of-capital tracking, and ILPA transparency reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: cumulative_distributions
attributes.description: Total distributions returned to the investor from fund inception through the end of the statement period. Used for DPI (Distributions to Paid-In) multiple calculation and ILPA transparency reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.description: Distributions to Paid-In (DPI) multiple for this investor from inception through the statement period end date. Calculated as cumulative_distributions / cumulative_contributions. Measures the realized return multiple relative to invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: ending_capital_balance
attributes.description: Investor's capital account balance at the close of the statement period. Calculated as: beginning_capital_balance + capital_contributions - capital_distributions + allocated_income_loss - management_fees_charged - carried_interest_allocated - other_fees_charged. This is the SSOT for the investor's fund position at period end.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter number (1–4) within the fiscal year for this statement period. Supports quarterly LP reporting packages and quarterly performance attribution analysis.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which this statement period falls (e.g., 2024). Used for annual rollup reporting, tax K-1 preparation, and year-over-year performance comparison.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IRS Schedule K-1; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: inception_to_date_irr
attributes.description: Cumulative Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for this investor's capital account from fund inception through the statement period end date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.142500 = 14.25%). Calculated using the XIRR methodology on all cash flows. Primary performance metric for LP reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: is_tax_exempt_investor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor is a tax-exempt entity (e.g., pension fund, endowment, foundation, ERISA plan) for purposes of UBTI (Unrelated Business Taxable Income) tracking and tax reporting. True = tax-exempt; False = taxable investor.
attributes.references: IRS UBTI Rules; ERISA; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: management_fees_charged
attributes.description: Asset management fees charged to this investor's capital account during the period, calculated per the fund's management fee schedule (typically expressed as a percentage of committed or invested capital). Reduces the capital account balance.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Investment Advisers Act; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: moic
attributes.description: Multiple on Invested Capital (MOIC) for this investor from inception through the statement period end date. Calculated as (ending_capital_balance + cumulative_distributions) / cumulative_contributions. Measures total value creation relative to invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per fund unit or interest as of the statement period end date, used to value the investor's position. Derived from the fund's total NAV divided by total units outstanding. Supports investor-level NAV attribution.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for asset manager or fund administrator annotations regarding this capital account statement, such as restatement explanations, special allocation notes, or investor-specific adjustments.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: other_fees_charged
attributes.description: Miscellaneous fees charged to the investor's capital account during the period not captured in management fees or carried interest, such as fund administration fees, audit fees, legal fees, or organizational expense allocations.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Investor's percentage ownership interest in the fund as of the statement period end date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Used for income/loss allocation, voting rights, and NAV attribution calculations.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the reporting period for this capital account statement. Determines the cadence of LP reporting obligations and aligns with fund governing document requirements.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: preferred_return_accrued
attributes.description: Cumulative preferred return accrued but not yet distributed to the investor from fund inception through the statement period end date. Represents the outstanding preferred return obligation owed to the LP before carried interest can be earned.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: Annual preferred return (hurdle rate) percentage applicable to this investor's capital account per the fund's limited partnership agreement (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%). Determines the threshold above which carried interest is charged to the investor.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Investor's pro-rata share of realized gains or losses from asset dispositions completed during the statement period. Represents the difference between net sale proceeds and cost basis allocated to this investor.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IRS Schedule K-1

attributes.name: rvpi
attributes.description: Residual Value to Paid-In (RVPI) multiple for this investor as of the statement period end date. Calculated as ending_capital_balance / cumulative_contributions. Measures the unrealized value remaining relative to invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier or reference code from the originating system of record (e.g., MRI Software or Argus Enterprise) for this capital account statement record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability back to the operational system.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: statement_issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this capital account statement was formally issued and made available to the investor. Used for ILPA compliance tracking and investor communication audit trails.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable identifier for this capital account statement, typically formatted as FUND-INVESTOR-PERIOD (e.g., FUND001-LP042-2024Q4). Used in LP reporting packages and investor communications.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: statement_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the reporting period covered by this capital account statement (e.g., 2024-03-31 for Q1 2024). Defines the end of the measurement window and the valuation date for ending balance calculations.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: statement_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the reporting period covered by this capital account statement (e.g., 2024-01-01 for Q1 2024). Defines the beginning of the measurement window for all period activity fields.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capital account statement. Draft indicates in-preparation; preliminary indicates unaudited release; final indicates audited and approved; restated indicates a corrected reissuance; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946 Financial Services — Investment Companies

attributes.name: tax_basis_adjustment
attributes.description: Cumulative tax basis adjustment to the investor's capital account from inception through the statement period end date, reflecting differences between GAAP book basis and tax basis (e.g., depreciation timing differences, Section 754 elections). Supports K-1 preparation.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1; IRS Section 754; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: total_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Investor's total committed capital to the fund as stated in the limited partnership agreement or subscription agreement. Represents the maximum capital obligation of the investor regardless of how much has been called.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: uncalled_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Remaining capital commitment not yet called by the fund as of the statement period end date. Calculated as total_commitment_amount minus cumulative_contributions. Represents the investor's remaining unfunded obligation (dry powder).
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: Number of fund units, interests, or shares held by the investor as of the statement period end date. Used in conjunction with nav_per_unit to calculate the investor's total NAV position.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Investor's pro-rata share of unrealized appreciation or depreciation in the fund's portfolio as of the statement period end date, based on current fair market valuations versus cost basis. Positive values indicate unrealized gain; negative values indicate unrealized loss.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital account statement record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks restatements, corrections, and preliminary-to-final transitions for audit and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of profits above the hurdle rate that the general partner retains as performance compensation (carry/promote). Expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.20 = 20% carry). Applicable only to performance fee types.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Fund LPA; SEC — REIT Disclosure

attributes.name: catch_up_rate
attributes.description: The rate at which the general partner receives distributions during the catch-up phase of the waterfall, after the preferred return hurdle is met and before the carried interest split applies. Expressed as a decimal fraction. Null if no catch-up provision exists.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund LPA; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: clawback_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether a clawback provision exists requiring the general partner to return previously distributed carried interest if cumulative fund performance falls below the hurdle rate at fund wind-down.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund LPA; SEC — REIT Disclosure

attributes.name: clawback_escrow_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of carried interest distributions held in escrow to satisfy potential clawback obligations, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.25 = 25% of carry escrowed). Null if clawback_applies is False.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund LPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fee schedule record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fee structure ceases to apply. Null for open-ended fee schedules. Populated when a fee is superseded by an amendment, fund termination, or investor redemption.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; Fund LPA

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this fee structure becomes binding and fee accrual begins. Aligns with fund inception, investor close date, or amendment effective date as documented in the fund's legal agreements.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; Fund LPA

attributes.name: fee_accrual_basis
attributes.description: The day count convention used to prorate fee accruals within a period (e.g., Actual/365, Actual/360, 30/360). Governs how partial-period fees are calculated for mid-period subscriptions, redemptions, or fund closes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; ISDA Day Count Conventions; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: The denominator or reference base upon which the fee rate is applied. Common bases include Assets Under Management (AUM), committed capital, invested capital, Gross Asset Value (GAV), and Net Asset Value (NAV). Drives fee calculation methodology and investor transparency disclosures.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; FASB ASC 946; SEC — Form ADV

attributes.name: fee_calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to compute the fee amount from the fee basis and rate. Flat rate applies a single rate uniformly; tiered applies different rates to different tranches of the basis; hurdle-based fees are only earned above a preferred return threshold; waterfall distributes proceeds in a defined sequence.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: fee_cap_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary ceiling on the fee amount in the fund's base currency. When both fee_cap_rate and fee_cap_amount are defined, the lesser of the two applies. Null if no absolute cap is specified.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund LPA

attributes.name: fee_cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum percentage rate or ceiling applied to the fee, expressed as a decimal fraction of the fee basis. Prevents fee amounts from exceeding a negotiated upper bound regardless of the fee basis growth. Null if no cap applies.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund LPA; SEC — Form ADV

attributes.name: fee_frequency
attributes.description: The periodicity at which the fee is assessed and accrued. Recurring fees (management, asset management) are typically quarterly or annual; transactional fees (acquisition, disposition) are one-time or upon-event.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts

attributes.name: fee_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the fee basis to calculate the fee amount (e.g., 0.015000 = 1.5% of AUM). Expressed as a decimal fraction. Sourced from fund legal documents and MRI Software fee schedule configuration.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund Limited Partnership Agreement (LPA); SEC — Form ADV

attributes.name: fee_recipient_entity
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity entitled to receive the fee (e.g., the General Partner entity, the Asset Manager, or the Investment Advisor). Supports fee payment processing and regulatory disclosure.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; SEC — Form ADV; Fund LPA

attributes.name: fee_schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this fee schedule, as referenced in fund legal documents, investor agreements, and MRI Software. Used for cross-system reconciliation and investor reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund Legal Documents

attributes.name: fee_schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing this fee structure (e.g., 'Class A Management Fee', 'Acquisition Fee — Core Fund 2024'). Used in investor reporting and fund documentation.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: fee_structure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fee schedule record. Active indicates the fee is currently accruing; superseded indicates it has been replaced by a newer version; pending_approval indicates it is awaiting GP/LP approval before taking effect.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund LPA

attributes.name: fee_tier_structure
attributes.description: Textual description of the tiered or stepped fee schedule breakpoints and corresponding rates (e.g., '1.5% on first $100M AUM; 1.25% on next $150M; 1.0% above $250M'). Populated when fee_calculation_method is tiered or stepped.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Fund LPA

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee by its business purpose within the investment vehicle. Management fees are recurring; acquisition and disposition fees are transactional; performance fees are incentive-based. attributes.description: The investor's pro-rata share of the fund's taxable income for the allocation period, as reported on Schedule K-1 Box 1 (ordinary business income). Positive values indicate income; negative values indicate loss.

attributes.name: allocated_taxable_loss

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number for this tax allocation record, used in K-1 packages, CPA correspondence, and investor tax statements. Sourced from MRI Software or tax preparation system.
