attributes.name: allocation_period_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax allocation covers a full annual period, a quarterly period, or an interim period (e.g., upon investor admission or exit). Determines reporting frequency and K-1 timing.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax allocation record. Draft indicates in-progress; preliminary indicates initial estimate; final indicates IRS-ready; amended indicates a corrected allocation; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; void indicates cancelled.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065; IRS Schedule K-1

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential amendment version number for this tax allocation record. Zero (0) indicates the original allocation; values greater than zero indicate amended K-1 versions. Used to track correction history and ensure investors receive the most current allocation data.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 Amended Return Rules; IRS Form 1065-X

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for amending this tax allocation record (e.g., corrected depreciation calculation, revised ownership percentage, updated Section 1031 exchange treatment). Required when amendment_number > 0.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065-X; IRS Schedule K-1 Amended Return Rules

attributes.name: capital_gain_allocated
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of net capital gains (short-term and long-term combined) from property dispositions or other capital events during the period. Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 9/10.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Box 9/10; IRS §1231

attributes.name: cpa_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CPA or external tax advisor completed their review and approved this tax allocation record. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX §302/404; AICPA Standards

attributes.name: cpa_review_status
attributes.description: The current status of the CPA (Certified Public Accountant) or external tax advisor review of this tax allocation record. Tracks the review workflow from initial preparation through final sign-off before K-1 issuance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; AICPA Standards; IRS Partnership Reporting

attributes.name: cpa_reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the CPA firm or individual tax advisor responsible for reviewing and signing off on this tax allocation. Used for audit trail and professional accountability tracking.
attributes.references: SOX §302/404; AICPA Standards; IRS Partnership Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax allocation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance documentation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX §302/404; Internal Data Governance; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: deferred_gain_1031
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of capital gain deferred under a Section 1031 like-kind exchange during the allocation period. Reduces current-period taxable gain and increases the investor's carryover basis in the replacement property.
attributes.references: IRS §1031; IRS Form 8824; IRS Reg. §1.1031(a)-1

attributes.name: depreciation_allocated
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of real property depreciation (MACRS/straight-line) passed through from the fund for the period. Reported on Schedule K-1 and used for investor tax basis calculations. Key metric for REIT and partnership tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065); IRS §168 MACRS; IRS §167

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (Q1–Q4) of the allocation period. Null for annual allocations. Used for quarterly K-1 estimates and interim investor reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: foreign_tax_credit
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of foreign taxes paid by the fund on foreign-sourced income, passed through as a foreign tax credit. Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 16. Applicable for funds with international real estate holdings.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Box 16; IRS §901 Foreign Tax Credit

attributes.name: investor_tax_basis_adjustment
attributes.description: The net adjustment to the investor's outside tax basis in the partnership interest for the allocation period, reflecting contributions, distributions, income/loss allocations, and depreciation pass-throughs. Critical for at-risk limitation and gain/loss calculations on disposition.
attributes.references: IRS §705 Partner Basis Rules; IRS Reg. §1.705-1

attributes.name: k1_delivery_method
attributes.description: The method by which the Schedule K-1 was delivered to the investor (electronic file, postal mail, investor portal, or email). Used for delivery confirmation tracking and investor preference management.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 Delivery Requirements; MRI Software

attributes.name: k1_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Schedule K-1 was formally issued and distributed to the investor. Must be on or before the IRS filing deadline (typically March 15 for partnerships). Used for compliance deadline tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065); IRS Form 1065 Filing Deadline

attributes.name: k1_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Schedule K-1 has been issued to the investor for this tax allocation period. True when K-1 has been formally distributed; false when pending. Used for compliance tracking and investor communication management.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065); IRS Partnership Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: long_term_capital_gain
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of long-term capital gains (assets held more than 12 months) from property dispositions. Taxed at preferential rates. Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 9a.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Box 9a; IRS §1(h)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, special tax treatment notes, CPA instructions, or investor-specific allocation adjustments that do not fit into structured fields. Used by tax preparers and asset managers for documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; IRS Partnership Reporting

attributes.name: ordinary_dividend_income
attributes.description: For REIT structures, the investor's allocated share of REIT dividends characterized as ordinary income (not return of capital or capital gain). Subject to standard income tax rates. Key component of REIT dividend characterization reporting.
attributes.references: IRS §857 REIT Dividend Rules; IRS Form 1099-DIV

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The investor's percentage ownership interest in the fund or partnership during the allocation period, used as the basis for computing pro-rata tax allocations. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065 Schedule K-1; IRS Reg. §1.704-1

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the tax allocation period. For annual allocations this is typically December 31; for quarterly allocations it is the last day of the fiscal quarter.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065; IRS Schedule K-1

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the tax allocation period. For annual allocations this is typically January 1; for quarterly allocations it is the first day of the fiscal quarter.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065; IRS Schedule K-1

attributes.name: return_of_capital_amount
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of distributions characterized as return of capital (ROC), which reduces the investor's tax basis rather than being taxed as income. Critical for REIT dividend characterization and investor basis tracking.
attributes.references: IRS §301; IRS Form 1099-DIV Box 3; REIT Dividend Characterization Rules

attributes.name: section_1031_exchange_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax allocation period includes a Section 1031 like-kind exchange transaction that defers capital gain recognition. When true, the allocation record must capture deferred gain details for investor basis tracking.
attributes.references: IRS §1031 Like-Kind Exchange Rules; IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: section_1231_gain_loss
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of net Section 1231 gain or loss from the sale or exchange of real property used in a trade or business. Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 10. Positive values are treated as long-term capital gain; negative values as ordinary loss.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Box 10; IRS §1231

attributes.name: section_199a_deduction
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of the Section 199A qualified business income (QBI) deduction passed through from the partnership or REIT. Allows eligible investors to deduct up to 20% of qualified REIT dividends or partnership income. Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 20Z.
attributes.references: IRS §199A; IRS Schedule K-1 Box 20Z; Tax Cuts and Jobs Act 2017

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The unique identifier or reference number of this tax allocation record in the originating source system (MRI Software or tax preparation system). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: state_taxable_income
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of taxable income apportioned to the primary state jurisdiction, after state-specific adjustments and apportionment factors. Used for state composite return filings and investor state tax compliance.
attributes.references: Multistate Tax Commission (MTC); UDITPA; State Partnership Return Requirements

attributes.name: tax_exempt_income
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of tax-exempt income generated by the fund (e.g., from tax-exempt bond investments or qualified opportunity zone income). Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 18A.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Box 18A; IRS §103

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal tax year (e.g., 2024) to which this allocation applies. Used for IRS partnership reporting and investor K-1 issuance.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1065; IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065)

attributes.name: ubti_amount
attributes.description: The investor's allocated share of Unrelated Business Taxable Income (UBTI) generated by the fund. Critical for tax-exempt investors (pension funds, endowments, foundations) who are subject to UBIT on UBTI. Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 20V.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Box 20V; IRS §511-514 UBTI Rules

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax allocation record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX §302/404; Internal Data Governance; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Federal or state income tax withheld on behalf of the investor by the fund or partnership during the allocation period. Reported on Schedule K-1 Box 13W or state equivalent. Relevant for foreign investors subject to FIRPTA withholding.
attributes.references: IRS §1446 Partnership Withholding; FIRPTA; IRS Schedule K-1 Box 13W
