attributes.references: Procore Project Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Level of organizational authority that approved this capital project. Reflects the delegation of authority matrix for CAPEX approvals. Used for SOX controls documentation and audit trail. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: property_manager|asset_manager|vp_operations|cfo|investment_committee|board — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360; Internal CAPEX Authorization Policy

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capital project received formal investment committee or board approval. Required for SOX financial controls documentation and CAPEX authorization audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Board or investment committee approved budget for the capital project in the operating currency. Represents the authorized CAPEX spend ceiling. Used for variance analysis against actual spend and DSCR/LTV covenant compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SOX Financial Controls; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Classification of the asset being created or improved by the capital project. Determines the depreciation method and useful life schedule applied upon capitalization. Aligns with the fixed asset register taxonomy in Yardi and SAP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: building_structure|mechanical_systems|electrical_systems|plumbing_systems|hvac|roof|elevators|parking|it_infrastructure|fit_out — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting; ISO 55000

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed project costs were capitalized and transferred to the fixed asset register in the GL. Marks the start of the depreciation schedule. Critical for FASB ASC 360 compliance and balance sheet accuracy.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: change_order_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative value of all approved change orders against the primary construction contract. Added to the original contract value to determine the revised contract sum. Used for budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: change_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of approved change orders issued against the primary construction contract. Indicates project scope stability and contractor performance. High change order counts may signal design deficiency or scope creep.
attributes.references: Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total value of purchase orders and contracts committed but not yet invoiced or paid for this project. Represents financial obligations already incurred. Used in cash flow forecasting and budget-to-complete analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Procore Commitments; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Total contracted value with the primary general contractor for execution of the capital project. May differ from approved budget due to contingency reserves or owner-direct procurement. Used for commitment tracking and lien exposure management.
attributes.references: Procore Commitments; SAP S/4HANA Procurement; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: coo_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Certificate of Occupancy (COO) was issued by the relevant authority, confirming the completed improvement meets all building code and safety requirements. Required before tenant occupancy and asset capitalization.
attributes.references: HUD Regulatory Requirements; Local Building Codes; OSHA Building Safety; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls documentation. Sourced from Building Engines or Procore at project initiation.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 55000

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this project record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency portfolio reporting for international real estate portfolios and REIT financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting depreciation method to be applied to the capitalized asset upon project completion. Determined by asset category and accounting policy. Straight-line is most common for real estate assets under FASB ASC 360.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: erp_project_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Project System Code
attributes.description: Project code assigned in SAP S/4HANA Project Systems (PS module) for cost collection, procurement integration, and financial consolidation. Used to reconcile CAPEX spend between the maintenance CMMS and the ERP general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funds financing the capital project. Determines accounting treatment, loan covenant implications, and investor reporting requirements. Insurance proceeds and tenant reimbursements have distinct revenue recognition rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating_reserves|debt_financing|equity_contribution|insurance_proceeds|tenant_reimbursement|government_grant|refinancing_proceeds — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; FASB ASC 842; SEC REIT Reporting; CMBS Loan Covenants

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA to which CAPEX project costs are posted. Ensures correct balance sheet classification (asset vs. expense) and supports financial consolidation and audit.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager General Ledger; SAP S/4HANA GL; FASB ASC 360; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_esg_initiative
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Initiative Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project is classified as an ESG initiative (e.g., LEED certification upgrade, BREEAM improvement, energy efficiency retrofit, EV charging installation). Supports ESG portfolio reporting and green financing eligibility.
attributes.references: USGBC LEED Certification; BREEAM; EPA Environmental Compliance; SEC ESG Disclosure; ULI ESG Standards

attributes.name: is_tenant_improvement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project constitutes a Tenant Improvement (TI) as defined under ASC 842 or IFRS 16. TI projects have distinct lease accounting treatment, amortization rules, and may be partially reimbursed by tenants.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; IFRS 16 Leases; NAR Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the capital project record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 55000

attributes.name: leed_certification_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target
attributes.description: Target LEED certification level sought for this capital project, if applicable. Relevant for green building upgrades and ESG-linked financing. Null or 'none' if LEED certification is not a project objective.
attributes.references: USGBC LEED Certification; EPA Environmental Compliance; SEC ESG Disclosure

attributes.name: osha_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Compliance Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project has mandatory OSHA safety compliance requirements (e.g., asbestos abatement, fall protection systems, electrical safety upgrades). Triggers safety inspection and documentation workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA Building Safety Standards; EPA Environmental Compliance; Building Engines Facility Operations

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Project Completion Date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled date for substantial completion of the capital project. Used for tenant coordination, COO applications, and fixed asset capitalization planning.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; FASB ASC 360; COO Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Project Start Date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled start date for project construction or installation activities. Used for project scheduling, contractor mobilization planning, and tenant disruption coordination.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; Building Engines Work Order Management

attributes.name: primary_contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary general contractor or construction firm engaged to execute the capital project. Used for vendor performance tracking, insurance certificate management, and lien waiver documentation.
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management; Building Engines Vendor Management

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority classification of the capital project, reflecting urgency, safety risk, regulatory compliance obligation, or strategic importance. Critical projects may involve OSHA safety compliance or COO requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Building Safety; Building Engines Facility Operations; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: procore_project_code
attributes.description: External project identifier from Procore construction management system. Enables cross-system traceability for RFIs, submittals, change orders, and document control records associated with this CAPEX project.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scope of work, business justification, and expected outcome of the capital project. Supports investment committee review, LOI documentation, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Document Control; FASB ASC 360; ISO 55000

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive short name for the capital project (e.g., 'HVAC Chiller Replacement — Tower A', 'Roof Membrane Renewal — Building 3'). Used in reporting dashboards, budget approvals, and fixed asset registers.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable project identifier assigned at project initiation. Used across Procore, SAP S/4HANA Project Systems, and Yardi Fixed Assets for cross-system reference and audit trail. Format: CAPEX-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Procore Project Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capital project workflow. Drives approval routing, budget release, and fixed asset capitalization triggers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_progress|on_hold|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by nature of work. Determines accounting treatment, depreciation schedule, and regulatory reporting category. Tenant Improvement (TI) projects may have separate amortization rules under ASC 842. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_construction|renovation|equipment_replacement|infrastructure_upgrade|tenant_improvement|environmental_remediation|safety_compliance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; ASC 842 Lease Accounting; OSHA Building Safety; ISO 55000

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: Most recent approved revision to the original project budget, reflecting change orders, scope changes, or cost escalations. Null if no revision has been approved. Supports change order management and budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the asset in years, used to calculate the annual depreciation charge upon capitalization. Set at project approval based on asset category and engineering assessment. Aligns with FASB ASC 360 and ISO 55000 asset lifecycle standards.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; ISO 55000 Asset Management; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

products.name: parts_inventory
products.description: Master record of maintenance parts, supplies, and consumables stocked at a property or central warehouse for building maintenance operations. Captures part number, description, unit of measure, current on-hand quantity, reorder point, reorder quantity, preferred supplier, unit cost, storage location, and asset compatibility. Supports parts availability for work order fulfillment, procurement planning, and min/max inventory management. SSOT for facility O&M inventory within the maintenance domain.

attributes.name: parts_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each parts inventory record in the maintenance domain. Primary key for the parts_inventory data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Parts/Inventory Module

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property or building at which this parts inventory is stocked. Links the inventory record to a specific facility in the real estate portfolio. A null value may indicate a central warehouse not tied to a single property.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Property/Site; Yardi Voyager — Property Module

attributes.name: building_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.building_asset. Business justification: Parts inventory records are often stocked specifically for particular building assets — critical spare parts for a specific HVAC unit, elevator components, or generator parts. Linking parts_inventory
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Parts inventory carries a gl_account_code for inventory asset and expense classification. A validated FK to chart_of_accounts ensures correct GL coding for parts issuance journal entries, inventory va
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Parts inventory is tracked by cost center for inventory valuation and maintenance expense allocation. RE property managers require cost center on parts inventory for inventory accounting, CAM expense
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the central or regional warehouse where this part is stocked, when inventory is managed at a warehouse level rather than at an individual property. Supports multi-site inventory pooling and centralized procurement strategies.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Warehouse; SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location

attributes.name: annual_usage_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of this part consumed across all work orders in the trailing 12-month period. Used for demand forecasting, economic order quantity (EOQ) calculations, and procurement budget planning. Expressed in the part's unit of measure. Updated periodically from work order issuance records.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Usage History; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: bin_number
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, rack, or slot identifier within the storage location where the part is physically placed. Provides granular pick-location detail for technicians and warehouse staff. Complements storage_location for precise part retrieval.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Bin Location; SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Bin

attributes.name: compatible_asset_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or descriptive text identifying the building equipment asset types or systems this part is compatible with (e.g., 'Carrier RTU-20, Trane AHU-5, York Chiller'). Supports technician part selection during work order execution and preventive maintenance scheduling. Sourced from Building Engines asset compatibility records.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Asset Compatibility; ISO 55000 Asset Management; BIM Standards

attributes.name: cost_classification
attributes.description: Accounting classification indicating whether the part's use is capitalized as a Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or expensed as an Operating Expenditure (OPEX). CAPEX parts extend asset life or add value; OPEX parts are routine maintenance consumables. Critical for financial reporting, GL coding, and compliance with FASB ASC 360 and IFRS 16.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 — Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 16 — Leases; SAP S/4HANA — Asset Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parts inventory record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX — Internal Controls; Building Engines CMMS — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the unit_cost is denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for portfolios spanning multiple countries.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current batch or lot of the part expires and should no longer be used. Applicable to chemicals, lubricants, sealants, and other time-sensitive consumables. Supports compliance with EPA and OSHA chemical storage regulations and FIFO inventory rotation.
attributes.references: EPA — Chemical Storage; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 — Process Safety Management; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which the cost of this part is posted when issued to a work order. Enables accurate financial reporting, cost center allocation, and CAPEX/OPEX segregation in the GL. Sourced from the chart of accounts in Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — General Ledger Module; SAP S/4HANA — Financial Accounting (FI); FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the parts inventory record: 'active' (available for use), 'inactive' (temporarily not stocked), 'discontinued' (no longer procured or used), 'on_order' (replenishment order placed, awaiting receipt), 'quarantined' (held pending inspection or quality review). Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory Status; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: is_critical_spare
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this part is designated as a critical spare — a part whose unavailability would cause significant building system downtime, tenant service disruption, or safety risk. Critical spares are subject to stricter minimum stock requirements and expedited procurement. True = critical spare; False = standard part.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Critical Parts; ISO 55000 Asset Management; OSHA Building Safety

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this part or supply is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, or disposal procedures (e.g., refrigerants, solvents, asbestos-containing materials). Triggers OSHA and EPA compliance workflows for storage, handling, and disposal. True = hazardous; False = non-hazardous.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 — Hazard Communication Standard; EPA — RCRA Hazardous Waste; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: last_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which this part was most recently issued from inventory to a work order or technician. Used to identify slow-moving or obsolete inventory items and to support FIFO rotation policies.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Part Issuance; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count was conducted for this part at its storage location. Used to assess inventory record accuracy, schedule cycle counts, and support audit compliance. Discrepancies between physical count and system quantity trigger adjustment transactions.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory Count; SOX — Internal Controls; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: last_physical_count_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity recorded during the most recent physical inventory count for this part. Compared against quantity_on_hand to identify shrinkage, loss, or data entry errors. Expressed in the part's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory Count; SOX — Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent replenishment receipt was recorded for this part. Used to track procurement cycle times, validate lead_time_days accuracy, and support inventory aging analysis.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory Receipt; SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from placement of a purchase order to receipt of the part at the storage location. Used in reorder point calculations to ensure parts are available before stock is depleted. Sourced from supplier agreements or historical procurement data.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Lead Time; SAP S/4HANA MM — Planned Delivery Time

attributes.name: leed_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this part or material meets LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) sustainability criteria, such as low-VOC content, recycled material content, or regional sourcing requirements. Supports ESG reporting and green building certification maintenance. True = LEED compliant; False = not LEED compliant.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED v4; BREEAM Standards; EPA — Sustainable Purchasing

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or brand that produces this part. Used for warranty validation, OEM compliance requirements, and sourcing alternative suppliers when the preferred supplier is unavailable.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Manufacturer; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) part number as assigned by the manufacturer. Used for cross-referencing with OEM documentation, warranty claims, and sourcing equivalent parts from alternative suppliers.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — OEM Part Number; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Upper bound of the desired inventory quantity for this part at the storage location. Prevents over-stocking and excess carrying costs. Used in conjunction with reorder_point and reorder_quantity for min/max inventory management. Expressed in the part's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Max Stock Level; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, substitution guidance, or procurement remarks related to this parts inventory record. Used by facility managers and procurement staff to capture context not covered by structured fields.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Notes Field

attributes.name: part_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping the part into a maintenance category (e.g., HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Structural, Landscaping, Fire Safety, Elevator, General Supplies). Supports inventory reporting, spend analysis by trade, and CAPEX vs. OPEX classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HVAC|Plumbing|Electrical|Structural|Fire Safety|Elevator|Landscaping|General Supplies|Mechanical|Roofing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Parts Category; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 — Facility Safety; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: part_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the part including specifications, dimensions, material composition, compatibility notes, and any distinguishing technical characteristics. Supports accurate procurement and technician identification during work order execution.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Parts Catalogue; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: part_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or short title of the maintenance part, supply, or consumable (e.g., 'HVAC Air Filter 20x20x1', 'Ballast 4-Lamp T8'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used in work order fulfillment, procurement requests, and inventory reports.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Parts Catalogue; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Externally-known manufacturer or supplier part number (catalogue number) that uniquely identifies the part across procurement and vendor systems. Used for purchase orders, vendor quotes, and cross-referencing with supplier catalogues. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Parts Catalogue; SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) Module

attributes.name: part_type
attributes.description: Operational classification distinguishing the nature of the inventory item: 'part' (durable replacement component), 'supply' (non-durable maintenance supply), 'consumable' (single-use item), 'tool' (reusable tool tracked in inventory), 'chemical' (cleaning or treatment chemical), 'equipment' (small equipment unit). Drives handling, storage, and procurement workflows. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory Type; SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Type

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical quantity of the part available in the storage location at the time of the last inventory update. Expressed in the part's unit of measure. Core operational metric for work order fulfillment and procurement planning. Updated upon part issuance, receipt, and physical count adjustments.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory On Hand; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: quantity_on_order
attributes.description: Total quantity of the part currently on open purchase orders placed with suppliers but not yet received into inventory. Used in min/max replenishment logic to avoid duplicate ordering and to project future stock levels.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory On Order; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Stock

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity of the part currently reserved or allocated to open work orders but not yet physically issued. Reduces the effective available quantity for new work order assignments. Supports accurate available-to-promise calculations for maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Inventory Reservation; SAP S/4HANA MM — Reserved Stock

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this part. When quantity_on_hand falls at or below this level, a procurement request is initiated. Expressed in the part's unit of measure. Core parameter for min/max inventory management in facility O&M operations.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Reorder Point; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity to be ordered when a replenishment is triggered (i.e., when quantity_on_hand reaches the reorder_point). May reflect economic order quantity (EOQ), supplier minimum order quantity (MOQ), or standard pack size. Expressed in the part's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Reorder Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM — Lot Size

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_number
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this part or chemical. Required by OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom) for all hazardous materials. Enables rapid access to handling, storage, and emergency response information.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 — Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom); GHS — Globally Harmonized System

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the part can be stored before it expires, degrades, or becomes unsuitable for use. Applicable to chemicals, lubricants, adhesives, and other perishable maintenance supplies. Null for non-perishable parts. Supports FIFO inventory management and waste reduction.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Shelf Life; EPA — Chemical Storage Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the part is stored within the property or central warehouse (e.g., 'Basement Storage Room B-12', 'Mechanical Room 3F', 'Central Warehouse Bin A-04'). Enables technicians to quickly locate parts during work order execution and supports physical inventory counts.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Storage Location; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
attributes.description: The part number assigned by the preferred supplier in their own catalogue system. Used when placing purchase orders to ensure the correct item is ordered. May differ from the internal part_number.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Vendor Part Number; SAP S/4HANA MM — Info Record

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard or last-purchase cost per unit of measure for this part, expressed in the operating currency. Used for CAPEX vs. OPEX cost classification, work order cost tracking, inventory valuation, and procurement budget planning. Sensitive business financial data.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Unit Cost; FASB ASC 360 — Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA MM — Moving Average Price

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the part is counted, issued, and ordered (e.g., EA = Each, BOX = Box, CASE = Case, ROLL = Roll, GAL = Gallon, LB = Pound, FT = Linear Foot, SQF = Square Foot, PKG = Package, SET = Set). Governs quantity calculations on work orders and purchase orders. Serves as the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE qualifier for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|BOX|CASE|ROLL|GAL|LB|FT|SQF|PKG|SET — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — UOM; RESO Data Dictionary; SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parts inventory record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance. Updated on any field change including quantity adjustments, cost updates, and status changes.
attributes.references: SOX — Internal Controls; Building Engines CMMS — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or supplier warranty for this part expires. Applicable to durable parts and equipment components. Enables warranty claim tracking and ensures parts are replaced under warranty before expiration where applicable.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Warranty Tracking; ISO 55000 Asset Management

products.name: sla_policy
products.description: Service Level Agreement policy record defining response and resolution time targets for maintenance work orders and tenant service requests by priority tier, property class, and request category. Captures SLA name, applicable property types, priority level (emergency, urgent, routine, planned), target response time, target resolution time, escalation rules, penalty terms, and effective date range. Supports multi-jurisdiction property management standards and can accommodate varying SLA frameworks across regions. Drives SLA compliance tracking and tenant satisfaction reporting.

attributes.name: sla_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the SLA policy record. Primary key for the sla_policy data product in the maintenance domain.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — SLA Policy Entity

attributes.name: policy_owner_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: SLA policy ownership by a defined position (Director of Facilities, Property Manager) is a real estate operations governance requirement for policy accountability, review scheduling, and escalation ro
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service contract or property management agreement under which this SLA policy is defined. Links the SLA policy to its governing contractual instrument managed in DocuSign CLM or Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; Yardi Voyager — Property Management Contract

attributes.name: applies_to_all_properties
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA policy applies universally to all properties in the portfolio (True) or is scoped to specific property types, classes, or jurisdictions (False). When True, property_class and property_use_type filters are ignored.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Policy Scope Configuration; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: auto_escalation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA policy triggers automatic escalation workflows in Building Engines when the escalation_threshold_hours is exceeded without resolution. When True, escalation notifications are sent to the designated PM or AM without manual intervention.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Auto-Escalation Rules; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: business_hours_end
attributes.description: End time of the standard business day used for SLA measurement when measurement_window is 'business_hours'. Expressed in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g., '18:00'). Varies by property jurisdiction and tenant lease terms.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Business Hours Configuration; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: business_hours_start
attributes.description: Start time of the standard business day used for SLA measurement when measurement_window is 'business_hours'. Expressed in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g., '08:00'). Varies by property jurisdiction and tenant lease terms.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Business Hours Configuration; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) vs Operating Expenditure (OPEX) Classification
attributes.description: Classifies the maintenance activities governed by this SLA policy as CAPEX (capital improvements), OPEX (routine operating expenditure), or both. Critical for financial reporting, GL coding in Yardi Voyager, and REIT FFO/AFFO calculations under SEC reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; SEC REIT Reporting — FFO/AFFO; Yardi Voyager GL; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA policy record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 404 and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; ISO 55000

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary penalty amounts defined in this SLA policy (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Supports multi-jurisdiction property portfolios and international REIT reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SEC REIT Reporting; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this SLA policy becomes binding and enforceable for work orders and tenant service requests. Aligns with lease commencement or property management contract start dates. Supports ASC 842 and IFRS 16 lease accounting compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Building Engines CMMS — Policy Effective Date

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA policy expires or is superseded. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no defined expiry. Used for WALT/WALE-aligned SLA lifecycle management and multi-jurisdiction compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Building Engines CMMS — Policy Expiry

attributes.name: escalation_level_count
attributes.description: Total number of escalation tiers defined within this SLA policy (e.g., 1 = escalate to PM, 2 = escalate to PM then AM, 3 = escalate to PM, AM, then executive). Governs the depth of the escalation chain for unresolved maintenance issues.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Escalation Configuration; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours after which an unresolved or unacknowledged work order is automatically escalated to the next management tier (e.g., Property Manager, Asset Manager). Supports automated escalation workflows in Building Engines and tenant satisfaction management.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Escalation Rules; BOMA Property Management Standards

attributes.name: esg_tracking_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Tracking Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether maintenance activities under this SLA policy require ESG impact tracking (e.g., energy consumption, carbon emissions, water usage). Relevant for LEED-certified and BREEAM-rated buildings and REIT ESG disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: USGBC LEED Certification; BREEAM Assessment Method; SEC ESG Disclosure; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Geographic or regulatory jurisdiction code to which this SLA policy applies (e.g., 'US-NY', 'US-CA', 'UK', 'AU-NSW'). Supports multi-jurisdiction property management standards and regional regulatory compliance requirements including HUD, EPA, and OSHA.
attributes.references: HUD Regulatory Framework; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; EPA Environmental Compliance; ISO 3166 Country/Region Codes

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA policy was most recently formally reviewed and approved by the policy owner. Supports SOX audit trail requirements and ISO 55000 asset management governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 55000 Asset Management; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: measurement_window
attributes.description: Defines the time basis against which SLA response and resolution targets are measured. 'calendar_hours' counts all hours including weekends and holidays; 'business_hours' counts only standard operating hours; '24_7' applies continuous measurement for emergency services.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — SLA Measurement Configuration; BOMA Property Management Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this SLA policy. Calculated based on last_reviewed_date and review_frequency. Triggers review workflow notifications to the policy owner in Building Engines.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 55000 Asset Management; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for tenant notifications triggered by this SLA policy (e.g., email, SMS, tenant portal, phone). Applicable when tenant_notification_required is True. Configured in Building Engines and Salesforce CRM tenant profiles.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Notification Configuration; Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: osha_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether work orders governed by this SLA policy require OSHA safety compliance documentation and sign-off. True for life-safety systems (fire suppression, electrical, structural), hazardous materials handling, and confined space entry work.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 — Occupational Safety; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 — Construction Safety

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary penalty amount applied per SLA breach event, expressed in the policy currency. Applicable when penalty_type is 'fixed_fee'. Used in Yardi Voyager AR for tenant credit processing and financial reporting under FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager AR; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: penalty_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial or contractual penalties apply when this SLA policy is breached. True when penalty terms are defined in the property management contract or lease agreement. Drives penalty calculation workflows and tenant credit processing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; DocuSign CLM — Contract Terms

attributes.name: penalty_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of monthly rent or service charge applied as a penalty per SLA breach event. Applicable when penalty_type is 'percentage_of_rent'. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 2.50 = 2.5%). Used in Yardi Voyager for automated credit calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager AR; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: penalty_type
attributes.description: Type of penalty applied when this SLA policy is breached. 'rent_credit' reduces tenant rent obligation; 'service_credit' credits the tenant's service charge account; 'fixed_fee' applies a fixed monetary penalty; 'percentage_of_rent' applies a percentage-based deduction. Null or 'none' when penalty_applicable is False.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; NAR Lease Standards; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the SLA policy across systems and contracts. Used in work order management, tenant service request tracking, and vendor dispatch communications. Sourced from Building Engines.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — SLA Policy Code; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the SLA policy scope, applicability conditions, and any special terms or exceptions. Provides context for property managers, asset managers, and compliance teams reviewing SLA compliance reports.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Policy Notes; BOMA Property Management Standards

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SLA policy (e.g., 'Emergency HVAC Response — Class A Office', 'Routine Maintenance — Residential'). Used in tenant communications, reporting dashboards, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — SLA Policy Name; NAR Property Management Standards

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SLA policy record. 'active' indicates the policy is currently enforced; 'superseded' indicates it has been replaced by a newer version; 'draft' indicates it is under review prior to activation.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Policy Lifecycle; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the SLA policy document (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Supports policy versioning and audit trail for regulatory compliance under OSHA and SOX. Incremented when material changes are made to response or resolution targets.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 — Building Safety; ISO 55000

attributes.name: preventive_maintenance_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA policy governs preventive maintenance (PM) schedules in addition to reactive work orders. When True, the policy applies to scheduled PM activities tracked in Building Engines, including HVAC servicing, elevator inspections, and O&M routines.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Preventive Maintenance Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority classification of the maintenance request or work order to which this SLA policy applies. 'emergency' covers life-safety and critical system failures; 'urgent' covers significant operational disruptions; 'routine' covers standard maintenance; 'planned' covers scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) activities.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Priority Tier; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; BOMA Property Management Standards

attributes.name: property_class
attributes.description: Classification of the property type to which this SLA policy applies. Class A/B/C refers to commercial office grading; residential covers multifamily and single-family; mixed_use and industrial cover respective asset classes. Enables differentiated SLA standards by asset quality tier.
attributes.references: BOMA International Property Classification; CoStar Property Class Standards; NAR

attributes.name: property_use_type
attributes.description: Operational use type of the property covered by this SLA policy. Distinguishes between commercial, residential, industrial, retail, mixed-use, and hospitality assets, enabling use-type-specific SLA frameworks aligned with tenant expectations and lease obligations.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary — Property Type; NAR; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: region_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the geographic region or market to which this SLA policy applies (e.g., 'Northeast US', 'Greater London', 'Sydney Metro'). Used for regional portfolio reporting and multi-market SLA benchmarking.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite — Market Region; NAR Regional Standards

attributes.name: request_category
attributes.description: Category of maintenance or facility service request covered by this SLA policy (e.g., HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Elevator, Fire Safety, Janitorial, Structural, Security). Drives routing rules and vendor dispatch in Building Engines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hvac|plumbing|electrical|elevator|fire_safety|janitorial|structural|security|general — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Work Order Category; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: resolution_time_target_hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours within which a maintenance issue must be fully resolved and the work order closed under this SLA policy. Measured from the time the request is logged. Drives OPEX planning and tenant satisfaction KPIs.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — SLA Resolution Target; BOMA Property Management Standards; ISO 55000

attributes.name: response_time_target_hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours within which a maintenance technician or vendor must acknowledge and respond to a work order or tenant service request under this SLA policy. Measured from the time the request is logged in Building Engines. Critical for tenant satisfaction reporting and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — SLA Response Target; BOMA Property Management Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: response_time_target_mins
attributes.description: Target response time expressed in minutes for high-precision SLA tracking, particularly for emergency priority tier requests where sub-hour targets apply (e.g., 15-minute emergency response). Complements response_time_target_hours for granular SLA measurement.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Emergency SLA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Life Safety

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this SLA policy is formally reviewed and updated to reflect changes in property management standards, tenant requirements, or regulatory obligations. Supports SOX internal controls and ISO 55000 asset management governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; ISO 55000 Asset Management; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this SLA policy record was sourced. Primarily Building Engines CMMS for facility operations; Yardi Voyager for property management contract-linked SLAs. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS; Yardi Voyager; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: source_system_policy_ref
attributes.description: Native identifier of this SLA policy record in the originating source system (e.g., Building Engines internal SLA policy ID). Enables reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — SLA Policy Reference; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: tenant_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether tenants must be proactively notified of work order status updates under this SLA policy. Supports tenant relationship management obligations in Salesforce CRM and lease compliance requirements under FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Salesforce CRM — Tenant Management; GDPR Article 5 — Data Minimisation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA policy record was most recently modified. Tracks policy amendments, version updates, and status changes for audit compliance under SOX Section 404. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; ISO 55000

attributes.name: vendor_dispatch_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether work orders under this SLA policy require external vendor dispatch rather than in-house maintenance staff. Drives vendor selection and dispatch workflows in Building Engines and procurement processes in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS — Vendor Dispatch; SAP S/4HANA Procurement; BOMA Vendor Management Standards

products.name: billable_charge
products.description: Billable maintenance charge record generated when maintenance costs are recoverable from tenants under NNN or modified gross lease structures as part of CAM reconciliation. Captures the originating work order or service contract, tenant reference, charge amount, charge category (HVAC, janitorial, repairs, landscaping), billing period, CAM pool allocation method, and invoice reference in the property management accounting system. Bridges the maintenance domain to the finance and lease domains for CAM charge-back processing.
products.reference: Yardi CAM Charge / NNN Expense Recovery

attributes.name: billable_charge_id
attributes.description: Primary key for billable_charge

attributes.name: amenity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.amenity. Business justification: Amenity operating charges (pool maintenance surcharge, amenity fee) may be billed to tenants. Amenity-level charge tracking supports amenity revenue/expense reporting and lease compliance.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: CAM charge and tenant billable charge approval by a specific employee is required for CAM reconciliation audit trails, tenant dispute resolution, and financial controls in real estate property managem
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Maintenance billable charges (tenant repairs, CAM charges) are invoiced through AR. The billable_charge.invoice_number is a denormalized reference to ar_invoice. This FK enables tenant billing reconci
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which the maintenance activity occurred and from which the billable charge is generated.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Management; Building Engines

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.building. Business justification: Billable maintenance charges are allocated at the building level for multi-building assets. Building-level CAM reconciliation and operating expense reporting require linking charges to specific buildi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cam_pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAM expense pool to which this charge is assigned for proration and reconciliation. CAM pools group recoverable expenses by building, floor, or expense category per lease terms.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA Standards; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Billable charges carry a gl_account_code for revenue recognition and CAM recovery classification. A validated FK to chart_of_accounts ensures correct income coding for AR invoicing, CAM reconciliation
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: common_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.common_area. Business justification: CAM charges are allocated to specific common areas. Common area-level charge tracking is the foundation of CAM reconciliation, enabling landlords to justify CAM expenses to tenants.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Billable charges are allocated to cost centers for CAM pool management and property-level revenue tracking. RE controllers require cost center assignment on billable charges to correctly allocate CAM
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Maintenance billable charges (CAM, tenant repairs) generate GL journal entries for revenue recognition and accrual accounting. RE controllers require the charge-to-journal-entry link for period-close
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: owner_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to owner.owner_agreement. Business justification: Owner NOI and management fee reporting: billable charges (CAM recoveries, maintenance costs) must be attributed to the governing owner agreement to compute net operating income, management fees, and o
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parking. Business justification: Parking maintenance charges are billed to tenants or tracked as parking operating expenses. Parking-level charge tracking supports parking revenue/expense reporting and tenant parking lease billing.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: property_space_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.space. Business justification: Commercial tenant charges are allocated to specific spaces. Space-level charge tracking is the foundation of CAM reconciliation and tenant billing in commercial real estate.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service contract under which this charge was incurred, if the charge originates from a vendor service agreement rather than a discrete work order.
attributes.references: Building Engines; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant responsible for or associated with this billable charge. Used for CAM charge-back processing and tenant billing under NNN or modified gross lease structures.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: tenant_occupancy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenant.occupancy. Business justification: CAM reconciliation, tenant-billable repair invoicing, and pro-rata share calculations require linking charges to the specific occupancy period. Property accountants need occupancy_id to validate that
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.unit. Business justification: Tenant-billable maintenance charges are allocated to specific units. Unit-level charge history supports lease administration, tenant billing disputes, and move-out cost reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.vendor_dispatch. Business justification: Billable charges to tenants are frequently generated from vendor dispatch events — when a vendor performs work and submits an invoice, the cost may be recoverable from the tenant under CAM provisions
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external vendor or contractor who performed the maintenance service that generated this charge. Used for vendor spend analysis, AP reconciliation, and service contract compliance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable; Building Engines Vendor Dispatch

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating work order in Building Engines that generated this billable charge. Links the maintenance activity to the recoverable cost.
attributes.references: Building Engines Work Order Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billable charge was approved by the property manager or asset manager for tenant invoicing. Part of the internal controls audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Management; SOX; SEC

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period to which this charge is allocated. Together with billing_period_start_date defines the CAM reconciliation window for this charge.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period to which this charge is allocated. Used in CAM reconciliation to match charges to the correct annual or monthly reconciliation cycle.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: cam_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate the CAM pool charge to this tenant. Pro-rata NLA/GLA allocates based on the tenant's proportionate share of leasable area; fixed percentage uses a lease-defined rate; direct assignment charges the full amount to one tenant.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA Standards; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance activity type that generated this billable charge. Used for CAM pool segmentation, tenant billing transparency, and OPEX vs. CAPEX reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HVAC|janitorial|repairs|landscaping|security|electrical|plumbing|pest_control|elevator|general_maintenance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Building Engines Facility Operations; Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: charge_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the billable maintenance charge was incurred or the service was rendered. Used as the basis for billing period assignment and CAM pool allocation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: charge_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable charge reference number used in tenant invoices, CAM reconciliation statements, and property management accounting systems such as Yardi Voyager AR. Format: BC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billable charge from creation through collection or write-off. Drives workflow routing in Yardi Voyager AR and CAM reconciliation processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|invoiced|collected|disputed|written_off|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Distinguishes the nature of the billable charge: CAM recoverable (pooled allocation), direct tenant charge (tenant-caused damage or exclusive service), capital improvement (CAPEX), emergency response, or warranty claim. Drives GL coding and lease compliance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Management; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: cost_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance charge is classified as an Operating Expenditure (OPEX) or Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) per accounting policy. Critical for financial reporting, asset lifecycle tracking, and REIT compliance under FASB and IFRS standards.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billable charge record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this charge record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency portfolio operations for international real estate portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830; IFRS 21

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant formally raised a dispute against this charge. Used to track dispute resolution timelines and SLA compliance for tenant relations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the tenant's stated reason for disputing this charge. Populated when charge_status is 'disputed'. Used for dispute resolution tracking and lease compliance review.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines Tenant Service Requests

attributes.name: estimated_cam_paid
attributes.description: Total estimated CAM payments already collected from the tenant during the reconciliation period. Used to calculate the reconciliation true-up amount (over- or under-collection) at year-end.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA to which this billable charge is posted. Determines the financial statement classification (revenue, expense recovery, or liability) for the charge.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager General Ledger; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB; GAAP

attributes.name: gross_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total gross cost of the maintenance activity before any tenant allocation, CAM pool proration, or adjustments. Represents the full vendor invoice or internal cost amount in the property's operating currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant invoice containing this charge was issued. Used for payment due date calculation and aging analysis in Accounts Receivable.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_cam_reconciliation_charge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Reconciliation Charge Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge is part of an annual CAM reconciliation adjustment (true) or a current-period direct billing (false). CAM reconciliation charges arise when actual expenses differ from estimated CAM payments collected during the year.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: lease_structure_type
attributes.description: The lease structure under which this charge is recoverable from the tenant. NNN (Triple Net) leases pass through all operating expenses; modified gross leases recover specific categories; gross leases are typically non-recoverable. Determines billing eligibility.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for property managers to record additional context, special billing instructions, or explanatory notes related to this charge. Visible in tenant-facing CAM reconciliation statements.
attributes.references: Building Engines; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the tenant is required to remit payment for this charge per the lease agreement terms. Used for AR aging, late fee assessment, and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: reconciliation_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year for which the CAM reconciliation is being performed. Applicable only when is_cam_reconciliation_charge is true. Used to match reconciliation charges to the correct operating year.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed charge was resolved, either through adjustment, credit, or confirmation of the original amount. Marks the closure of the dispute lifecycle.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this billable charge record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Building Engines CMMS and Yardi Voyager AR.
attributes.references: Building Engines; Yardi Voyager; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_charge_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this charge record in the originating source system (e.g., Building Engines charge ID or Yardi Voyager transaction ID). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and deduplication in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Building Engines; Yardi Voyager; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Applicable sales or use tax assessed on the billable maintenance charge, where required by jurisdiction. Included in the tenant invoice and tracked separately for tax remittance compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; IRS; State Tax Authorities

attributes.name: tenant_allocated_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross charge amount allocated to the specific tenant after applying the CAM pool allocation method (pro-rata share, fixed percentage, or direct assignment). This is the net amount billed to the tenant.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: tenant_pro_rata_share
attributes.description: The tenant's proportionate share of the CAM pool expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Derived from the ratio of the tenant's Net Leasable Area (NLA) to the total building NLA or applicable pool area as defined in the lease.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA Standards; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: closure_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded at the time of incident closure, summarizing the final outcome, verification of corrective actions, and any residual risk considerations. Provides a complete audit trail for the incident lifecycle.
