attributes.name: contributing_factors
attributes.description: Narrative description of secondary or contributing factors that contributed to the safety incident beyond the primary root cause. May include environmental conditions, time pressure, staffing levels, or equipment age. Supports comprehensive incident investigation.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; OSHA Incident Investigation Guidelines

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which all corrective and preventive actions were completed and verified. Null if corrective actions are still pending. Used to measure remediation timeliness and close the incident lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date by which all corrective and preventive actions identified in the incident investigation must be implemented. Used for tracking remediation progress and accountability.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; OSHA Incident Investigation Guidelines

attributes.name: corrective_actions
attributes.description: Description of the corrective and preventive actions taken or planned in response to the safety incident to prevent recurrence. May include equipment repair, procedural updates, additional training, or physical modifications to the facility.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when the safety incident record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 45001:2018

attributes.name: days_away_from_work
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the injured party was away from work as a result of the safety incident. Required for OSHA 300 log (Column K) and OSHA 300A annual summary. Zero for incidents not resulting in lost time.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7(b)(3); OSHA Form 300 Column K

attributes.name: days_job_transfer_restriction
attributes.business_glossary_term: Days on Job Transfer or Restriction
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the injured party was on job transfer or work restriction as a result of the safety incident. Required for OSHA 300 log (Column L). Distinct from days_away_from_work.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7(b)(4); OSHA Form 300 Column L

attributes.name: equipment_involved
attributes.description: Description or identifier of the building equipment, machinery, or system involved in the safety incident, such as HVAC unit, elevator, electrical panel, or scaffolding. Supports equipment lifecycle analysis and O&M safety reviews.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Building Engines CMMS; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1910

attributes.name: esg_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the safety incident is material for ESG reporting purposes, including sustainability disclosures, GRESB assessments, or SEC climate and social risk disclosures for publicly traded REITs. Supports ESG portfolio-level safety metrics.
attributes.references: SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; GRESB Real Estate Assessment; GRI 403 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: estimated_remediation_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of corrective actions and remediation activities required to address the safety incident, expressed in the local currency. Used for CAPEX/OPEX budgeting and insurance claim estimation. Sourced from Building Engines work order cost estimates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; Yardi Voyager; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: incident_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing more granular categorization of the incident type, such as slip/trip/fall, struck-by object, electrical hazard, chemical exposure, equipment failure, or structural failure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: slip_trip_fall|struck_by|electrical|chemical_exposure|equipment_failure|structural|ergonomic|fire_explosion|environmental_release|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; ANSI/ASSP Z16.2; ISO 45001:2018

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the safety incident or near-miss event, including what happened, the sequence of events, conditions at the time, and any immediate actions taken. Free-text field captured by the reporting party.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: incident_location_detail
attributes.description: Specific location within the property where the incident occurred, such as floor number, suite, common area, rooftop, parking garage, mechanical room, or stairwell. Complements the property_id with sub-property granularity.
attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the safety incident at the time of reporting. Used for cross-referencing with regulatory filings, insurance claims, and Building Engines work order records. Format: INC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; Building Engines CMMS Incident Module

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the safety incident record, tracking its lifecycle from initial report through investigation, corrective action, and closure. Valid values: open, under_investigation, corrective_action_pending, closed, voided.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904

attributes.name: incident_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the safety incident or near-miss event occurred at the property. This is the principal real-world event timestamp, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.5; RIDDOR 2013 (UK); ISO 45001:2018

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the safety incident by nature of the event. Drives regulatory recordability determination and reporting pathway. Valid values: injury, near_miss, property_damage, environmental, fire, security.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7; RIDDOR 2013; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 6.1.2

attributes.name: injured_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the person involved in the safety incident by their relationship to the property or organization. Determines applicable regulatory reporting obligations and insurance coverage. Valid values: employee, contractor, tenant, visitor, vendor.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.31; RIDDOR 2013 Regulation 4

attributes.name: injury_nature
attributes.description: Description of the nature of the injury or occupational illness sustained, such as laceration, fracture, sprain, burn, or respiratory condition. Required for OSHA 300 log and workers compensation filings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: laceration|fracture|sprain_strain|burn|contusion|respiratory|eye_injury|amputation|fatality|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29 (Form 300 Column G); BLS Occupational Injury and Illness Classification Manual

attributes.name: investigating_officer
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the property manager, safety officer, or facility operations lead responsible for conducting the incident investigation. Supports accountability and audit trail for the investigation process.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; OSHA Incident Investigation Guidelines; Building Engines CMMS

attributes.name: investigation_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal incident investigation was completed and findings were documented. Marks the transition from investigation to corrective action phase in the incident lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; OSHA Incident Investigation Guidelines

attributes.name: is_environmental_release
attributes.description: Indicates whether the safety incident involved a release of hazardous materials, chemicals, or pollutants into the environment. Triggers EPA reporting obligations and environmental compliance review when True.
attributes.references: EPA CERCLA; EPA EPCRA Section 304; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1910.119

attributes.name: is_osha_recordable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the safety incident meets OSHA recordability criteria under 29 CFR Part 1904 and must be entered on the OSHA 300 log. True if the incident resulted in medical treatment beyond first aid, days away from work, restricted work, job transfer, loss of consciousness, or diagnosis of a significant injury by a healthcare professional.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7; OSHA Form 300

attributes.name: is_riddor_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the safety incident is reportable under the UK Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations 2013 (RIDDOR). Applicable for properties under UK jurisdiction. Null for non-UK properties.
attributes.references: RIDDOR 2013 (SI 2013/1471); Health and Safety Executive (HSE) UK

attributes.name: osha_300_log_entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the safety incident was entered onto the OSHA 300 log. OSHA requires recordable incidents to be logged within seven calendar days of receiving information that a recordable case occurred. Nullable for non-OSHA-recordable incidents.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29(b)(3); OSHA Form 300

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The country jurisdiction governing the regulatory reporting obligations for this safety incident. Determines which reporting framework applies (OSHA 300 for USA, RIDDOR for GBR, etc.). Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|GBR|CAN|AUS|DEU|FRA|SGP|ARE|OTHER — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; RIDDOR 2013; OSHA Canada

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who initially reported the safety incident to the facility management team. May be the injured party, a witness, or a property manager. Supports incident reporting accountability.

attributes.name: reported_timestamp

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: The identified root cause of the safety incident as determined through investigation. Describes the underlying systemic or behavioral factor that allowed the incident to occur, such as inadequate PPE, equipment malfunction, procedural non-compliance, or environmental hazard.

attributes.name: treatment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the medical treatment provided following the safety incident. Valid values: first_aid, medical_treatment, hospitalization, fatality, no_treatment.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7; RIDDOR 2013 Regulation 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when the safety incident record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to investigation findings, corrective actions, or regulatory filing status.

attributes.name: witness_names
attributes.description: Names of individuals who witnessed the safety incident. Recorded as a comma-separated list or narrative. Used during incident investigation and may be required for regulatory filings or legal proceedings. Classified as confidential due to sensitivity of witness information.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; ISO 45001:2018; GDPR Article 5

Provides the historical audit trail of PM compliance and supports equipment reliability analysis and mean-time-between-failure (MTBF) calculations.

attributes.name: checklist_passed_items
attributes.description: Number of checklist task items that received a 'pass' result during this PM execution. Used to calculate pass rate and assess overall equipment condition at time of inspection.

attributes.name: checklist_total_items
attributes.description: Total number of checklist task items defined for this PM execution, as inherited from the parent PM schedule template. Provides the denominator for checklist completion rate calculations.

attributes.name: corrective_wo_spawned

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the technician completed the PM task. Used with start_timestamp to derive actual duration for labor reporting and equipment reliability analysis.

attributes.references: Building Engines CMMS; ISO 55000 Asset Management; ASHRAE Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the preventive maintenance task was performed. Compared against scheduled_date to measure schedule compliance and variance.

attributes.name: execution_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for this PM execution record as assigned by the Building Engines CMMS (e.g., PME-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reference, audit trails, and field technician communication.

attributes.name: labor_cost

attributes.name: leed_compliance_relevant

attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM execution contributes to LEED certification maintenance requirements (e.g., HVAC filter changes, energy system inspections). Supports ESG reporting and green building certification compliance tracking.

attributes.name: meter_reading_unit

products.name: asset_service_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the contractual coverage relationship between building assets and maintenance service contracts. It captures which specific assets are covered under which service agreements, with coverage-specific terms that exist only in the context of this relationship. Each record links one building asset to one service contract with attributes defining the scope, duration, and service level commitments for that specific asset under that specific contract.. Existence Justification: In real estate facility management, building assets routinely have overlapping service coverage from multiple contracts (manufacturer warranty service, independent maintenance agreements, specialized system contracts), and service contracts routinely cover dozens to hundreds of individual assets across properties. The service_contract.covered_equipment_description STRING field is a denormalized representation that cannot support asset-specific coverage terms, SLAs, or coverage history tracking.

attributes.name: asset_service_coverage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each asset-contract coverage record

attributes.name: building_asset_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset Service Coverage - Building Asset Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific building asset covered under this service contract
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset Service Coverage - Service Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the service contract providing coverage for this asset
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: added_to_contract_date
attributes.description: Date this asset was formally added to the service contract scope. Used for contract amendment tracking and billing reconciliation when assets are added mid-term.

attributes.name: asset_specific_sla_hours
attributes.description: Response time SLA in hours specific to this asset under this contract. May override the contract-level SLA for critical assets (e.g., life safety systems, data center cooling) that require faster response than the standard contract terms.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which coverage for this specific asset under this contract ends. May differ from contract expiration if asset is removed, replaced, or transferred.

attributes.name: coverage_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special terms, exclusions, or conditions specific to this asset's coverage under this contract (e.g., 'Excludes compressor replacement', 'Requires 24-hour notice for access').

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Specific scope of service coverage for this asset under this contract. Defines what types of maintenance activities are covered (full service, PM only, emergency repairs, parts replacement, labor, or custom terms).

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this specific asset became covered under this service contract. May differ from contract commencement if assets are added mid-term.

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of coverage for this asset under this contract. Active = currently covered; suspended = temporarily not covered (e.g., asset offline for renovation); expired = coverage period ended; terminated = coverage cancelled before end date.

attributes.name: is_primary_contract
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary service contract for this asset. Used when an asset has overlapping coverage (e.g., manufacturer warranty + independent maintenance contract) to designate the first-call service provider.

attributes.name: removed_from_contract_date
attributes.description: Date this asset was formally removed from the service contract scope. Null if asset remains covered. Used for contract amendment tracking and billing adjustments.

products.name: asset_coverage_schedule
products.description: This association product represents the scheduled insurance coverage relationship between building assets and insurance coverage lines. In real estate insurance, major building equipment (boilers, chillers, elevators, HVAC systems) are individually scheduled on equipment breakdown, boiler and machinery, or inland marine coverage lines. Each record captures the insured value, deductible, coverage limits, and effective dates specific to that asset-coverage pairing. A single building asset may appear on multiple coverage lines across different policy years or coverage types, and a single coverage line may schedule multiple high-value assets. This is the operational record used by risk managers to verify adequate coverage per asset and by claims adjusters to determine coverage applicability.. Existence Justification: In real estate insurance operations, high-value building equipment (boilers, chillers, elevators, HVAC systems, generators) are individually scheduled on equipment breakdown, boiler and machinery, or inland marine coverage lines. A single building asset can appear on multiple coverage lines across different policy years, coverage types, or insurers, and a single coverage line typically schedules multiple assets. Risk managers actively manage these schedules, assigning insured values, deductibles, and effective dates specific to each asset-coverage pairing.

attributes.name: asset_coverage_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each asset-coverage schedule record

attributes.name: building_asset_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset Coverage Schedule - Building Asset Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific building equipment or infrastructure asset being scheduled on this coverage line
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the insurance coverage line under which this asset is scheduled
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: asset_specific_deductible
attributes.description: Deductible amount applicable to claims involving this specific asset under this coverage line. May differ from the coverage line's standard deductible_amount if the asset has a higher-risk profile or negotiated terms. Null if the coverage line's standard deductible applies.

attributes.name: asset_specific_limit
attributes.description: Maximum payout limit for claims involving this specific asset under this coverage line. May differ from the coverage line's overall coverage_limit if the asset has a sub-limit or enhanced limit. Null if the coverage line's standard limit applies.

attributes.name: endorsement_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the policy endorsement that added or modified this asset's schedule entry on this coverage line. Null if the asset was included in the original policy schedule.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent insurance carrier inspection or risk assessment conducted specifically for this asset under this coverage line. Used to track compliance with underwriter-required inspection schedules.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next insurance carrier inspection or risk assessment is required for this asset under this coverage line to maintain coverage. Null if no periodic inspection is required.

attributes.name: schedule_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this asset was added to this coverage line schedule and became covered. May differ from the coverage line's overall effective_date if the asset was added mid-term via endorsement.

attributes.name: schedule_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this asset's coverage under this specific coverage line expires. May differ from the coverage line's overall expiration_date if the asset was removed mid-term or if coverage was non-renewed for this asset only.

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, underwriter requirements, or risk mitigation measures specific to this asset's coverage under this line (e.g., 'Requires annual boiler inspection by licensed engineer', 'Coverage contingent on sprinkler system maintenance').

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current status of this asset's inclusion on this coverage line schedule. active = currently covered; expired = coverage period ended; pending = endorsement submitted but not yet effective; cancelled = removed mid-term; excluded = explicitly excluded from coverage via endorsement.

attributes.name: scheduled_insured_value
attributes.description: The specific insured value assigned to this building asset on this coverage line. May differ from the asset's replacement_cost based on agreed value endorsements, depreciation schedules, or coverage-specific valuation methods. This is the amount used for premium calculation and loss settlement for this asset under this coverage.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Basis on which this asset's insured value and loss settlement are calculated under this coverage line. May differ from the coverage line's overall valuation_basis if the asset has specific endorsements (e.g., agreed value for a historic boiler, ACV for an aging chiller).

products.name: parts_usage
products.description: This association product represents the consumption of maintenance parts against work orders in facility operations. It captures the operational event of issuing inventory items to fulfill maintenance work. Each record links one parts_inventory item to one work_order with attributes that exist only in the context of this consumption transaction: quantity issued, unit cost at time of issuance, issue date, returned quantity, and cost classification.. Existence Justification: In facility maintenance operations, parts usage represents the operational event of consuming inventory items to fulfill work orders. A single work order routinely requires multiple different parts (e.g., HVAC repair needs filters, belts, refrigerant), and a single part type is consumed across many different work orders over time. CMMS platforms like Building Engines explicitly model this as a parts usage or materials used transaction entity with its own attributes (quantity, cost at issuance, date, returns).

attributes.name: parts_usage_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each parts usage transaction record

attributes.name: parts_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the parts inventory item consumed in this usage transaction
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the work order against which parts were issued
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: cost_classification
attributes.description: Accounting classification indicating whether this specific parts usage is capitalized as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) or expensed as an operating expenditure (OPEX). May differ from the part's default classification based on the nature of the work order.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the unit_cost_at_issuance is denominated. Inherited from the parts_inventory record at time of issuance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217

attributes.name: issued_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technician, warehouse staff, or system user who issued the part to the work order. Supports audit trail and accountability for inventory transactions.

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the part was physically issued from inventory and allocated to the work order. Critical for inventory transaction history and work order timeline tracking.

attributes.name: quantity_issued
attributes.description: The quantity of the part issued from inventory to fulfill the work order, expressed in the part's unit of measure. This is relationship-specific data that represents the consumption amount for this specific work order.

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the part that was returned to inventory after being issued to the work order (e.g., unused surplus). Enables accurate net consumption calculation and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_cost_at_issuance
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the part at the time it was issued to the work order. Captures historical cost for accurate work order costing, as the current unit_cost in parts_inventory may change over time.

domains.name: brokerage
domains.description: Manages sales and leasing brokerage activity including deal pipelines, listing agreements, commission structures, co-broker arrangements, MLS/CoStar listing syndication, and agent/broker licensing. products.name: listing

Serves as the SSOT for all brokerage-managed property offerings.

products.name: brokerage_deal
products.description: Core transactional record representing a brokerage deal from prospect to close, sourced from Salesforce CRM opportunity pipeline. Serves as the SSOT for brokerage deal pipeline activity and deal stage audit trail across buy-side and sell-side operations.

products.name: negotiation_instrument
products.description: Pre-contract negotiation instrument record capturing all formal offers and letters of intent submitted during the brokerage deal process. Covers LOIs (non-binding), binding purchase offers, lease proposals, and counter-offers via a type discriminator. Records submission date, expiration date, proposed terms (price or rent PSF, lease term, TI allowance, CAM structure, NNN vs gross), contingencies (financing, inspection, due diligence period), earnest money deposit, counterparty identity, property reference, deal reference, negotiation round, binding/non-binding flag, and status (submitted, countered, accepted, rejected, expired, withdrawn). Serves as the SSOT for all pre-contract negotiation instruments in the brokerage deal lifecycle — from initial non-binding LOI through binding offer acceptance. Replaces the need for a separate offer entity by using a type discriminator to distinguish instrument types.

products.name: commission_split
products.description: Detailed allocation and disbursement record breaking down how a gross commission is split among participating brokers, agents, co-brokers, and the brokerage house, and tracking actual payment execution through to settlement. Captures recipient type (in-house agent, co-broker firm, referral partner, brokerage house), recipient identity, split percentage, split dollar amount, override adjustments, disbursement date, payment method (wire, ACH, check), bank account reference, disbursement status (scheduled, processed, failed, reversed), and Yardi Voyager AP transaction reference. Serves as the SSOT for both commission allocation and disbursement — each row represents one payee's share of a commission and the payment lifecycle for that share. Supports multi-party commission disbursement workflows, agent production tracking, 1099 reporting, and provides the financial audit trail for all commission payments.

attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; NAR; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission split record was last modified. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of IRS backup withholding deducted from the commission disbursement when the recipient has not provided a valid TIN or is subject to backup withholding per IRS rules.
attributes.references: IRS Backup Withholding Rules; IRS Publication 1281

attributes.name: yardi_ap_transaction_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable (AP) Transaction Reference
attributes.description: Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable transaction identifier for this commission disbursement. Provides the financial system audit trail linking the commission split to the GL posting and AP check run.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SOX Financial Controls

products.name: co_broker_agreement
products.description: Formal co-brokerage arrangement record between the listing brokerage and a cooperating broker firm for a specific deal or listing. Captures cooperating broker firm name, license number, designated agent, agreed co-broker commission split percentage, SNDA requirements, MLS cooperation flag, agreement execution date, and deal or listing reference. Governs the legal and financial terms of inter-firm brokerage cooperation.

attributes.name: co_broker_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the co-brokerage agreement record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: brokerage_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brokerage.deal. Business justification: A co-broker agreement is executed in the context of a specific brokerage deal. The co_broker_agreement currently links to listing but not to the deal itself. Adding deal_id enables direct association
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brokerage.commission. Business justification: A co-broker agreement defines the commission split terms between the listing brokerage and the cooperating broker. Linking co_broker_agreement to the commission record enables direct traceability betw
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Co-broker commission split amounts and flat fees require standardized currency classification for multi-market financial reporting and inter-firm commission disbursement. currency_code is a denormaliz
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Co-broker agreements are subject to jurisdiction-specific real estate commission rules, MLS cooperation requirements, and license law. governing_law_state is a denormalized text field. Linking to comp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: listing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property listing or deal for which this co-brokerage arrangement is established. Links the agreement to a specific listing record.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this co-brokerage agreement, used for reference in correspondence, DocuSign CLM, and Salesforce CRM deal tracking.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the co-brokerage agreement, tracking progression from draft through execution to termination or expiry.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the co-brokerage arrangement indicating whether it covers a sale transaction, lease transaction, combined sale and lease, referral arrangement, or buyer representation engagement.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments executed against this co-brokerage agreement since its original execution. Supports version control and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: brokerage_side
attributes.description: Indicates which side of the transaction the cooperating broker represents: buy-side (buyer representation), sell-side (seller representation), tenant representation, landlord representation, or dual agency where permitted.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: co_broker_commission_flat_fee
attributes.description: Fixed flat-fee dollar amount agreed as the co-broker commission, used when the arrangement is structured as a flat fee rather than a percentage split. Nullable when percentage-based structure applies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: co_broker_commission_split_pct
attributes.description: Agreed percentage of the total gross commission to be paid to the cooperating broker firm upon successful transaction close. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Governs commission disbursement in Yardi Voyager AR.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: commission_paid_date
attributes.description: Date on which the co-broker commission was disbursed to the cooperating broker firm. Nullable until payment is made. Reconciled against Yardi Voyager General Ledger.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: commission_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the co-broker commission has been disbursed following transaction close. True = commission paid; False = pending payment. Supports Yardi Voyager AP commission disbursement tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; Yardi Voyager AP

attributes.name: commission_structure
attributes.description: Defines the commission payment structure for the co-broker arrangement: percentage split of gross commission, flat fee, hybrid (combination), or referral fee arrangement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: cooperating_firm_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued real estate brokerage license number for the cooperating firm. Required for regulatory compliance and commission disbursement validation.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Licensing Authorities; NAR; SEC (for REIT-related transactions)

attributes.name: cooperating_firm_license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code in which the cooperating broker firm holds its primary real estate brokerage license (e.g., CA, NY, TX).
attributes.references: State Real Estate Licensing Authorities; NAR

attributes.name: cooperating_firm_name
attributes.description: Legal registered name of the cooperating (co-broker) brokerage firm participating in this arrangement. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and verified against state licensing records.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Licensing Authorities

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this co-brokerage agreement record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX and GDPR.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: designated_agent_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the designated cooperating agent, used for deal communications, DocuSign CLM routing, and Salesforce CRM contact management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: designated_agent_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued individual real estate salesperson or broker license number for the designated cooperating agent. Required for commission payment and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Licensing Authorities; NAR

attributes.name: designated_agent_license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code in which the designated cooperating agent holds their individual real estate license.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Licensing Authorities; NAR

attributes.name: designated_agent_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual real estate agent designated by the cooperating broker firm to represent the co-broker side of this transaction.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); GDPR Article 4; State Real Estate Licensing Authorities

attributes.name: designated_agent_phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the designated cooperating agent for deal coordination and showing scheduling.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Contractually agreed method for resolving disputes arising from this co-brokerage arrangement, as specified in the agreement terms.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) Code of Ethics; American Arbitration Association

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: Unique envelope identifier from DocuSign CLM for the digitally executed co-brokerage agreement, enabling retrieval of the signed document and audit trail of signature events.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ESIGN Act; UETA

attributes.name: dual_agency_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether all parties have provided informed written consent to dual agency representation where the cooperating broker or designated agent may represent both sides of the transaction.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) Code of Ethics; State Real Estate Licensing Authorities

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the co-brokerage agreement becomes operative and the cooperating broker is authorized to act. May differ from execution date if a future start is stipulated.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the co-brokerage agreement was formally executed and signed by all parties, establishing the binding effective date of cooperation.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the co-brokerage agreement expires if no transaction closes. Nullable for open-ended arrangements tied solely to deal close.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: last_amended_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal amendment to this co-brokerage agreement. Nullable when no amendments have been executed.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: mls_cooperation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this co-brokerage arrangement is governed by MLS cooperation rules and the cooperating broker was procured through MLS. True = MLS cooperation applies; False = off-MLS or private arrangement.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: mls_number
attributes.description: MLS listing number associated with the property or deal covered by this co-brokerage agreement, enabling cross-reference to MLS cooperation records and CoStar Suite data.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional deal-specific terms, special conditions, or operational notes related to the co-brokerage arrangement not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: protection_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after agreement expiration during which the cooperating broker retains commission rights if a transaction closes with a prospect they introduced during the agreement term.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the corresponding deal opportunity record in Salesforce CRM, enabling traceability between the co-brokerage agreement and the deal pipeline stage.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: snda_execution_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Execution Date
attributes.description: Date on which the required SNDA agreement was executed, confirming lender consent to the co-brokerage arrangement. Nullable when SNDA is not required.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: snda_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) agreement is required as a condition of this co-brokerage arrangement, typically applicable in commercial lease transactions.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this co-brokerage agreement record was originated or last updated (e.g., Salesforce CRM, Yardi Voyager, DocuSign CLM).
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the co-brokerage agreement was terminated prior to its natural expiration, if applicable. Nullable for agreements that expire naturally or remain active.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the co-brokerage agreement was terminated before its natural expiration. Nullable for active or naturally expired agreements.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this co-brokerage agreement record in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

products.name: brokerage_broker
products.description: Master record for licensed brokers and agents operating within or on behalf of the brokerage. Captures broker type (principal broker, associate broker, managing broker, leasing agent, buyer's agent, seller's agent), state license number, license expiration date, NAR/CCIM/SIOR membership status, MLS membership ID, designated market areas, production tier (based on GCI thresholds), hire date, employment type (W-2, 1099 independent contractor), team/desk assignment, and commission plan reference. Distinct from the workforce domain's employee record — this is the brokerage-specific professional identity, licensing, and production tracking record. Serves as the SSOT for broker identity referenced by deals, listings, commissions, showings, and prospect assignments.

attributes.name: brokerage_broker_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the broker or agent record within the brokerage platform. Serves as the primary key and SSOT reference for all deal, listing, commission, showing, and prospect assignment records.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission plan record that governs this broker's split structure, Gross Commission Income (GCI) thresholds, and payout tiers. Drives commission calculation for all closed transactions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; MRI Software

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Broker GCI (gross commission income) tracking and compensation reporting require standardized currency classification for multi-market broker performance analytics and payroll processing. currency_cod
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding workforce domain employee record in ADP Workforce Now or SAP S/4HANA HCM. Links the brokerage-specific professional identity to the HR master record. Distinct from broker_id — this is the HR system identifier.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA HCM

attributes.name: additional_license_states
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional US state codes where the broker holds active real estate licenses beyond the primary license state. Supports multi-state brokerage operations and deal eligibility validation.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Commission; NAR

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent background check was completed for the broker. Used to determine recency of compliance verification and schedule periodic re-checks per brokerage policy.
attributes.references: NAR; State Real Estate Commission

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the broker's most recent background check conducted as part of onboarding or periodic compliance review. Required for NAR membership, state licensing, and brokerage risk management.
attributes.references: NAR; State Real Estate Commission; HUD

attributes.name: broker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the broker's role and authority level within the brokerage. Determines supervisory responsibilities, permissible transaction types, and commission split eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: principal_broker|managing_broker|associate_broker|leasing_agent|buyers_agent|sellers_agent — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAR; State Real Estate Commission Licensing Standards

attributes.name: ccim_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker holds the CCIM designation from the CCIM Institute, signifying advanced expertise in commercial and investment real estate. Used for deal team assembly and marketing credentials.
attributes.references: CCIM Institute; NAR

attributes.name: continuing_education_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the broker must complete state-mandated continuing education (CE) credits to maintain their real estate license. Used to trigger CE completion reminders and license renewal workflows.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Commission; NAR

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours_completed
attributes.description: Number of continuing education (CE) credit hours completed by the broker in the current license renewal cycle. Tracked against state-mandated CE requirements for license renewal compliance.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Commission; NAR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the broker record was first created in the brokerage data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance for the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: designated_market_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic market area codes or names that the broker is authorized and expected to serve. Used for lead routing, listing assignment, and market coverage gap analysis in CoStar Suite.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; NAR; RESO

attributes.name: dual_agency_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker is authorized to act as a dual agent (representing both buyer/tenant and seller/landlord in the same transaction) per state law and brokerage policy. Drives compliance checks on deal assignments.
attributes.references: NAR Code of Ethics; State Real Estate Commission; RESO

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the broker. Used for Salesforce CRM deal assignments, MLS communications, DocuSign CLM contract routing, and internal brokerage notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; NAR Code of Ethics

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the broker's employment relationship with the brokerage. Determines payroll processing method (W-2 via ADP vs. 1099 independent contractor), benefits eligibility, and commission payout structure.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; ADP Workforce Now; SOX

attributes.name: errors_omissions_expiration_date

attributes.description: Expiration date of the broker's E&O insurance policy. Used to trigger renewal alerts and enforce compliance gates before deal assignment or listing agreement execution.

attributes.name: errors_omissions_insurer
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability coverage for the broker. Required for brokerage compliance and risk management. Tracked for policy renewal monitoring.
attributes.references: NAR; State Real Estate Commission; OSHA

attributes.name: errors_omissions_policy_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Insurance Policy Number
attributes.description: Policy number for the broker's Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance. Required for compliance verification, co-broker agreements, and listing agreement execution.

attributes.name: full_name

attributes.name: gci_prior_year

attributes.name: gci_ytd
attributes.description: Total Gross Commission Income (GCI) earned by the broker in the current calendar or fiscal year to date. Used for production tier evaluation, commission plan threshold tracking, and annual performance reporting. Sourced from closed transaction records.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the broker was formally engaged by the brokerage, either as a W-2 employee or 1099 independent contractor. Used for tenure calculations, production tier eligibility, and commission plan assignment.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker is currently active and eligible to be assigned to deals, listings, showings, and prospect records. Set to false upon termination, license suspension, or voluntary leave.
attributes.references: NAR; Salesforce CRM; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker's state real estate license expires. Used to trigger renewal workflows, compliance alerts, and eligibility checks before deal assignment or listing execution.

attributes.name: license_number

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction that issued the broker's real estate license. Determines the governing state real estate commission and applicable transaction law.

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current status of the broker's state-issued real estate license. Drives eligibility to execute listings, represent clients, and receive commission. Monitored for compliance with state real estate commission requirements.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Commission; NAR; RESO

attributes.name: mls_board_name
attributes.description: Name of the MLS board or association through which the broker holds membership. Determines listing syndication scope, co-broker cooperation rules, and MLS data feed access.

attributes.name: mls_member_number

attributes.name: nar_member_number

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Name or code of the brokerage office or branch to which the broker is physically assigned. Used for geographic market coverage reporting, desk assignment, and regional production analytics.

attributes.name: phone

attributes.name: production_tier

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
