attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: errors_omissions_insured
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds active Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance coverage. E&O insurance is required by many brokerages and some states as a condition of active licensure. Supports risk management and brokerage compliance.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: errors_omissions_policy_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Insurance Policy Number
attributes.description: Policy number of the agent's active Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance. Used for claims processing, brokerage risk management, and regulatory compliance verification.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the license expires and must be renewed to remain valid. Licenses operating past this date without renewal are flagged as expired and the agent is prohibited from conducting brokerage activity. Drives automated renewal alerts.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the license was originally issued by the regulatory authority. Used to calculate license tenure, renewal cycles, and continuing education (CE) compliance windows.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Full name of the state real estate commission or regulatory body that issued the license (e.g., California Department of Real Estate, New York Department of State Division of Licensing Services). Supports regulatory correspondence and audit trails.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction that issued this license (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Brokers operating across state lines hold separate licenses per jurisdiction. Used for multi-state compliance tracking and deal assignment validation.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: license_class
attributes.description: Indicates whether the license authorizes residential brokerage, commercial real estate (CRE) brokerage, or both. Determines which transaction types and listings the agent is authorized to handle under this license.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: license_endorsements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specialty endorsements or designations attached to this license (e.g., ABR — Accredited Buyer's Representative, CRS — Certified Residential Specialist, CCIM — Certified Commercial Investment Member, SIOR). Supports agent capability matching for deal assignments.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: license_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers or brokerage administrators to record additional context about this license record, such as pending reinstatement conditions, special restrictions, or correspondence with the state commission.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The official license number assigned by the issuing state or regulatory authority. Used for NAR compliance verification, MLS access, and co-broker arrangement validation. Corresponds to the license number tracked in Salesforce CRM brokerage activity records.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the license as reported by the issuing authority. Active licenses are required for brokerage activity. Suspended or revoked licenses trigger compliance flags and must be reported to NAR and state commissions.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Classification of the license held by the agent or broker, indicating their level of authority and responsibility. Salesperson licenses require broker supervision; broker and managing broker licenses allow independent practice and supervision of others.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: license_verification_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the license status was verified against the issuing state commission's public license lookup or ARELLO (Association of Real Estate License Law Officials) database. Supports ongoing compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Association of Real Estate License Law Officials (ARELLO)

attributes.name: license_verification_source
attributes.description: The source used to verify the license status during the most recent verification. State portal refers to the issuing state's online license lookup; ARELLO is the national license law officials database; manual indicates staff-verified; third_party indicates a vendor verification service.
attributes.references: Association of Real Estate License Law Officials (ARELLO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: mls_member_number
attributes.description: The agent's membership identifier with the local Multiple Listing Service (MLS) board. Required for MLS listing access and syndication. May differ from NAR member ID. Supports MLS compliance and listing authorization validation.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: nar_member_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Realtors (NAR) Member ID
attributes.description: The agent's membership identifier with the National Association of Realtors (NAR). Required for MLS access and use of the REALTOR® designation. Null if the agent is not a NAR member.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: original_issue_date
attributes.description: The date the license was first ever issued to this agent in this jurisdiction, regardless of subsequent renewals. Distinct from issue_date which reflects the current license term start. Used to calculate total years licensed in a state for seniority and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: primary_practice_state
attributes.description: Indicates whether this license record represents the agent's primary state of practice. An agent holding licenses in multiple states will have exactly one record with this flag set to True. Used for reporting, commission calculations, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: reciprocal_home_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the agent's primary licensing state from which reciprocity was granted. Populated only when reciprocal_license is True. Required for multi-state compliance tracking.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: reciprocal_license
attributes.description: Indicates whether this license was obtained through a reciprocity agreement between states, rather than by passing the full state licensing examination. Reciprocal licenses may carry additional restrictions in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the license was most recently renewed by the issuing authority. Null if the license has never been renewed (original issuance still active). Supports renewal cycle tracking and CE compliance verification.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the license renewal process. Tracks whether a renewal application has been initiated, submitted to the state commission, approved, or lapsed due to non-action before the expiration date.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: salesforce_contact_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the corresponding agent or broker contact record in Salesforce CRM. Enables cross-system traceability between the broker license compliance record and the CRM brokerage activity tracking profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Brokerage Activity Tracking)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this license record was sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Salesforce CRM, Yardi Voyager, and manual compliance entry workflows.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: sponsoring_broker_license_number
attributes.description: The official license number of the sponsoring broker or brokerage firm. Used to validate the sponsorship relationship with the state commission and to cross-reference brokerage firm licensing records.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: sponsoring_broker_name
attributes.description: The name of the licensed broker or brokerage firm under whose sponsorship this salesperson or associate broker license is held. Required for salesperson-level licenses in most states. Null for independent broker licenses.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this broker license record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: yardi_agent_code
attributes.description: The agent or broker code as recorded in Yardi Voyager, used to link license compliance data to lease administration, commission processing, and accounts receivable records within the property management system.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager (Lease Administration; Accounts Receivable)

products.name: mls_syndication
products.description: Tracks the syndication status of each listing to external platforms including MLS (via RETS/RESO Web API), CoStar, LoopNet, Zillow, Realtor.com, CREXi, and other listing portals. Captures target platform, syndication status (active, pending, failed, withdrawn, suppressed), external listing ID on the target platform, syndication date, last refresh timestamp, data feed type (IDX, VOW, RETS), RESO Data Dictionary compliance flag, and any platform-specific validation errors. Sourced from CoStar Suite and MLS data feeds. Supports multi-channel listing distribution management and ensures RESO/IDX compliance across syndication targets.
products.reference: MLS Listing Syndication / CoStar Listing Feed

attributes.name: mls_syndication_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each MLS syndication record tracking the distribution of a listing to a specific external platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: brokerage_broker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed agent or broker responsible for managing the syndication of this listing to the target platform.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: MLS syndication is authorized and funded as part of a specific marketing campaign. Linking mls_syndication to campaign enables campaign spend attribution for syndication costs and tracks which campaig
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.channel. Business justification: MLS syndication is a specific marketing channel (MLS/IDX). Linking mls_syndication to marketing.channel enables unified channel performance reporting across all syndication and paid channels — standar
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_mls_listing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal listing record being syndicated to the external platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: costar_property_code
attributes.description: The CoStar Suite-assigned property identifier for the listing, used for cross-referencing syndication records with CoStar market data and comparable analytics.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this syndication record was first created in the system, providing an audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the listing price transmitted to the target platform (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: data_feed_type
attributes.description: The technical protocol or feed standard used to transmit listing data to the target platform. IDX (Internet Data Exchange) is used for consumer-facing websites; VOW (Virtual Office Website) for registered users; RETS (Real Estate Transaction Standard) for legacy feeds; RESO Web API for modern REST-based feeds; DIRECT for proprietary platform integrations.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) IDX Policy

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the syndication of this listing to the target platform is scheduled to expire or be automatically withdrawn, aligned with the listing agreement expiration.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: floor_plan_synced
attributes.description: Indicates whether a floor plan document or image was included in the syndication payload transmitted to the target platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: http_response_code
attributes.description: The HTTP status code returned by the target platform's API upon the most recent syndication transmission attempt (e.g., 200 for success, 400 for bad request, 500 for server error). Applicable for API-based transmissions.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Web API Specification; IETF RFC 7231

attributes.name: idx_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing owner or agent has opted in to IDX distribution, permitting the listing to be displayed on participating broker and agent websites via the IDX feed.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) IDX Policy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: is_featured_listing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing has been designated as a featured or premium placement on the target platform, typically associated with an additional marketing spend or platform subscription tier.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: is_reso_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the syndicated listing payload conforms to the RESO Data Dictionary standard, ensuring field-level interoperability across MLS platforms and portals.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary v2.0

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: The most recent date and timestamp when the listing data was refreshed or re-transmitted to the target platform to ensure data currency and accuracy.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Web API Specification

attributes.name: listing_price_synced
attributes.description: The listing price transmitted to the target platform at the time of syndication or last refresh. May differ from the current internal listing price if a refresh has not yet occurred, enabling price discrepancy detection.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: mls_board_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the specific MLS board or association through which the listing is syndicated (e.g., CRMLS, NWMLS, MRED). Applicable when target_platform is 'MLS'.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: next_scheduled_refresh
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when the next automated data refresh is scheduled to be transmitted to the target platform, based on the platform's refresh frequency requirements.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Web API Specification; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: open_house_synced
attributes.description: Indicates whether open house schedule data was included in the syndication payload transmitted to the target platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: photos_synced_count
attributes.description: The number of listing photos successfully transmitted to the target platform during the most recent syndication or refresh cycle. Used to verify media completeness on the external platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: platform_account_code
attributes.description: The brokerage or agent account identifier registered with the target syndication platform, used to attribute the listing to the correct account for billing and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: platform_listing_url
attributes.description: The publicly accessible URL of the listing on the target external platform, used for marketing, deep-linking, and performance tracking.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: platform_subscription_tier
attributes.description: The subscription or membership tier held with the target platform that governs listing visibility, feature access, and syndication limits (e.g., basic, standard, premium, enterprise).
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: reso_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary Version
attributes.description: The version of the RESO Data Dictionary standard used when constructing the syndication payload (e.g., 1.7, 2.0). Ensures compatibility tracking as standards evolve.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the syndication submission has been retried following a failed or pending transmission to the target platform. Used to identify chronic failures requiring manual intervention.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Web API Specification

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the syndication record and listing data originate (e.g., CoStar Suite, MLS data feed, Salesforce CRM). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The business reason why a listing has been suppressed from syndication to the target platform. Applicable only when syndication_status is 'suppressed'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner_request|compliance_hold|duplicate_listing|platform_policy|legal_hold|expired|do_not_market — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: syndication_authorized_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or role who authorized the syndication of this listing to the target platform, supporting audit and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: syndication_authorized_date
attributes.description: The date on which syndication of this listing to the target platform was formally authorized by the responsible agent, broker, or owner.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: syndication_channel
attributes.description: The property market channel under which the listing is syndicated to the target platform, determining which section or category of the platform the listing appears in.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: syndication_date
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when the listing was first successfully submitted and accepted by the target external platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: syndication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the syndication record on the target platform. Active indicates the listing is live; pending indicates submission in progress; failed indicates a transmission or validation error; withdrawn indicates the listing was removed; suppressed indicates intentionally excluded from the platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: target_platform
attributes.description: The external listing portal or platform to which this listing is being syndicated (e.g., MLS, CoStar, LoopNet, Zillow, Realtor.com, CREXi). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MLS|CoStar|LoopNet|Zillow|Realtor.com|CREXi|Homes.com|CommercialSearch|PropertyShark — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: transmission_method
attributes.description: The technical delivery method used to transmit the listing data to the target platform (e.g., REST API, SFTP file drop, manual upload). Supports operational troubleshooting and feed management.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Web API Specification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this syndication record was most recently modified, supporting change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: validation_error_code
attributes.description: Platform-specific error code returned by the target platform when the syndication submission fails validation (e.g., missing required field, invalid format, duplicate listing). Null when syndication is successful.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Web API Specification; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: validation_error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the validation error returned by the target platform upon failed syndication submission. Provides actionable detail for remediation by the listing coordinator.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Web API Specification

attributes.name: virtual_tour_synced
attributes.description: Indicates whether a virtual tour URL or media asset was included in the syndication payload transmitted to the target platform.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: vow_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing owner or agent has opted in to VOW distribution, permitting the listing to be displayed on Virtual Office Websites accessible to registered users.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) VOW Policy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when the listing was withdrawn or removed from the target external platform. Applicable when syndication_status is 'withdrawn'.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

products.name: referral

Captures referral direction (inbound, outbound), referring party name and firm, referred prospect or deal, referral fee percentage or flat amount, referral agreement date, referral status (pending, active, closed, paid), and deal outcome. Supports referral fee tracking and network relationship management.

attributes.name: brokerage_deal_id

attributes.description: Final closed transaction value (sale price or total lease value) of the referred deal upon closing, used for accurate fee calculation.

attributes.name: fee_amount

attributes.name: fee_flat_amount

attributes.name: fee_paid_date
attributes.description: Date on which the referral fee was disbursed to the referring party or received from the receiving party, confirming payment completion.

attributes.name: fee_pct
attributes.description: Referral fee expressed as a percentage of the gross commission income (GCI) earned on the referred deal. Applicable when fee_structure is 'percentage'. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%).

attributes.name: fee_structure

attributes.name: gross_commission_income
attributes.description: Total gross commission income (GCI) earned by the brokerage on the referred deal, from which the referral fee is calculated.

attributes.name: is_reciprocal

attributes.name: payment_direction

attributes.name: referral_number

attributes.name: referral_status

attributes.name: referral_type

products.name: broker_program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between licensed brokers and enterprise compliance programs. It captures the operational reality that brokers must participate in multiple mandatory compliance programs (Fair Housing, AML, Continuing Education, E&O Insurance) and each program covers many brokers across the brokerage. Each record links one broker to one compliance program with enrollment-specific attributes including enrollment date, completion status, compliance score, renewal tracking, and assigned role within the program. This is an actively managed operational entity — compliance officers create enrollments, track completion, monitor scores, and manage renewals as part of regulatory obligation management.. Existence Justification: In real estate brokerage operations, licensed brokers must participate in multiple mandatory compliance programs simultaneously (Fair Housing training, Anti-Money Laundering certification, Continuing Education requirements, Errors & Omissions insurance compliance, state-specific regulatory programs). Each compliance program covers many brokers across the brokerage organization. Compliance officers actively manage these enrollments as operational records — they enroll brokers in programs, track completion status, monitor compliance scores, manage renewal deadlines, and assign program-specific roles. This is not an analytical correlation derived from transactional data; it is an operational business entity that humans create, update, and query as part of regulatory obligation management.

attributes.description: Total training hours completed by this broker for this specific compliance program. Supports programs with hour-based completion requirements (e.g., Continuing Education programs requiring 15 hours annually).

products.name: deal_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance obligation tracking between brokerage deals and regulatory requirements. It captures the per-deal compliance status, evidence submission, responsible party assignment, and waiver management for each requirement that must be satisfied before deal close. Each record links one deal to one compliance requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific deal-requirement relationship.. Existence Justification: In commercial real estate brokerage operations, each deal must satisfy multiple compliance requirements (environmental disclosure, ADA certification, zoning confirmation, FIRPTA, transfer tax documentation) before closing, and each compliance requirement applies to many deals across the portfolio. The business actively manages per-deal compliance tracking as a critical deal-closing workflow, with brokers and transaction coordinators monitoring status, assigning responsible parties, collecting evidence, and managing waivers for each deal-requirement combination.

attributes.name: deal_compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each deal-compliance requirement association record

attributes.name: brokerage_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the brokerage deal record
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance requirement record
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compliance requirement was assigned to the deal (typically when deal reaches a stage where compliance tracking begins)

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compliance requirement was satisfied or marked complete for this deal

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of this compliance requirement for this specific deal. Tracks progression from identification through satisfaction or waiver.

attributes.name: cost_incurred
attributes.description: Dollar amount of costs incurred to satisfy this compliance requirement for this deal (inspection fees, certification costs, legal review fees)

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Deal-specific due date by which this compliance requirement must be satisfied, typically calculated relative to projected_close_date or deal stage transitions

attributes.name: evidence_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which compliance evidence was submitted for this deal-requirement combination

attributes.name: evidence_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation or evidence of compliance has been submitted for review for this deal-requirement combination

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing deal-specific compliance considerations, issues encountered, or resolution details for this requirement

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role assigned to ensure this compliance requirement is satisfied for this deal (may be broker, transaction coordinator, legal counsel, or third-party consultant)

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authority who approved the compliance waiver for this deal

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance waiver was granted for this deal-requirement combination

attributes.name: waiver_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a waiver or exception has been granted for this compliance requirement for this specific deal

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale or legal basis for granting a waiver for this compliance requirement on this deal

products.name: listing_disclosure
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between property listings and regulatory disclosure requirements. It captures the fulfillment status of each mandatory disclosure requirement for each listing, tracking completion dates, responsible parties, evidence documentation, and any waivers or exceptions. Each record links one listing to one compliance requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific listing-requirement pairing.. Existence Justification: In real estate brokerage operations, each property listing must satisfy multiple mandatory disclosure requirements that vary by jurisdiction, property type, and transaction type (e.g., lead paint disclosure for pre-1978 residential, environmental hazard disclosure for commercial, agency disclosure for all, fair housing posting requirements). Conversely, each compliance requirement applies to many listings across the portfolio. Brokerages actively manage per-listing disclosure completion, tracking status, completion dates, responsible parties, and evidence documentation for each listing-requirement pairing as part of the listing lifecycle and transaction closing process.

attributes.name: listing_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each listing-disclosure compliance record

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific regulatory disclosure requirement that applies to this listing
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: listing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the property listing record for which this disclosure requirement must be fulfilled
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: completed_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the broker, agent, or compliance officer who completed or verified this disclosure for this listing. Tracks accountability for disclosure fulfillment at the individual listing-requirement level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this listing-disclosure compliance record was created, typically when the listing became active or when the requirement became applicable

attributes.name: disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date on which this specific disclosure requirement was fulfilled for this listing. Used for compliance audit trails and to calculate days-to-compliance metrics. This date is specific to each listing-requirement combination.

attributes.name: disclosure_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this disclosure requirement for this specific listing. Tracks whether the disclosure has been completed, is pending, has been waived, or is overdue. This status is specific to the listing-requirement pairing and cannot exist on either entity alone.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Calculated or assigned due date by which this disclosure must be completed for this listing, based on listing start date, jurisdiction requirements, and deal stage. This date is specific to each listing-requirement pairing.

attributes.name: evidence_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the documentation, form, certificate, or system record that evidences completion of this disclosure requirement for this listing (e.g., document management system URI, form number, certificate ID). This evidence is specific to each listing-requirement pairing.

attributes.name: reminder_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which a compliance reminder or notification was sent to the responsible party for this specific listing-disclosure combination. Used to track proactive compliance management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this listing-disclosure compliance record

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why this disclosure requirement was waived or marked not applicable for this specific listing (e.g., property built after 1978 exempt from lead paint disclosure, commercial property exempt from residential fair housing posting). This reason is contextual to the listing-requirement combination.

products.name: broker_commission
products.description: This association product represents the commission assignment between a property sale transaction and a broker. It captures the specific role, representation side, and commission economics for each broker involved in a property sale transaction. Each record links one property_sale to one broker with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific transaction participation.. Existence Justification: In real estate transactions, a single property sale involves multiple brokers in different roles (listing broker, buyer's broker, co-brokers, referral brokers), and each broker participates in many property sales throughout their career. The business actively manages broker commission assignments as operational records, tracking each broker's specific role, representation type, commission split percentage, and payment status for each transaction. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where commission assignments are created, approved, and paid as distinct business events.

attributes.name: broker_commission_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the broker_commission association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: brokerage_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broker or agent record
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: property_sale_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the property sale transaction record
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this broker was formally assigned to or engaged in this property sale transaction. Used for tracking broker involvement timeline and commission eligibility.

attributes.name: brokerage_side
attributes.description: The role or side of the transaction that this broker represents. Determines commission source and fiduciary duty. Values: listing_broker, buyers_broker, co_listing_broker, co_buyers_broker, referral_broker, dual_agent.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of commission earned by this broker for this specific property sale transaction. Calculated as (total_commission * commission_split_pct) and used for broker compensation and production tracking.

attributes.name: commission_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the commission amount was paid to this broker for this transaction. Used for broker compensation tracking and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: commission_split_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the total transaction commission allocated to this specific broker. Used to calculate individual broker compensation. Sum of all splits for a transaction should equal 100%.

attributes.name: commission_status
attributes.description: Current status of the commission payment for this broker on this transaction. Drives commission payment workflow and broker compensation reporting. Values: pending, approved, paid, disputed, cancelled.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The state real estate license number under which this broker operated for this specific transaction. Captured at transaction time for regulatory compliance and audit trail, as license numbers can change over time.

attributes.name: representation_type
attributes.description: The type of representation agreement under which this broker participated in the transaction. Affects commission structure and legal obligations. Values: exclusive, non_exclusive, dual, referral.

products.name: broker_market_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the territory assignment between broker and geographic_hierarchy. It captures the formal designation of which geographic markets a broker is authorized and assigned to cover for lead routing, listing assignments, and production tracking. Each record links one broker to one geographic market node with attributes that define the nature and period of that market coverage assignment.. Existence Justification: In real estate brokerage operations, brokers are assigned to cover multiple geographic markets (MSAs, submarkets, cities, zip codes) simultaneously for lead routing and territory management, and each market has multiple brokers assigned with different coverage roles (primary, secondary, backup). The brokerage actively manages these territory assignments as operational records with effective dates, designation types, and coverage status to drive lead distribution and production reporting by market.

attributes.name: broker_market_coverage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this broker-to-market coverage assignment record

attributes.name: brokerage_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broker record who is assigned coverage for this geographic market
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: geographic_hierarchy_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Broker Market Coverage - Geographic Hierarchy Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the geographic hierarchy node (market, submarket, MSA, city, or zip) that this broker is assigned to cover
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the rationale for this market assignment, any special conditions, or coordination requirements with other brokers covering the same market.

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this market coverage assignment: active (broker is currently covering this market), inactive (assignment ended), suspended (temporarily paused), pending (scheduled future assignment). Drives real-time lead routing logic.

attributes.name: designation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the brokers coverage role for this market: primary (main territory), secondary (overflow support), backup (coverage during absence), or specialty (specific property type focus within market). Drives lead routing priority and commission plan applicability.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this market coverage assignment became active. Used for historical territory analysis and commission dispute resolution when leads were assigned during transition periods.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this market coverage assignment ended or is scheduled to end. Null for currently active assignments. Used to track broker territory changes over time and ensure leads are not routed to brokers no longer covering a market.

attributes.name: is_primary_market
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this geographic market is the brokers primary territory for production reporting and quota assignment. Each broker typically has one primary market but may have multiple secondary market assignments.

products.name: commission_plan
products.description: Master reference table for commission_plan. Referenced by commission_plan_id.

attributes.name: co_broker_split_rate

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the commission plan including key features, benefits, and terms.

attributes.name: desk_fee

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria

attributes.name: minimum_commission_amount

attributes.name: mls_syndication_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether listings under this commission plan are eligible for syndication to MLS and other listing platforms.

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: tier_structure

attributes.name: transaction_fee

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: created_by

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Enterprise financial backbone covering GL, AP, AR, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting as sourced from Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA. Owns cost centers, chart of accounts, NOI statements, EGI/PGI/GOI calculations, EBITDA roll-ups, DSCR calculations, cash management, financial consolidation, and SOX-compliant financial controls. Authoritative source for all property-level and portfolio-level P&L data.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master registry of cost centers used for financial allocation and reporting across the real estate portfolio. Each cost center maps to a property, department, or business unit and serves as the foundational dimension for GL posting, NOI statements, and OPEX/CAPEX tracking. Attributes include cost center code, name, type (property-level, corporate, departmental), responsible manager, active status, effective dates, hierarchy parent, and functional currency.
products.reference: Cost Center — SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA / Yardi Voyager Entity

attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Master; MRI Software Property Accounting; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: currency_code_id

Domain experts expect cost centers to refe

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Hierarchy; Yardi Voyager GL Hierarchy; FASB ASC 280

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate costs from this cost center to other cost centers or properties. 'direct' = direct charge; 'percentage' = fixed percentage split; 'square_footage' = allocated by GLA/NLA; 'headcount' = allocated by employee count; 'none' = no allocation (standalone center).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Assessment/Distribution Cycles; Yardi Voyager CAM Reconciliation; GAAP Cost Allocation

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Fixed percentage used when allocation_method is 'percentage'. Represents the share of this cost center's costs to be allocated to downstream cost centers or properties. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget for this cost center in the functional currency. Represents the planned OPEX and/or CAPEX for the fiscal year as approved in Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA budgeting module. Used for variance analysis and NOI forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting and Forecasting; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management; FASB ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Real estate asset class associated with this cost center when center_type is 'property'. Enables asset-class-level financial benchmarking, CAP rate analysis, and portfolio segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: office|retail|industrial|multifamily|mixed_use|land|hotel|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Suite Property Classification; NAR Property Type Standards; Argus Enterprise Asset Classification

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division to which this cost center is assigned (e.g., Commercial Real Estate, Residential, Development, Investment Advisory). Supports segment-level P&L reporting and portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure; FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: cam_pool_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is designated as a Common Area Maintenance (CAM) expense pool. When True, costs accumulated here are subject to CAM reconciliation and tenant recovery billing per lease agreements.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Reconciliation; FASB ASC 842; BOMA CAM Standards

attributes.name: capex_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) postings are permitted against this cost center. Controls GL posting rules to ensure proper OPEX vs. CAPEX segregation for fixed asset accounting and financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by its organizational scope. 'property' = property-level cost center tied to a specific asset; 'corporate' = enterprise-wide overhead; 'departmental' = functional department (e.g., Finance, HR); 'development' = active construction or development project; 'investment' = investment vehicle or fund-level tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Category; Yardi Voyager Property Accounting; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA or Yardi Voyager company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit to which this cost center belongs. Used for financial consolidation, statutory reporting, and SOX-compliant entity-level controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Configuration; Yardi Voyager Entity Setup; SOX Section 302/404; SEC Reporting

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA controlling area code that governs the management accounting rules, currency, and fiscal year variant applicable to this cost center. Defines the scope of internal cost accounting and allocation cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Module; SAP Cost Center Accounting (CCA)

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Financial category indicating the primary nature of expenditures tracked by this cost center. 'opex' = Operating Expenditure (OPEX) only; 'capex' = Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) only; 'mixed' = both OPEX and CAPEX; 'overhead' = corporate overhead allocation; 'revenue' = revenue-generating center for NOI tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Category; Yardi Voyager OPEX/CAPEX Classification; GAAP

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cost center within the chart of accounts and GL posting structure. Used in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA for financial allocation, NOI statements, and OPEX/CAPEX tracking. Serves as the business-facing identifier across all financial systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Master; Yardi Voyager GL; FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the cost center's business purpose, scope of financial activities, and any special accounting treatment or allocation rules. Used for financial reporting documentation and audit support.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Master; Yardi Voyager GL Module; SOX Section 302 Documentation

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center as displayed in financial reports, NOI statements, and budget documents. Examples: 'Downtown Office Tower — Property Operations', 'Corporate Finance Department', 'Residential Portfolio — Leasing'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Master; Yardi Voyager GL Module

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. 'active' = open for GL postings; 'inactive' = temporarily suspended; 'pending' = awaiting activation; 'closed' = permanently decommissioned; 'locked' = frozen for period-end close or audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Lifecycle; Yardi Voyager GL; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where this cost center operates. Governs applicable tax regulations, statutory reporting requirements, and currency rules.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FASB ASC 830; IFRS 16; SEC Reporting; GDPR (for EU jurisdictions)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports SOX-compliant audit trails and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55000 Asset Management; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the functional department associated with this cost center (e.g., Finance, Property Management, Leasing, Development). Used for departmental OPEX allocation and headcount cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Management; ADP Workforce Now Department Structure

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Validity Period; FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: Date on which the cost center ceases to be active. Null indicates an open-ended cost center with no planned closure. Used for period-accurate financial reporting and historical GL analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Validity Period; FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: esg_tracking_enabled

attributes.description: Indicates whether Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) cost tracking is enabled for this cost center. When True, OPEX related to LEED certification, BREEAM compliance, energy efficiency, and sustainability initiatives are tracked separately.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the cost center's budget and financial plan are defined. Enables year-over-year budget comparison and period-accurate financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; Yardi Voyager Fiscal Calendar; FASB ASC 270

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Code identifying the fiscal year variant (calendar year, April–March, October–September, etc.) applicable to this cost center. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA controlling area configuration. Ensures correct period mapping for financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant Configuration; FASB ASC 270 Interim Reporting

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: The GL account group or chart of accounts segment to which this cost center belongs. Governs which GL accounts are permissible for posting against this cost center. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA chart of accounts configuration and Yardi Voyager GL setup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Yardi Voyager GL; FASB ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: hierarchy_level

attributes.name: hierarchy_path

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: noi_tracking_enabled

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: responsible_manager
attributes.description: Full name of the manager or cost center owner accountable for financial performance, budget adherence, and OPEX/CAPEX approvals for this cost center. Used in SOX-compliant approval workflows and financial reporting sign-offs.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the entity as it appears on formation documents, tax filings, and regulatory submissions (e.g., 'Acme Properties LLC', 'Acme REIT I, L.P.'). Must match state/jurisdiction registration records.
attributes.references: SEC EDGAR; IRS EIN Registration; State Secretary of State Filing

attributes.name: mri_entity_code
attributes.description: Entity identifier assigned in MRI Software for investment management and property accounting. Enables cross-system reconciliation between MRI and SAP/Yardi financial records.

attributes.name: nav_usd
attributes.description: Net Asset Value of the entity calculated as total assets minus total liabilities, expressed in USD. Primary valuation metric for REIT and fund entities used in investor reporting, unit pricing, and performance benchmarking per INREV/NCREIF guidelines.
attributes.references: INREV NAV Guidelines; NCREIF; FASB ASC 946; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the legal entity owned by the immediate parent entity, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 100.00 for wholly-owned, 50.00 for 50/50 JV). Drives consolidation thresholds and minority interest calculations under FASB ASC 810.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 3A-02

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary contact for the entity. Used for regulatory notifications, audit correspondence, and financial reporting communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact or authorized representative for the entity, typically the CFO, Controller, or Asset Manager responsible for financial reporting and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 Certifying Officer; SEC Exchange Act

attributes.name: property_sector
attributes.description: Primary real estate sector classification for the entity's portfolio focus. Used for REIT sector reporting, NCREIF benchmarking, and investor disclosure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: office|retail|industrial|multifamily|hospitality|mixed_use|land|healthcare|self_storage|data_center — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCREIF Property Index; NAREIT Sector Classification; CoStar Property Type

attributes.name: registered_address_city
attributes.description: City of the entity's official registered address. Required for state tax filings, regulatory submissions, and legal service of process.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; IRS EIN Registration

attributes.name: registered_address_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the entity's official registered address. Distinguishes domestic US entities from foreign subsidiaries requiring FBAR and FATCA reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IRS FATCA; FinCEN FBAR

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the entity's official registered address as filed with the state Secretary of State and IRS. Used for legal notices, regulatory correspondence, and title company communications.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; IRS EIN Registration; ALTA

attributes.name: registered_address_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the entity's official registered address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination and regulatory correspondence routing.
attributes.references: USPS; IRS EIN Registration

attributes.name: registered_address_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the entity's official registered address. May differ from the formation jurisdiction for entities with a registered agent in a different state.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: registered_agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity's designated registered agent responsible for receiving legal service of process, state notices, and annual report reminders on behalf of the entity.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; Uniform Business Organizations Code

attributes.name: reporting_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for consolidated financial reporting at the enterprise or fund level. May differ from functional currency for foreign subsidiaries requiring translation under ASC 830.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IFRS 16; ISO 4217

attributes.name: state_registration_number
attributes.description: State-issued entity registration or charter number assigned by the Secretary of State in the jurisdiction of formation. Used for state tax filings, good-standing certificates, and title searches.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; ALTA Title Standards

attributes.name: state_tax_nexus
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of two-letter US state codes where the entity has established tax nexus through property ownership, operations, or employee presence. Drives multi-state apportionment and state tax filing obligations.
attributes.references: State Uniform Division of Income for Tax Purposes Act (UDITPA); FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: IRS federal tax classification of the entity for income tax purposes. Determines the applicable tax return form (1120-REIT, 1065, Schedule C) and pass-through treatment for investors.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8832; IRC Section 856; IRS Check-the-Box Regulations

attributes.name: tax_year_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which the entity's tax year ends, which may differ from the fiscal year end for certain partnership structures. Drives K-1 issuance timing and estimated tax payment schedules.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 538; IRC Section 441

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) name used in commercial transactions, marketing, and tenant-facing communications when different from the registered legal name.
attributes.references: State DBA Registration; NAR Business Practices

attributes.name: yardi_entity_code
attributes.description: Entity identifier assigned in Yardi Voyager property management and accounting system. Used to link this legal entity master record to Yardi GL, AR, AP, and lease administration data.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Entity Setup; Yardi GL Module

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core GL transactional record capturing all financial postings across the real estate portfolio with embedded debit/credit line items. Each entry is a balanced posting event with line-level detail mapped to GL accounts, cost centers, and properties. Supports property-level P&L, NOI statements, CAM allocations, EBITDA roll-ups, and SOX audit trails. Sourced from Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA. Attributes include journal entry number, posting date, period, document type, source system, approval status, reversal flag, and per-line: debit/credit indicator, amount, functional currency amount, GL account, cost center, property reference, profit center, segment, tax code, and line description.
products.reference: Journal Entry — SAP S/4HANA FI-GL / Yardi Voyager GL Journal

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment fund or Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) vehicle to which this journal entry is attributed. Supports fund-level financial reporting, Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations, and investor distribution tracking.

attributes.name: ledger_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting; Yardi Voyager Profit Center; FASB ASC 280

attributes.name: property_sale_id

attributes.name: reversed_entry_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when is_reversal is True. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking reversal entries to their originating postings for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Reversal Reference; Yardi Voyager Reversal; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business segment (e.g., commercial, residential, industrial, retail) for segment reporting under FASB ASC 280 and SEC disclosure requirements for publicly traded REITs. Supports EBITDA roll-ups by segment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting; SEC REIT Disclosure; SAP S/4HANA Segment

attributes.name: sox_control_id

attributes.name: transaction_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.transaction_type. Business justification: In RE accounting, journal entry document types (acquisition, disposition, lease commencement, CAM reconciliation) map to transaction types that drive GL coding rules, FASB ASC 842 classification, and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the journal entry. Tracks the SOX-compliant approval chain from draft creation through posting. 'posted' indicates the entry has been committed to the GL; 'reversed' indicates a reversal has been executed.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow; Yardi Voyager Approval Workflow; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who approved this journal entry in the SOX-compliant approval workflow. Required for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance. Populated when approval_status is 'approved' or 'posted'.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval; Yardi Voyager Approval; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was approved by the authorized approver. Supports SOX audit trail, segregation of duties verification, and period-end close timeline monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Timestamp; Yardi Voyager Audit Log

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Yardi Voyager Audit Log; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document or business transaction that triggered the journal entry (e.g., invoice date, lease commencement date). May differ from posting date. Maps to SAP BKPF-BLDAT.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA FI Document Date; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable document number assigned by the source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager journal number or SAP document number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail. Maps to SAP BKPF-BELNR or Yardi JE reference number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Numbering; Yardi Voyager GL; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to translate the transaction currency amount to the functional currency amount at the time of posting. Stored with six decimal precision to support accurate multi-currency financial consolidation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Translation; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Exchange Rate

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (month) within the fiscal year to which this journal entry belongs, expressed as a two-digit period number (01–12 for regular periods; 13–16 for special closing periods). Used for period-end close, NOI statements, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; SAP S/4HANA Period Management; Yardi Voyager Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The four-digit fiscal year to which this journal entry belongs. Combined with fiscal_period, uniquely identifies the accounting period for financial reporting, budgeting, and year-end close processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; Yardi Voyager Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: functional_credit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all credit line item amounts translated to the functional currency using the exchange_rate. Used for financial statement preparation, NOI reporting, and EBITDA roll-ups in the entity's reporting currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Parallel Currency; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the functional currency of the legal entity (company code) in which financial statements are prepared. Used for foreign currency translation and consolidation under FASB ASC 830 and IFRS 21.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Parallel Currency

attributes.name: functional_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit line item amounts translated to the functional currency using the exchange_rate. Used for financial statement preparation, NOI reporting, and EBITDA roll-ups in the entity's reporting currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Parallel Currency; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry header level explaining the business purpose or context of the posting (e.g., 'Q3 CAM Reconciliation Accrual', 'Lease Commencement ROU Asset Recognition'). Supports audit trail and business user understanding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Document Header Text; Yardi Voyager Journal Description; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: intercompany_partner_code
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany trading partner entity. Populated when is_intercompany is True. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries during financial consolidation. Maps to SAP BKPF-VBUND.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Partner; SEC REIT Consolidation

attributes.name: is_balanced
attributes.description: Indicates whether the journal entry is balanced (total debits equal total credits). A value of True confirms the entry satisfies double-entry bookkeeping requirements. Unbalanced entries (False) are flagged for correction before posting.
attributes.references: GAAP Double-Entry Bookkeeping; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA GL Validation

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry involves a transaction between two legal entities within the same corporate group (intercompany posting). True entries require elimination during financial consolidation for REIT and group-level reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted entry. True means this entry was created to negate a prior posting (e.g., accrual reversal at period start). Used for period-end close management and audit trail.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; SAP S/4HANA Reversal Document; Yardi Voyager Reversal; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: noi_category
attributes.description: Classification of this journal entry's contribution to the Net Operating Income (NOI) statement. Categorizes postings as revenue (rental income, CAM recoveries), operating expense (property OPEX), capital expenditure (CAPEX), below-NOI items, or non-operating. Drives property-level NOI reporting and CAP Rate analysis.
attributes.references: NCREIF NOI Definition; Yardi Voyager NOI Reporting; Argus Enterprise NOI Model; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the General Ledger (GL). Determines the accounting period in which the transaction is recognized. Distinct from the document date and value date. Maps to SAP BKPF-BUDAT.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code controlling the debit/credit indicator, account type, and field selection for the journal entry posting. Maps to SAP posting key (BSEG-BSCHL). Common values include 40 (GL debit), 50 (GL credit), 01 (customer invoice), 31 (vendor invoice).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Key; Yardi Voyager Posting Rules; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to a related business document such as a lease agreement, invoice, purchase order, or contract. Supports cross-document traceability and audit trail. Maps to SAP BKPF-XBLNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Reference Document; Yardi Voyager Cross-Reference; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which this journal entry is to be reversed. Populated for accrual entries that are set up for automatic reversal at the start of the next accounting period. Supports automated period-end close workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; SAP S/4HANA Planned Reversal; Yardi Voyager Accrual Reversal

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this journal entry. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. Critical for SOX compliance and cross-system financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA Integration; Yardi Voyager API

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native document or transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi batch number, SAP BKPF compound key). Enables direct traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Data Lineage; Yardi Voyager Audit Trail

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax determination code applied to this journal entry, identifying the applicable tax rate and jurisdiction (e.g., sales tax, VAT, property transfer tax). Maps to SAP BKPF-MWSKZ. Used for tax reporting and compliance with local tax authorities.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code; SAP S/4HANA Tax Code; Yardi Voyager Tax Module; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all credit line item amounts in the transaction currency for this journal entry. Must equal total_debit_amount for the entry to be balanced per double-entry bookkeeping principles. Used for entry-level validation and reconciliation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; GAAP Double-Entry Bookkeeping; SAP S/4HANA GL; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit line item amounts in the transaction currency for this journal entry. Must equal total_credit_amount for the entry to be balanced per double-entry bookkeeping principles. Used for entry-level validation and reconciliation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 420; GAAP Double-Entry Bookkeeping; SAP S/4HANA GL; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and SOX audit trail. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Change Log; Yardi Voyager Audit Log; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who created or prepared this journal entry. Supports segregation of duties (preparer vs. approver vs. poster) required under SOX Section 404 internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SAP S/4HANA User Audit; Yardi Voyager User Tracking

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit or credit line items within a journal entry, each mapped to a GL account, cost center, and property. Provides the granular posting detail required for property-level NOI statements, CAM reconciliations, and OPEX/CAPEX allocations. Attributes include line number, debit/credit indicator, amount, functional currency amount, account code, cost center, property reference, profit center, segment, tax code, and line description.
