attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property against which this line item is posted. Enables property-level P&L, NOI statements, CAM reconciliations, and per-property financial reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Module; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account in the chart of accounts to which this line item is posted. Drives property-level NOI statements, OPEX/CAPEX classification, and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; Yardi Voyager Chart of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this line item. Enables departmental and property-level cost allocation, OPEX tracking, and budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA; Yardi Voyager Cost Center Module

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Multi-currency RE portfolio accounting requires JE lines to reference a validated transaction currency for exchange rate lookups, functional currency translation, and multi-currency consolidation repo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-detail relationship per double-entry bookkeeping standards.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lease agreement associated with this line item. Enables lease-level financial tracking, ASC 842/IFRS 16 right-of-use asset and liability postings, and CAM reconciliation by lease.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: original_line_journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original journal entry line that this line reverses or corrects. Populated only when reversal_flag is true. Enables audit trail linkage between original and reversal postings.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Reversal Reference; FASB ASC 840/842

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this line item. Supports portfolio-level P&L segmentation, investment performance reporting, and REIT segment disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SEC REIT Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: source_document_id
attributes.description: The native document or line item identifier from the originating source system (Yardi Voyager transaction ID or SAP S/4HANA accounting document number + line). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who approved this journal entry line posting. Required for SOX Section 302/404 internal controls documentation and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 840/842; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric assignment field used for open item management, payment clearing, and AR/AP matching. In Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA, this field links line items to specific invoices, payments, or clearing documents.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR/AP Module; SAP S/4HANA Assignment Field; FASB ASC 840/842

attributes.name: cam_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a Common Area Maintenance (CAM) expense eligible for tenant pass-through billing and CAM reconciliation under NNN or modified gross lease structures.
attributes.references: BOMA CAM Standards; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Reconciliation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this journal entry line record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 840/842

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting per double-entry bookkeeping. Fundamental to GL balance verification and trial balance preparation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; IASB IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating business document (invoice, receipt, lease amendment, etc.) that triggered this journal entry line. May differ from posting_date due to accrual accounting and period-end adjustments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; SAP S/4HANA Document Date; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the posting amount from transaction currency to functional currency at the time of posting. Required for multi-currency reconciliation and audit trail under FASB ASC 830.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IASB IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA Currency Translation

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (accounting month, 1–12 or 1–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year to which this line item is assigned. Drives period-end close, monthly NOI statements, and budget-to-actual variance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; Yardi Voyager Period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this journal entry line belongs. Used for annual financial consolidation, REIT FFO/AFFO reporting, and year-over-year NOI comparisons.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; SEC Annual Report (10-K); SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The posting amount translated into the entity's functional currency (typically USD for US-based REITs). Required for financial consolidation, EBITDA roll-ups, and SEC/FASB reporting when transaction currency differs from functional currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IASB IAS 21; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the entity's functional currency used in financial consolidation and statutory reporting (e.g., USD). Distinct from transaction_currency_code for multi-currency portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830; IASB IAS 21

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric GL account code from the chart of accounts as it appears in the source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Retained as a denormalized reference for direct financial reporting and reconciliation without requiring a join.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Chart of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; FASB ASC 840/842

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item represents an intercompany transaction between related legal entities within the same ownership structure. Required for intercompany elimination during financial consolidation and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) to which this payment is attributed for financial reporting. Derived from gl_posting_date but stored explicitly to support period-based filtering, NOI period reporting, and budget-vs-actual variance analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount expressed in the entity's functional (base) currency after applying the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, NOI statements, and EBITDA roll-ups across multi-currency portfolios.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; IASB IAS 21

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this payment is posted to the General Ledger. May differ from payment_date due to period-close cutoffs or accrual adjustments. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting and SOX-compliant period-end close.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is subject to IRS Form 1099 reporting requirements. True = payment must be included in annual 1099 filing for the vendor. Determined by vendor tax classification and payment type.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: is_partial_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment represents a partial settlement of the associated invoice(s) rather than full payment. True = partial payment; False = full payment. Used for open invoice aging and vendor statement reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: is_voided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment has been voided (cancelled after issuance but before or after clearing). True = payment is voided and should be excluded from cash disbursement totals. Used for audit trails and reissuance tracking.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual net cash disbursed to the vendor after deducting any early-payment discounts or adjustments from the gross payment amount. Equals payment_amount minus discount_taken_amount. Used for bank reconciliation and cash management reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount disbursed to the vendor in the transaction currency. Represents the total funds transferred, before any discount adjustments. Core monetary field for AP cash disbursement reporting and DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the vendor. For checks, this is the check date; for ACH/wire, this is the value date. Used for cash flow reporting and period-close cutoff.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_memo
attributes.description: Free-text memo or description associated with the payment, as entered by the AP processor. Appears on check stubs, ACH addenda records, or wire instructions. Used for vendor communication and internal reference.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; NACHA CCD+ Addenda Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used to disburse funds to the vendor. 'check' = physical or laser-printed check; 'ach' = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; 'wire' = same-day wire transfer; 'virtual_card' = single-use virtual credit card; 'eft' = generic electronic funds transfer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the source system (e.g., Yardi check number or SAP payment document number). Used for reconciliation, audit trails, and vendor remittance advice.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the AP payment. 'pending' = approved but not yet disbursed; 'issued' = check printed or ACH/wire initiated; 'cleared' = confirmed settled by bank; 'voided' = cancelled before clearing; 'stopped' = stop-payment placed; 'returned' = ACH/wire returned by receiving bank.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the payment purpose. 'vendor_payment' = standard operating expense vendor; 'ti_allowance' = Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance disbursement to tenant or contractor; 'construction_draw' = CAPEX draw for development/renovation; 'security_deposit_refund' = return of tenant security deposit; 'owner_distribution' = distribution to property owner; 'corporate_payable' = non-property corporate expense. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vendor_payment|ti_allowance|construction_draw|security_deposit_refund|owner_distribution|corporate_payable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; FASB ASC 842 (TI); FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: positive_pay_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this check payment has been submitted to the bank's positive pay fraud prevention service. True = submitted; False = not submitted. Applicable only to check payments. Used for fraud control compliance and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SOX Section 404; Bank Positive Pay Standards

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the remittance advice document sent to the vendor detailing which invoices are being paid and any discounts applied. Used for vendor reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; NACHA CCD+ Addenda Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this payment record originated. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and Silver Layer provenance tracking. Supports multi-system consolidation across Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; MRI Software; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_payment_code
attributes.description: Native payment identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager internal payment key or SAP FI document number). Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage, and drill-back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal tax year to which this payment is attributed for 1099 reporting purposes. Required for IRS Form 1099-MISC/NEC annual reporting for vendor payments exceeding IRS thresholds. Null for non-1099-reportable payments.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AP payment record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks updates such as void processing, cleared date population, or approval status changes. Used for incremental load detection and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The bank value date on which funds are available to the recipient. For ACH payments, this is the settlement date (typically T+1 or T+2). For wires, this is the same-day settlement date. Distinct from payment_date (initiation) and cleared_date (confirmation).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Fedwire Funds Service; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the vendor/payee at the time of payment. Captured as a denormalized field for remittance advice, audit trails, and reporting without requiring a join to the vendor master.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master; IRS 1099 Reporting

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was voided in the source system. Null if the payment has not been voided. Used for audit trails, outstanding check resolution, and period-close adjustments.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the payment was voided. Used for audit compliance, fraud detection, and AP process improvement. Null if payment is not voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lost_check|stale_dated|incorrect_amount|duplicate_payment|vendor_request|bank_return|stop_payment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 404; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: wire_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned reference number for wire transfer payments (SWIFT/Fedwire). Used to trace and confirm wire settlement with the receiving bank. Null for non-wire payments.
attributes.references: SWIFT Standards; Fedwire Funds Service; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the vendor payment for backup withholding, retention, or tax withholding purposes. Common in construction contracts (retention holdback) and for 1099-reportable vendors subject to IRS backup withholding. Reduces net disbursement.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1281 Backup Withholding; Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

products.name: ar_invoice
products.description: Accounts receivable records covering the full order-to-cash cycle for tenant charges and cash receipts — rent billings, CAM reconciliations, percentage rent, TI reimbursements, and miscellaneous property income. Sourced from Yardi Voyager AR. Invoice attributes include invoice number, tenant reference, lease reference, property reference, invoice date, due date, billing period, charge type (base rent, CAM, percentage rent, parking, utility, late fee), gross amount, tax amount, net amount, currency, and aging bucket. Receipt attributes include receipt number, receipt date, payment method, bank deposit reference, amount received, applied amount, unapplied amount, and NSF flag. Supports EGI/PGI calculations and tenant receivable aging reports.
products.reference: Tenant Invoice / Charge — Yardi Voyager AR / MRI Lease Billing

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Reference to the lease agreement under which this invoice is generated. Enables lease-level receivable tracking, CAM reconciliation, and WALT/WALE analytics.

attributes.name: parking_id

attributes.name: property_space_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.space. Business justification: AR invoices for commercial space rent, CAM charges, and percentage rent reference the specific space for CAM reconciliation, percentage rent breakpoint calculations, and space-level revenue reporting.

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant party responsible for this invoice. Links to the tenant master record for receivable aging, tenant ledger, and CRM reporting.

attributes.name: tenant_occupancy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenant.occupancy. Business justification: Rent invoices are generated per occupancy period. Property accountants tie each AR invoice to the occupancy record to validate billing period alignment, prorate move-in/move-out charges, and support C
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.transaction_type. Business justification: In RE AR, charge types (base rent, CAM recovery, percentage rent, late fee, TI reimbursement) map to transaction types that drive revenue recognition (ASC 842), NOI categorization, and investor report

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.unit. Business justification: AR invoices for unit rent, utilities, and ancillary charges reference the specific unit for rent roll reconciliation, delinquency tracking, and lease administration. ar_invoice has agreement_id but un
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Receivable aging classification based on days elapsed since the invoice due date. Used in tenant receivable aging reports, credit risk assessment, and property-level delinquency dashboards.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310; NAR Standards

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Total cash receipts applied against this invoice to date. The difference between net_amount and applied_amount yields the outstanding balance. Critical for aging and delinquency reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: bank_deposit_reference
attributes.description: Bank deposit slip or batch reference number linking this receipt to the physical or electronic bank deposit. Supports bank reconciliation and treasury cash management.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the billing period covered by this invoice. Together with billing_period_start defines the service period for revenue recognition and CAM reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; RESO Standards

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: First day of the billing period covered by this invoice. Used for proration calculations, CAM reconciliation periods, and EGI/PGI period alignment.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; RESO Standards

attributes.name: breakpoint_amount
attributes.description: Natural or artificial breakpoint threshold above which percentage rent is owed per the lease agreement. Used to calculate overage rent on percentage_rent charge type invoices.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; RESO Standards

attributes.name: cam_reconciliation_year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal year for which CAM charges on this invoice are being reconciled. Applicable only to CAM charge type invoices. Supports annual CAM true-up calculations per lease terms.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; RESO Standards; NAR Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the source system. Provides the audit trail creation point required for SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 606; GDPR Article 5; Yardi Voyager AR

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any credit memo issued against this invoice for adjustments, concessions, or billing corrections. Null if no credit memo applies.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed since the invoice due date as of the last refresh. Zero or negative indicates current. Drives aging bucket assignment and late fee eligibility.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice dispute was formally raised. Used to track dispute resolution SLAs and tenant relationship metrics.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the tenant or property manager when an invoice is placed in disputed status. Supports dispute resolution workflow and tenant relationship management.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is contractually required per the lease terms. Drives aging bucket classification, late fee triggering, and tenant delinquency reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; NAR Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting fiscal period (YYYY-MM) to which this invoice is attributed for financial reporting. Aligns with the property management entity's fiscal calendar in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL; SAP S/4HANA Finance; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total pre-tax invoice amount before any adjustments, credits, or concessions. Represents the full contractual charge for the billing period. Used as the basis for PGI calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the invoice was issued to the tenant. Used as the basis for aging calculations, revenue recognition, and EGI/PGI reporting periods.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable invoice reference number as assigned by Yardi Voyager AR. Used for tenant correspondence, remittance matching, and audit trails. Unique within a property management entity.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the AR invoice. Controls downstream processing: draft invoices are not yet posted; open invoices are outstanding; partially_paid indicates partial cash application; paid indicates full settlement; void indicates cancellation; disputed indicates tenant-raised dispute under review.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: late_fee_rate
attributes.description: Contractual late fee rate (as a decimal percentage) applied to overdue balances per the lease agreement. Used to calculate late fee invoice amounts when days_past_due exceeds the grace period.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; State Landlord-Tenant Laws

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total amount due from the tenant after tax inclusion (gross_amount + tax_amount). Represents the actual receivable balance posted to the tenant ledger and used in EGI calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: nsf_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment associated with this invoice was returned due to non-sufficient funds (NSF). True triggers reversal of the applied receipt and potential late fee assessment per lease terms.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; NACHA Operating Rules; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument used by the tenant to remit payment. Informs treasury operations, bank deposit routing, and NSF risk profiling. ACH and wire are most common for commercial tenants.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; NACHA Operating Rules; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: percentage_rent_sales_amount
attributes.description: Tenant-reported gross sales amount used as the basis for percentage rent calculation. Applicable only to percentage_rent charge type invoices. Sourced from tenant sales reports per lease breakpoint provisions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 842; RESO Standards

attributes.name: post_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice was posted to the General Ledger accounting period. May differ from invoice_date for accrual adjustments. Controls which fiscal period the revenue is recognized in.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice has been posted to the General Ledger. Unposted invoices are excluded from financial reporting. SOX control point for period-end close.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; Yardi Voyager GL; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which cash payment was received and recorded in Yardi Voyager AR. Used for cash flow reporting, bank deposit reconciliation, and DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the cash receipt applied to this invoice, as assigned by Yardi Voyager AR. Enables order-to-cash traceability and bank reconciliation. Null if no payment has been received.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this invoice record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer ingestion audit.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; MRI Software; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_invoice_code
attributes.description: Native primary key or invoice identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager internal invoice ID). Enables reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; Enterprise Data Governance Policy; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales tax, GST, VAT, or other applicable tax assessed on the invoice. Jurisdiction-specific; may be zero for NNN leases where tenant pays taxes directly.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 740; IRS Regulations; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of received cash not yet applied to a specific invoice line. Represents tenant prepayments or unallocated receipts held in suspense pending application.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this invoice record in the source system or Silver Layer. Required for incremental data loading, change data capture, and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 606; GDPR Article 5; Yardi Voyager AR

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the invoice balance written off as uncollectible per the bad debt policy. Impacts NOI and requires GL journal entry. Subject to SOX controls and credit committee approval.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310-10-35; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bad debt write-off was approved and posted. Required for SOX-compliant audit trail and GL period close.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; FASB ASC 310-10-35; SOX Section 302

products.name: ar_receipt
products.description: Records of cash receipts and tenant payments applied against AR invoices, including rent payments, security deposit receipts, and miscellaneous income. Tracks EGI realization at the property level. Attributes include receipt number, receipt date, payment method, bank deposit reference, amount received, currency, applied amount, unapplied amount, tenant reference, property reference, and NSF flag.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The discount amount granted to the tenant for early payment, if applicable under the lease terms. Reduces the net receivable and is recorded as a contra-revenue item in the GL.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional/reporting currency at the time of receipt. Relevant for international portfolios and REIT financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; IASB IFRS 16; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The received amount converted to the entity's functional (reporting) currency using the exchange_rate. Used for consolidated financial statements, REIT reporting, and SEC filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; FASB ASC 830; IASB IAS 21; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: income_category
attributes.description: The income classification of the receipt for EGI (Effective Gross Income) and NOI (Net Operating Income) reporting. Aligns with Argus Enterprise income line categories and property-level P&L structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_rent|percentage_rent|cam|tax_recovery|insurance_recovery|parking|storage|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Yardi Voyager GL Module; FASB ASC 842; NCREIF Standards

attributes.name: is_nsf
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment was returned by the bank due to non-sufficient funds (NSF) or a dishonoured check/ACH. When True, triggers NSF fee assessment, AR reversal, and tenant credit risk review.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: is_prepayment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt represents a prepayment for a future billing period. When True, the amount is held as a deferred liability until the applicable period, per FASB ASC 842 revenue recognition rules.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: is_security_deposit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt is a security deposit payment. Security deposits are held in trust and are not recognized as income until forfeited or applied. Drives separate GL coding and regulatory compliance with state/local landlord-tenant laws.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; HUD Regulations; State Landlord-Tenant Laws

attributes.name: nsf_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bank notified the company of the NSF return. Populated only when is_nsf = True. Used to calculate NSF fee due dates and initiate AR reversal processing.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used by the tenant to make the payment (e.g., ACH electronic transfer, wire, check, credit card, cash). Drives bank reconciliation, NSF risk assessment, and treasury management.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA Treasury; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The payer-provided reference number accompanying the payment (e.g., check number, ACH trace number, wire reference, remittance advice number). Used for remittance matching and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period to which this receipt relates. Together with period_start_date, defines the revenue recognition window for the payment under FASB ASC 842 and IFRS 16.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period to which this receipt relates. Used to match receipts to the correct accounting period for EGI realization and accrual-basis reporting under FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: posted_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the AR staff member who posted this receipt in the system of record (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the receipt was posted to the General Ledger (GL). May differ from receipt_date due to processing delays or period-end adjustments. Critical for period-close accuracy and SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The real-world business date on which the payment was received from the tenant or payer. This is the principal business event date used for EGI realization, period-end close, and cash flow reporting. Distinct from the posting date and bank value date.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: receipt_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the AR processor regarding the receipt, such as tenant instructions, dispute context, partial payment explanations, or special handling instructions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable receipt reference number assigned by the AR system (e.g., Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA) at the time of payment posting. Used for tenant remittance matching and audit trails.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the cash receipt. 'posted' indicates fully applied to AR; 'unposted' is pending review; 'reversed' indicates a reversal entry was created; 'nsf' indicates a returned/bounced payment; 'on_account' indicates unapplied credit; 'voided' indicates the receipt was cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: posted|unposted|reversed|nsf|on_account|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: receipt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the payment received. Distinguishes rent payments, security deposit receipts, CAM (Common Area Maintenance) reconciliation payments, late fees, prepayments, and miscellaneous income. Drives EGI component analysis and GL coding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rent|security_deposit|cam_reconciliation|late_fee|miscellaneous|prepayment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; NAR Standards

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: The gross amount of cash received from the tenant or payer in the transaction currency. This is the total funds received before any application or allocation. Core component of EGI realization and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number
attributes.description: The remittance advice document number provided by the tenant with their payment, detailing which invoices the payment is intended to cover. Supports automated cash application and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt record is a reversal entry created to offset a previously posted receipt (e.g., due to NSF, data entry error, or duplicate posting). When True, the original_receipt_id should be populated.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this receipt record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and Silver Layer provenance tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; SAP S/4HANA; MRI Software; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_receipt_code
attributes.description: The native receipt identifier from the originating system of record (e.g., Yardi Voyager receipt key or SAP document number). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the source system for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the received amount that has not yet been applied to any AR invoice and remains as an on-account credit. Triggers follow-up by the AR team for proper allocation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this AR receipt record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks corrections, reversals, and status changes for audit trail and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The amount written off against this receipt as uncollectable, if a partial write-off was applied at the time of receipt posting. Impacts bad debt expense and AR aging reports.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FASB ASC 310; SOX Section 302

Attributes include budget name, type (operating, capital, reforecast), fiscal year, version, status, approval chain, and per-line: GL account, cost center, property reference, period, budgeted amount, prior year actual, variance amount, variance percentage, and line description.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the budget received its final approval. Used in SOX audit trails, investor reporting timelines, and budget lock-down processes.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the budget within Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA. Used for cross-system reconciliation and investor reporting references.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the budget (e.g., '2025 Annual Operating Budget – Portfolio A', '2025 Capital Budget – 123 Main St'). Used in reports and approval workflows.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by purpose: operating (OPEX-focused NOI budget), capital (CAPEX project budget), reforecast (revised in-year estimate), cash_flow (treasury cash planning), or leasing (TI and leasing cost budget). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating|capital|reforecast|cash_flow|leasing|master — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module

attributes.name: budgeted_amount
attributes.description: The planned monetary amount for this budget line in the reporting currency. Represents the baseline for NOI variance analysis, OPEX/CAPEX planning, and investor reporting. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cam_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line is a recoverable Common Area Maintenance (CAM) expense that can be passed through to tenants under NNN or modified gross lease structures. True = CAM-recoverable; False = non-recoverable. Critical for CAM reconciliation and tenant billing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR Lease Standards; Yardi Voyager CAM Reconciliation Module

attributes.name: capex_category
attributes.description: Sub-classification for capital budget lines: tenant_improvement (TI allowances), building_improvement (structural/envelope), equipment (HVAC, elevators), land, or other. Applicable only when account_category = capex. Supports CAPEX planning and fixed asset capitalization per FASB ASC 360.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED marker for data lineage, SOX audit trails, and incremental load processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget version becomes the active baseline for variance analysis and financial reporting. For annual budgets, typically the first day of the fiscal year.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget version ceases to be the active baseline, typically superseded by a reforecast or new version. Null for the currently active version. Supports multi-year and reforecast budget management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management

attributes.name: finance_budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the budget record: draft (being prepared), in_review (submitted for approval), approved (authorized for use), locked (frozen for reporting), archived (superseded), or rejected (returned for revision). Drives SOX-compliant approval workflow controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Workflow

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric fiscal period (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Aligns with the SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager fiscal calendar configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The four-digit fiscal year to which this budget applies (e.g., 2025). Aligns with the entity's fiscal calendar as configured in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA for NOI and EBITDA roll-up reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module

attributes.name: is_consolidated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record represents a consolidated roll-up across multiple properties or cost centers (True) versus a single property/cost center budget (False). Supports portfolio-level EBITDA and NOI consolidation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; SEC REIT Reporting; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget version has been locked and is no longer editable (True = locked; False = editable). Locked budgets serve as the immutable baseline for variance reporting and SOX audit evidence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Lock

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the budget line item explaining the nature of the planned expenditure or revenue (e.g., 'HVAC preventive maintenance contract', 'Base rent revenue – Suite 200'). Sourced from Yardi Voyager budget entry notes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management

attributes.name: noi_category
attributes.description: Categorizes the budget line within the NOI waterfall: pgi (Potential Gross Income), egi (Effective Gross Income), goi (Gross Operating Income), noi_above (above-NOI line item), noi_below (below-NOI line item), or non_operating. Enables automated NOI statement construction and CAP Rate analysis.
attributes.references: NCREIF NOI Definition; Argus Enterprise NOI Modeling; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for budget preparer or approver annotations, assumptions, or justifications (e.g., 'Assumes 3% rent escalation per lease terms', 'CAPEX deferred from 2024'). Supports audit trail and investor reporting commentary.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Management

attributes.name: period_end_date

attributes.name: period_start_date

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the budget period: monthly (12 periods), quarterly (4 periods), or annual (1 period). Determines how budget amounts are distributed and compared against actuals in NOI and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: prepared_by

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_ref

attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Budget Module; NAR Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: budget_scenario
attributes.description: The planning scenario under which this budget line was prepared. Base = most likely; optimistic = upside case; conservative = downside case; stress = adverse scenario for DSCR and LTV stress testing. Supports Argus Enterprise scenario analysis.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Scenario Analysis; ULI Real Estate Finance; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the budget iteration this line belongs to (e.g., 'ORIGINAL', 'REV1', 'REFORECAST_Q2'). Supports multi-version budget comparison and rolling forecast workflows in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Versioning; Argus Enterprise Scenario Management; SAP S/4HANA Budget Version

attributes.name: budgeted_amount
attributes.description: The approved budgeted monetary amount for this GL account, cost center, and period combination. Core field for variance analysis against actuals. Expressed in the entity's functional currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Line; FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget line record was first created in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–12 or 1–13 for 4-4-5 calendars) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Enables monthly variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; Yardi Voyager Period Accounting

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this budget line applies. Aligns with the enterprise fiscal calendar as defined in SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; Yardi Voyager Fiscal Calendar; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_cam_recoverable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expense budget line is recoverable from tenants as part of Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges under NNN or modified gross lease structures. True = recoverable; False = landlord-absorbed.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; NAR Lease Standards

attributes.name: is_capex
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line represents a capital expenditure (CAPEX) rather than an operating expenditure (OPEX). True = CAPEX (capitalized asset investment); False = OPEX (period expense). Drives fixed asset capitalization and depreciation scheduling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this budget line within the source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Line

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the budget line item, such as 'Base Rent Income', 'CAM Expense', 'HVAC Maintenance', or 'Property Tax'. Sourced from Yardi Voyager budget entry.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Line

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering this item within its parent budget. Used for display ordering, referencing, and reconciliation against source budget documents in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Line

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the budget line. Draft = under preparation; submitted = pending approval; approved = authorized for use; rejected = returned for revision; locked = period-closed and immutable; superseded = replaced by a revised line. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|locked|superseded — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Approval Workflow; SAP S/4HANA Budget Status; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classifies the budget line as income (e.g., base rent, CAM recovery), expense (e.g., maintenance, insurance), transfer, reserve contribution, or adjustment. Drives sign convention in NOI and EGI roll-ups.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Line; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: noi_component
attributes.description: Indicates which NOI/EGI/PGI/GOI/EBITDA roll-up component this budget line contributes to. PGI = Potential Gross Income; EGI = Effective Gross Income; GOI = Gross Operating Income; NOI = Net Operating Income; EBITDA = Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization; excluded = not included in any standard roll-up.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Cash Flow Model; FASB ASC 842; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards; NAR

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or commentary entered by the budget preparer or approver explaining assumptions, drivers, or exceptions for this budget line (e.g., 'Includes TI allowance for Suite 200 renewal', 'CAM estimate based on prior year actuals +3%').
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Notes; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar end date of the budget period covered by this line item. Paired with period_start_date to define the exact budget window.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Period

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar start date of the budget period covered by this line item. Used for time-series alignment in NOI and variance reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Period

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual posted amount for the equivalent GL account, cost center, and period in the prior fiscal year. Used as a benchmark for year-over-year budget analysis and trend reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA Actuals; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: The most recently approved revised or reforecast budget amount for this line, reflecting mid-year budget amendments. Null if no revision has been approved. Supports rolling forecast analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Revision Module; SAP S/4HANA Supplementary Budget; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this budget line was sourced. Yardi Voyager = property-level budgets; SAP S/4HANA = corporate/consolidated budgets; Argus = investment/valuation budgets; MRI = residential/investment budgets; manual = spreadsheet or manual entry.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; SAP S/4HANA; Argus Enterprise; MRI Software

attributes.name: source_system_line_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or line identifier of this budget line in the originating source system (Yardi Voyager, SAP S/4HANA, or Argus Enterprise). Enables bi-directional traceability for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA Budget Line; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget line record was last modified in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Tracks revisions, reforecasts, and period-close updates for SOX-compliant change management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); Yardi Voyager Audit Log

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between actual_amount and budgeted_amount (actual minus budget). Positive variance on income lines indicates favorable performance; negative variance on expense lines indicates favorable performance. Core metric for NOI variance reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Variance Report; SAP S/4HANA Budget vs Actual; FASB ASC 842; ULI

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the budgeted amount ((actual - budget) / budget * 100). Enables proportional comparison across budget lines of different magnitudes for portfolio-level reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budget Variance Report; SAP S/4HANA Budget vs Actual; Argus Enterprise

Attributes include forecast name, forecast type (rolling, annual, multi-year), fiscal year, forecast period, version, status, projected NOI, projected EGI, projected PGI, projected OPEX, projected CAPEX, DSCR projection, and prepared-by user.

attributes.name: portfolio_id

attributes.name: primary_financial_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (Asset Manager or Finance Analyst) who prepared this forecast. Required for SOX audit trail and approval workflow tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Yardi Voyager Budgeting and Forecasting

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this forecast was formally approved by the authorized approver. Required for SOX audit trail and investor reporting governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this forecast record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Required for SOX audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted discount rate (as a decimal) used in the DCF model to calculate NPV of projected cash flows. Reflects the required rate of return for the investment. Core Argus Enterprise input for multi-year forecasts.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: expense_growth_rate
attributes.description: Annual operating expense escalation rate (as a decimal) applied to OPEX in the forecast model. Typically benchmarked against CPI or historical expense trends. Key input to Argus Enterprise cash flow models.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2025) to which this forecast applies. Aligns with the entity's fiscal calendar for annual budget cycles, REIT reporting, and SEC filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: forecast_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this forecast record across systems (Yardi, SAP, Argus). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail linkage.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting and Forecasting; SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_months
attributes.description: Total number of months covered by this forecast (e.g., 12 for annual, 36 for 3-year, 60 for 5-year). Defines the DCF projection window in Argus Enterprise and the DSCR covenant monitoring period.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; CMBS Loan Covenants

attributes.name: forecast_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying this forecast, e.g., 'FY2025 Q2 Reforecast — Downtown Office Portfolio'. Used as the business identifier in Argus Enterprise and investor reporting packages.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Yardi Voyager Budgeting

attributes.name: forecast_period_end
attributes.description: The last date of the forecast horizon. For rolling forecasts this is 12 months from the start; for multi-year forecasts this may extend 3–5 years. Defines the DSCR covenant monitoring window.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Cash Flow Modeling; IFRS 16; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: forecast_period_start
attributes.description: The first date of the forecast horizon. For rolling forecasts this is typically the first day of the next calendar month; for annual forecasts it is the fiscal year start date. Used to align Argus Enterprise DCF model inputs.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Cash Flow Modeling; IFRS 16; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: forecast_scenario
attributes.description: Scenario classification for this forecast: base (most likely), upside (optimistic), downside (conservative), or stress (severe adverse). Enables scenario analysis for investor reporting, DSCR sensitivity testing, and lender covenant compliance.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC IVS 105; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the forecast: draft (in preparation), under_review (submitted for approval), approved (signed off), published (distributed to investors), superseded (replaced by a newer version), or archived (retained for audit). Governs SOX-compliant workflow controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; Yardi Voyager Budgeting; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast methodology: rolling (continuous 12-month horizon), annual (full fiscal year), multi_year (3–5 year DCF horizon), reforecast (mid-period revision), or budget (approved annual plan). Drives Argus Enterprise cash flow model inputs and investor reporting templates.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC Valuation Standards; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: is_baseline
attributes.description: Indicates whether this version is the approved baseline forecast for the period (True) or a subsequent reforecast/revision (False). The baseline is the benchmark against which variance analysis is performed.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting and Forecasting; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative commentary on key assumptions, material changes from prior versions, or significant market conditions affecting this forecast. Supports investor reporting transparency and SOX documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-X; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: prepared_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this forecast was prepared and submitted for review. Distinct from the system audit timestamp. Used for version control and investor reporting package dating.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Yardi Voyager Budgeting and Forecasting

attributes.name: projected_cap_rate
attributes.description: Projected CAP Rate = Projected NOI / Projected Property Value. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 for 5.50%). Used for property valuation benchmarking, investment underwriting, and Argus Enterprise exit assumptions.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: projected_capex
attributes.description: Projected capital expenditures for the forecast period, including tenant improvements (TI), building improvements, and major equipment replacements. CAPEX is tracked separately from OPEX per FASB capitalization thresholds.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: projected_debt_service
attributes.description: Projected total debt service (principal and interest payments) for the forecast period. Used as the denominator in the DSCR calculation. Sourced from loan amortization schedules in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; CMBS Loan Covenants

attributes.name: projected_dscr
attributes.description: Projected DSCR = Projected NOI / Projected Debt Service. Critical covenant metric for CMBS and commercial mortgage lenders. A DSCR below the covenant threshold (typically 1.20x–1.25x) triggers lender notification requirements.
attributes.references: CMBS Loan Covenants; FASB ASC 470; SEC Regulation S-X; Argus Enterprise Investment Analysis

attributes.name: projected_ebitda
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA)
attributes.description: Projected EBITDA for the forecast period. Used for portfolio-level financial consolidation, REIT AFFO/FFO roll-ups, and investor reporting. Derived from NOI adjusted for non-cash items and corporate overhead allocations.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation G Non-GAAP Measures; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: projected_egi
attributes.description: Projected income after deducting vacancy and credit loss from PGI. EGI = PGI − Vacancy Loss. Core metric in the NOI waterfall used for investor reporting, DSCR calculations, and Argus Enterprise cash flow models.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: projected_goi
attributes.description: Projected total operating income including EGI plus other income. GOI = EGI + Other Income. Intermediate metric in the NOI waterfall before deducting operating expenses.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute Income Approach

attributes.name: projected_noi
attributes.description: Projected net operating income for the forecast period. NOI = GOI − OPEX. The primary metric for property valuation (CAP Rate = NOI / Value), DSCR covenant compliance, and investor reporting. Authoritative source for all property-level P&L data.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: projected_opex
attributes.description: Projected total operating expenses for the forecast period, including property management fees, insurance, real estate taxes, utilities, repairs and maintenance, and administrative costs. OPEX is deducted from GOI to derive NOI.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP and GL Modules; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB ASC 840

attributes.name: projected_other_income
attributes.description: Projected ancillary income not captured in base rent, including parking fees, CAM recoveries, late charges, and miscellaneous tenant charges. Added to EGI to derive GOI.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: projected_pgi
attributes.description: Projected total rental revenue assuming 100% occupancy with no vacancy or credit loss, expressed in the forecast currency. PGI is the top-line revenue figure in the NOI waterfall and a key input to Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: projected_vacancy_loss
attributes.description: Projected deduction from PGI for anticipated vacancy and tenant credit loss during the forecast period. Expressed as a positive monetary amount. EGI = PGI − Vacancy Loss.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: The date on which this forecast was published and distributed to investors, lenders, or internal stakeholders. Marks the transition from approved to published status in the forecast lifecycle.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; REIT Investor Reporting Standards; NAR

attributes.name: rent_growth_rate
attributes.description: Annual rent escalation rate (as a decimal) applied to base rents in the forecast model. Derived from CoStar market rent trends and lease escalation clauses. Key input to multi-year DCF models in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Market Research; Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this forecast was originated or imported: Yardi Voyager (budgeting), Argus Enterprise (DCF modeling), SAP S/4HANA (financial consolidation), MRI Software (investment management), or Manual (spreadsheet-based entry).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Budgeting; Argus Enterprise; SAP S/4HANA; MRI Software

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this forecast record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks reforecast revisions and status transitions for SOX audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: vacancy_rate_assumption
attributes.description: Assumed vacancy rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.0500 for 5%) applied to PGI to derive the vacancy loss in this forecast. Sourced from CoStar market research and internal leasing pipeline data.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Market Research; Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer version of this forecast for the same property/portfolio and period. Enables version control and audit trail for reforecasts and budget revisions. Version 1 is the initial submission; subsequent revisions increment by 1.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Yardi Voyager Budgeting; SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning

Attributes include statement period, property reference, PGI, vacancy loss, concessions, EGI, operating expense categories, NOI, management fee, CAP rate applied, and reporting currency.

attributes.name: cam_recovery

attributes.name: cap_rate_applied
