attributes.name: capex_reserve
attributes.description: Capital expenditure reserve amount set aside for the reporting period for major building improvements, replacements, and non-recurring capital items. Deducted from NOI to arrive at AFFO in REIT reporting.
attributes.references: NAREIT AFFO Definition; Appraisal Institute; ISO 55000 Asset Management; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: concessions
attributes.description: Monetary value of rent-free periods, move-in incentives, and other lease concessions granted to tenants during the reporting period. Expressed as a positive deduction from PGI in the income waterfall.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this NOI statement record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Provides the audit trail for record provenance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Internal Data Governance Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: credit_loss
attributes.description: Revenue lost due to tenant non-payment, bad debt write-offs, and collection shortfalls during the reporting period. Expressed as a positive deduction from PGI. Sourced from Yardi Voyager AR aging.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Appraisal Institute Income Approach; Yardi Voyager AR

attributes.name: debt_service
attributes.description: Total principal and interest payments on property-level debt obligations for the reporting period. Used as the denominator in DSCR calculations. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA loan schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Debt Service Coverage Ratio — NOI divided by total debt service for the reporting period (NOI / Debt Service). A DSCR below 1.0 indicates the property does not generate sufficient income to cover debt obligations. Critical for lender covenant compliance and CMBS reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; CMBS Reporting Standards; SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: egi
attributes.description: Effective Gross Income — PGI minus vacancy loss, credit loss, and concessions, plus other income. Represents the actual income collected or collectible from the property. Core input for NOI and CAP rate calculations.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly). Enables period-over-period variance analysis and WALE/WALT calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager General Ledger; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this NOI statement belongs (e.g., 2024). Used for annual roll-up, budget comparison, and SEC/REIT regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Total Gross Leasable Area of the property in square feet as of the reporting period. Used to calculate PSF metrics (NOI PSF, rent PSF) for benchmarking and CAP rate analysis.
attributes.references: BOMA International Measurement Standards; RESO Data Dictionary; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: implied_property_value
attributes.description: Estimated property value derived by dividing NOI by the applied CAP rate (NOI / CAP Rate). Used for investor reporting, portfolio NAV calculations, and REIT asset valuations. Not a formal appraisal value.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: insurance_expense
attributes.description: Property and casualty insurance premiums allocated to the reporting period. Includes building, liability, and any specialized coverage (flood, earthquake). Component of total operating expenses.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; Yardi Voyager AP; OSHA

attributes.name: is_consolidated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NOI statement represents a consolidated multi-property or portfolio-level roll-up (True) versus a single-property statement (False). Drives aggregation logic in SAP S/4HANA financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB ASC 810; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: leasing_commission_expense
attributes.description: Brokerage leasing commissions paid or accrued during the reporting period for new leases and renewals. Tracked separately for AFFO adjustments and amortized per FASB ASC 842 straight-line requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAREIT AFFO Definition; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: management_fee_expense
attributes.description: Fee paid to the property manager (PM) for operational management services, typically calculated as a percentage of EGI or collected rents. Key line item for NOI sensitivity and management contract evaluation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; Yardi Voyager Property Management; NAR

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Management fee expressed as a decimal percentage of EGI or collected rents (e.g., 0.0400 = 4.00%). Used to validate the management_fee_expense calculation and benchmark against market rates.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; NAR; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income — EGI minus total operating expenses. The primary measure of a property's income-generating performance before debt service, capital expenditures, depreciation, and income taxes. Authoritative input for CAP rate valuation and DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 842; NAREIT; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: noi_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Operating Income Per Square Foot (NOI PSF)
attributes.description: NOI divided by GLA in square feet, expressed as a per-square-foot metric. Industry-standard benchmark for comparing property performance across the portfolio and against market comparables.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; CoStar Suite; NAREIT

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative notes from the asset manager or finance team providing context for unusual variances, one-time items, or material events affecting the NOI statement for the reporting period.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Internal Financial Reporting Policy

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of total leasable area that is occupied and generating rent during the reporting period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9200 = 92.00%). Complement of vacancy rate; used in investor dashboards and REIT disclosures.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NAREIT; CoStar Suite; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: other_income
attributes.description: Ancillary income not captured in base rent — includes parking fees, storage fees, antenna/rooftop license income, late charges, and miscellaneous tenant charges. Added to PGI net of losses to arrive at EGI.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR; Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: period_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency granularity of this NOI statement — monthly for operational monitoring, quarterly for investor reporting, annual for REIT filings, year-to-date for cumulative tracking, or trailing 12 months for CAP rate valuation.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; NAREIT FFO/AFFO Reporting Guidelines; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: pgi
attributes.description: Potential Gross Income — the maximum theoretical rental revenue achievable if the property were 100% occupied at market rents for the full reporting period. Top line of the NOI income waterfall. Sourced from Yardi Voyager lease schedules.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: property_tax_expense
attributes.description: Real estate tax and special assessment charges levied on the property for the reporting period. A primary component of operating expenses and a key driver of NOI sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; HUD; Yardi Voyager AP

attributes.name: repairs_maintenance_expense
attributes.description: Costs for routine repairs, preventive maintenance, and non-capital building upkeep during the reporting period. Sourced from Building Engines work orders and Yardi Voyager AP. Component of total operating expenses.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Appraisal Institute; Yardi Voyager AP; Building Engines

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the financial reporting period covered by this NOI statement (e.g., 2024-01-31 for a January monthly statement).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: First calendar date of the financial reporting period covered by this NOI statement (e.g., 2024-01-01 for a January monthly statement).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: restatement_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a previously published NOI statement was restated. Required when statement_status is 'restated'. Supports SOX audit trail and SEC disclosure requirements for material restatements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this NOI statement data was sourced (e.g., Yardi Voyager for property-level actuals, Argus Enterprise for budget/forecast, SAP S/4HANA for consolidated financials, or manual for off-system entries).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this NOI statement, formatted as NOI-YYYY-MM-PropertyCode. Used in investor reports, audit trails, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the NOI statement. Draft indicates work-in-progress; under_review is pending approval; approved is finalized; published is distributed to investors; restated indicates a prior-period correction; voided is cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|published|restated|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the statement as actual reported results, approved budget, current forecast, reforecast, or prior-year actual for variance analysis. Drives how the statement is consumed in Argus Enterprise and investor reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: ti_allowance
attributes.description: Tenant Improvement allowance costs incurred or accrued during the reporting period for build-out and fit-out of leased spaces. Impacts AFFO calculations and is tracked separately from operating expenses per FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAREIT AFFO Definition; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: total_operating_expenses
attributes.description: Sum of all property-level operating expenditures for the reporting period, including management fees, repairs and maintenance, insurance, property taxes, utilities, and administrative costs. Deducted from EGI to arrive at NOI.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this NOI statement record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks restatements, corrections, and re-approvals for audit and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Internal Data Governance Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: utilities_expense
attributes.description: Landlord-paid utility costs for the reporting period including electricity, gas, water, sewer, and trash removal for common areas and vacant spaces. Component of total operating expenses.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; EPA Environmental Compliance; Yardi Voyager AP

attributes.name: vacancy_loss
attributes.description: Revenue lost due to unoccupied units or spaces during the reporting period. Expressed as a positive deduction from PGI. Includes both physical vacancy and economic vacancy from lease-up periods.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: vacancy_rate
attributes.description: Physical vacancy rate for the property during the reporting period, expressed as a decimal percentage of total leasable area that is unoccupied (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%). Key driver of PGI-to-EGI waterfall.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Suite

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset register for all capitalized real estate assets including buildings, land improvements, tenant improvements (TI), HVAC systems, and capital equipment. Supports CAPEX tracking, depreciation schedules, and FASB ASC 360 asset impairment testing. Sourced from Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and SAP S/4HANA FA. Attributes include asset number, asset description, asset class, property reference, acquisition date, acquisition cost, useful life, depreciation method, accumulated depreciation, net book value, disposal date, and disposal proceeds.

A real estate sustain

attributes.name: construction_type_id

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Fixed assets (buildings, land improvements, TI allowances) are owned by specific legal entities in the real estate enterprise. The fixed_asset register must be linked to the owning legal entity for de

attributes.name: portfolio_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio_asset. Business justification: Fixed assets (TI allowances, building improvements, equipment) correspond to portfolio assets in the investment domain. Linking them enables depreciation schedules to feed into portfolio asset book va
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: property_space_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.space. Business justification: Commercial space TI and leasehold improvements are capitalized at the space level for depreciation tracking and lease accounting. Real estate accountants and auditors expect fixed assets to reference

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.unit. Business justification: Tenant improvement allowances and unit-specific capital improvements are capitalized as fixed assets at the unit level under ASC 842/IFRS 16. Real estate accountants tracking TI depreciation and lease

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense charged against this asset from the in-service date through the current reporting period. Contra-asset balance used to compute net book value.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total capitalized cost of the fixed asset at the time of acquisition, including purchase price, transaction costs, and any costs necessary to bring the asset to its intended use. Represents the gross book value before depreciation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was acquired, purchased, or placed in service. This is the capitalization date used as the start point for depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of the fixed asset into a standardized category that governs depreciation method and useful life defaults. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: building|land|land_improvement|tenant_improvement|hvac_system|capital_equipment|furniture_fixtures|leasehold_improvement|infrastructure|intangible — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA Asset Class Configuration; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fixed asset, such as 'HVAC Rooftop Unit — Building A' or 'Lobby Renovation — Tenant Improvement Suite 400'. Used for identification in financial reports and audits.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_location
attributes.description: Physical location of the asset within the property, such as building name, floor, suite, or room number (e.g., 'Building A — Floor 3 — Mechanical Room'). Supports physical inventory verification.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset indicating its operational and accounting state. 'under_construction' applies to assets in the Assets Under Construction (AUC) stage prior to capitalization.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: asset_sub_class
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within an asset class, such as 'Mechanical' or 'Electrical' within the HVAC class, or 'Structural' within Building. Supports detailed CAPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Physical barcode or RFID tag number affixed to the asset for inventory tracking and physical verification during annual fixed asset audits.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: book_tax_difference
attributes.description: Cumulative difference between book depreciation and tax depreciation for this asset, representing the temporary timing difference used in deferred tax calculations under FASB ASC 740.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed asset record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in compliance with SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: depreciation_convention
attributes.description: Timing convention applied to the first and last year of depreciation, determining how much depreciation is taken in the year of acquisition and disposal. Relevant for MACRS and book depreciation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946; FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of the asset over its useful life. 'macrs' refers to the Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System used for US tax depreciation. Land assets use 'no_depreciation'.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was disposed of, sold, scrapped, or retired from service. Triggers the recognition of any gain or loss on disposal in the GL.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the fixed asset was removed from the asset register. Determines the accounting treatment for the disposal transaction.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Net cash proceeds received upon disposal or sale of the fixed asset. Used to calculate the gain or loss on disposal (disposal_proceeds minus net_book_value at disposal date).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment charge recognized against this asset when its carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount per FASB ASC 360 impairment testing. Reduces net book value below the normal depreciation schedule.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Impairment Testing; IFRS IAS 36; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: impairment_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent FASB ASC 360 impairment test was performed for this asset. Required for SOX compliance documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; IFRS IAS 36

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was placed into active service and depreciation commenced. May differ from acquisition_date for assets under construction that are capitalized upon completion.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference to the property or equipment insurance policy covering this fixed asset. Required for insurance claims processing and risk management reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Real Estate Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: insured_value
attributes.description: Replacement cost or insured value of the fixed asset as declared on the insurance policy. May differ from net book value and is used for insurance adequacy reviews.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; ALTA American Land Title Association

attributes.name: leed_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset or the improvement it represents has achieved LEED certification from the U.S. Green Building Council. Supports ESG reporting and green building compliance tracking.
attributes.references: USGBC LEED Certification Standards; EPA Environmental Compliance; ESG Reporting

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the fixed asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition_cost minus accumulated_depreciation minus any impairment charges. Represents the asset's accounting value at the reporting date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the acquisition of this fixed asset. Links the asset to the originating procurement transaction for three-way match and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Yardi Voyager AP

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in straight-line depreciation calculations as the floor below which book value is not depreciated.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for equipment and mechanical assets such as HVAC units, elevators, and generators. Used for warranty tracking and maintenance records.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Building Engines Facility Operations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this fixed asset record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and SAP S/4HANA FI-AA.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_asset_code
attributes.description: Native asset identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi asset number or SAP asset master number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied for US federal income tax purposes, which may differ from the book depreciation method. MACRS and bonus depreciation are common for real estate capital assets.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: tax_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Useful life assigned to the asset for tax depreciation purposes under IRS MACRS or ADS rules. May differ from the book useful_life_years used for GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed asset record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, incremental loads, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful economic life of the asset in years, used to calculate straight-line and other depreciation schedules. Determined per asset class per FASB ASC 360 and IRS guidelines.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor, contractor, or supplier from whom the asset was acquired or who performed the capital improvement. Supports AP reconciliation and vendor spend analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA Procurement

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or contractor warranty for this asset expires. Used to trigger preventive maintenance scheduling and warranty claim management before expiry.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Building Engines Facility Operations

attributes.name: ytd_depreciation
attributes.description: Depreciation expense charged against this asset in the current fiscal year to date. Used for period-end financial reporting and budget-to-actual CAPEX variance analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account by its designated business purpose. Operating accounts handle day-to-day receipts and disbursements; escrow accounts hold funds pending transaction close; security deposit accounts hold tenant security deposits per statutory requirements; reserve accounts hold capital reserve funds; payroll accounts fund employee compensation; construction accounts fund development draws.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Account Type; ASC 842; FASB ASC 230 Cash Flow Statement

attributes.name: ach_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Automated Clearing House (ACH) electronic payments are enabled for this bank account. Supports automated rent collection and vendor disbursement workflows.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Yardi Voyager — ACH Setup

attributes.name: balance_as_of_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the current_balance figure. Indicates the point in time to which the reported balance applies, enabling accurate cash position reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Cash Management; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: bank_branch_address
attributes.description: Street address of the bank branch where the account is held. Used for official correspondence and audit documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific bank branch where the account is domiciled. Used for correspondence and relationship management with the banking institution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Setup

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the financial institution where the account is held (e.g., 'JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.'). Used for bank reconciliation reporting and counterparty risk management.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Setup; SAP S/4HANA House Bank

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number identifying the financial institution for ACH and wire transfer transactions. Classified confidential as it enables payment initiation.
attributes.references: ABA Routing Number Standard; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: bank_statement_delivery
attributes.description: Method by which bank statements are delivered for this account. Electronic statements are imported directly into Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA for automated reconciliation; paper statements require manual processing.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Reconciliation; SAP S/4HANA Bank Statement Processing (FF_5)

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bank account was closed or decommissioned. Null for active accounts. Required for account lifecycle management and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Setup; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Most recently confirmed ledger balance of the bank account as of the last reconciliation or bank statement date. Used for cash position monitoring and liquidity management. Not a calculated aggregate — represents the point-in-time balance from the source system.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Cash Management; SAP S/4HANA Cash and Liquidity Management; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: dual_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions on this account require dual authorization (two signatories). True for accounts with high transaction thresholds or escrow accounts per SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Yardi Voyager Authorization Controls

attributes.name: house_bank_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA House Bank identifier representing the bank-level grouping under which this account is configured. Used for payment program configuration and bank statement processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — House Bank Configuration (FI12); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) for accounts held at international financial institutions. Required for cross-border wire transfers and EU/UK regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 13616 IBAN Standard; EU Payment Services Directive (PSD2)

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applicable to the bank account balance, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 for 4.5%). Applicable for interest-bearing accounts such as money market or reserve accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Risk Management; Yardi Voyager Bank Setup

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account is used for intercompany transactions between related legal entities within the portfolio. Supports intercompany elimination in financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_reconciled_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent completed bank reconciliation for this account. Critical for SOX-compliant financial controls and cash position accuracy monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; Yardi Voyager Bank Reconciliation Module; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned lockbox number for accounts configured to receive tenant rent payments via lockbox processing. Enables automated AR cash application in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lockbox Processing; NACHA ACH Operating Rules

attributes.name: minimum_balance
attributes.description: Minimum balance required to be maintained in the account per bank agreement or internal policy (e.g., compensating balance requirements for credit facilities). Triggers alerts when balance falls below threshold.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Cash Management; SAP S/4HANA House Bank Agreement

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bank account was officially opened with the financial institution. Used for account lifecycle tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Setup; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: Maximum overdraft facility approved by the bank for this account. Zero or null if no overdraft facility exists. Used in cash management and liquidity risk monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cash and Liquidity Management; Yardi Voyager Bank Setup

attributes.name: positive_pay_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in the bank's Positive Pay fraud prevention service, which validates issued checks against a transmitted file before clearing. Critical for AP disbursement fraud controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Fraud Controls; Yardi Voyager — Positive Pay

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency at which this bank account must be reconciled per internal controls policy. Drives automated reconciliation scheduling in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Yardi Voyager Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: Internal reference code or short identifier assigned to this bank account within Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA for use in GL postings, bank reconciliation, and reporting. Distinct from the masked account number.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Code; SAP S/4HANA House Bank Account ID

attributes.name: secondary_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the secondary authorized signatory on the bank account. Supports dual-control authorization requirements for high-value disbursements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; Yardi Voyager Bank Account Setup

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC) for the bank. Required for international wire transfers. Applicable for accounts at institutions with international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 9362 — BIC Standard; SWIFT Network Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this bank account record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and SOX-compliant record management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wire_transfer_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether outgoing wire transfers are enabled for this bank account. Controls payment method availability in AP disbursement workflows.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Payment Processing; SAP S/4HANA Payment Methods

attributes.name: yardi_bank_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this bank account record in Yardi Voyager. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system, and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Setup; Data Governance Lineage Standard

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Records of financial transactions between legal entities within the real estate enterprise — management fee allocations, intercompany loans, shared service cost allocations, equity contributions, and distribution payments. Critical for financial consolidation, elimination entries, and REIT distribution compliance. Attributes include transaction date, sending entity, receiving entity, transaction type, amount, currency, GL account, elimination flag, netting status, and approval status.
products.reference: Intercompany Transaction — SAP S/4HANA FI-IC / Yardi Voyager Intercompany

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each intercompany transaction record within the real estate enterprise. Primary key for the silver layer data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Intercompany transaction approval in real estate fund structures (management fee allocations, intercompany loans) requires employee accountability for SOX elimination controls and audit. approved_by i
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property to which this intercompany transaction is attributable, where applicable (e.g., management fee for a specific asset). Enables property-level NOI and OPEX analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Setup; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the GL account in the chart of accounts to which this intercompany transaction is posted on the sending entity's books. Drives the elimination entry pairing during consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Yardi Voyager GL Module; FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center within the sending entity to which the intercompany charge is allocated. Enables property-level and portfolio-level P&L attribution for NOI and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Module; Yardi Voyager Cost Center; FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: RE intercompany transactions between entities in different countries require validated currency references for elimination entries, currency translation, and consolidated financial reporting. Replaces
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: netting_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the netting cycle run in which this transaction was included. Enables traceability of which transactions were settled together in a given netting period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA In-House Cash Netting Run; Treasury Operations

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio or fund to which this intercompany transaction belongs. Supports portfolio-level consolidation, AUM reporting, and REIT distribution compliance.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity originating the intercompany charge or payment — the entity recording the intercompany payable or expense. References the enterprise legal entity master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code; FASB ASC 810; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: property_sale_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transaction.property_sale. Business justification: Related-party property sales between affiliated entities generate intercompany transactions requiring consolidation elimination. Real estate fund accountants must link IC transactions to the triggerin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: receiving_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity on the receiving end of the intercompany charge or payment — the entity recording the intercompany receivable or income. References the enterprise legal entity master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB ASC 810; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original intercompany_transaction_id that this record reverses. Null if reversal_flag is False. Enables full audit chain tracing for correcting entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Reversal Document Reference; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: transaction_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.transaction_type. Business justification: In RE intercompany accounting, transaction types (management fee allocation, intercompany loan, property transfer, cost allocation) drive elimination entries, consolidation rules, and transfer pricing
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allocation_basis_value
attributes.description: The quantitative driver value used to compute the allocation (e.g., headcount count, square footage, or revenue amount) corresponding to the allocation_method. Supports audit trail for transfer pricing justification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Allocation; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IRS Section 482

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to allocate shared service costs or management fees across receiving entities. Drives transfer pricing documentation and supports regulatory scrutiny of intercompany arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Overhead Cost Allocation; IRS Transfer Pricing Regulations; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the intercompany transaction. SOX-compliant approval workflows require documented authorization before posting. 'Escalated' indicates the transaction exceeded a threshold requiring senior approval.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval; Yardi Voyager Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the intercompany transaction received final approval. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this intercompany transaction record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit record creation timestamp for the silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Document Creation

attributes.name: elimination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the elimination entry was processed in the consolidation system. Null if elimination_flag is False or elimination has not yet been executed.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting Elimination Run

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction has been flagged for elimination in the consolidated financial statements. True = transaction is subject to elimination; False = not yet eliminated or not applicable. Critical for FASB ASC 810 consolidation compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to translate the transaction currency amount to the functional currency at the time of posting. Expressed as units of functional currency per one unit of transaction currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Exchange Rate Table

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–12 or 1–13 for 4-4-5 calendars) within the fiscal year to which this transaction is assigned. Used for monthly consolidation runs and period-level elimination entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; Yardi Voyager Accounting Period; FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this intercompany transaction belongs, as determined by the posting date and the enterprise fiscal calendar. Used for annual financial consolidation and REIT distribution compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; FASB ASC 810; SEC REIT Annual Reporting

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net transaction amount translated into the sending entity's functional currency using the applicable exchange rate. Required for entities operating in non-USD functional currencies under FASB ASC 830 or IFRS 21.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Currency Translation

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric GL account code from the chart of accounts for the sending entity's posting. Retained for direct reporting without requiring a join to the GL account master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Yardi Voyager GL Module

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The full face value of the intercompany transaction before any withholding tax, netting, or adjustments, expressed in the transaction currency. For management fees, this is the fee billed; for loans, this is the principal disbursed.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Billing; Yardi Voyager AR/AP

attributes.name: intercompany_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the underlying intercompany agreement (e.g., management services agreement, intercompany loan agreement) that authorizes this transaction. Links to the contract lifecycle management system (DocuSign CLM).
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Agreement; Transfer Pricing Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature and purpose of the intercompany transaction (e.g., 'Q3 2024 property management fee — 123 Main Street', 'Intercompany loan drawdown — Fund III'). Supports audit review and business user understanding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Document Text; Yardi Voyager Memo Field; SOX Audit Documentation

attributes.name: loan_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number for the intercompany loan facility when transaction_type is 'intercompany_loan' or 'interest_charge'. Used to group principal and interest transactions under the same loan instrument for DSCR and LTV analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Risk Management; FASB ASC 310; SEC REIT Debt Disclosure

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net value of the intercompany transaction after deducting withholding tax and any approved adjustments (gross_amount minus tax_amount). This is the amount recorded in the GL and used for elimination entries during consolidation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: netting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction has been included in an intercompany netting cycle, where offsetting payables and receivables between the same entity pair are settled on a net basis to reduce cash movement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA In-House Cash / Netting; Treasury Best Practices; FASB ASC 210-20

attributes.name: offset_gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account code used for the offsetting (contra) entry on the receiving entity's books. Required to confirm the intercompany pair is balanced and to generate elimination journal entries during consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation; FASB ASC 810; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the General Ledger (GL) in the source system. May differ from transaction_date due to period-end cut-off adjustments. Critical for fiscal period assignment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SAP S/4HANA GL Posting; Yardi Voyager GL Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: receiving_entity_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code of the receiving legal entity as defined in the chart of entities. Used for consolidation mapping and elimination journal entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Configuration; Yardi Voyager Entity Setup

attributes.name: receiving_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the entity receiving the intercompany transaction. Retained for reporting and audit purposes without requiring a join to the entity master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal of a previously posted intercompany entry. True = this is a reversal transaction. Used to identify correcting entries during period-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Reversal Document; Yardi Voyager Void/Reversal; FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: sending_entity_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code of the sending legal entity as defined in the chart of entities within SAP S/4HANA or Yardi Voyager. Used for consolidation mapping and elimination journal entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Configuration; Yardi Voyager Entity Setup

attributes.name: sending_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the entity originating the intercompany transaction. Retained for reporting and audit purposes without requiring a join to the entity master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this intercompany transaction was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Yardi Voyager (property-level) and SAP S/4HANA (consolidation-level) postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Data Integration; Yardi Voyager Integration; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_code
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., SAP document number, Yardi batch reference). Enables reconciliation between the silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Document Number; Yardi Voyager Batch ID; Databricks Lakehouse Lineage

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Withholding tax or VAT amount applicable to the intercompany transaction, expressed in the transaction currency. Relevant for cross-border intercompany transactions subject to transfer pricing and tax treaty provisions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; IFRS 16; IRS Transfer Pricing Regulations; SAP S/4HANA Tax Module

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the intercompany transaction occurred — i.e., the date the management fee was earned, the loan was disbursed, or the allocation was triggered. Used as the primary date for period matching and consolidation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SAP S/4HANA Posting Date; Yardi Voyager Transaction Date

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the intercompany transaction, used for cross-entity reconciliation and audit trail. Typically assigned by SAP S/4HANA or Yardi Voyager at the time of posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the intercompany transaction. Drives consolidation processing: only 'posted' and 'eliminated' records are included in consolidated financial statements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|eliminated|reversed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB ASC 810; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this intercompany transaction record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect changes during incremental loads and to support SCD Type 1 merge operations in the silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Databricks Lakehouse Delta Lake; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

products.name: debt_instrument
products.description: Master registry of all property-level and portfolio-level debt instruments — mortgages, construction loans, mezzanine debt, CMBS, and credit facilities — with embedded debt service payment history. Supports LTV monitoring, DSCR covenant tracking, amortization schedules, and lender reporting. Attributes include loan number, lender, loan type, original principal, outstanding balance, interest rate, rate type (fixed/variable), maturity date, LTV ratio, DSCR covenant threshold, collateral property reference, and per-payment: scheduled/actual principal and interest amounts, payment date, payment status, outstanding balance after payment, escrow amount, and late fees.
products.reference: Loan / Debt Instrument — Yardi Voyager Debt Management / SAP S/4HANA TRM

attributes.name: debt_instrument_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each debt instrument record in the master registry. Primary key for the debt_instrument data product.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collateral property securing this debt instrument. Supports LTV monitoring, property-level DSCR calculations, and collateral reporting to lenders.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; ALTA Title Standards

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account used to record the debt liability on the balance sheet. Ensures proper financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA and SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA GL standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this debt instrument for financial reporting and budget allocation purposes within SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: RE debt instruments (mortgages, mezzanine loans, construction loans) for international properties are denominated in specific currencies for debt service calculation, LTV covenant monitoring, and lend
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Debt instruments (mortgages, construction loans, credit facilities) are obligations of a specific legal entity in the real estate enterprise. The debt_instrument product currently has no FK to legal_e
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lender_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.lender

attributes.name: parcel_id
