attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio to which this debt instrument belongs. Enables portfolio-level debt aggregation, LTV roll-up, and DSCR covenant tracking across multi-property portfolios.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: regulatory_framework_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.regulatory_framework. Business justification: RE debt instruments are governed by specific regulatory frameworks (CMBS pooling agreements, HUD/FHA programs, Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac guidelines) that dictate reporting requirements, covenant structur
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: required_insurance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.policy. Business justification: Lenders require specific insurance policies as loan covenant conditions (property, liability, flood). Linking debt_instrument to the required insurance policy supports covenant compliance monitoring,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tenure_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.tenure_type. Business justification: In RE debt management, loan terms, LTV limits, and CMBS eligibility differ based on collateral tenure type (fee simple, ground lease, leasehold). Lenders require tenure type classification for underwr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: title_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.title_record. Business justification: Debt instruments (mortgages, deeds of trust) are recorded as encumbrances on title records with specific recording numbers and priority positions. Title officers and real estate attorneys require this
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: amortization_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months over which the loan principal is amortized for payment calculation purposes. May differ from the loan term for balloon loans (e.g., 30-year amortization with 10-year balloon).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: amortization_type
attributes.description: Describes the principal repayment structure of the debt instrument. Fully amortizing loans retire principal over the term; interest-only loans defer principal to maturity; balloon loans have a large final payment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this debt instrument record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 302/404 and data governance lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 data integrity

attributes.name: cross_collateralized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this debt instrument is cross-collateralized with other properties or loans, meaning multiple properties secure the same debt obligation. Impacts disposition and refinancing strategies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards

attributes.name: debt_issuance_costs
attributes.description: Total capitalized costs incurred to obtain the debt financing including legal fees, title insurance, appraisal fees, and origination fees. Presented as a direct deduction from the carrying amount of the debt per FASB ASC 835-30.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 835-30 Debt Issuance Costs; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: dscr_covenant_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) Covenant Threshold
attributes.description: Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) required under the loan agreement. DSCR is Net Operating Income (NOI) divided by total debt service. Breach triggers lender notification and potential cash trap provisions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X for REITs

attributes.name: escrow_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender requires the borrower to maintain escrow accounts for taxes, insurance, and/or capital reserves as a condition of the loan.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; HUD escrow requirements

attributes.name: extended_maturity_date
attributes.description: Revised maturity date if the borrower has exercised an extension option under the loan agreement. Null if no extension has been exercised.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: guarantor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity or individual providing a personal or corporate guarantee on the debt instrument. Applicable for recourse and partial-recourse loans. Required for credit risk and exposure reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 460 Guarantees; FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: instrument_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the debt instrument. Drives covenant monitoring workflows, lender reporting, and portfolio risk dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|paid_off|in_default|in_foreclosure|refinanced|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SEC Regulation S-X for REIT disclosures

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the debt instrument by its structural form. Determines applicable accounting treatment, covenant structures, and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mortgage|construction_loan|mezzanine_debt|cmbs|credit_facility|bridge_loan — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: interest_only_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the interest-only period expires and principal amortization payments commence. Applicable for hybrid and partial-amortization instruments. Null for fully amortizing loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applicable to the debt instrument expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.065000 for 6.5%). For variable-rate instruments, reflects the current all-in rate including spread over the index.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the lender to this debt instrument. Used for lender correspondence, covenant reporting, and CMBS/RMBS pool identification. Maps to the loan reference number in Yardi Voyager Debt Management and SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement standards

attributes.name: loan_term_months
attributes.description: Contractual duration of the debt instrument in months from origination to scheduled maturity. Used for debt maturity ladder analysis and refinancing pipeline planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: ltv_covenant_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio permitted under the loan agreement before a covenant breach is triggered. Drives automated covenant monitoring alerts and lender notification workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404 financial controls

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio calculated as outstanding principal balance divided by the appraised or market value of the collateral property. Key covenant metric monitored against lender thresholds for compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IVSC Valuation Standards; SEC Regulation S-X for REITs

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Contractual date on which the outstanding principal balance is due in full. Critical for refinancing planning, balloon payment scheduling, and WALT/WALE analysis in portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: next_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled debt service payment is due. Used for cash management, AP payment scheduling in Yardi Voyager, and covenant compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: original_principal
attributes.description: Total principal amount of the debt instrument at origination. Serves as the baseline for LTV calculations, amortization schedules, and historical debt capacity analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the debt instrument was originated and funds were first disbursed. Marks the effective start of the debt obligation and is used for amortization schedule calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: origination_fee
attributes.description: Upfront fee paid to the lender at loan origination, typically expressed as points (percentage of loan amount). Capitalized as debt issuance cost and amortized over the loan term per FASB ASC 835.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 835 Interest; FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid principal balance of the debt instrument as of the most recent payment date. Used for LTV ratio monitoring, balance sheet reporting, and DSCR covenant compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which scheduled debt service payments (principal and interest) are due under the loan agreement. Drives payment schedule generation and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: prepayment_lockout_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the borrower is permitted to prepay the loan without triggering a lockout penalty. Null if no lockout period applies. Critical for disposition and refinancing timing decisions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_type
attributes.description: Type of prepayment restriction or penalty applicable to early loan payoff. Yield maintenance and defeasance are common in CMBS structures. Drives refinancing cost analysis and disposition planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement standards

attributes.name: rate_index
attributes.description: Benchmark interest rate index to which a variable-rate instrument is tied (e.g., SOFR, Prime Rate, Treasury). Null for fixed-rate instruments. Required for interest rate risk management and hedging analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; ARRC SOFR transition guidelines

attributes.name: rate_spread
attributes.description: Contractual spread in basis points expressed as a decimal added to the benchmark index to determine the all-in interest rate for variable-rate instruments (e.g., 0.020000 for 200 bps over SOFR). Null for fixed-rate instruments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interest rate structure. Fixed Rate Mortgage (FRM) maintains a constant rate; variable/Adjustable Rate Mortgage (ARM) floats against a benchmark index; hybrid combines both periods.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; ARM/FRM industry standards

attributes.name: recourse_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender has recourse to the borrower's other assets beyond the collateral property in the event of default. Non-recourse is standard for CMBS; full recourse is common for construction loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SNDA Agreement standards

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total scheduled periodic debt service payment amount including both principal and interest components. Used for cash flow forecasting, NOI impact analysis, and DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: servicer_name
attributes.description: Name of the loan servicer responsible for collecting payments and managing escrow accounts, particularly relevant for CMBS instruments where the servicer differs from the originating lender.
attributes.references: CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement standards; FASB ASC 470

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this debt instrument record was sourced (e.g., Yardi Voyager, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across systems.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 data lineage requirements

attributes.name: source_system_loan_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this debt instrument in the originating source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Enables bi-directional reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 data lineage requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this debt instrument record was most recently modified in the data platform. Required for incremental data pipeline processing and SOX audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 data integrity

products.name: debt_service_payment
products.description: Records of scheduled and actual debt service payments (principal and interest) made against debt instruments. Supports DSCR calculations, cash flow modeling, and lender covenant reporting. Attributes include payment date, scheduled date, payment type (principal, interest, escrow), scheduled principal amount, scheduled interest amount, actual principal paid, actual interest paid, outstanding balance after payment, payment status, and late fee amount.
products.reference: Debt Service Payment — Yardi Voyager Debt / SAP S/4HANA TRM

attributes.name: debt_service_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each debt service payment record. Primary key for the debt_service_payment data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property or asset securing or associated with the debt instrument. Enables property-level DSCR calculations and NOI-to-debt-service analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Property Module

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: debt_service_payment has bank_account_reference as a denormalized STRING but lacks a proper FK to finance.bank_account. Debt service payments are disbursed from specific property-level or corporate ba
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the GL account to which this debt service payment is posted. Ensures accurate financial consolidation and SOX-compliant audit trails.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA GL Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this debt service obligation. Supports GL allocation and financial consolidation under SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: RE debt service payments for international properties require validated currency references for payment processing, exchange rate application, and DSCR covenant monitoring in functional currency. Repl
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: debt_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.debt_facility. Business justification: Debt service payments are made against specific investment-domain debt facilities. This link enables covenant compliance monitoring, DSCR calculation, and debt service coverage reporting by connecting
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: debt_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent debt instrument (loan, mortgage, bond, or credit facility) against which this payment is applied. Used to link payments to the originating debt obligation for DSCR and covenant reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 — Debt; Yardi Voyager Loan Management Module

attributes.name: lender_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lending institution or counterparty to whom the debt service payment is remitted. Used for lender covenant reporting and cash management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio to which the debt-encumbered property belongs. Supports portfolio-level debt service aggregation and DSCR roll-up reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: actual_escrow_paid
attributes.description: The actual escrow amount remitted to the lender for this payment period. Compared against scheduled_escrow_amount to identify escrow shortfalls or surpluses.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; HUD Escrow Requirements; Yardi Voyager Escrow Module

attributes.name: actual_interest_paid
attributes.description: The actual interest amount remitted to the lender for this payment. Compared against scheduled_interest_amount to identify variances. Feeds into interest expense reporting on the P&L.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; Yardi Voyager Loan Payment Module

attributes.name: actual_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the debt service payment was actually remitted to the lender. Compared against scheduled_payment_date to determine timeliness and trigger late fee calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Yardi Voyager AP Payment Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: actual_principal_paid
attributes.description: The actual principal amount remitted to the lender for this payment. Compared against scheduled_principal_amount to identify shortfalls or prepayments. Used to update the outstanding loan balance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Yardi Voyager Loan Payment Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The internal approval workflow status for this debt service payment. Ensures SOX-compliant dual-control authorization before payment disbursement.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Approval Workflow; Yardi Voyager AP Approval

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or user identifier of the individual who authorized this debt service payment in the internal approval workflow. Required for SOX-compliant audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Authorization; Yardi Voyager AP Approval

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the debt service payment was approved by the authorized approver. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial disbursements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: covenant_breach_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the type of lender covenant breach triggered by this payment event. Null or 'none' when no breach occurred. Used for lender reporting and risk management escalation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Lender Covenant Agreement; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this debt service payment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX-compliant record-keeping.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of calendar days by which the actual payment date exceeded the scheduled payment date. Zero for on-time payments. Used for lender covenant monitoring, late fee calculation, and credit risk reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Lender Covenant Agreement; Yardi Voyager Loan Module

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting fiscal period (YYYY-MM) to which this debt service payment is attributed. Used for period-level P&L reporting, DSCR calculations, and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA Period-End Close; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days after the scheduled payment date within which payment may be made without triggering a late fee or covenant breach, as defined in the loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Loan Agreement Grace Period Provisions

attributes.name: interest_rate_applied
attributes.description: The effective annual interest rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.065 for 6.5%) applied to calculate the interest component of this payment. Captures the rate in effect for the period, which may vary for adjustable-rate mortgages (ARM).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; ARM/FRM Loan Agreement Terms

attributes.name: is_covenant_breach
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment event triggered a lender covenant breach (e.g., missed payment, DSCR threshold violation, LTV breach). Drives escalation workflows and lender notification requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Lender Covenant Agreement; SEC Reporting for REITs

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: The penalty fee charged by the lender for a payment received after the scheduled due date or grace period. Tracked separately for covenant compliance reporting and expense analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Loan Agreement Terms; Yardi Voyager Loan Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context or commentary on this debt service payment, such as reasons for partial payment, lender waiver details, or manual adjustment explanations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Loan Module; SAP S/4HANA Payment Notes

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_after
attributes.description: The remaining outstanding principal balance of the debt instrument immediately after this payment is applied. Critical for Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio monitoring, DSCR calculations, and lender covenant compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; LTV Covenant Monitoring; Argus Enterprise; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_before
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of the debt instrument immediately before this payment is applied. Used to verify interest calculations and track amortization progress.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Argus Enterprise Debt Schedule; Yardi Voyager Loan Module

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to remit the debt service payment to the lender (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check). Used for cash management, bank reconciliation, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Payment Module; SAP S/4HANA Payment Run

attributes.name: payment_period_number
attributes.description: The sequential payment period number within the loan amortization schedule (e.g., payment 1 of 360 for a 30-year mortgage). Used to track amortization progress and validate payment schedules.
attributes.references: Loan Amortization Schedule; Argus Enterprise Debt Modeling; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for this debt service payment, as assigned by the source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA) or the lender's payment portal. Used for reconciliation and lender confirmation matching.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Loan Payment Module; SAP S/4HANA AP Payment Run

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the debt service payment. Drives DSCR monitoring, lender covenant alerts, and cash flow forecasting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|pending|paid|partial|late|missed|reversed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Yardi Voyager Loan Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the debt service payment was posted to the General Ledger. May differ from actual_payment_date due to period-end cut-off rules. Critical for SOX-compliant financial period reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA GL Posting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The penalty amount charged by the lender for early repayment of principal beyond the scheduled amortization. Relevant for disposition planning and refinancing analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Loan Agreement Prepayment Provisions; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest rate for this payment period is fixed (FRM), variable/adjustable (ARM), or hybrid. Relevant for interest rate risk analysis and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; ARM/FRM Loan Agreement Terms

attributes.name: scheduled_escrow_amount
attributes.description: The contractually scheduled escrow deposit amount due for this payment period, covering property taxes, insurance, and reserves as required by the lender. Included in total debt service obligation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; HUD Escrow Requirements; Yardi Voyager Escrow Module

attributes.name: scheduled_interest_amount
attributes.description: The contractually scheduled interest payment amount due for this payment period, calculated based on the outstanding loan balance and the applicable interest rate. Core component of total debt service for DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; Argus Enterprise Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed date on which the debt service payment is due to the lender, as defined in the loan agreement or amortization schedule. Used for cash flow modeling and covenant compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Argus Enterprise Cash Flow Modeling; Loan Amortization Schedule

attributes.name: scheduled_principal_amount
attributes.description: The contractually scheduled principal repayment amount due for this payment period, as defined in the loan amortization schedule. Used as the baseline for DSCR numerator calculations and variance analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Argus Enterprise DCF Modeling; Loan Amortization Schedule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this debt service payment record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system_payment_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this payment record in the originating source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount actually remitted to the lender for this payment, representing the sum of actual principal, interest, escrow, and any late fees paid. Used for cash management reconciliation and lender statement matching.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Yardi Voyager Loan Payment Module; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this debt service payment record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks changes for audit trail and SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: wire_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The bank-issued confirmation or transaction reference number for wire transfer or ACH payments. Used for payment reconciliation against lender statements and bank records.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA Bank Communication Management

products.name: financial_period_close
products.description: Fiscal calendar periods and month-end/year-end financial close management for each legal entity. Defines when GL postings are open or closed and tracks close process execution — task completion, sign-off milestones, and SOX control checkpoints. Ensures completeness of GL postings, AR/AP reconciliations, and intercompany eliminations before period lock. Attributes include fiscal year, period number, period name, start/end dates, period status (open, closed, locked), close type (monthly, quarterly, annual), target/actual close dates, outstanding task count, SOX sign-off flag, controller sign-off, and close timestamp.
products.reference: Period Close — SAP S/4HANA FI Period Close / Yardi Voyager Close Process

attributes.name: financial_period_close_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each financial period close record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_engagement. Business justification: Real estate period-end close is directly tied to audit engagements — external auditors review close packages and the close cannot be finalized without audit sign-off. The financial_period_close has so
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: RE period close processes for multi-currency portfolios require validated currency references for currency translation completeness checks, bank reconciliation sign-off, and consolidated financial sta
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (company code) for which this fiscal period close is being managed. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA company code and Yardi Voyager entity structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the real estate investment portfolio associated with this period close, enabling portfolio-level P&L roll-up and NOI reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; REIT SEC Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_framework_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.regulatory_framework. Business justification: RE period close procedures are governed by specific regulatory frameworks (SOX Section 302/404, GAAP ASC 842, IFRS 16) that dictate sign-off requirements, control documentation, and reporting deadline
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: Real estate period close procedures are governed by specific SOX controls (period-end close controls, reconciliation sign-off controls). The financial_period_close has sox_sign_off_flag indicating SOX
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accrual_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of period-end accrual journal entries including CAM expense accruals, property tax accruals, insurance accruals, and deferred rent. Must be 'posted' before period close gate.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Accruals; FASB ASC 420; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the period was actually closed and locked. Compared against target_close_date to measure close efficiency and identify process bottlenecks.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit

attributes.name: ap_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the AP sub-ledger to GL reconciliation for this period. Must reach 'completed' before period lock. Covers vendor invoices, CAPEX accruals, and operating expense payables in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; FASB ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: ar_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the AR sub-ledger to GL reconciliation for this period. Must reach 'completed' before period lock. Tracks tenant rent roll, CAM charges, and percentage rent AR balances in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: bank_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of bank account reconciliation for all operating and escrow accounts associated with the legal entity for this period. Must be 'completed' before period lock per SOX cash management controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Yardi Voyager Cash Management; SAP S/4HANA Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: cfo_sign_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CFO has provided final sign-off on the period close for SEC certification purposes (True = CFO signed off; False = pending). Required for quarterly and annual close cycles under SOX Section 302.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 13a-14

attributes.name: cfo_sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the CFO provided final sign-off on the period close. Null if not yet signed. Provides the authoritative executive certification timestamp for SEC filings.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: close_days_variance
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the actual close date differed from the target close date (positive = late, negative = early, zero = on time). Used for close process performance benchmarking and continuous improvement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit; Internal Close Calendar KPI

attributes.name: close_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the period status was set to 'closed' or 'locked'. Provides the authoritative audit trail timestamp for SOX compliance and financial reporting cutoff.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 855 Subsequent Events

attributes.name: close_type
attributes.description: Classification of the close cycle: monthly (standard month-end), quarterly (Q-end with additional procedures), annual (year-end with full audit package), or adjustment (out-of-cycle correction period). Drives the task checklist and SOX control scope.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 270; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit

attributes.name: completed_task_count
attributes.description: Number of close checklist tasks that have been completed and signed off as of the last record update. Enables close progress percentage calculation for management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: controller_sign_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Controller or Chief Accounting Officer has formally signed off on the period close, certifying the completeness and accuracy of the financial statements (True = signed off; False = pending).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 855; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: controller_sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the Controller formally signed off on the period close. Null if sign-off has not yet occurred. Used as the authoritative certification timestamp for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 855 Subsequent Events

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this financial period close record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Provides the audit trail for record origination.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Enterprise Data Governance

attributes.name: depreciation_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of fixed asset depreciation journal entry posting for this period. Covers building depreciation, tenant improvement (TI) amortization, and CAPEX asset depreciation as managed in Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The four-digit fiscal year to which this period close belongs (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the legal entity's fiscal calendar as configured in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 270; SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: gl_posting_completeness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all expected GL journal entries (accruals, prepayments, depreciation, CAM reconciliations, NOI adjustments) have been posted for this period (True = complete; False = postings outstanding).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: gl_posting_open_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GL journal entries can currently be posted to this period (True = postings allowed; False = period is closed to new postings). Directly controls transaction entry in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA Posting Period Variant

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_status
attributes.description: Status of intercompany transaction elimination processing for this period close. Required for consolidated financial statements across legal entities in SAP S/4HANA. Must be 'completed' before annual close lock.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: noi_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of NOI-related GL journal entries (EGI, OPEX, vacancy adjustments) for this period. NOI is the primary performance metric for real estate assets and must be fully posted before period lock.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager NOI Reporting; Argus Enterprise; NCREIF Property Index Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for Controller or accounting team to document significant period-end events, accounting policy decisions, material adjustments, or exceptions that affected this close cycle (e.g., 'Q3 includes one-time lease termination fee for Tenant ABC').
attributes.references: FASB ASC 855 Subsequent Events; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: outstanding_task_count
attributes.description: Number of close checklist tasks that remain incomplete at the time of record update. Used to track close progress and gate period lock until all tasks are resolved. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit task management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: period_close_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this period close record, used in cross-system references between Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA (e.g., 'FY2024-M03-ENT001').
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the fiscal period. Defines the inclusive upper bound for GL postings, rent roll cutoffs, and CAM reconciliation accruals.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Period Control

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the fiscal period (e.g., 'March 2024', 'Q1 FY2024', 'Year-End 2024'). Used in financial reports, NOI statements, and EBITDA roll-ups.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 270 Interim Reporting; Yardi Voyager Period Labels

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential numeric identifier of the fiscal period within the fiscal year (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly, or 13/16 for adjustment periods). Sourced from Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA period definitions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Fiscal Calendar; SAP S/4HANA Posting Period

attributes.name: period_start_date

attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision record was formally approved. Provides an audit trail for SOX-compliant financial controls.

attributes.name: book_tax_difference
attributes.description: The aggregate difference between book income and taxable income for the provision period, encompassing permanent and temporary differences. Key input for deferred tax calculation and FASB ASC 740 rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor required for SOX-compliant financial controls.

attributes.name: current_tax_expense
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to taxes currently payable or recoverable in the current period. Represents the actual tax liability due to taxing authorities for the provision period, per FASB ASC 740.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: deferred_tax_asset
attributes.description: The deferred tax asset balance arising from temporary differences, net operating loss (NOL) carryforwards, and tax credit carryforwards that will reduce future taxable income. Critical for REIT entities with depreciation timing differences.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_expense
attributes.description: The net change in deferred tax assets and liabilities during the provision period. A positive value represents deferred tax expense; a negative value represents a deferred tax benefit. Supports FASB ASC 740 income tax footnote disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: deferred_tax_liability
attributes.description: The deferred tax liability balance arising from temporary differences where taxable income will exceed book income in future periods. Common in real estate due to accelerated depreciation (MACRS) versus straight-line book depreciation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-25; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of total income tax expense to pre-tax income, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%). Used for FASB ASC 740 rate reconciliation disclosures and REIT tax efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-50; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: filing_due_date
attributes.description: The statutory deadline by which the tax return or payment associated with this provision must be filed with the relevant taxing authority. Supports tax compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: IRS; State Revenue Authorities; Local Tax Authorities

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (quarterly or monthly) within the fiscal year for this provision. Supports interim tax provision calculations required under FASB ASC 740-270. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Q1|Q2|Q3|Q4|M01|M02|M03|M04|M05|M06|M07|M08|M09|M10|M11|M12|Annual — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this tax provision belongs. Used for annual tax provision roll-ups, REIT distribution testing, and SOX-compliant financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: nol_carryforward
attributes.description: The cumulative net operating loss carryforward balance available to offset future taxable income. Tracked per entity and jurisdiction for REIT tax planning and FASB ASC 740 deferred tax asset valuation.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 172; FASB ASC 740-10

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for tax preparer or reviewer commentary, including explanations of significant estimates, assumptions, or adjustments made in the provision calculation. Supports audit documentation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the tax payment associated with this provision is due to the taxing authority. May differ from the filing due date for estimated tax payments and installment obligations.
attributes.references: IRS; State Revenue Authorities; Local Tax Authorities

attributes.name: permanent_difference
attributes.description: The portion of the book-to-tax difference that will never reverse, such as non-deductible meals and entertainment, tax-exempt income, or REIT-specific permanent exclusions. Drives the effective tax rate reconciliation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-50; IRS

attributes.name: pretax_income
attributes.description: The book income before income taxes for the provision period, used as the base for effective tax rate calculation and FASB ASC 740 rate reconciliation. Sourced from the entity-level P&L in Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; FASB ASC 220

attributes.name: property_tax_accrual
attributes.description: The accrued property tax expense for the provision period, representing the estimated property tax liability recognized on a straight-line basis over the tax year. Sourced from Yardi Voyager property tax module.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: property_tax_assessed_value
attributes.description: The assessed value of the property as determined by the taxing authority, used as the basis for property tax calculation. Applicable when tax_type is 'property'. Supports property tax appeal and accrual management.
attributes.references: IAAO (International Association of Assessing Officers); Local Tax Authorities

attributes.name: property_tax_rate
attributes.description: The property tax rate (mill rate) applied to the assessed value to calculate the property tax obligation. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.012500 for 1.25%). Applicable when tax_type is 'property'.
attributes.references: Local Tax Authorities; IAAO

attributes.name: provision_number

attributes.name: provision_period_end
attributes.description: The last day of the fiscal or calendar period covered by this tax provision. Together with provision_period_start, defines the measurement window for current and deferred tax calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: provision_period_start
attributes.description: The first day of the fiscal or calendar period covered by this tax provision. Used to align provisions with reporting periods for FASB ASC 740 interim and annual calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the tax provision record, tracking progression from initial calculation through review, approval, filing, and closure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: provision_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the tax provision entry: current period tax, deferred tax movement, uncertain tax position reserve, periodic accrual, interim estimate, or year-end true-up adjustment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; FASB ASC 740-270

attributes.name: reit_distribution_deduction
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Distribution Deduction
attributes.description: The dividends-paid deduction claimed by a REIT entity to reduce taxable income. REITs must distribute at least 90% of taxable income to maintain REIT qualification and avoid corporate-level income tax.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 857; SEC Regulation S-X; NAREIT

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this tax provision data originated (e.g., Yardi Voyager, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this tax provision record in the originating source system (e.g., SAP document number, Yardi transaction ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Data Governance

attributes.name: statutory_tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable statutory (legal) tax rate for the filing jurisdiction and tax type in the provision period (e.g., 0.2100 for the US federal corporate rate). Used as the baseline for effective tax rate reconciliation under FASB ASC 740.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-50; IRS; State Revenue Authorities

attributes.name: tax_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total tax credits applied in the provision period, including Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC), Historic Tax Credits, energy efficiency credits, and other applicable real estate tax incentives.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 42 (LIHTC); IRS IRC Section 47 (Historic); FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: tax_return_basis
attributes.description: The accounting basis used for the tax return filing associated with this provision (cash, accrual, or modified accrual). Relevant for identifying book-to-tax differences driving deferred tax calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 538; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax obligation being provisioned. Income tax applies to REIT taxable income; property tax applies to real estate holdings; transfer tax applies to property dispositions; sales tax applies to taxable services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: income|property|transfer|sales|excise|franchise — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; IRS Publication 946; HUD; SEC

attributes.name: taxable_income
attributes.description: The income amount subject to tax after applying allowable deductions, exclusions, and REIT distribution deductions. For REITs, this reflects income after the dividends-paid deduction required to maintain REIT qualification.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 857 (REIT); FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: temporary_difference
attributes.description: The portion of the book-to-tax difference that will reverse in future periods, generating deferred tax assets or liabilities. In real estate, primarily driven by depreciation timing differences (MACRS vs. straight-line) and lease accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-25; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: total_tax_expense
attributes.description: The sum of current tax expense and deferred tax expense for the provision period. Represents the total income tax charge recognized in the income statement per FASB ASC 740.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: uncertain_tax_position_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate amount of unrecognized tax benefits related to uncertain tax positions under FASB ASC 740-10-25 (FIN 48). Represents tax positions where the technical merits do not meet the more-likely-than-not recognition threshold.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-25 (FIN 48); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Data Governance

attributes.name: valuation_allowance
attributes.description: The valuation allowance recorded against deferred tax assets when it is more likely than not that some or all of the deferred tax asset will not be realized. Required disclosure under FASB ASC 740-10-30.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30; FASB ASC 740-10-50

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of employee compensation and benefits across multiple cost centers in the real estate portfolio. It captures the financial distribution of workforce costs when employees work across multiple properties, departments, or business units. Each record links one employee to one cost center with allocation percentage, effective dates, and primary assignment flag. This is essential for accurate NOI reporting, OPEX tracking, and multi-property financial consolidation in real estate operations.. Existence Justification: In real estate operations, employees (especially property managers, asset managers, and regional staff) are routinely allocated across multiple cost centers representing different properties or business units, with each cost center having multiple employees. The business actively manages these allocations with specific percentages, effective dates, and primary assignment flags for accurate NOI reporting and OPEX tracking. This is standard split-cost accounting in multi-property real estate firms.

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each cost allocation record

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the cost center receiving the allocated employee cost
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee whose compensation is being allocated
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the employee's total compensation and benefits allocated to this cost center. Must sum to 100% across all active allocations for an employee. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: allocation_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the split allocation (e.g., 'Multi-property portfolio manager', 'Shared services support', 'Regional oversight role'). Required for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allocation: active = in effect for GL posting; pending = approved but not yet effective; expired = past effective_end_date; cancelled = revoked before expiry

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cost allocation was formally approved for financial reporting

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cost allocation ceases to be active. Null indicates an open-ended allocation. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cost allocation becomes active for GL posting and financial reporting. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation to this cost center, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.50 for half-time). Used for headcount reporting and capacity planning. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: primary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the employee's primary cost center assignment for HR and operational purposes (e.g., physical workspace, manager reporting). Only one allocation per employee can be primary at any time. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

products.name: privacy_request
products.description: Manages data subject rights requests under GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations from tenants, prospects, employees, and other individuals. Covers subject access requests (SARs), right to erasure, data portability, consent withdrawals, objection to processing, and opt-out of sale (CCPA). Also serves as the registry for GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) — documenting processing purposes, legal bases, data categories, retention periods, third-party processors, and cross-border transfer mechanisms. Captures request type, requestor identity, date received, response deadline, processing status, response date, and outcome. Supports GDPR Articles 15-22 and 30 compliance, CCPA consumer rights, and tenant data privacy obligations.

products.name: esg_metric
products.description: Captures ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) performance metrics at the property and portfolio level for investor reporting and regulatory disclosure. Environmental metrics include energy consumption (kWh), water usage, GHG emissions (Scope 1/2/3 in CO2e), waste diversion rates, and renewable energy percentage. Social metrics cover affordable housing units, community investment, and tenant satisfaction. Governance metrics track board diversity, ethics violations, and anti-corruption measures. Each metric record captures the reporting period, measurement methodology, data source, and verification status. Supports ESG reporting frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD, GRESB) and REIT investor ESG disclosure requirements.
products.reference: ESG Performance Metric (GRESB / GRI / SASB / TCFD)

attributes.description: The calendar year in which this certification data was included in the organization's GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark) submission. Used to track ESG reporting cycles and benchmark performance year-over-year.
attributes.references: GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark); SEC Regulation S-K — ESG Disclosures

attributes.name: incentive_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific financial incentives, tax credits, or grants for which the property is eligible as a result of this certification (e.g., IRS Section 179D deduction, state property tax abatement, utility rebate program). Populated when incentive_eligible is True.
attributes.references: IRS Section 179D; U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) — Green Building Incentives

attributes.name: incentive_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property qualifies for financial incentives (tax credits, grants, reduced permit fees, expedited permitting) as a result of achieving this green certification. Supports CAPEX planning and investment advisory analysis.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) — Green Building Incentives; IRS Section 179D Energy Efficiency Deduction; State and Local Green Building Incentive Programs

attributes.name: leed_category_breakdown
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Category Breakdown
attributes.description: Structured summary of points earned across LEED credit categories (e.g., Sustainable Sites, Water Efficiency, Energy & Atmosphere, Materials & Resources, Indoor Environmental Quality, Innovation). Stored as a delimited string for LEED-type certifications; null for non-LEED certifications.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Credit Categories

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, conditions, exceptions, or observations related to the certification record (e.g., conditional certification notes, outstanding credit appeals, assessor observations, special circumstances affecting the certification outcome).
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: points_available
attributes.description: The maximum number of credits or points available under the applicable certification version and building type. Used to calculate the percentage score and determine the achievable certification level.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Rating System; BRE — BREEAM Technical Standards

attributes.name: points_scored
attributes.description: The total number of credits or points awarded to the property under the certification framework's scoring system (e.g., LEED points out of 110, BREEAM percentage score). Represents the principal quantitative outcome of the certification assessment.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Credit Categories; BRE — BREEAM Technical Standards

attributes.name: prerequisites_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether all mandatory prerequisites required by the certification framework have been satisfied. A value of True confirms all prerequisites are fulfilled; False indicates outstanding prerequisites that must be resolved before certification can be awarded.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Prerequisites; BRE — BREEAM Mandatory Credits

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the renewal application must be submitted to the certifying body to avoid lapse of certification. May differ from expiry_date if the certifying body requires advance submission. Supports compliance calendar and deadline management.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Recertification; BRE — BREEAM In-Use Renewal

attributes.name: renewal_in_progress
attributes.description: Indicates whether a renewal application for this certification is currently in progress with the certifying body. True if the renewal process has been initiated but not yet completed; False otherwise. Supports compliance monitoring and workflow management.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Recertification; BRE — BREEAM In-Use Renewal

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the physical scope of the certification — specifying which building, floor, wing, or portion of the property is covered by this certification record. Relevant for multi-building campuses or partial certifications.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Project Boundary; BRE — BREEAM Assessment Scope

attributes.name: score_percentage
attributes.description: The certification score expressed as a percentage of total available points (points_scored / points_available × 100). Used for cross-framework ESG benchmarking and portfolio-level green performance reporting.
attributes.references: BRE — BREEAM Technical Standards; ESG Reporting Frameworks; GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark)

attributes.name: supporting_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the certification documentation package stored in the document management system (e.g., DocuSign CLM, Procore document repository). Includes the official certificate, assessment report, and supporting evidence submitted to the certifying body.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Document Retention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this green certification record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

products.name: sox_control
products.description: Documents SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) internal controls and their testing history for publicly traded REITs. Captures control definitions (control ID, objective, type — preventive/detective, owner, frequency) and test execution records (tester identity, test approach — inquiry/observation/inspection/re-performance, sample size, exceptions, test conclusion, sign-off status). Covers financial reporting controls, IT general controls (ITGCs), and entity-level controls. Each control record maintains the full testing history including the most recent test date, result (effective/ineffective), and any remediation status for identified deficiencies. Supports SOX Section 302 certifications, Section 404 management assessments, and external auditor reliance testing for SEC-reporting REITs.

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control by its timing relative to the risk event: preventive (stops errors before they occur), detective (identifies errors after they occur), or corrective (remedies identified errors). Drives audit strategy and reliance decisions.

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Classification of any identified control deficiency per PCAOB/SEC definitions: none (no deficiency), control_deficiency (minor gap), significant_deficiency (important enough to merit attention but not material weakness), or material_weakness (reasonable possibility of material misstatement in SEC filings). Material weaknesses require public disclosure in the REIT's annual report.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SEC Release No. 33-8810; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: design_effectiveness
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the control is suitably designed to prevent or detect a material misstatement if it operates as intended. Evaluated separately from operating effectiveness. A design deficiency may result in a significant deficiency or material weakness.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of exceptions (deviations from the expected control operation) identified during the most recent test execution. A non-zero exception count triggers deficiency evaluation and may require expanded testing or remediation.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of exceptions identified during testing, including the nature of the deviation, root cause analysis, and potential financial statement impact (e.g., 'Lease commencement date not updated in Yardi Voyager within required 5-day window for 3 of 25 samples'). Null if no exceptions.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: external_auditor_reliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the external auditor (registered public accounting firm) has placed reliance on this control as part of their integrated audit under PCAOB AS 2201. True means the external auditor is relying on management's testing; False means the auditor is performing independent testing.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; PCAOB AS 2605; SOX Section 404b

attributes.name: financial_assertion
attributes.description: The PCAOB/AICPA financial reporting assertion addressed by the control: completeness (all transactions recorded), accuracy (correct amounts), existence (assets/liabilities exist), valuation (proper measurement), rights_obligations (entity owns/owes), or presentation (proper classification and disclosure).

attributes.description: The specific financial statement line item or account balance that the control addresses (e.g., 'Rental Revenue', 'Right-of-Use Asset', 'Lease Liability', 'Investment Property at Fair Value'). Links the control to the SEC/REIT financial reporting assertions.

attributes.name: is_key_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control is designated as a key control (True) — i.e., a control whose failure could result in a material misstatement in the REIT's SEC financial filings. Key controls receive enhanced testing and are included in the external auditor's reliance scope.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent test execution was completed. Used to assess whether the control has been tested within the required testing cycle and to determine if rollforward testing is needed for year-end reliance.

attributes.name: operating_effectiveness
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the control operated effectively throughout the testing period — i.e., it was applied consistently and as designed. Determined through test execution (inquiry, observation, inspection, re-performance). Drives the overall test conclusion.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; PCAOB AS 2301; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: The business process or cycle to which the control belongs (e.g., 'Lease Revenue Recognition', 'Property Acquisition and Disposition', 'Accounts Payable — CAM Reconciliation', 'Financial Close and Reporting', 'IT Access Management'). Aligns to the process-level scoping in the SOX risk and control matrix (RCM).
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control — Integrated Framework

attributes.name: remediation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the remediation plan and actions taken to address the identified control deficiency (e.g., 'Updated Yardi Voyager workflow to enforce mandatory lease commencement date entry; retrained property accounting team'). Null if no deficiency.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which management commits to completing remediation actions for an identified deficiency. Tracked against the fiscal year-end to assess whether the deficiency will be remediated before the Section 404 management assessment sign-off date.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Tracks the remediation lifecycle for identified deficiencies: not_applicable (no deficiency), open (deficiency identified, remediation not started), in_progress (remediation actions underway), remediated (management believes deficiency is resolved), or verified (remediation confirmed effective through re-testing).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SEC Release No. 33-8810

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who reviewed and approved the test workpapers and conclusion. Distinct from the tester. Supports the two-person review requirement for SOX documentation integrity.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Inherent risk rating assigned to the control area: high (significant risk of material misstatement), medium (moderate risk), or low (minimal risk). Drives testing frequency, sample size, and management attention. Assessed during the annual SOX scoping exercise.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Enterprise Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of transactions, documents, or instances selected for testing in the most recent test execution. Sample size is determined by control frequency and risk rating per PCAOB guidance (e.g., 25 for monthly controls, 60 for daily controls).
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2301; AICPA Audit Sampling Guide

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorized reviewer (e.g., SOX Manager, VP Internal Audit, CFO) formally approved the test results and conclusion. Required for Section 302 sub-certification and Section 404 management assessment documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: sign_off_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the test results: pending (awaiting reviewer sign-off), signed_off (approved by authorized reviewer), rejected (returned for rework), or escalated (elevated to senior management or audit committee due to deficiency severity).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record in which the control operates or is documented (e.g., 'Yardi Voyager', 'SAP S/4HANA', 'MRI Software', 'Argus Enterprise', 'DocuSign CLM'). Critical for ITGC scoping — automated controls inherit risk from their host application.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; PCAOB AS 2110

attributes.name: sox_section
attributes.description: The SOX section under which this control is evaluated: 302 (CEO/CFO quarterly certification of disclosure controls), 404a (annual management assessment of internal controls over financial reporting), or 404b (external auditor attestation — applicable to large accelerated filers). Determines reporting obligations for the REIT.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; SEC Release No. 33-8810

attributes.name: test_approach
attributes.description: The audit testing methodology applied to evaluate operating effectiveness: inquiry (interviews with control performers), observation (watching the control execute), inspection (reviewing evidence/documentation), re_performance (independently re-executing the control), or combination (multiple approaches). Per PCAOB AS 2301, re-performance provides the highest level of assurance.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2301; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: test_conclusion
attributes.description: Overall conclusion of the most recent test execution: effective (control operated as designed with no or immaterial exceptions), ineffective (control failed to operate as designed), or inconclusive (insufficient evidence to reach a conclusion, requiring additional testing).
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; PCAOB AS 2301; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tester_name
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who performed the most recent control test. May be an internal audit team member, management tester, or external auditor representative. Required for audit trail and sign-off accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; PCAOB AS 2301

attributes.name: tester_role
attributes.description: Role of the party who performed the test: internal_audit (in-house IA function), management (first-line or second-line management testing), external_auditor (Big 4 or registered public accounting firm), or co_sourced (third-party firm supporting internal audit). Determines reliance hierarchy for PCAOB purposes.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; PCAOB AS 2605

attributes.name: testing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by the most recent test execution. For year-end reliance, this is typically the fiscal year-end date (e.g., December 31). Determines whether rollforward testing is required.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2301; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: testing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by the most recent test execution. For annual controls, this is typically the fiscal year start date. For interim testing, this reflects the rollforward period start.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2301; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOX control record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to control definitions, test results, or remediation status for audit trail and change management purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: workpaper_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or hyperlink to the test workpaper stored in the audit management system (e.g., AuditBoard, Workiva, or SharePoint). Provides traceability from the control record to the supporting evidence for external auditor review.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_contested

attributes.name: is_mandatory_report

When true, drives the mandatory reporting workflow.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.39; GDPR Article 33; SEC Regulation FD; SOX Section 409

attributes.name: is_repeat_violation

attributes.name: leed_breeam_impact
