products.name: payroll_result
products.description: Individual employee-level payroll calculation results for each payroll run. Captures employee reference, payroll run reference, pay period dates, gross earnings by component (base salary, overtime, commission, bonus, allowances), pre-tax deductions (401k, HSA, FSA, medical/dental/vision premiums), federal/state/local tax withholdings, post-tax deductions, net pay, payment method (direct deposit, check), bank account reference, and YTD accumulators. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now. Supports W-2 preparation, payroll audits, and compensation analytics for real estate workforce.
products.reference: ADP Workforce Now — Employee Pay Statement / Payroll Detail

attributes.name: payroll_result_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual employee payroll calculation result record in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payroll Result Record

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's designated bank account for direct deposit of net pay. Null when payment method is check.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Employee Bank Account; NACHA ACH Standards

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Individual payroll result GL posting in real estate requires validated chart of accounts mapping for accurate labor cost classification (opex vs. capex, CAM-recoverable). gl_account_code is a denormal
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.compensation_plan. Business justification: Individual payroll results are calculated based on the employee's active compensation plan. Adding compensation_plan_id to payroll_result links each employee's pay calculation to the specific compensa
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Individual payroll result cost center allocation is required for real estate property-level labor cost reporting and NOI calculation. cost_center_code is a denormalized string; this FK enables validat
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee whose payroll was calculated in this run. Links to the workforce employee master record.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Employee Master

attributes.name: payroll_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch under which this result was calculated. Identifies the specific payroll processing cycle.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payroll Run

attributes.name: adp_payroll_result_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by ADP Workforce Now to this individual payroll result record. Used for reconciliation with the source system.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payroll Result Reference

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Total allowances paid in this pay period, including vehicle allowances, mobile phone allowances, and housing allowances for property managers or field staff.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Allowance Earnings; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when an authorized payroll administrator approved this result for payment disbursement. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payroll Approval Workflow; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: Gross base salary or regular hourly wage earnings for the pay period before any additions or deductions. Core compensation component for salaried and hourly employees.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Earnings; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus paid in this pay period. Includes signing bonuses, annual performance bonuses, and deal-closing incentives for real estate professionals.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Bonus Earnings; IRS Publication 15 Supplemental Wages

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission earnings paid in this pay period, typically applicable to brokers, leasing agents, and sales staff based on closed transactions or lease executions.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Commission Earnings; NAR Commission Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll result. Typically USD for US-based real estate operations; supports multi-currency for international portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ADP Workforce Now — Currency

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational department to which the employee's compensation is charged. Used for cost allocation across property management, development, brokerage, and corporate functions.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Department; SAP S/4HANA Cost Center

attributes.name: employee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's compensation arrangement at the time of this payroll result. Determines applicable overtime rules and tax treatment.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Employee Classification; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross earnings for this pay period based on W-4 filing status and allowances. Reported on IRS Form W-2 Box 2.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Federal Tax Withholding; IRS Publication 15; IRS Form W-2

attributes.name: gross_earnings_amount
attributes.description: Total gross earnings for the pay period, representing the sum of base salary, overtime, commission, bonus, and allowances before any deductions or tax withholdings.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Gross Pay; IRS Form W-2 Box 1 basis; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total regular hours worked by the employee during the pay period as recorded in ADP time and attendance. Used for overtime calculation and labor cost allocation to properties.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Time and Attendance; FLSA Section 7

attributes.name: is_void
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll result has been voided. True when the result was cancelled before or after payment, requiring a reversal entry in the General Ledger.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Void Payroll; SOX Section 404 Payroll Controls

attributes.name: local_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Local or municipal income tax withheld from the employee's earnings. Applicable in jurisdictions with city or county income taxes. Reported on IRS Form W-2 Box 19.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Local Tax Withholding; IRS Form W-2

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Medicare (HI) tax withheld, including the Additional Medicare Tax for high earners. Reported on IRS Form W-2 Box 6.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — FICA Medicare; IRS Publication 15; IRC Section 3101; ACA Additional Medicare Tax

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Final take-home pay disbursed to the employee after all pre-tax deductions, tax withholdings, and post-tax deductions are subtracted from gross earnings. Represents the actual amount deposited or paid by check.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Net Pay; IRS Form W-2; FLSA

attributes.name: overtime_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime pay earned during the pay period, calculated at 1.5x or 2x the regular rate for hours exceeding FLSA thresholds. Applicable to non-exempt employees.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Overtime Earnings; FLSA Section 7

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period exceeding the FLSA threshold. Drives overtime_amount calculation and labor compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Overtime Hours; FLSA Section 7

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the employee is paid. Determines the number of pay periods per year and the proration of annual salary components.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Pay Frequency; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll result. Together with pay_period_start_date defines the earnings window.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Pay Period; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll result. Defines the earnings window for time and attendance calculations.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Pay Period; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run type for this result. 'regular' = standard scheduled payroll; 'supplemental' = bonus or commission run; 'off_cycle' = manual correction; 'final' = termination pay; 'void_replacement' = reissued after void.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Pay Run Type; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date on which net pay is disbursed to the employee via direct deposit or check. Used for cash flow planning and W-2 tax year assignment.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Check Date; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. 'direct_deposit' = ACH transfer to bank account; 'check' = paper check; 'wire_transfer' = same-day wire; 'pay_card' = prepaid debit card.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payment Method; NACHA ACH Operating Rules

attributes.name: posttax_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Total post-tax deductions from the employee's pay, including Roth 401(k) contributions, garnishments, union dues, and voluntary after-tax benefit elections.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Post-Tax Deductions; IRS Publication 15; Consumer Credit Protection Act (wage garnishment)

attributes.name: pretax_401k_deduction
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contribution to the 401(k) retirement savings plan deducted from gross earnings. Reduces federal taxable wages. Subject to IRS annual contribution limits.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — 401k Deduction; IRS IRC Section 401(k); IRS Publication 560

attributes.name: pretax_dental_vision_deduction
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pre-Tax Dental and Vision Premium Deduction Amount
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax payroll deduction for employer-sponsored dental and vision insurance premiums under a Section 125 cafeteria plan.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Dental/Vision Premium Deduction; IRS IRC Section 125

attributes.name: pretax_fsa_deduction
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pre-Tax Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Deduction Amount
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contribution to a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare or dependent care expenses deducted from gross earnings.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — FSA Deduction; IRS IRC Section 125; IRS Publication 969

attributes.name: pretax_hsa_deduction
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pre-Tax Health Savings Account (HSA) Deduction Amount
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contribution to a Health Savings Account (HSA) deducted from gross earnings. Applicable only to employees enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP).
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — HSA Deduction; IRS IRC Section 223; IRS Publication 969

attributes.name: pretax_medical_deduction
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax payroll deduction for employer-sponsored medical insurance premiums under a Section 125 cafeteria plan.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Medical Premium Deduction; IRS IRC Section 125

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll result was calculated and finalized by the payroll processing engine in ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payroll Processing Log; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this payroll result. 'calculated' = computed but not yet approved; 'approved' = authorized for payment; 'paid' = disbursed to employee; 'voided' = cancelled before payment; 'reversed' = payment recalled after disbursement.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payroll Processing Workflow; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld at the applicable rate on wages up to the annual wage base. Reported on IRS Form W-2 Box 4.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — FICA Social Security; IRS Publication 15; IRC Section 3101

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: State income tax withheld from the employee's earnings for the primary work state. Reported on IRS Form W-2 Box 17. Varies by state tax jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — State Tax Withholding; IRS Form W-2; State Revenue Authorities

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the state in which the employee performed work during this pay period. Determines state income tax withholding jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Work State; IRS Form W-2 Box 15; ANSI INCITS 38

attributes.name: ytd_federal_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Cumulative federal income tax withheld from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Reported on IRS Form W-2 Box 2 at year-end.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — YTD Federal Tax; IRS Form W-2; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: ytd_gross_earnings
attributes.description: Cumulative gross earnings from the start of the calendar year through and including this pay period. Used for W-2 preparation, Social Security wage base tracking, and compensation analytics.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — YTD Accumulators; IRS Form W-2; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: ytd_net_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative net pay disbursed to the employee from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Supports payroll audit reconciliation and compensation reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — YTD Net Pay Accumulator; SOX Section 404

products.name: compensation_plan
products.description: Compensation structures and pay plans assigned to employees across the real estate enterprise. Captures compensation plan type (salary, hourly, commission-based, draw-against-commission for brokers/leasing agents, hybrid), base pay rate, pay frequency, commission rate schedule reference, bonus target percentage, effective date, expiration date, approval status, and the job profile and grade band it applies to. Brokers and leasing agents may have commission-only or draw-against-commission plans. Property managers may have base plus performance bonus. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now Compensation module.

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the compensation plan record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Compensation Module

attributes.name: geographic_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.geographic_hierarchy. Business justification: Real estate compensation plans are market-specific — broker pay bands and commission rates differ by MSA. Replaces denormalized geographic_market text field; enables market-benchmarked compensation an
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: grade_band_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pay grade band associated with this compensation plan, used to define salary ranges and pay equity tiers across the real estate enterprise.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job profile (role definition) to which this compensation plan applies, such as Property Manager, Leasing Agent, or Asset Manager.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Compensation plans in real estate enterprises are often scoped to specific organizational units — property management divisions, brokerage groups, development teams, or corporate functions. Adding org
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: superseded_by_plan_compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer compensation plan record that replaced this plan when it was superseded. Enables plan lineage tracking and historical compensation analysis. Null if this is the current active version.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SOX

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation plan received final approval from the authorized HR or finance approver. Required for SOX audit trail and compensation governance.
attributes.references: SOX; ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the compensation plan record. Draft plans are under construction; pending_approval awaits HR/finance sign-off; approved plans are active; rejected plans were declined; expired plans have passed their end date; superseded plans have been replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SOX Compensation Controls; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the HR or finance authority who approved this compensation plan. Required for SOX compensation controls and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX; ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA HCM

attributes.name: base_pay_rate
attributes.description: The base compensation rate assigned under this plan. For salaried employees this is the annual salary amount; for hourly employees this is the hourly rate. Expressed in the plan currency. Sensitive compensation data.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710; SOX

attributes.name: bonus_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which performance bonuses are evaluated and paid under this plan. Common in property management roles where NOI performance is assessed quarterly or annually.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: bonus_max_pct
attributes.description: The maximum achievable bonus as a percentage of base pay under this plan, representing the cap on performance-based bonus payouts. Used for compensation budgeting and NOI impact analysis.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710; SOX

attributes.name: bonus_target_pct
attributes.description: The target annual bonus expressed as a percentage of base pay for plans that include a performance bonus component (e.g., Property Manager base plus bonus). Null for commission-only or pure salary plans without bonus.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710; SOX

attributes.name: car_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Monthly vehicle allowance included in this compensation plan, commonly provided to property managers, asset managers, and brokers who travel between properties. Expressed in plan currency per month.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; IRS Publication 463; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: The transaction value base upon which the commission rate is applied. Gross Sale Price (PSF or total), Net Sale Price, Lease Value (total lease term value), Annual Rent (GRI), or Gross Commission Income (GCI) for split arrangements. Null for non-commission plans.
attributes.references: NAR; RESO; Salesforce CRM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission percentage applied to qualifying transaction values (e.g., sale price, lease value) for brokers and leasing agents. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 3.0000 = 3%). Null for non-commission plan types.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; NAR Commission Standards; Salesforce CRM Deal Pipeline

attributes.name: commission_schedule_ref
attributes.description: Reference code or identifier pointing to the detailed commission rate schedule document or table that governs tiered or variable commission structures for this plan. Links to the commission schedule master in ADP or Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; Salesforce CRM; NAR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compensation plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX; ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this compensation plan (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international real estate portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: draw_amount
attributes.description: For draw-against-commission plans, the periodic advance amount paid to the broker or leasing agent against future earned commissions. Expressed in plan currency per pay period. Null for non-draw plan types.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; NAR; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: draw_recovery_method
attributes.description: Specifies whether the draw advance is recoverable (must be repaid from future commissions if earned commissions are insufficient) or non-recoverable (forgiven if commissions do not cover the draw). Critical for broker compensation accounting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710; NAR

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation plan becomes binding and active for the assigned job profile and grade band. Aligns with payroll cycle start dates in ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710; SOX

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: The employment classification for which this plan is applicable. Independent contractor is common for brokers; full_time for property managers and corporate staff. Affects tax treatment and benefit eligibility.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; IRS Worker Classification; FLSA

attributes.name: equity_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees under this compensation plan are eligible for equity-based compensation (e.g., REIT stock grants, restricted stock units, or partnership interests). Relevant for senior AM and executive roles.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SEC REIT Regulations; FASB ASC 718

attributes.name: equity_grant_target_pct
attributes.description: Target equity grant expressed as a percentage of base pay for eligible employees under this plan. Used for long-term incentive planning in REIT and investment management roles. Null if equity_eligible is False.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SEC REIT Regulations; FASB ASC 718

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation plan ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended plan with no defined end date. Used for plan versioning and renewal workflows.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.description: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) classification for employees under this plan. Exempt employees are not entitled to overtime; non-exempt employees are entitled to overtime pay; highly_compensated applies to employees meeting the HCE threshold.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); U.S. Department of Labor; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: housing_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Monthly housing allowance included in this compensation plan, applicable to on-site property managers or resident managers who may receive housing as part of their compensation package.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; IRS Publication 15-B; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: license_stipend_amount
attributes.description: Annual stipend provided to employees for maintaining required professional licenses and certifications (e.g., real estate broker license, appraiser credentials, LEED certification). Expressed in plan currency per year.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; NAR; Appraisal Institute; USGBC LEED

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees under this compensation plan are eligible for overtime pay under FLSA regulations. True for non-exempt hourly workers; False for exempt salaried employees.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); ADP Workforce Now; OSHA

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which employees under this plan are paid (e.g., biweekly, semimonthly). Drives payroll cycle configuration in ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The pay grade designation within the compensation structure (e.g., G5, M3, E2). Defines the salary band range and career level for the role. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA HCM grade definitions.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management

attributes.name: pay_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates the unit basis for the base_pay_rate field: annual salary, hourly rate, monthly rate, or weekly rate. Determines how payroll calculations are performed in ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this compensation plan within ADP Workforce Now and downstream HR/payroll systems. Used for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Compensation Module

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the compensation plan's purpose, eligibility criteria, special provisions, and any unique terms applicable to specific roles such as broker draw arrangements or resident manager housing benefits.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the compensation plan (e.g., 'Broker Commission-Only Plan', 'Property Manager Base + Bonus', 'Leasing Agent Draw-Against-Commission').
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Compensation Module

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compensation structure. Salary for salaried employees, hourly for hourly workers, commission_only for brokers/leasing agents on pure commission, draw_against_commission for brokers receiving advances against future commissions, base_plus_commission for hybrid roles, base_plus_bonus for property managers with performance bonuses, hybrid for multi-component plans. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salary|hourly|commission_only|draw_against_commission|base_plus_commission|base_plus_bonus|hybrid — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; NAR Compensation Standards; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: salary_range_max
attributes.description: The maximum base pay rate defined for this compensation plan's grade band. Caps the base pay for the associated job profile and grade, used for budget control and compensation governance.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA HCM; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: salary_range_midpoint
attributes.description: The midpoint of the salary range for this compensation plan's grade band. Used as the market reference point for compa-ratio calculations and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA HCM; WorldatWork Total Rewards

attributes.name: salary_range_min
attributes.description: The minimum base pay rate defined for this compensation plan's grade band. Used for pay equity analysis, offer management, and compensation benchmarking against market data.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA HCM; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system of record for this compensation plan record. ADP for ADP Workforce Now, SAP for SAP S/4HANA HCM, MANUAL for records entered directly into the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA; Enterprise Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system_plan_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this compensation plan in the originating source system (e.g., ADP Workforce Now plan ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; Enterprise Data Governance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compensation plan record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this compensation plan record. Incremented each time the plan is revised and re-approved. Supports plan history tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SOX; FASB ASC 710

attributes.name: workforce_segment
attributes.description: The business segment or functional area for which this compensation plan is designed. Drives plan applicability rules and reporting segmentation across the real estate enterprise. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: brokerage|property_management|asset_management|development|corporate|leasing|facility_operations — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA HCM; ULI Workforce Standards

products.name: benefit
products.description: Catalog of employee benefit plans offered by the real estate enterprise and employee enrollment/election records for each plan year. Plan data captures plan name, type (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401k, HSA, FSA, commuter, EAP), carrier, plan year, coverage tiers, premium contributions, deductibles, 401k match formula, vesting schedule, and eligibility criteria. Enrollment data captures employee reference, enrollment event type (new hire, open enrollment, qualifying life event), coverage tier elected, contribution amounts, dependent coverage, effective dates, waiver indicator, and enrollment status. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration module. Supports ACA compliance reporting (1095-C), benefits cost allocation, and COBRA administration for terminated employees.

attributes.name: benefit_id
attributes.description: Primary key for benefit

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee enrolled in or associated with this benefit plan record. Links to the workforce employee master.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 715 Compensation — Retirement Benefits

attributes.name: aca_offer_of_coverage_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Offer of Coverage Code
attributes.description: IRS-defined code (1A–1I) reported on Form 1095-C Line 14 indicating the type of health coverage offered to the employee and their dependents for each month of the plan year. Required for ACA employer shared responsibility reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 6056; IRS Form 1095-C Instructions; IRS Section 4980H

attributes.name: aca_safe_harbor_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Safe Harbor Code
attributes.description: IRS-defined code (2A–2I) reported on Form 1095-C Line 16 indicating the applicable safe harbor or relief provision used by the employer for ACA employer shared responsibility penalty avoidance.
attributes.references: ACA Section 6056; IRS Form 1095-C Instructions; IRS Section 4980H

attributes.name: annual_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual out-of-pocket deductible amount the employee must satisfy before the plan begins paying covered expenses. Applicable to medical, dental, and vision plans. Used in employee benefits communications and plan comparison analytics.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 1302; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier, financial institution, or third-party administrator (TPA) providing the benefit plan (e.g., Aetna, Delta Dental, Fidelity Investments, WageWorks). Used for carrier billing reconciliation and employee communications.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; ERISA

attributes.name: carrier_plan_code
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned plan identifier used for EDI 834 benefit enrollment transactions and carrier billing reconciliation. Distinct from the internal plan_code.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: cobra_election_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which the employee or qualified beneficiary must elect COBRA continuation coverage (60 days from the later of coverage loss date or COBRA notice date). Used for COBRA administration compliance tracking.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1165); DOL COBRA Regulations; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee or dependent is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event (e.g., termination, reduction in hours). Drives COBRA notice generation and administration.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); DOL COBRA Regulations; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Coverage tier elected by the employee, defining who is covered under the plan. Drives premium contribution amounts and dependent eligibility. Standard tiers: employee only, employee + spouse, employee + child(ren), employee + family.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; ACA Section 4980H; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents enrolled under the employee's benefit plan election. Used for coverage tier validation, carrier eligibility feeds, and ACA 1095-C Part III reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1001; IRS Form 1095-C; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: dependent_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has elected dependent coverage under this benefit plan. True when one or more dependents are enrolled. Drives ACA 1095-C Part III dependent reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1001; IRS Form 1095-C; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: disability_benefit_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the employee's base salary replaced by the disability benefit plan (short-term or long-term disability). Applicable when plan_type = 'disability'. Used in total compensation reporting and workforce planning.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; ADP Workforce Now; ERISA

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee's coverage under this benefit plan ends. Null for currently active enrollments. Triggers COBRA notification requirements upon termination of coverage.
attributes.references: COBRA; ACA Section 4980H; ERISA; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee's coverage under this benefit plan becomes effective. Used for payroll deduction start, carrier eligibility feeds, and ACA minimum essential coverage determination.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H; ERISA; IRS Publication 15-B; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of the eligibility rules for this benefit plan, including minimum hours worked, employment classification (full-time, part-time), waiting period, and applicable employee groups (e.g., property managers, brokers, corporate staff).
attributes.references: ERISA; ACA Section 4980H; IRS Publication 15-B; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: employee_hsa_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Health Savings Account (HSA) Contribution Amount
attributes.description: Annual employee contribution amount elected for a Health Savings Account (HSA). Applicable only when plan_type = 'HSA'. Subject to IRS annual contribution limits. Used for payroll deduction and W-2 Box 12 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Section 223; IRS Publication 969; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: employee_premium_amount
attributes.description: Per-pay-period premium amount deducted from the employee's paycheck for this benefit plan. Used for payroll deduction configuration and benefits cost allocation reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; ADP Workforce Now Payroll; FASB ASC 715

attributes.name: employer_hsa_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) Contribution Amount
attributes.description: Annual employer seed contribution to the employee's Health Savings Account (HSA). Applicable only when plan_type = 'HSA'. Reported on W-2 Box 12 Code W.
attributes.references: IRS Section 223; IRS Publication 969; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: employer_match_formula
attributes.description: Textual description of the employer's 401(k) matching contribution formula (e.g., '100% match on first 3% of compensation, 50% match on next 2%'). Applicable when plan_type = '401k'. Used in employee communications and total compensation reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: employer_match_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of eligible compensation the employer will match under the 401(k) plan. Used for benefits cost modeling, OPEX budgeting, and total compensation analytics.
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: employer_premium_amount
attributes.description: Per-pay-period premium amount contributed by the employer for this benefit plan. Used for benefits cost allocation to property management, development, and corporate cost centers (OPEX tracking).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 715; IRS Publication 15-B; ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA Cost Allocation

attributes.name: enrollment_event_type
attributes.description: The triggering event that initiated this benefit enrollment or change. Determines the enrollment window and permissible elections under IRS and ERISA rules.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 701; IRS Section 125; ACA; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employee's enrollment in this benefit plan. Enrolled indicates active coverage; waived indicates the employee declined coverage; COBRA_elected indicates post-termination continuation coverage.
attributes.references: ERISA; COBRA; ACA 1095-C; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the benefit enrollment record was first created in ADP Workforce Now. Serves as the audit trail anchor for the enrollment lifecycle and supports SOX financial controls over payroll deductions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ADP Workforce Now; ERISA

attributes.name: fsa_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Annual employee contribution amount elected for a Flexible Spending Account (FSA). Applicable when plan_type = 'FSA'. Subject to IRS annual contribution limits and use-it-or-lose-it rules.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; IRS Publication 969; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the benefit enrollment record in ADP Workforce Now. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer ingestion pipeline and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ADP Workforce Now; ERISA

attributes.name: life_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Face value of life insurance coverage elected by the employee. Applicable when plan_type = 'life'. Amounts exceeding $50,000 of employer-paid coverage are subject to imputed income under IRS Section 79.
attributes.references: IRS Section 79; IRS Publication 15-B; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_amount
attributes.description: Maximum annual out-of-pocket cost the employee is responsible for under the plan, after which the plan covers 100% of covered expenses. ACA-mandated limit for qualified health plans.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302; IRS Publication 15-B; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the benefit plan by the carrier or the enterprise HR system (ADP Workforce Now). Used as the business identifier for plan lookup and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit plan as presented to employees (e.g., 'Aetna PPO Gold', 'Delta Dental Premier', 'Fidelity 401(k) Plan'). Used in employee-facing communications and ACA reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; ACA 1095-C Reporting

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit plan offering. Active plans are available for enrollment; terminated plans are closed to new elections; suspended plans are temporarily unavailable.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; ERISA

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan. Drives eligibility rules, tax treatment, and ACA compliance logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life|disability|401k|HSA|FSA|commuter|EAP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 4980H; ERISA; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal year for which this benefit plan is offered (e.g., 2024). Used to segment plan configurations, premium rates, and enrollment windows by year for ACA 1095-C reporting and cost allocation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 6055/6056; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the benefit plan year. Defines when current coverage terms, premium rates, and contribution limits expire. Used for COBRA administration and ACA reporting period boundaries.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 4980H; COBRA

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the benefit plan year. Defines the effective start of coverage terms, premium rates, deductibles, and contribution limits for the plan year.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 4980H

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premium contributions are deducted from payroll or billed to the employer. Must align with the payroll cycle configured in ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Payroll; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: retirement_employee_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Employee's elected contribution rate as a percentage of eligible compensation for the 401(k) or retirement plan. Applicable when plan_type = '401k'. Used for payroll deduction calculation and IRS annual limit compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total per-pay-period premium for this benefit plan (employee + employer contributions combined). Used for carrier billing reconciliation and total benefits cost reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; ERISA; FASB ASC 715

attributes.name: vesting_cliff_months
attributes.description: Number of months of service required before employer contributions begin to vest under a cliff or graded vesting schedule. Applicable when vesting_schedule_type is 'cliff' or 'graded'.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 203; IRS Section 411; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: vesting_full_months
attributes.description: Total months of service required for the employee to become 100% vested in employer contributions. Used for workforce retention analytics and ERISA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 203; IRS Section 411; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: vesting_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of vesting schedule applied to employer contributions in the retirement plan. Immediate vesting grants full ownership at once; cliff vesting grants full ownership after a defined period; graded vesting grants incremental ownership over time.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 203; IRS Section 411; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the employee's hire date or qualifying event before coverage under this benefit plan becomes effective. ACA limits waiting periods to 90 days for employer-sponsored health plans.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2708; IRS Notice 2012-59; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: waiver_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has affirmatively waived coverage under this benefit plan. True when the employee declined enrollment. Required for ACA 1095-C Line 16 reporting to document offer and waiver.
attributes.references: ACA Section 6056; IRS Form 1095-C; ADP Workforce Now

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Employee elections and enrollments in benefit plans for each plan year. Captures employee reference, benefit plan reference, enrollment event type (new hire, open enrollment, qualifying life event), coverage tier elected, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, dependent coverage details, enrollment effective date, termination date, waiver indicator (employee declined coverage), and enrollment status. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration. Supports ACA compliance reporting (1095-C), benefits cost allocation, and COBRA administration for terminated real estate employees.
products.reference: ADP Workforce Now — Benefit Enrollment / ACA 1095-C

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each benefit enrollment record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the benefit_enrollment data product.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: benefit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the benefit plan in which the employee is enrolling or waiving. Links to the benefit plan master record (e.g., medical, dental, vision, 401k, FSA, HSA, life insurance).
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finance cost center to which the employer's benefit contribution cost for this enrollment is allocated. Enables benefits OPEX allocation across real estate business units such as property management, development, brokerage, and corporate functions. Links to the finance cost center master.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 715; SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who elected or waived this benefit plan. Links to the workforce employee master record sourced from ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: aca_offer_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: ACA Offer of Coverage Type Code
attributes.description: The IRS-defined code indicating the type of health coverage offered to the employee for ACA Form 1095-C Line 14 reporting (e.g., 1A through 1I). Identifies whether minimum essential coverage was offered to the employee only, employee and dependents, or not offered. Required for ACA employer shared responsibility compliance for real estate employers with 50+ full-time equivalent employees.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1095-C Instructions; IRC § 4980H; ACA Employer Shared Responsibility

attributes.name: aca_safe_harbor_code
attributes.description: The IRS-defined code for ACA Form 1095-C Line 16 indicating the applicable safe harbor or relief provision (e.g., 2A through 2I). Used to indicate months the employee was not employed, was in a waiting period, or the employer qualifies for an affordability safe harbor. Required for ACA employer shared responsibility reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1095-C Instructions; IRC § 4980H; IRS Notice 2015-87

attributes.name: annual_employee_cost
attributes.description: The annualized employee premium cost for this benefit enrollment, calculated as the per-period employee contribution multiplied by the number of pay periods in the plan year. Used for ACA affordability testing (employee cost must not exceed a percentage of household income) and total compensation reporting.
attributes.references: IRS ACA Affordability Rules (IRC § 36B); ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: annual_employer_cost
attributes.description: The annualized employer contribution toward this benefit enrollment for the plan year. Used for OPEX budgeting, benefits cost allocation across real estate business units, and FASB ASC 715 disclosure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 715; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; SOX

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the benefit enrollment was approved by HR or the benefits administrator. Null if the enrollment is pending approval or was auto-approved. Supports audit trail requirements and enrollment processing SLA tracking.
attributes.references: ERISA; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: carrier_member_number
attributes.description: The unique member identification number assigned by the insurance carrier or benefit plan provider to the enrolled employee. Used for claims processing, eligibility verification, and carrier EDI 834 enrollment file reconciliation. Distinct from the internal ADP employee ID.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment Transaction; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: cobra_election_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the qualified beneficiary must elect COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event. Typically 60 days from the later of the qualifying event date or the date the COBRA election notice was provided. Null if cobra_eligible is False or no qualifying event has occurred.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1165); DOL COBRA Regulations

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon a qualifying event (e.g., employment termination, reduction in hours). True for group health plans subject to COBRA; False for plans exempt from COBRA (e.g., dental-only, vision-only under certain thresholds, or employers with fewer than 20 employees).
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); DOL COBRA Regulations; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: The pay period frequency at which employee and employer contributions are applied for this enrollment. Determines how per-period amounts are annualized for ACA affordability testing and benefits cost reporting.
attributes.references: IRS ACA Affordability Safe Harbors; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The coverage tier elected by the employee, defining who is covered under the benefit plan. Employee Only covers the employee alone; Employee + Spouse adds a spouse or domestic partner; Employee + Children adds dependent children; Employee + Family covers all eligible dependents. Drives premium contribution calculations and ACA affordability testing.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; IRS ACA Affordability Rules; ERISA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the system. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage, Silver Layer ingestion tracking, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: The number of dependents (spouse, domestic partner, children) covered under this enrollment. Used to validate coverage tier elections, calculate per-dependent costs, and support ACA dependent coverage reporting for children up to age 26.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2714 (Dependent Coverage to Age 26); ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit coverage becomes active for the employee under this enrollment. Determines when premium deductions begin and when claims can be submitted. Critical for ACA minimum essential coverage (MEC) determination and 1095-C line 14/15/16 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS ACA Reporting; ERISA; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: election_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the employee submitted their benefit election or waiver. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this enrollment transaction. Used for audit trails, late enrollment identification, and compliance with enrollment window deadlines.
attributes.references: ERISA; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; HIPAA Special Enrollment Rules

attributes.name: eligibility_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee first became eligible to enroll in this benefit plan, typically based on hire date plus any applicable waiting period (e.g., 30, 60, or 90 days). Used to validate enrollment timeliness and ACA waiting period compliance (maximum 90-day waiting period rule).
attributes.references: ACA 90-Day Waiting Period Rule (IRC § 9815); ERISA; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The per-pay-period pre-tax or post-tax dollar amount deducted from the employee's paycheck for this benefit plan enrollment. Used for payroll deduction processing, benefits cost allocation across real estate cost centers (property management, development, corporate), and W-2 Box 12 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; FASB ASC 715

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The per-pay-period dollar amount contributed by the employer toward this benefit plan enrollment. Used for benefits cost allocation to property management, development, and corporate OPEX budgets, and for FASB ASC 715 post-employment benefit accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 715; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: The employment classification of the employee at the time of enrollment. Determines benefit eligibility rules; full-time employees (30+ hours per week) are subject to ACA employer mandate; part-time employees may have limited benefit eligibility. Relevant for real estate roles including property managers, leasing agents, brokers, and construction staff.
attributes.references: IRS ACA Full-Time Employee Definition (IRC § 4980H); ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: enrollment_event_type
attributes.description: The triggering event that initiated this benefit enrollment or change. New hire enrollments occur within the initial eligibility window; open enrollment occurs during the annual election period; qualifying life events (QLE) include marriage, birth, divorce, or loss of other coverage; rehire triggers a new enrollment window; COBRA enrollments apply to terminated employees electing continuation coverage.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; ERISA; HIPAA Special Enrollment; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique enrollment reference number assigned by ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration. Used for cross-system reconciliation, ACA 1095-C reporting, and COBRA administration correspondence.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; IRS ACA Reporting

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the benefit enrollment was submitted. Self-service indicates the employee enrolled via the ADP employee self-service portal; hr_admin indicates HR staff entered the election on behalf of the employee; paper_form indicates a physical enrollment form was submitted; api_integration indicates enrollment was received via system integration; auto_enrolled indicates the employee was automatically enrolled per plan rules.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit enrollment record. Active indicates coverage is in force; pending indicates awaiting approval or effective date; terminated indicates coverage has ended; waived indicates employee declined coverage; suspended indicates temporary hold; cancelled indicates enrollment was voided before taking effect.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; ERISA; ACA

attributes.name: fsa_election_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Annual Election Amount
attributes.description: The annual dollar amount the employee elected to contribute to a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for the plan year. Subject to IRS annual FSA contribution limits. Null for non-FSA plan types. Used for payroll deduction scheduling and IRS Section 125 cafeteria plan compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; IRS FSA Contribution Limits (IRC § 106); ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The insurance carrier's group policy number associated with the employer's benefit plan. Used for carrier billing reconciliation, claims adjudication, and EDI 834 enrollment file submissions. Typically the same for all employees enrolled in the same plan.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: has_dependent_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more dependents are covered under this benefit enrollment. True when dependent_count is greater than zero. Used for ACA minimum essential coverage (MEC) reporting and dependent eligibility audits.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2714; IRS ACA Reporting; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: hsa_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The per-period employer contribution to the employee's Health Savings Account (HSA), applicable when the employee is enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP). Null for non-HSA-eligible plans. Subject to IRS annual HSA contribution limits. Used for payroll processing and W-2 Box 12 Code W reporting.
attributes.references: IRS HSA Contribution Limits (IRC § 223); IRS Form W-2 Box 12 Code W; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: life_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The face value of group term life insurance coverage elected by the employee. Applicable only for life insurance plan types. Amounts exceeding IRS imputed income threshold (currently $50,000) require W-2 Box 12 Code C reporting for the taxable portion of employer-provided group term life insurance.
attributes.references: IRS Group Term Life Insurance Rules (IRC § 79); IRS Form W-2 Box 12 Code C; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by HR administrators regarding this benefit enrollment. May include documentation of special circumstances, late enrollment justifications, carrier exception approvals, or COBRA administration notes. Not used for structured reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: open_enrollment_period
attributes.description: The identifier or label for the open enrollment period during which this election was made (e.g., 'OE-2024', 'OE-2025'). Null for new hire and qualifying life event enrollments. Used to group elections by enrollment campaign and track open enrollment completion rates across the real estate workforce.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; ERISA

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal plan year (e.g., 2024) for which this enrollment is effective. Used to segment enrollments by annual benefit cycle and support ACA compliance reporting (1095-C) by tax year.
attributes.references: IRS ACA Reporting; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the qualifying life event (QLE) occurred that triggered a mid-year enrollment change outside of open enrollment. Examples include marriage, birth of a child, adoption, divorce, or loss of other coverage. Null for new hire and open enrollment event types. Required for HIPAA special enrollment and IRS Section 125 cafeteria plan compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment (29 CFR § 2590.701-6); IRS Section 125; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type
attributes.description: The type of qualifying life event that triggered a mid-year enrollment change. Marriage includes domestic partnership; birth_adoption covers new dependents; divorce includes legal separation; loss_of_coverage covers involuntary loss of other group coverage; death_of_dependent removes a covered dependent. Null for new hire and open enrollment event types.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment (29 CFR § 2590.701-6); IRS Section 125; ERISA

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit coverage ends for this enrollment. Populated upon employment termination, voluntary cancellation, or plan year end. Null indicates coverage is currently active. Used to determine COBRA qualifying event dates and continuation coverage election windows.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); ERISA; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit enrollment record was last modified. Tracks changes to enrollment elections, contribution amounts, coverage tiers, or status updates. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and SOX audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days from the employee's hire date (or rehire date) before they become eligible to enroll in this benefit plan. Must not exceed 90 days for group health plans under ACA. Used to calculate eligibility_start_date and validate ACA waiting period compliance.
attributes.references: ACA 90-Day Waiting Period Rule (IRC § 9815); ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: waiver_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee affirmatively declined (waived) coverage under this benefit plan for the plan year. True means the employee opted out; False means the employee enrolled. Required for ACA 1095-C Line 14 reporting to distinguish employees who were offered but declined minimum essential coverage.
attributes.references: IRS ACA Reporting (Form 1095-C); ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: The stated reason the employee declined coverage under this benefit plan. Other coverage indicates the employee has coverage through another source (e.g., spouse's employer plan); cost indicates the premium was unaffordable; ineligible indicates the employee does not meet plan eligibility criteria. Null when waiver_indicator is False.
attributes.references: IRS ACA Reporting; ADP Workforce Now Benefits Administration

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Individual time and attendance records submitted by real estate employees for each work period. Captures employee reference, work date, clock-in time, clock-out time, total hours worked, overtime hours, pay code (regular, overtime, PTO, sick, holiday, jury duty, bereavement), project or property cost allocation code, approval status (submitted, approved, rejected), approving manager, and submission timestamp. Applicable to hourly field staff, maintenance technicians, construction workers, and any salaried employees tracking project time for CAPEX/OPEX allocation. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance module.
