attributes.name: adp_time_entry_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by ADP Workforce Now to this time entry record. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse and the source payroll system.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for amending or correcting this time entry after initial submission. Required when is_amended is True to maintain a complete audit trail for payroll and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the time entry in the approval lifecycle. Drives payroll processing eligibility; only APPROVED entries are included in payroll runs.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the approving manager approved or rejected this time entry. Provides a complete audit trail for payroll authorization and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of unpaid break time in minutes deducted from the employee's clocked hours during this work period. Required for accurate net hours calculation and compliance with labor regulations.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); OSHA

attributes.name: clock_in_time
attributes.description: The date and timestamp at which the employee clocked in or started their work period. Used to calculate total hours worked and validate shift compliance.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module; OSHA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: clock_out_time
attributes.description: The date and timestamp at which the employee clocked out or ended their work period. Combined with clock-in time to derive total hours worked.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module; OSHA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: cost_allocation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the labor hours in this time entry are allocated as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for development/construction projects or Operating Expenditure (OPEX) for ongoing property management and maintenance. Critical for financial reporting and asset capitalization under FASB ASC 840/842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this time entry record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the labor cost amount recorded in this time entry (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency portfolio reporting for international real estate operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational department to which the employee belongs at the time of the entry (e.g., Property Management, Development, Brokerage, Corporate Finance). Supports departmental labor cost reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked at double-time pay rate, applicable for work performed on holidays or beyond extended overtime thresholds per applicable labor agreements. Distinct from standard overtime hours.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Payroll; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: entry_method
attributes.description: The method by which this time entry was recorded in ADP Workforce Now (e.g., manual entry by employee, physical clock-in/out terminal, mobile app, timesheet batch, or imported from a third-party system such as Procore).
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The employee's hourly pay rate applicable at the time of this entry, used to calculate the labor cost value of the time entry for CAPEX/OPEX allocation and project cost reporting. Classified as confidential business-sensitive compensation data.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Payroll; FASB ASC 420; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_amended
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has been amended or corrected after initial submission. True if the entry was modified post-submission; False for original unmodified entries. Supports audit trail and payroll correction tracking.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SOX Financial Controls; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: The gross labor cost in USD for this time entry, calculated as total hours multiplied by the applicable pay rate including any overtime premium. Used for project cost tracking, CAPEX/OPEX allocation, and NOI (Net Operating Income) analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; SAP S/4HANA; FASB ASC 360; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the employee or manager providing additional context for this time entry, such as special work conditions, task descriptions, or explanations for unusual hours.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked beyond the standard threshold (typically 8 hours/day or 40 hours/week) during this time entry period. Triggers premium pay rates per FLSA regulations.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: pay_code
attributes.description: Classification code indicating the type of pay associated with this time entry. Drives payroll calculation rules, benefit accrual, and labor cost categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REGULAR|OVERTIME|PTO|SICK|HOLIDAY|BEREAVEMENT|JURY_DUTY|TRAINING|UNPAID_LEAVE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Payroll; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the payroll period to which this time entry belongs. Defines the boundary for payroll batch inclusion and period-close accruals.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Payroll; FASB ASC 420; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the payroll period to which this time entry belongs. Used to group time entries for payroll batch processing and period-end financial reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Payroll; FASB ASC 420; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: payroll_batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll processing batch in ADP Workforce Now into which this approved time entry was included. Enables traceability from individual time entries to payroll run outputs and GL postings.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Payroll Processing; SOX Financial Controls; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total number of regular (non-overtime) hours worked by the employee during this time entry period. Used for standard payroll calculation and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approving manager when rejecting a time entry. Populated only when approval_status is REJECTED. Supports employee feedback and payroll dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work shift associated with this time entry. Relevant for maintenance technicians, security staff, and construction workers who may work non-standard shifts at real estate properties.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance; Building Engines Facility Operations

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the employee submitted this time entry for approval. Used to assess timeliness of submission relative to payroll deadlines and to support audit trails.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Total hours recorded for this time entry, inclusive of regular, overtime, and any leave hours. Represents the gross time claimed for payroll and cost allocation purposes.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now Time and Attendance Module; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining agreement applicable to the employee for this time entry. Relevant for construction workers and building trades staff; drives union-specific pay rules and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this time entry record was most recently modified. Tracks amendments, corrections, and re-submissions for audit and change management purposes.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the employee performed the work recorded in this time entry. Principal business event date for payroll period alignment and project cost allocation.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; FASB ASC 420; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical work location where the employee performed the work (e.g., a specific property address, construction site, or corporate office). Supports geographic labor cost allocation and site-level reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now; Yardi Voyager Property Management; Building Engines

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Employee leave of absence requests and approved leave records. Captures employee reference, leave type (FMLA, personal leave, military leave, parental leave, medical leave, sabbatical), requested start date, requested end date, approved start date, approved end date, leave reason, FMLA eligibility indicator, intermittent leave indicator, leave status (requested, approved, denied, in-progress, returned, cancelled), HR approver, return-to-work date, and accommodation notes. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now. Supports FMLA compliance tracking, workforce availability planning, and leave liability accrual for real estate operations.
products.reference: ADP Workforce Now — Leave of Absence / FMLA Tracking

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each employee leave of absence request record in the workforce management system.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property or portfolio asset to which the employee is primarily assigned at the time of the leave request. Enables property-level workforce availability analysis and operational impact assessment for property management and leasing operations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management Module; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which the employee's leave-related costs (pay continuation, benefits, temporary replacement) are charged. Supports leave liability accrual and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager GL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Cost Center Accounting; Yardi Voyager — General Ledger; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: job_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's job position at the time of the leave request. Used to identify the role requiring coverage (e.g., property manager, leasing agent, construction superintendent) and to plan temporary staffing or workload redistribution.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Human Capital Management Module

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Employee Master

attributes.name: accommodation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any workplace accommodations arranged in connection with the leave, such as modified duties upon return, reduced schedule, or assistive equipment. Relevant for ADA interactive process documentation. Classified as confidential due to health-related content.
attributes.references: ADA (42 U.S.C. §12101); GDPR Article 9; ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: The date the employee actually returned to active employment following the leave. May differ from approved_end_date due to early return, medical clearance delays, or leave extensions. Critical for FMLA compliance and payroll reinstatement.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR §825.312)

attributes.name: adp_leave_case_number
attributes.description: The source system case number assigned by ADP Workforce Now to this leave request. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the Silver Layer and ADP, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: approved_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days approved by HR for the leave of absence, calculated from approved_start_date to approved_end_date inclusive. Used for FMLA entitlement balance tracking (maximum 84 days / 12 weeks per rolling year) and leave liability accrual.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.200); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: approved_end_date
attributes.description: The HR-approved last calendar date of the leave of absence. Used alongside approved_start_date to calculate approved leave duration for payroll, benefits continuation, and FMLA entitlement tracking.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: approved_start_date
attributes.description: The HR-approved first calendar date of the leave of absence, which may differ from the requested start date. Used for payroll processing, leave liability accrual, and workforce scheduling.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: benefits_continuation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's group health benefits are being maintained by the employer during the leave period. Under FMLA, employers must maintain group health coverage on the same terms as if the employee had continued working.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.209); ADP Workforce Now — Benefits Module

attributes.name: coverage_arrangement
attributes.description: Describes how the employee's responsibilities will be covered during the leave period: temp_hire = temporary employee engaged; internal_reassignment = duties redistributed to existing staff; overtime = existing staff work additional hours; no_coverage = role left vacant; deferred = work deferred until return. Supports workforce planning for property management and brokerage operations.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Workforce Planning; Real Estate Operations Best Practice

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when the leave request record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from submitted_timestamp which reflects the business event time.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which HR formally approved or denied the leave request. Used to measure HR response time and ensure FMLA designation notice is provided within the required 5-business-day window (29 CFR §825.300).
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.300); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation provided by HR for denying the leave request. Populated only when leave_status = denied. Required for documentation of adverse employment actions and potential legal review under FMLA or ADA.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.301); ADA (42 U.S.C. §12101); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: employee_premium_owed
attributes.description: Dollar amount of employee-share health insurance premiums that the employee owes during the unpaid leave period. Tracked for potential recovery if the employee fails to return from FMLA leave (29 CFR §825.213). Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.213); ADP Workforce Now — Benefits and Payroll Module

attributes.name: fmla_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Designated Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether HR has formally designated this leave as FMLA-qualifying following review of the leave reason and medical certification. Distinct from fmla_eligible — an employee may be eligible but the leave may not qualify for FMLA designation.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.300); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: fmla_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Eligibility Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee meets FMLA eligibility criteria at the time of the request: employed for at least 12 months, worked 1,250 hours in the prior 12 months, and works at a location with 50+ employees within 75 miles. Drives FMLA designation and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.110); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Used
attributes.description: Cumulative FMLA-protected hours consumed by this leave request against the employee's 480-hour (12-week) annual FMLA entitlement. Tracked in hours to support intermittent leave scenarios where partial days are taken.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.205); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: hr_notes
attributes.description: Internal HR narrative notes documenting case management activities, communications with the employee, escalations, or special circumstances related to the leave request. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive employment information.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: intermittent_frequency
attributes.description: Expected frequency of intermittent leave episodes as certified by the healthcare provider. Applicable only when intermittent_leave is True. Used for workforce scheduling and absence pattern monitoring.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.202); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: intermittent_leave
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is taken intermittently (in separate blocks of time or by reducing the normal weekly or daily work schedule) rather than as a single continuous period. Intermittent FMLA leave requires separate scheduling and tracking in ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.202); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for the leave request as provided by the employee. May include medical condition references, family circumstances, or personal reasons. Classified as confidential due to sensitivity of health and personal information.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; ADA (42 U.S.C. §12101); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: leave_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized categorical code classifying the reason for leave per FMLA and HR policy definitions. Used for compliance reporting and workforce analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: serious_health_condition|birth_adoption|family_care|military_service|personal|sabbatical|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.113); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: leave_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the leave request throughout its lifecycle: requested = submitted pending review; approved = HR/manager approved; denied = request rejected; in_progress = employee currently on leave; returned = employee has returned to work; cancelled = request withdrawn by employee or voided by HR.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave of absence by regulatory or policy category. FMLA = Family and Medical Leave Act protected leave; parental = birth/adoption/foster care bonding; medical = non-FMLA health-related; military = USERRA-protected military service; personal = discretionary personal leave; sabbatical = extended professional development leave. Drives eligibility rules, pay continuation, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); USERRA (38 U.S.C. §§ 4301–4335); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: leave_year_type
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the 12-month period for FMLA entitlement tracking: calendar_year = January–December; rolling_12_month = 12 months measured backward from the date leave is used; fixed_leave_year = any fixed 12-month period (e.g., fiscal year); rolling_forward = 12-month period starting on the first date FMLA leave is taken.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.200(b)); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: medical_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed medical certification form was received by HR. Used to verify compliance with the 15-calendar-day submission deadline and to trigger FMLA designation notice.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.305); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: medical_certification_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certification has been received from the employee's healthcare provider. Employees have 15 calendar days to provide certification (29 CFR §825.305). Tracks compliance with certification deadlines.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.305); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether HR has determined that a medical certification (WH-380-E or WH-380-F form) is required to support this leave request. Required for FMLA-qualifying serious health conditions.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.305); DOL Form WH-380-E/WH-380-F

attributes.name: paid_leave
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved leave period is fully or partially paid under company policy, state law, or short-term disability benefits. Drives payroll processing and leave liability accrual calculations.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Payroll and Benefits Module; FASB ASC 420; State Paid Family Leave Laws

attributes.name: pay_continuation_type
attributes.description: Specifies the compensation arrangement during the leave period: full_pay = 100% salary continuation; partial_pay = reduced pay per policy; unpaid = no compensation; std_benefit = short-term disability benefit payments; pto_substitution = employee elects to use accrued PTO/sick time to receive pay during FMLA leave.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.207); ADP Workforce Now — Payroll Module; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the leave request, used in correspondence with employees, HR, and payroll teams (e.g., LR-2024-000123). Sourced from ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: requested_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days requested by the employee for the leave of absence, calculated from requested_start_date to requested_end_date inclusive. Used for initial workforce planning and FMLA entitlement assessment.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The employee-requested last calendar date of the leave of absence. Combined with requested_start_date to determine the requested leave duration for planning purposes.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The employee-requested first calendar date of the leave of absence. Used for workforce availability planning and scheduling coverage for property management, leasing, and construction roles.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: return_to_work_clearance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has provided a fitness-for-duty certification or medical clearance from their healthcare provider prior to returning from leave. Required for certain FMLA leave types per company policy and 29 CFR §825.312.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR §825.312); ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee formally submitted the leave request in ADP Workforce Now. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the transaction and is used to measure HR response time and FMLA notice compliance (29 CFR §825.302).
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module; FMLA (29 CFR §825.302)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when the leave request record was most recently modified in the data platform, capturing status changes, date amendments, or accommodation note updates.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ADP Workforce Now — Leave Management Module

products.name: license_certification
products.description: Professional licenses and certifications held by real estate workforce members, including renewal lifecycle tracking. Credential data captures employee reference, credential type (real estate broker license, salesperson license, appraiser license — Certified Residential, Certified General, Licensed Residential, MAI, LEED AP, BREEAM assessor, CPM, CCIM, RPA, FMA, PMP, OSHA 30, contractor license), issuing authority, license number, issue date, expiration date, jurisdiction (state/country), and CE hours required vs completed. Renewal data captures renewal cycle dates, renewal deadline, CE hours progress, application submission date, renewal fee, renewed license number, new expiration date, renewal status (pending, submitted, approved, lapsed, suspended), and regulatory body confirmation. Supports proactive license expiry alerts, multi-state compliance audits, and ensures brokers, appraisers, and property managers maintain active credentials required by state commissions, NAR, and the Appraisal Institute.
products.reference: NAR / Appraisal Institute / USGBC / State Real Estate Commission — License Registry

attributes.name: license_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each professional license or certification record held by a real estate workforce member. Primary key for the license_certification data product in the workforce domain.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Talent Management Module

attributes.name: brokerage_broker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed broker under whose sponsorship a salesperson or associate broker license is held, as required by most state real estate commissions. A salesperson license is only active when affiliated with a sponsoring broker. Null for independent broker licenses, appraiser credentials, and non-brokerage certifications.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commissions

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce member (property manager, broker, appraiser, leasing agent, construction staff, or corporate employee) who holds this license or certification. Links to the employee master record sourced from ADP Workforce Now.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Employee Master

attributes.name: geographic_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.geographic_hierarchy. Business justification: Real estate licenses are jurisdiction-specific. Linking to geographic_hierarchy enables geographic license coverage reporting — critical for ensuring licensed staff coverage across all operating marke
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_framework_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.regulatory_framework. Business justification: Real estate broker and appraiser licenses are governed by specific regulatory frameworks (state RE commission rules, USPAP). Linking enables compliance tracking against specific mandates, automated re
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adp_credential_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to this license or certification record within ADP Workforce Now's talent management module. Used for system-of-record traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the ADP source system.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Talent Management Module

attributes.name: alert_days_before_expiry
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the expiration_date at which automated renewal alert notifications should be triggered for this credential. Configurable per credential type and jurisdiction (e.g., 90 days for broker licenses, 60 days for appraiser credentials). Drives the proactive license expiry alert workflow.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: ce_cycle_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the current CE reporting cycle for this credential. CE hours completed are counted from this date through the renewal deadline. Enables accurate tracking of CE progress within the applicable compliance window.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; State Real Estate Commissions

attributes.name: ce_hours_completed
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Education (CE) hours the employee has completed in the current renewal cycle to date. Compared against ce_hours_required to determine compliance progress and identify employees at risk of credential lapse. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now training records and issuing authority portals.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; State Real Estate Commissions; USPAP

attributes.name: ce_hours_required
attributes.description: Total number of Continuing Education (CE) hours mandated by the issuing authority for the current renewal cycle. Varies by credential type and jurisdiction (e.g., 45 CE hours per 2-year cycle for California real estate broker, 28 hours for Certified General Appraiser per USPAP cycle). Supports compliance gap analysis.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; State Real Estate Commissions; USPAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this license or certification record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance, lineage tracking, and SOX compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5; ADP Workforce Now

attributes.name: credential_name
attributes.description: Human-readable full name of the license or certification (e.g., 'Certified General Appraiser License', 'LEED Accredited Professional — Building Design and Construction', 'Certified Property Manager (CPM)', 'CCIM Designation'). Provides the identity label for the credential record.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; National Association of Realtors (NAR); U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC); BOMA International

attributes.name: credential_number
attributes.description: The official license or certification number assigned by the issuing authority (e.g., state real estate commission license number, appraiser credential number, LEED AP certificate number). This is the externally-known business identifier used for regulatory verification and compliance audits.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC)

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the license or certification. 'active' indicates the credential is valid and in good standing; 'pending' indicates initial application or renewal in progress; 'expired' indicates the credential has passed its expiration date without renewal; 'suspended' indicates temporary regulatory action; 'lapsed' indicates the credential was not renewed within the grace period; 'revoked' indicates permanent cancellation by the issuing authority. Drives proactive expiry alerts and compliance dashboards.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; State Real Estate Commissions

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: Classification of the professional license or certification held. Indicates the category of credential such as real estate broker license, salesperson license, appraiser license, or professional designation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: real_estate_broker_license|salesperson_license|appraiser_certified_residential|appraiser_certified_general|appraiser_licensed_residential|MAI_designation|LEED_AP|BREEAM_assessor|CPM|CCIM|RPA|FMA|PMP|OSHA_30|contractor_license — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC); OSHA

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the scanned copy or digital document of the license or certification certificate stored in the document management system (e.g., DocuSign CLM or SharePoint). Enables auditors and compliance officers to retrieve the original credential document for verification.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the license or certification expires and is no longer valid without renewal. This is the primary date used for proactive expiry alert generation, renewal deadline scheduling, and multi-state compliance audit reporting. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute; State Real Estate Commissions; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_company_sponsored
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is sponsoring this credential (True) — covering renewal fees, CE costs, and administrative support — or whether the employee maintains it independently (False). Drives reimbursement eligibility, OPEX cost allocation, and workforce benefit reporting.
attributes.references: ADP Workforce Now — Benefits Administration; SAP S/4HANA — Human Capital Management

attributes.name: is_primary_credential

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the enrollment was initiated: manager-assigned (by direct supervisor), self-enrolled (employee-initiated), hr-assigned (by HR department), system-auto (automatically triggered by role or compliance rule), or compliance-required (mandated by regulatory obligation).

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training enrollment. Tracks progression from initial enrollment through completion or exit. Values: enrolled (registered, not yet started), in-progress (actively attending), completed (successfully finished), failed (did not meet passing criteria), withdrawn (voluntarily removed before completion), no-show (did not attend without prior withdrawal).

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Classification of whether the training enrollment is mandatory (required by policy or regulation), elective (employee-initiated), recommended (manager-suggested), or regulatory (required by an external governing body such as OSHA, HUD, or SEC).

attributes.name: is_overdue

products.description: Formal employee performance evaluation records conducted on a scheduled or ad-hoc basis. Captures employee reference, review period (annual, mid-year, probationary, project-based), review type, overall performance rating (e.g., exceeds expectations, meets expectations, needs improvement), individual goal ratings, competency ratings, manager comments, employee self-assessment reference, calibration status, merit increase recommendation, promotion recommendation, PIP (Performance Improvement Plan) indicator, review completion date, and approving HR business partner. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now Talent Management. Drives compensation decisions, succession planning, and talent development for real estate workforce.

products.name: headcount_plan
products.description: Workforce planning and headcount budgeting records by department, property, or business unit for a planning period. Captures planning period (fiscal year, quarter), org unit reference, job profile reference, budgeted headcount (FTE), actual filled headcount, open requisition count, planned new hires, planned attrition, net headcount change, budgeted labor cost (salary + benefits), actual labor cost, variance, and plan approval status. Now also captures succession planning data for critical roles: successor candidates, readiness levels, development gaps, and retention risk. Supports annual workforce planning cycles, CAPEX/OPEX labor budgeting for development projects, property-level staffing models, and leadership continuity planning. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA for financial consolidation.

products.name: role_training_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the formal assignment of mandatory or recommended training courses to job profiles within the real estate enterprise. It captures regulatory CE requirements, compliance mandates, and professional development standards that apply to specific roles. Each record links one training course to one job profile with attributes that define the requirement's nature, timing, and applicability. Sourced from ADP Workforce Now LMS and HCM modules, this association supports compliance tracking, license renewal planning, and onboarding curriculum design.. Existence Justification: In real estate workforce management, training requirements are formally assigned to job profiles based on regulatory mandates (state real estate commission CE requirements for brokers, appraisal board requirements for appraisers), compliance policies (Fair Housing, OSHA), and role-specific competencies. A single training course (e.g., Fair Housing Act compliance) is required for multiple job profiles (broker, property manager, leasing agent), and a single job profile requires multiple training courses to maintain licensure and operational competency. This is an actively managed business process in ADP Workforce Now LMS, where HR and compliance teams create, update, and retire training requirements as regulations and business needs evolve.

domains.name: reference
domains.description: Centralized repository for all enterprise reference and lookup data — property types, lease types, transaction types, geographic hierarchies, market segments, zoning codes, currency codes, unit-of-measure standards (PSF, SQF/SQM), industry classification codes, and business taxonomies. Provides controlled vocabularies and standardized code sets that ensure data consistency across all operational and analytical domains.

products.name: property_type
products.description: Enterprise-wide property classification taxonomy organized as a self-referencing multi-level hierarchy. Level 1: asset class (commercial, residential, mixed-use, land, special-purpose). Level 2: sub-category (office, retail, industrial, hospitality, single-family, multifamily, condo). Level 3: quality tier / building class (Class A/B/C, trophy, institutional-grade, luxury, affordable). Level 4: space use type (office, retail, restaurant, medical, fitness, storage, parking). Level 5: construction method (wood frame, steel, concrete, masonry, modular). Level 6: amenity classification (building-level, unit-level, community). Each node carries applicable attributes: GLA applicability flags, zoning compatibility codes, fire resistance ratings (IBC Type I–V), ESG/LEED relevance indicators, CAM inclusion rules, TI allowance benchmarks, and measurement methodology (GLA/NLA/GFA). Aligned with RESO, CoStar, BOMA, and NAIOP standards. Referenced by property, lease, valuation, brokerage, development, and maintenance domains as the single source of truth for all property classification.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Relevance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) reporting metrics and sustainability certifications are applicable and tracked for properties of this type. True for property types subject to LEED, BREEAM, or ENERGY STAR certification programs. Drives ESG data collection requirements and SEC sustainability disclosure obligations for publicly traded REITs.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; BREEAM; SEC ESG Disclosure Requirements; EPA Energy Star

attributes.name: is_gla_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Gross Leasable Area (GLA) measurement methodology is applicable to properties of this type. True for retail and commercial property types where GLA is the standard measurement basis per BOMA and ICSC standards. False for property types measured by other methodologies (e.g., residential measured by GFA or NLA).
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; ICSC (International Council of Shopping Centers); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: is_investment_grade
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties of this type qualify as institutional investment-grade assets suitable for REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust) portfolios, pension fund investment, and institutional capital allocation. Drives portfolio screening in Argus Enterprise and investment advisory workflows. Typically True for Class A and Trophy commercial assets.
attributes.references: SEC REIT Regulations; Appraisal Institute; Urban Land Institute (ULI); IVSC (International Valuation Standards Council)

attributes.name: is_leaf_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy node is a terminal leaf node (True) with no child nodes, or an intermediate branch node (False). Leaf nodes represent the most granular assignable property type classifications. Used to enforce that only leaf-level types are assigned to individual properties and leases.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: is_reit_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties of this type qualify as REIT-eligible assets under IRS REIT qualification rules (IRC Section 856). Drives asset classification in financial consolidation (SAP S/4HANA) and SEC regulatory reporting for publicly traded REITs. Distinct from investment_grade as it reflects specific tax and regulatory eligibility.
attributes.references: SEC REIT Regulations; IRS IRC Section 856; FASB ASC 842; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: is_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this property type is classified as residential for regulatory, tax, and accounting purposes. Drives applicability of HUD regulations, residential mortgage underwriting standards (PMI, ARM, FRM, DTI), and RMBS (Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities) eligibility. Distinct from asset_class for use in compliance filtering.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: leed_certification_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification is applicable and pursued for properties of this type. Drives green building data collection, energy benchmarking, and ESG reporting workflows. Relevant for institutional-grade commercial and multifamily property types.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED Certification Standards; EPA Energy Star

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Standard area measurement methodology applicable to this property type. GLA (Gross Leasable Area) for retail; NLA (Net Leasable Area) for commercial office; GFA (Gross Floor Area) for development and planning; IPMS (International Property Measurement Standards) for cross-border portfolios. Drives how PSF (Per Square Foot) rent and valuation metrics are calculated.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; IPMS (International Property Measurement Standards); RESO Data Dictionary; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: naiop_type_code
attributes.description: NAIOP (National Association for Industrial and Office Properties) standardized property type code for commercial real estate classification. Used for industry benchmarking, market research alignment, and CRE (Commercial Real Estate) portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Suite Market Data

attributes.name: property_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this property type taxonomy node. 'active' nodes are available for assignment to properties, leases, and valuations. 'deprecated' nodes are retained for historical data integrity but no longer assignable. 'draft' nodes are under review prior to enterprise publication.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: reso_property_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Property Type Code
attributes.description: RESO (Real Estate Standards Organization) standardized property type code for MLS (Multiple Listing Service) data exchange and industry interoperability. Enables syndication of property listings via MLS platforms and ensures compliance with RESO Data Dictionary standards.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Standards

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Integer defining the preferred display sequence of this property type node within its sibling group at the same hierarchy level. Used to control the ordering of property type options in dropdown menus, reports, and dashboards across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and Salesforce CRM integrations.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: sub_category
attributes.description: Level 2 sub-category classification denormalized from the taxonomy hierarchy for analytical convenience. Examples: Office, Retail, Industrial, Hospitality, Single-Family, Multifamily, Condo, Mixed-Use Retail/Office. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Office|Retail|Industrial|Hospitality|Single-Family|Multifamily|Condo|Mixed-Use|Self-Storage|Data Center|Life Science|Senior Housing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: ti_allowance_benchmark_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Improvement (TI) Allowance Benchmark Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Market benchmark for Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance expressed in dollars Per Square Foot (PSF) for this property type. Used as a default starting point in lease negotiations and deal underwriting. Sourced from CoStar market data and internal brokerage transaction history. Supports deal pipeline analysis in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Suite Market Data; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this property type node within the enterprise taxonomy. Used as the stable business key for cross-system integration with Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, CoStar, and Argus Enterprise. Examples: COMM_OFF_A, RES_MF_LUX, IND_WRHSE.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: type_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the property classification node, including defining characteristics, typical use cases, and distinguishing criteria from adjacent nodes. Supports business user understanding and onboarding.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Urban Land Institute (ULI) Property Classification Guidelines

attributes.name: type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for this property classification node as used in reports, dashboards, and user interfaces across all operational systems. Examples: 'Class A Office', 'Luxury Multifamily', 'Triple Net Retail'.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: typical_lease_term_months
attributes.description: Market-standard typical lease term in months for this property type. Used as a default assumption in lease underwriting, WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) calculations, and cash flow modeling in Argus Enterprise. Examples: 12 months for residential, 60-120 months for commercial office, 36-60 months for retail.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; IASB IFRS 16 Leases; NAIOP Property Classification Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this property type taxonomy node was last modified in the enterprise reference data repository. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and reference data governance workflows.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: zoning_compatibility_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of standard zoning designation codes compatible with this property type (e.g., 'C-1|C-2|M-1' for light commercial/industrial). Supports regulatory compliance checks, development feasibility analysis, and GIS (Geographic Information System) integration. Aligned with local municipal zoning ordinances and FAR (Floor Area Ratio) regulations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Local Municipal Zoning Ordinances; GIS Standards

products.name: lease_type
products.description: Standardized classification of lease structures used across commercial and residential leasing — NNN (Triple Net), gross lease, modified gross, percentage lease, ground lease, sublease, and short-term/month-to-month. Defines rent calculation methodology, CAM/OpEx responsibility allocation, and applicable accounting treatment under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Includes escalation method indicators (CPI, fixed-step, market reset) and renewal option classification. Serves as the authoritative lookup for lease administration across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and all operational domains requiring lease structure classification.

attributes.name: lease_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lease_type

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.market_segment. Business justification: Lease types are associated with specific market segments (e.g., NNN leases are typical in Core commercial segments, gross leases in Value-Add residential segments). Linking to the market_segment regis
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Industry-standard abbreviation for the lease type used in market communications, CoStar listings, and brokerage reports (e.g., NNN, MG, FS, PCT, GL). Aligns with CoStar Suite and MLS syndication field conventions.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: area_measure_standard
attributes.description: Specifies the standard unit of area measurement used for rent calculation under this lease type: SQF (Square Feet), SQM (Square Meters), GLA (Gross Leasable Area), NLA (Net Leasable Area), or GFA (Gross Floor Area). Ensures consistency in PSF/SQM rent calculations across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and CoStar Suite.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); BOMA International; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: argus_lease_type_code
attributes.description: The corresponding lease type identifier as used in Argus Enterprise cash flow and valuation models. Enables mapping between this reference record and Argus Enterprise lease structure assumptions for DCF modeling, CAP rate analysis, and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling Module

attributes.name: asc842_lease_classification
attributes.description: Specifies the default lease classification under FASB ASC 842 for this lease type: 'operating' (lessee recognizes right-of-use asset and operating lease liability), 'finance' (lessee recognizes finance lease asset and liability with front-loaded expense), 'short_term_exemption' (leases ≤12 months exempt from balance sheet recognition), or 'not_applicable' (lessor-side or non-applicable structures). Drives accounting treatment in SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager GL.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB); Yardi Voyager General Ledger

attributes.name: cam_reconciliation_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Reconciliation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether annual CAM reconciliation is required for this lease type (True). CAM reconciliation compares estimated CAM charges billed to tenants against actual CAM expenses incurred. Required for NNN and modified gross leases; not applicable for full gross leases. Activates CAM reconciliation workflows in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: cam_responsibility
attributes.description: Indicates which party bears responsibility for Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges under this lease type. 'landlord' means the landlord absorbs all CAM costs; 'tenant' means the tenant pays CAM directly (as in NNN); 'shared' means costs are pro-rated; 'not_applicable' for lease types where CAM is not a relevant concept (e.g., ground lease). Governs CAM reconciliation workflows in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lease type reference record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements under SOX financial controls, and reference data governance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this lease type classification became or becomes effective for use in new lease agreements. Supports temporal validity tracking for reference data governance and ensures that historical lease records retain the correct classification at the time of execution.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: escalation_method
attributes.description: Indicates the standard rent escalation methodology associated with this lease type: fixed_step (predetermined dollar or percentage increases), cpi_indexed (Consumer Price Index-linked adjustments), market_reset (rent reset to prevailing market rate at intervals), none (flat rent for term), or hybrid (combination of methods). Governs rent schedule escalation logic in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: esg_reporting_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reporting Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) reporting obligations — such as green lease clauses, LEED/BREEAM compliance requirements, or energy consumption data sharing — are applicable to this lease type (True). Relevant for institutional and REIT portfolios subject to SEC ESG disclosure requirements and USGBC LEED certification programs.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC); EPA Environmental Compliance; BREEAM

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this lease type classification ceases to be valid for use in new lease agreements (nullable for open-ended classifications). Supports reference data lifecycle management and ensures deprecated lease types are not applied to new leases after their retirement date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Industry-standard or regulatory body reference code for this lease type, such as RESO standard codes, NCREIF property type codes, or CoStar lease type identifiers. Enables cross-system interoperability and alignment with industry data exchange standards.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; National Council of Real Estate Investment Fiduciaries (NCREIF)

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_classification
attributes.description: Specifies the default lease classification under IASB IFRS 16 for this lease type: 'single_model' (all leases recognized on balance sheet as right-of-use asset and lease liability), 'short_term_exemption' (leases ≤12 months), 'low_value_exemption' (underlying asset of low value), or 'not_applicable'. Supports international financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA for entities reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: IASB IFRS 16; International Accounting Standards Board (IASB); SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: insurance_responsibility
attributes.description: Defines which party is responsible for property insurance premiums under this lease type. Relevant for NNN and modified gross lease structures where insurance cost allocation varies. Used in lease administration billing and CAM reconciliation processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: is_ground_lease
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease type is a ground lease (True), where the tenant leases land only and typically constructs improvements. Ground leases have distinct legal, accounting, and investment characteristics including long terms (50–99 years), land-only rent, and reversion of improvements to the landlord. Relevant for REIT portfolio classification and Argus Enterprise valuation modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: is_short_term
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease type is classified as short-term (True), typically defined as a lease term of 12 months or less at commencement. Short-term leases qualify for the practical expedient exemption from balance sheet recognition under both FASB ASC 842 and IASB IFRS 16. Drives accounting treatment selection in SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB)

attributes.name: is_sublease
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease type represents a sublease arrangement (True), where the original lessee (sublandlord) leases all or part of the demised space to a subtenant. Subleases require distinct accounting treatment under FASB ASC 842 (intermediate lessor classification) and separate tracking in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: lease_category
attributes.description: Broad property-use category to which this lease type applies — commercial, residential, industrial, mixed_use, or land. Determines which operational workflows in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software are applicable and which regulatory frameworks (ASC 842, IFRS 16) govern accounting treatment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: lease_type_code
attributes.description: Short, system-facing alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the lease type (e.g., NNN, GROSS, MOD_GROSS, PCT, GROUND, SUBLEASE, MTM). Used as the canonical lookup key in Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and downstream analytical systems to join lease records to their classification.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: lease_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the lease type, including its defining characteristics, typical use cases, cost responsibility allocation, and distinguishing features from similar lease structures. Used in training materials, lease administration documentation, and business glossary entries.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Urban Land Institute (ULI); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: lease_type_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the lease structure classification (e.g., 'Triple Net Lease', 'Gross Lease', 'Modified Gross Lease', 'Percentage Lease', 'Ground Lease', 'Sublease', 'Month-to-Month'). Displayed in reporting, lease administration screens, and tenant-facing documents.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: lease_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this lease type reference record: 'active' (available for use in new lease agreements), 'inactive' (temporarily disabled but retained for historical reference), or 'deprecated' (superseded by a newer classification; retained for legacy lease records only). Controls availability in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software lease type selection lists.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: loi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Letter of Intent (LOI) is a standard prerequisite in the deal process for this lease type (True). LOIs are standard for commercial leases but typically not required for residential or month-to-month arrangements. Governs deal pipeline workflow in Salesforce CRM and DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Deal Pipeline; DocuSign CLM; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: mri_lease_type_code
attributes.description: The corresponding lease type code as configured in MRI Software Lease Management module. Enables direct mapping between this enterprise reference record and the MRI source system code for data integration and reconciliation, particularly for residential and investment management portfolios.
attributes.references: MRI Software Lease Management Module

attributes.name: noi_impact_classification
attributes.description: Classifies how this lease type impacts Net Operating Income (NOI) calculation: 'gross_revenue' (all income flows through gross revenue line before expense deductions), 'net_revenue' (tenant pays expenses directly, reducing gross revenue line), or 'not_applicable'. Used in Argus Enterprise NOI modeling and MRI Software investment reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; MRI Software Investment Management; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: opex_responsibility
attributes.description: Defines which party is responsible for property operating expenditures (OpEx) beyond CAM — including insurance, management fees, and administrative costs — under this lease type. Critical for NOI calculation accuracy in Argus Enterprise and financial reporting under FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: percentage_rent_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether percentage rent (a portion of tenant gross sales revenue above a breakpoint) is a feature of this lease type (True). Applicable primarily to retail percentage leases. Activates percentage rent calculation and reporting workflows in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: renewal_option_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether renewal options are a standard feature of this lease type (True) or not applicable (False). For example, ground leases and long-term commercial leases typically include renewal options, while month-to-month leases do not. Informs lease renewal option tracking in Yardi Voyager and WALT/WALE calculations in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: rent_basis
attributes.description: Defines the standard unit of measure for rent quotation under this lease type: PSF (Per Square Foot) annual, PSF monthly, flat monthly amount, flat annual amount, or percentage of sales. Aligns with industry PSF/SQF conventions and drives rent schedule generation in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise underwriting models.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: rent_structure
attributes.description: Defines the fundamental rent calculation methodology for this lease type: fixed (flat base rent), variable (indexed or market-reset), percentage (percentage of tenant sales revenue), hybrid (base + percentage), or ground_rent (land-only lease payment). Drives rent schedule generation logic in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise cash flow models.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise Valuation Module

attributes.name: security_deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security deposit is a standard requirement for this lease type (True). Security deposits are common in residential and commercial leases but may not apply to ground leases or certain institutional arrangements. Drives security deposit tracking and accounting in Yardi Voyager AR and MRI Software.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; MRI Software Residential Management; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: snda_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Agreement Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) agreement is a standard requirement for this lease type (True). SNDAs are typically required for commercial leases where the property is encumbered by a mortgage. Tracked in DocuSign CLM and Yardi Voyager lease document management.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of lease type options in user interface dropdowns, reports, and lease administration screens. Lower values appear first. Enables business-defined ordering independent of alphabetical or ID-based sorting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: sublease_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether subleasing is a standard permitted feature under this lease type (True). Relevant for distinguishing primary lease structures from sublease structures and for compliance with FASB ASC 842 sublease accounting requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: tax_responsibility
attributes.description: Specifies which party is responsible for real estate property taxes under this lease type. In a Triple Net (NNN) lease, the tenant bears tax responsibility; in a gross lease, the landlord absorbs taxes. Drives tax pass-through billing logic in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ti_allowance_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Tenant Improvement (TI) allowances are a standard feature of this lease type (True). TI allowances are common in commercial gross and modified gross leases but less common in NNN or ground leases. Drives TI allowance tracking and amortization in Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and FASB ASC 842 right-of-use asset calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: typical_term_max_months
attributes.description: The typical maximum lease duration in months associated with this lease type (e.g., 12 months for short-term, 120 months for standard commercial, 1200 months for ground leases). Used in Argus Enterprise for WALT/WALE modeling, portfolio duration analytics, and investment underwriting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: typical_term_min_months
attributes.description: The typical minimum lease duration in months associated with this lease type (e.g., 1 month for month-to-month, 12 months for short-term, 60 months for standard commercial NNN). Used in Argus Enterprise for WALT/WALE modeling and portfolio duration analytics.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lease type reference record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail requirements under SOX financial controls for reference data governance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: utility_responsibility
attributes.description: Specifies which party is responsible for utility costs (electricity, water, gas, HVAC) under this lease type. Gross leases typically assign utilities to the landlord; NNN leases assign them to the tenant. Drives utility billing configuration in Building Engines and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Building Engines; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: yardi_lease_type_code
attributes.description: The corresponding lease type code as configured in Yardi Voyager Lease Administration module. Enables direct mapping between this enterprise reference record and the source system code for data integration, reconciliation, and ETL processes from Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration Module

products.name: transaction_type
products.description: Controlled vocabulary for all real estate transaction categories — acquisition, disposition, 1031 exchange, REO sale, foreclosure, short sale, ground lease assignment, joint venture formation, and portfolio trade. Includes transaction sub-types, applicable regulatory reporting flags (SEC, HUD), and required documentation checklists per transaction category. Used by the transaction domain and brokerage domain as the authoritative classification source.

attributes.name: transaction_type_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each transaction type record in the controlled vocabulary. Primary key for the transaction_type reference product. [Role: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — _canonical_skip_reason: This is a controlled vocabulary / code-list entity; per-role minimum categories do not apply.]
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: regulatory_framework_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.regulatory_framework. Business justification: Transaction types are subject to specific primary regulatory frameworks (e.g., 1031 exchanges governed by IRS Section 1031, REIT transactions governed by SEC regulations, lease transactions governed b
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: appraisal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal property appraisal or valuation is required for transactions of this type. Triggers valuation workflow initiation in Argus Enterprise and appraisal order management processes.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC)

attributes.name: asset_class_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of real estate asset classes to which this transaction type applies (e.g., 'office,retail,industrial,multifamily,land,hotel,mixed-use'). Governs which asset classes can be tagged with this transaction type in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: broker_commission_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether brokerage commissions are applicable to transactions of this type. Drives commission calculation and split workflows in Salesforce CRM and the brokerage domain commission products.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: capex_or_opex
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operating Expenditure (OPEX) Classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions of this type are classified as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), Operating Expenditure (OPEX), both, or neither for financial reporting and budgeting purposes. Drives budget line categorization in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB); Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction type record was first created in the enterprise data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance reporting requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

attributes.name: due_diligence_period_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days allocated for due diligence for transactions of this type, as defined by industry convention or internal policy. Used as a default in deal timeline planning within Salesforce CRM and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this transaction type record becomes active and available for use across all operational and analytical systems. Supports temporal validity management of the controlled vocabulary.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: environmental_review_required
attributes.description: Flags whether an environmental site assessment (Phase I/II ESA) is required for transactions of this type. Drives due diligence checklist items in Procore and compliance tracking in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA); ASTM E1527 Phase I ESA Standard

attributes.name: esg_disclosure_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Disclosure Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions of this type require ESG-related disclosures (e.g., energy performance, LEED/BREEAM certification status, carbon footprint). Supports ESG reporting obligations for publicly traded REITs and institutional investors.
