attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; MLS data standards

attributes.name: fasb_asc842_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) ASC 842 Lease Classification
attributes.description: Specifies the lease accounting classification applicable to this tenure type under FASB ASC 842. Leasehold interests may be classified as finance or operating leases; freehold is classified as owned asset. Drives accounting treatment in the finance domain.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) — ASC 842 Lease Accounting

attributes.name: fractional_ownership
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tenure type inherently involves fractional or shared ownership of a property interest (True for timeshare, co-op share structures; False for sole freehold or standard leasehold). Relevant for investment portfolio and AUM calculations.
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: ground_lease_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tenure type is associated with or derived from a ground lease arrangement (True for leasehold, air rights; False for freehold, condominium). Links to the lease.ground_lease product for detailed ground lease terms.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: hoa_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties held under this tenure type are typically subject to Homeowners Association (HOA) governance, fees, and covenants. Applicable to condominium and certain freehold planned community structures.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: ifrs16_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) 16 Lease Classification
attributes.description: Specifies the lease accounting classification applicable to this tenure type under IFRS 16. Leasehold interests are typically recognized as right-of-use assets; freehold as owned assets. Supports international portfolio reporting and financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) — IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: is_financeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties held under this tenure type are generally eligible for conventional mortgage financing (True) or face significant financing restrictions (False), as is common with co-ops, timeshares, and certain leasehold structures. Informs LTV limit applicability.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenure type permits unrestricted transfer of ownership interest (True) or imposes transferability constraints such as board approval (co-op), lease assignment restrictions, or statutory limitations (life estate). Critical for deal structuring and title underwriting.
attributes.references: ALTA Standards; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: ltv_limit_pct
attributes.description: Maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio percentage typically permitted by lenders for properties held under this tenure type (e.g., 80.00 for freehold, 70.00 for leasehold, null for non-financeable types). Used in finance domain deal structuring and debt instrument underwriting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); CMBS/RMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional governance notes, legal caveats, jurisdiction-specific considerations, or data steward annotations related to this tenure type. Not used for operational processing; intended for data governance and reference data management purposes.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ownership_category
attributes.description: Broad legal ownership category grouping tenure types for portfolio analysis and regulatory reporting. 'freehold' = absolute ownership (fee simple); 'leasehold' = time-limited ownership under a ground lease; 'shared_ownership' = condominium or co-op structures; 'limited_interest' = easement, air rights, life estate; 'other' = non-standard structures.
attributes.references: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: ownership_duration_type
attributes.description: Classifies the temporal nature of ownership rights conferred by this tenure type. 'perpetual' = freehold/fee simple with no expiry; 'fixed_term' = leasehold with defined expiry; 'life_of_holder' = life estate; 'conditional' = easement or air rights subject to conditions; 'not_applicable' = timeshare or other fractional structures.
attributes.references: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: pmi_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) requirements apply to financing arrangements for properties held under this tenure type. Relevant for residential freehold and condominium structures where LTV exceeds 80%.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); PMI industry standards

attributes.name: property_use_class
attributes.description: Indicates the primary property use classification(s) for which this tenure type is applicable. For example, 'co-op' is predominantly residential; 'air rights' may apply to commercial or mixed-use; 'freehold' applies to all. Used to filter valid tenure types in property and transaction domain workflows.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: registration_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal title or deed registration with a government land registry is required for this tenure type. Typically True for freehold and long leasehold; may vary for easements and air rights depending on jurisdiction.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); ALTA Standards; U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: reit_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties held under this tenure type qualify for inclusion in a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) portfolio under SEC and IRS REIT qualification rules. Certain limited-interest tenures (e.g., timeshare, some easements) may not qualify.
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC); IRS REIT qualification rules

attributes.name: reso_field_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Field Name
attributes.description: The standardized field name or lookup value from the Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary that corresponds to this tenure type. Ensures MLS interoperability and industry-standard data exchange compliance.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: short_name

attributes.name: snda_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) agreement is typically required for financing or leasing transactions under this tenure type. Relevant for leasehold and ground lease structures.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: title_insurance_required

attributes.references: CoStar Suite Market Research; Argus Enterprise Valuation; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: breakpoint_type
attributes.description: Specifies the breakpoint type used in percentage rent calculations for this space use type — natural breakpoint (base rent divided by percentage rate), artificial breakpoint (negotiated fixed threshold), or not applicable. Relevant for retail and F&B use types in Yardi Voyager percentage rent schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module

attributes.name: cam_inclusion_rule
attributes.description: Defines whether Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges are included, excluded, partially included, or not applicable for spaces of this use type. Drives CAM reconciliation logic in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software lease accounting modules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA International

attributes.name: cam_recovery_method
attributes.description: Specifies the CAM expense recovery methodology applicable to this space use type — pro-rata share, fixed amount, capped recovery, base-year stop, or not applicable. Used in Yardi Voyager CAM estimate and reconciliation schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager CAM Administration

attributes.name: capex_responsibility
attributes.description: Defines the default Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) responsibility for structural improvements and major systems for this space use type — landlord, tenant, shared, or not applicable. Supports CAPEX planning in Procore and fixed asset management in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Procore Construction Management; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: co_tenancy_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether co-tenancy clauses (allowing rent reduction or termination rights if anchor tenants vacate) are typically applicable for this space use type. Primarily relevant for retail and food-and-beverage use types in shopping center lease structures.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Urban Land Institute (ULI); DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this space use type classification became or becomes effective in the enterprise controlled vocabulary. Supports temporal validity tracking for data governance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: exclusive_use_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether exclusive use clauses (restricting the landlord from leasing adjacent space to competing tenants) are typically applicable for this space use type. Relevant for retail, food-and-beverage, and medical use types in lease negotiation and Salesforce CRM deal pipeline management.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Salesforce CRM Deal Pipeline; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this space use type classification ceases to be valid in the enterprise controlled vocabulary. Null indicates no planned expiry. Supports deprecation management and controlled vocabulary lifecycle governance.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: external_code_costar

attributes.name: external_code_reso

attributes.name: fire_egress_class

attributes.name: fit_out_category
attributes.description: Standard fit-out delivery condition associated with this space use type — warm shell, cold shell, turnkey, as-is, or not applicable. Informs TI allowance benchmarking, construction scope in Procore, and lease negotiation defaults in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: food_service_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether food preparation and service activities are permitted for spaces of this use type. attributes.name: hvac_responsibility
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Responsibility
attributes.description: Defines who bears responsibility for Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems for this space use type — landlord, tenant, shared, or not applicable. Drives lease clause defaults in DocuSign CLM and work order assignment rules in Building Engines.

attributes.name: leed_relevance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Relevance
attributes.description: Indicates the degree to which LEED certification criteria and ESG sustainability metrics are relevant to this space use type — high, medium, low, or not applicable. attributes.name: load_factor_typical
attributes.description: Typical load factor (also known as loss factor or add-on factor) expressed as a decimal ratio for this space use type, representing the difference between rentable and usable area (e.g., 0.15 = 15%). Used in BOMA-compliant area calculations and rent roll reporting in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: BOMA International; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: max_contiguous_area
attributes.description: Maximum contiguous leasable area (in the applicable unit of measure — SQF or SQM) typically available for this space use type within a single building. Used in CoStar Suite availability searches and brokerage space matching for large-block tenant requirements.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Property Analytics; BOMA International; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: measurement_standard
attributes.description: Defines the area measurement methodology applicable to this space use type — Gross Leasable Area (GLA), Net Leasable Area (NLA), BOMA standard, IPMS standard, gross, or net. Governs how rentable square footage is calculated and reported for rent roll and lease administration purposes.
attributes.references: BOMA International; International Property Measurement Standards (IPMS); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: min_divisible_area
attributes.description: Minimum leasable area (in the applicable unit of measure — SQF or SQM) to which a space of this use type can be subdivided. Governs space planning and demised space configuration in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software space inventory management.
attributes.references: BOMA International; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Space Management

attributes.name: occupancy_density_typical
attributes.description: Typical occupancy density expressed as area per person (SQF or SQM per person) for this space use type. Used in building capacity planning, HVAC sizing, fire safety compliance, and ESG workplace analytics.
attributes.references: OSHA Building Safety; BOMA International; U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED

attributes.name: opex_responsibility
attributes.description: Defines the default Operating Expenditure (OPEX) responsibility allocation for this space use type — landlord, tenant, shared, or not applicable. Informs lease structure defaults, CAM billing configuration in Yardi Voyager, and NOI modeling in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: outdoor_area_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether outdoor or exterior leasable area (e.g., patio, terrace, rooftop deck, signage fascia) is applicable and measurable for this space use type. Affects GLA/NLA calculation methodology and lease area definitions in Yardi Voyager.

attributes.name: parking_ratio_per_1000sqf
attributes.description: Standard parking ratio (number of parking stalls per 1,000 square feet of leasable area) associated with this space use type. Used in property development feasibility, zoning compliance, and lease negotiation for office, retail, and medical use types.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Local Zoning Authorities

attributes.name: percentage_rent_applicable

attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: property_type_applicability
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of property types to which this space use type applies (e.g., 'office_building|mixed_use|retail_center|medical_office'). attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: rent_escalation_type
attributes.description: Typical rent escalation mechanism associated with this space use type — fixed step increases, CPI-indexed, percentage-based, flat (no escalation), or not applicable. Informs rent schedule configuration in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise cash flow projections.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting revenue recognition method applicable to lease income for this space use type — straight-line, cash basis, percentage of completion, or not applicable. attributes.name: rou_asset_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Right-of-Use (ROU) asset must be recognized on the lessee's balance sheet for leases of this space use type under FASB ASC 842 or IFRS 16. Drives lease accounting classification logic in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software lease accounting modules.

attributes.name: sort_order

attributes.name: sublease_permitted

attributes.name: ti_allowance_benchmark_psf

attributes.description: Market benchmark Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance expressed in currency Per Square Foot (PSF) for this space use type. Provides a reference value for lease negotiation, deal underwriting in Argus Enterprise, and TI budget planning in Procore.

attributes.name: typical_lease_term_min_months

attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); CoStar Suite Market Research; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: use_category
attributes.description: Broad asset class category grouping the space use type (e.g., commercial, residential, mixed_use, industrial, hospitality, specialty). Aligns with CoStar Suite and Argus Enterprise asset class taxonomies for portfolio-level reporting and investment analysis.

attributes.name: use_type_code
attributes.description: Short, system-recognized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the space use type (e.g., OFF, RET, F&B, MED, FIT, STG, PRK, RTF, SGN, CAM). Used as the business key in Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and CoStar Suite for space inventory classification and rent roll reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite Property Analytics

attributes.name: use_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the space use classification, including typical tenant profile, permitted activities, and distinguishing characteristics from adjacent use types. Supports training, onboarding, and data governance documentation.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: use_type_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the space use classification (e.g., 'Office', 'Retail', 'Restaurant / Food and Beverage', 'Medical / Dental', 'Fitness', 'Storage', 'Parking', 'Rooftop', 'Signage', 'Common Area'). Displayed in lease administration, rent roll, and brokerage reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: zoning_use_class
attributes.description: Standard zoning use classification code or category associated with this space use type (e.g., B1, A1, A3, D1 under UK Use Classes Order; or C-1, C-2, O-1 under US zoning codes). products.name: investment_vehicle
products.description: Reference classification for real estate investment structures and legal vehicles — REIT (equity, mortgage, hybrid), private equity fund (open-end, closed-end), ODCE fund, value-add/opportunistic fund, joint venture (JV), separate account, CMBS, RMBS, DST (Delaware Statutory Trust), TIC (Tenants in Common), and 1031 exchange vehicle. Defines regulatory classification (SEC, FINRA, state blue sky), applicable tax treatment (pass-through, REIT distribution requirements, UBTI), investor eligibility requirements (accredited, qualified purchaser, institutional), minimum investment thresholds, and reporting standards (NCREIF, INREV, ANREV). attributes.name: esg_reporting_required

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: finra_product_type_code

attributes.name: fund_structure

attributes.name: geographic_focus

attributes.name: ifrs_adopted

attributes.name: land_registration_system

attributes.name: lease_accounting_standard

attributes.name: leed_recognized

products.name: regulatory_framework
products.description: Registry of regulatory and compliance frameworks governing real estate operations across all jurisdictions. Covers lease accounting (ASC 842, IFRS 16), financial reporting (SOX, SEC Regulation S-X), fair housing (HUD Fair Housing Act), environmental (EPA CERCLA, state brownfield programs), workplace safety (OSHA 29 CFR 1910), data privacy (GDPR, CCPA), accessibility (ADA), building codes (IBC, NFPA), and local ordinances (rent control, inclusionary zoning). products.name: program_property_type_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the underwriting coverage configuration between property_type and insurance_program. It captures the specific coverage requirements, limits, endorsements, and exclusions that apply when a particular property type is included in an insurance program. Each record links one property_type to one insurance_program with underwriting parameters that exist only in the context of this relationship. This is an operational underwriting design artifact created during program structuring and renewal processes.. Existence Justification: Insurance programs in real estate cover portfolios containing multiple property types (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, land), and each property type appears across multiple insurance programs over different policy years and portfolio segments. The underwriting process requires risk managers to define specific coverage requirements, minimum limits, mandatory endorsements, exclusions, and rate tiers for each property type within each program. This is an operational underwriting design activity performed during program structuring and renewal.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master record for every marketing campaign executed across commercial and residential portfolios. Captures campaign name, type (digital, print, OOH, email, social, event), objective (lead generation, brand awareness, listing promotion, market penetration), target audience segment, geographic market, property type focus, campaign status (draft, active, paused, completed), planned start and end dates, actual run dates, total approved budget, total spend to date, campaign owner, and associated brand or sub-brand. SSOT for campaign identity across all marketing activities.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign concluded. Used to calculate true campaign duration and compare against planned timeline for post-campaign performance analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign went live and began generating impressions or leads. May differ from planned start date due to creative approval delays or market timing adjustments.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the campaign received final budget and compliance approval. Used for SOX audit trails and to measure planning-to-launch lead time.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Budget Approval

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current state of the campaign's internal approval workflow, including budget authorization and compliance sign-off. Distinct from campaign lifecycle status — a campaign may be approved but not yet active.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval; SOX Section 302 (financial controls); DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) / Operating Expenditure (OPEX) budget allocated to the campaign, expressed in the operating currency. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA budget approval workflow and reconciled against finance.budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Management; FASB ASC 340-40; SOX Section 302 (financial controls)

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who granted final budget and compliance approval for the campaign. Supports SOX audit trail requirements for marketing spend authorization.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; SAP S/4HANA Approval Workflow

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the campaign, used in cross-system references, purchase orders, and vendor invoices. Format: MARKET-YEAR-SEQUENCE (e.g., CRE-2024-QTRQ1).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the marketing campaign as displayed in Salesforce CRM and internal reporting dashboards (e.g., 'Q1 2024 Downtown Office Leasing Drive').
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the campaign. Controls visibility in active reporting, spend authorization, and lead attribution routing within Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Status Field

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the marketing channel or medium used for the campaign. Drives channel-specific performance benchmarking and spend allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: digital|print|out_of_home|email|social_media|event|direct_mail|broadcast — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Type Field; National Association of Realtors (NAR) Marketing Standards

attributes.name: channel_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of marketing channels deployed within this campaign (e.g., 'google_ads,facebook,email,mls_syndication'). Provides a high-level channel inventory for multi-channel campaign analysis without requiring a separate channel line table.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; National Association of Realtors (NAR) Digital Marketing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the campaign record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for the Silver Layer and supports SOX compliance audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability); Salesforce CRM System Fields

attributes.name: creative_theme
attributes.description: The overarching creative concept or messaging theme of the campaign (e.g., 'Urban Living Redefined', 'Prime Office Space Available', 'ESG-Certified Buildings'). Used for brand consistency audits and creative performance analysis.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) Brand Standards; U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) ESG Marketing Guidelines

attributes.name: digital_platform
attributes.description: Name of the primary digital advertising platform used for the campaign (e.g., 'Google Ads', 'Meta Ads Manager', 'LinkedIn Campaign Manager', 'CoStar Advertise'). Supports platform-level spend and performance reconciliation.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Advertising Platform; Salesforce CRM Campaign Object

attributes.name: esg_aligned_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Aligned Campaign Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campaign promotes Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) credentials such as Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) certification, Building Research Establishment Environmental Assessment Method (BREEAM) ratings, or sustainability initiatives.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED Marketing; SEC ESG Disclosure Requirements; Urban Land Institute (ULI) ESG Framework

attributes.name: fair_housing_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campaign has been reviewed and confirmed compliant with the Fair Housing Act and U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) advertising guidelines. Mandatory for all residential marketing campaigns.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Fair Housing Act; compliance.fair_housing_record; National Association of Realtors (NAR) Code of Ethics

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campaign's audience targeting, data collection, and lead capture processes comply with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) requirements. Required for campaigns targeting EU-based prospects.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing); GDPR Article 13 (Transparency); compliance.program

attributes.name: mls_syndication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campaign includes syndication of property listings to Multiple Listing Service (MLS) platforms (e.g., Zillow, Realtor.com, CoStar). Drives integration with brokerage.mls_syndication records.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for campaign managers to record strategic context, special instructions, vendor notes, or post-campaign observations not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Description Field

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Primary business objective the campaign is designed to achieve. Used to align campaign KPIs and measure success against strategic marketing goals across commercial and residential portfolios.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; Urban Land Institute (ULI) Marketing Best Practices

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally approved end date for the campaign. Used for budget period alignment, Weighted Average Lease Term (WALT) correlation analysis, and campaign lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign End Date Field; FASB ASC 340-40

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The originally approved start date for the campaign as defined during the planning and budget approval process. Used for campaign scheduling and budget period alignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Start Date Field; FASB ASC 340-40 (marketing cost capitalization)

attributes.name: primary_channel
attributes.description: The dominant marketing channel driving the majority of campaign spend and reach. Used for channel-level performance benchmarking and budget allocation optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paid_search|paid_social|email|display|out_of_home|print|event|mls_syndication|direct_mail|broadcast — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this campaign record originated (e.g., Salesforce CRM, CoStar Suite, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; CoStar Suite; SAP S/4HANA; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: source_system_campaign_code
attributes.description: The native campaign identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Campaign ID). Enables reconciliation between the Silver Layer and source systems during ETL validation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: target_impression_count
attributes.description: The planned number of ad impressions or audience reach exposures targeted for the campaign. Used for brand awareness campaigns and digital media planning benchmarks.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; National Association of Realtors (NAR) Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: target_lead_count
attributes.description: The planned number of qualified leads the campaign is expected to generate. Set during campaign planning and used as the primary lead generation KPI benchmark in Salesforce CRM pipeline reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Expected Responses Field; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: total_spend_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative actual spend incurred against the campaign budget as of the last reconciliation date. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable (AP) and reconciled with finance.ap_invoice records. Enables real-time budget utilization monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable (AP); FASB ASC 340-40; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the campaign record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and change data capture (CDC) processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate Field

products.name: campaign_flight
products.description: Transactional record representing a discrete execution flight or burst within a parent campaign — a specific channel activation, media buy, or ad run period. Captures flight name, channel type (Google Ads, Meta, CoStar, Zillow, LoopNet, email, direct mail, billboard), flight start and end dates, flight budget, impressions delivered, clicks, spend, placement details, creative asset reference, and flight status. Enables multi-channel campaign decomposition and channel-level performance tracking.

attributes.name: cpc_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated or platform-set cost per click (CPC) for this flight, in the operating currency. Used for click-based channel cost benchmarking and ROI analysis on lead generation flights.
attributes.references: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) — CPC Standard; Google Ads Billing

attributes.name: cpm_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated or platform-set cost per one thousand impressions (CPM) for this flight, in the operating currency. Used for media buy pricing benchmarking and impression-based channel cost analysis.
attributes.references: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) — CPM Standard; CoStar Suite — Advertising Rate Card

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this campaign flight record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and record provenance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail; Internal Data Governance

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: image|video|carousel|text|html5|direct_mail_piece|email_template|outdoor — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) — Ad Unit Guidelines; Internal Creative Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this flight record (flight_budget, actual_spend, cpm_rate, cpc_rate). Defaults to USD for domestic US real estate operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this campaign flight is scheduled to stop delivering. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen flights. Used for budget pacing, expiry alerts, and WALT-style weighted average flight term calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign End Date; Internal Campaign Management Policy

attributes.name: esg_aligned
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Aligned Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flight promotes ESG-certified or sustainability-focused properties (e.g., LEED, BREEAM certified assets). Supports ESG marketing reporting and green portfolio brand positioning.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Certification; BREEAM Standards; SEC — ESG Disclosure for REITs

attributes.name: fair_housing_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flight's creative, targeting, and placement have been reviewed and confirmed compliant with the Fair Housing Act (FHA) and HUD advertising guidelines. Mandatory for residential property marketing flights. True = compliant, False = pending review or non-compliant.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) — Fair Housing Act; National Association of Realtors (NAR) — Fair Housing Policy; compliance.fair_housing_record

attributes.name: flight_budget
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to this specific flight in the operating currency (USD). Represents the planned CAPEX/OPEX marketing spend for this channel activation. Used for budget vs. actual spend variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Cost Center Budgeting; FASB ASC 720 — Advertising Costs; Internal Marketing Budget Policy

attributes.name: flight_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for this flight, typically including the channel, property portfolio, and run period (e.g., 'Q3-2024 Google Ads — Downtown Office Portfolio').
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Object; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: flight_number

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member/Activity; Internal Naming Convention

attributes.name: flight_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the campaign flight. Tracks progression from planning through execution to closure. Values: draft (being configured), scheduled (approved, not yet started), active (currently running), paused (temporarily halted), completed (run period ended), cancelled (terminated before completion).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Status; Internal Campaign Management Policy

attributes.name: impressions_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of ad impressions served to target audiences during this flight. A key reach metric for brand awareness campaigns across digital channels (Google Ads, Meta, CoStar, Zillow, LoopNet). Used in CPM (Cost Per Mille) performance calculations.

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: The destination URL to which users are directed upon clicking the ad in this flight. Typically a property listing page, microsite, or lead capture form. Used for conversion tracking and digital experience analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Landing Page; Internal Digital Marketing Standards

attributes.name: leads_generated
attributes.description: Number of qualified leads (prospect inquiries, form submissions, or contact requests) directly attributed to this flight. Core lead generation KPI linking marketing spend to brokerage pipeline activity in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Lead Source Attribution; National Association of Realtors (NAR) — Lead Management Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for campaign managers to capture contextual notes, special instructions, vendor negotiation details, or performance observations related to this flight. Not used for structured analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Notes; Internal Campaign Management Policy

attributes.name: placement_name

attributes.references: CoStar Suite — Listing Advertising; Salesforce CRM — Campaign Activity

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — Data Lineage Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: avg_asking_rent_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Asking Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Weighted or simple average of the quoted/advertised asking rent across all surveyed properties, expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) annual basis. Represents the gross market asking rate before concessions or negotiation.

attributes.name: avg_concession_value_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Concession Value Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Average total value of landlord concessions offered per square foot across the surveyed competitive set, including free rent periods (converted to PSF equivalent) and tenant improvement (TI) allowances. Measures the gap between asking and effective rents.

attributes.name: avg_effective_rent_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Effective Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Average net rent actually achievable after accounting for concessions such as free rent periods, tenant improvement (TI) allowances, and other landlord incentives. Reflects true market pricing and is used in Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) and Net Operating Income (NOI) modeling.

attributes.name: avg_free_rent_months

attributes.name: avg_lease_term_months
attributes.description: Average lease duration in months for new leases executed in the surveyed competitive set during the survey period. Informs Weighted Average Lease Term (WALT) benchmarking and portfolio duration risk analysis.

attributes.name: avg_ti_allowance_psf

attributes.name: source_system_campaign_id
attributes.description: The native primary key or identifier for this email campaign record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud Job ID, HubSpot Email ID, Mailchimp Campaign ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: campaign_spend

attributes.name: can_spam_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this email campaign was verified as compliant with the CAN-SPAM Act requirements, including accurate sender identification, non-deceptive subject lines, physical address inclusion, and opt-out mechanism.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704)

attributes.name: click_count
attributes.description: The number of unique clicks on tracked links within the email body for this campaign. Primary engagement metric for measuring content effectiveness and lead intent signals.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this email campaign record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5(2) — Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the campaign spend amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency portfolio environments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: delivered_count
attributes.description: The number of emails successfully delivered to recipient inboxes (total recipients minus hard and soft bounces). Core deliverability metric for ESP performance evaluation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Delivered Count; Email Sender & Provider Coalition (ESPC) Standards

attributes.name: esp_campaign_ref
attributes.description: The native campaign or send identifier assigned by the email service provider (Mailchimp, HubSpot, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Used for cross-system reconciliation and ESP-level reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Job ID; Mailchimp — Campaign ID; HubSpot — Email Campaign ID

attributes.name: fair_housing_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the email campaign content was reviewed and confirmed compliant with the Fair Housing Act, ensuring no discriminatory language, imagery, or targeting based on protected class characteristics.
attributes.references: Fair Housing Act (42 U.S.C. § 3604); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines; NAR Code of Ethics

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this email campaign was verified as compliant with GDPR requirements, including lawful basis for processing, consent verification, unsubscribe mechanism, and sender identification.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 6, 7, 13 — Lawful Basis, Consent, Transparency

attributes.name: hard_bounce_count
attributes.description: The number of emails that permanently failed delivery due to invalid or non-existent email addresses. Hard bounces must be suppressed from future sends per ESP best practices and GDPR data accuracy requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Hard Bounce Count; GDPR Article 5(1)(d) — Accuracy

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: The primary destination URL to which email recipients are directed upon clicking the main call-to-action. Used for conversion tracking and property listing page performance analysis.
attributes.references: NAR Digital Marketing Standards; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) — Listing URL

attributes.name: lead_count
attributes.description: The number of qualified leads generated as a direct attribution of this email campaign, based on click-through actions resulting in form submissions, inquiry calls, or CRM lead creation in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Lead Object; NAR Digital Marketing Standards

attributes.name: open_count
attributes.description: The number of unique email opens recorded for this campaign. Measures recipient engagement with the subject line and preview text. Note: impacted by Apple Mail Privacy Protection (MPP) since iOS 15.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Unique Opens; GDPR Article 5 — Data Minimisation

attributes.name: personalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this email campaign used dynamic content personalization (e.g., recipient name merge fields, personalized property recommendations, or dynamic listing content). Used to measure personalization impact on engagement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Dynamic Content; GDPR Article 22 — Automated Decision-Making

attributes.name: preview_text
attributes.description: Pre-header or preview text displayed alongside the subject line in email clients. Complements the subject line to improve open rates and is tracked for A/B testing effectiveness.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Preheader Text; NAR Digital Marketing Standards

attributes.name: reply_to_email
attributes.description: The email address to which recipient replies are directed, which may differ from the sender address. Required for CAN-SPAM compliance and tenant/investor response management.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704); GDPR Article 13

attributes.name: scheduled_send_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the email campaign was scheduled to be sent to the target audience. Used for send-time optimization analysis and operational scheduling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Scheduled Send Time

attributes.name: send_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the ESP confirmed completion of the full send to all recipients. Marks the end of the active sending lifecycle phase and is used for throughput and performance window calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Send Completion Timestamp

attributes.name: sender_email
attributes.description: The FROM email address used to send this campaign. Must be a verified domain address per CAN-SPAM and GDPR requirements. Used for deliverability tracking and compliance auditing.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704); GDPR Article 13; RFC 5321 — SMTP

attributes.name: sender_name
attributes.description: The display name shown as the sender in the recipient's email client (e.g., 'Acme Realty Investor Relations', 'Downtown Leasing Team'). Affects deliverability and brand recognition.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704) — Sender Identification

attributes.name: soft_bounce_count
attributes.description: The number of emails that temporarily failed delivery due to recipient mailbox full, server unavailable, or message size issues. Soft bounces are retried and monitored for conversion to hard bounces.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Soft Bounce Count; Email Sender & Provider Coalition (ESPC) Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this email campaign record originated (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Mailchimp, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; HubSpot; Mailchimp; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: spam_complaint_count
attributes.description: The number of recipients who marked this email as spam or junk. High complaint rates damage sender reputation and ESP deliverability scores. Monitored for CAN-SPAM and GDPR compliance.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704); GDPR Article 7; RFC 5965 — Abuse Reporting Format

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: The subject line text displayed to recipients in their email inbox. Critical for open rate analysis, A/B testing, and compliance with CAN-SPAM and GDPR subject line transparency requirements.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704); GDPR Article 13 — Transparency

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the email template used for this campaign execution, governing layout, branding, and base content. Enables template performance benchmarking across sends.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Email Template Object

attributes.name: total_recipients
attributes.description: The total number of email addresses included in the send list for this campaign before any suppression or filtering. Represents the gross audience size.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Audience Size; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: unsubscribe_count
attributes.description: The number of recipients who opted out of future email communications via the unsubscribe link in this campaign. Critical for CAN-SPAM and GDPR compliance monitoring and list health management.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704) — Opt-Out Mechanism; GDPR Article 7 — Withdrawal of Consent

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this email campaign record was last modified. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail requirements in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5(2) — Accountability

attributes.name: keyword_phrase

attributes.name: last_ranking_check_date

attributes.name: last_updated_date

attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: property_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.property_type. Business justification: Campaign property inclusion decisions and marketing spend allocation are reported by property type. Normalizing enables campaign ROI analysis segmented by asset class for portfolio marketing decisions
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sustainability_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.sustainability_rating. Business justification: ESG-aligned marketing campaigns highlight sustainability certifications as a key selling point. Normalizing green_certification_code to reference.sustainability_rating enables ESG marketing reporting
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: transaction_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.transaction_type. Business justification: Properties are marketed for specific transaction types (for sale, for lease, for investment). Campaign property records must reference the transaction type to ensure correct messaging, pricing display
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Actual marketing expenditure incurred for promoting this specific property within the campaign to date. Used for budget variance analysis and property-level OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 340-40; SOX Financial Controls; Yardi Voyager — GL Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the inclusion of this property in the campaign was formally approved by the authorized marketing or asset management stakeholder.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Internal Controls; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the marketing manager or asset manager who approved the inclusion of this property in the campaign. Supports governance, audit trail, and SOX compliance for marketing spend authorization.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Internal Controls; FASB ASC 340-40

attributes.name: asking_price
attributes.description: The listed asking price for the property at the time of campaign inclusion, applicable for sale transactions. Used in campaign creative and lead qualification. Expressed in the campaign's operating currency.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) — Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: asking_rent_psf
attributes.description: The advertised asking rent expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis for lease transactions. Key metric used in campaign materials and competitive positioning for commercial leasing campaigns.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite — Lease Comparables

attributes.name: available_sqft
attributes.description: The total available square footage (SQF) of the property being marketed in this campaign. Used in campaign listings, lead qualification, and size-based audience targeting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) — GLA/NLA Standards; BOMA International

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this campaign-property association record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this record (property_budget_amount, actual_spend_amount). Defaults to the campaign's operating currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: days_on_market
attributes.description: Number of days this property has been actively marketed as of the campaign association record. A key real estate performance indicator used to assess campaign urgency, pricing competitiveness, and market demand.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) — Days on Market

attributes.name: esg_aligned
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Aligned Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property's campaign promotion highlights ESG credentials such as LEED certification, BREEAM rating, or other sustainability attributes as part of the campaign messaging strategy.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED; BREEAM; Urban Land Institute (ULI) ESG Reporting

attributes.name: fair_housing_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campaign materials and promotional content for this property have been reviewed and confirmed compliant with the Fair Housing Act and applicable anti-discrimination regulations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) — Fair Housing Act; National Association of Realtors (NAR) Code of Ethics

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: The geographic market or submarket designation for this property within the campaign (e.g., 'Manhattan Midtown', 'Austin CBD', 'Los Angeles Westside'). Used for market-level campaign performance segmentation and CoStar submarket alignment.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite — Submarket Definitions; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: inclusion_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this property's promotion within the campaign is scheduled to end or was actually removed. Nullable for open-ended inclusions that run through the campaign's full duration.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: inclusion_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this property began being actively promoted within the campaign. May differ from the campaign start date if the property was added mid-campaign.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: inclusion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this property's inclusion within the campaign. 'active' means the property is currently being promoted; 'paused' means promotion is temporarily suspended; 'pending' means inclusion is approved but not yet live; 'removed' means the property has been withdrawn from the campaign; 'completed' means the campaign period for this property has ended.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Status; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this property is designated as the featured or hero property in the campaign, receiving premium placement in campaign materials, digital ads, and listing portals.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: listing_url
attributes.description: The specific listing URL used to promote this property within the campaign. May be a campaign-specific landing page URL distinct from the standard MLS or portal listing URL, enabling campaign-level click tracking and attribution.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) — Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: mls_number
attributes.description: The MLS listing number associated with this property as used in the campaign. Enables cross-referencing with MLS syndication records and tracking of campaign-driven MLS activity.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) — MLS Policy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or qualitative observations about this property's inclusion in the campaign (e.g., negotiated placement terms, special promotional conditions, asset manager directives).
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); Salesforce CRM — Campaign Notes

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the relative promotional priority of this property within the campaign. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used to determine placement order in multi-property campaign materials and digital listings.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Sort Order

attributes.name: property_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the overall campaign budget specifically allocated to promote this individual property. Enables property-level marketing spend tracking and ROI analysis. Expressed in the campaign's operating currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 340-40; Urban Land Institute (ULI); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: property_lead_count
attributes.description: Number of qualified leads directly attributed to this property's promotion within the campaign. Supports property-level lead attribution and campaign effectiveness measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Lead Attribution; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: property_role
attributes.description: Defines the strategic role this property plays within the campaign. 'featured' indicates the property is the primary promotional focus; 'portfolio_showcase' indicates it is part of a multi-asset portfolio presentation; 'comparable_reference' indicates it is used as a market comparable; 'anchor' indicates it is the lead asset driving campaign identity; 'supporting' indicates a secondary promotional role.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: removal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this property was removed or excluded from the campaign before its scheduled end date. Populated only when inclusion_status is 'removed'. Supports campaign post-mortem analysis and portfolio management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sold|leased|withdrawn|budget_exhausted|strategy_change|duplicate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this campaign-property association record originated (e.g., Salesforce CRM, Yardi Voyager, MRI Software). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; Salesforce CRM; MRI Software

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier or record key for this campaign-property association in the originating source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; Salesforce CRM; MRI Software

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this campaign-property association record was last modified. Supports change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: The UTM campaign tracking parameter appended to the property's listing URL for this campaign association. Enables digital attribution of web traffic and leads to this specific campaign-property combination.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce CRM — Campaign Tracking

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: The UTM medium tracking parameter identifying the marketing medium used for this property's campaign promotion (e.g., cpc, email, display, organic). Supports multi-channel attribution reporting.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce CRM — Campaign Tracking

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: The UTM source tracking parameter identifying the originating platform or channel for this property's campaign promotion (e.g., costar, loopnet, zillow, google). Supports channel-level attribution analysis.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: replaced_campaign_property_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on campaign_property (replaced_campaign_property_id)

products.name: campaign_unit_inclusion
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a specific unit in a marketing campaign. It captures the operational relationship between property inventory and marketing activities. Each record links one unit to one campaign with attributes that track when the unit was featured, at what asking rent, with what priority level, and what budget was allocated to promote that specific unit within the campaign.. Existence Justification: In real estate marketing operations, a single unit can be simultaneously featured across multiple campaigns (e.g., a vacant unit appears in a lease-up campaign, a seasonal promotion, and a referral incentive campaign at the same time), and a single campaign typically promotes multiple units (e.g., a building lease-up campaign features 20+ available units). Marketing teams actively manage these inclusions, adjusting which units are featured, at what priority, and with what budget allocation as vacancy and market conditions change.

attributes.name: campaign_unit_inclusion_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this campaign-unit inclusion record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign in which this unit is featured
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific leasable or saleable unit included in this campaign
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: asking_rent_at_inclusion
attributes.description: The asking rent per square foot (PSF) for this unit at the time it was included in the campaign. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot because asking rent may change during the campaign lifecycle, and marketing needs to track what rent was advertised.

attributes.name: campaign_unit_budget
attributes.description: The portion of the total campaign budget allocated specifically to promoting this unit. Used in multi-unit campaigns to track spend per unit and calculate cost-per-lead and cost-per-lease at the unit level.

attributes.name: inclusion_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this unit was removed from the campaign or the campaign concluded. Used to calculate total days featured and measure time-to-lease for campaign-driven leads.

attributes.name: inclusion_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this unit was added to the campaign and began being featured in marketing materials. Used to calculate exposure duration and align with campaign flight dates.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this unit is designated as a featured or hero unit within the campaign, receiving premium placement in creative assets and higher budget allocation.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this unit within the campaign (1 = highest priority). Determines placement in digital ads, email sequences, and listing order on landing pages. Used by marketing to feature premium or high-vacancy units more prominently.

products.name: campaign_contribution
products.description: This association product represents the participation of real estate workforce personnel in marketing campaigns. It captures the specific role, time allocation, and contribution period for each employee working on each campaign. Each record links one employee to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this working relationship, enabling tracking of multi-disciplinary campaign teams and individual workload allocation across concurrent campaigns.. Existence Justification: In real estate marketing operations, campaigns require multi-disciplinary teams where a single employee (e.g., a listing agent) works across multiple concurrent campaigns, and each campaign engages multiple employees in different roles (photographer, copywriter, marketing coordinator, lead agent). The business actively manages these assignments with specific role definitions, time allocation percentages, and contribution periods that are tracked, updated, and reported on as operational data.

attributes.name: campaign_contribution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each employee-campaign contribution record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign receiving the contribution
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to workforce.employee identifying the contributing employee
attributes.references: workforce.employee.employee_id

attributes.name: actual_hours
attributes.description: The actual total hours the employee contributed to this campaign, as recorded in time tracking systems. Used for performance analysis, cost reconciliation, and future estimation calibration.

attributes.name: allocation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the employee's working time allocated to this campaign during the contribution period. Used for workload balancing, capacity planning, and cost allocation. Values range from 0.01 to 100.00.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this employee's assignment to the campaign. Values: Planned (scheduled but not started), Active (currently contributing), On Hold (temporarily paused), Completed (contribution finished), Cancelled (assignment removed before completion). Drives active resource reporting.

attributes.name: billable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employee's time on this campaign is billable to a client or property owner (true) or is internal overhead (false). Relevant for brokerage campaigns where marketing costs may be passed through to sellers.

attributes.name: contribution_type
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the nature of the employee's contribution to the campaign. Values: Creative (content creation, design), Execution (campaign deployment, coordination), Strategy (planning, targeting), Analysis (performance measurement), Support (administrative, logistics). Used for team composition analysis.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this contribution record was created in the data product.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee's contribution to this campaign concluded. Null if the employee is still actively contributing. Used to calculate actual contribution duration and close out resource assignments.

attributes.name: estimated_hours
attributes.description: The estimated total hours the employee is expected to contribute to this campaign over the contribution period. Used for resource planning and budget estimation.

attributes.name: is_primary_owner
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employee is the primary owner or lead for the campaign. Typically only one employee per campaign has this flag set to true. Used to identify accountability and primary contact.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context about this employee's contribution to the campaign, such as specific deliverables, special circumstances, or handoff notes.

attributes.name: role_on_campaign
attributes.description: The specific functional role the employee performs on this campaign. Examples: Lead Agent (primary listing agent), Supporting Agent, Marketing Coordinator, Photographer, Copywriter, Graphic Designer, Social Media Manager, Campaign Manager, Analyst. Drives responsibility assignment and performance attribution.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee began contributing to this campaign. Used to track contribution duration and align with campaign phases.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this contribution record was last modified.

domains.name: insurance
domains.description: Manages property and liability insurance policies, claims, risk assessments, certificates of insurance (COI), and loss run reports across the real estate portfolio. Tracks policy renewals, premium payments, coverage limits, deductibles, and insured values for all asset types.

products.name: policy
products.description: Master record for every property and liability insurance policy held across the real estate portfolio. Captures policy number, insurer name, policy type (property, general liability, umbrella, D&O, workers comp, flood, earthquake, terrorism, title), coverage class, policy status (active, expired, cancelled, non-renewed), effective date, expiration date, renewal date, premium amount, payment frequency, insured value, total insurable value (TIV), deductible structure, coverage limits, sub-limits, coinsurance percentage, policy form, endorsements summary, broker of record, and the legal entity or property asset the policy covers. SSOT for all insurance policy master data across the portfolio.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.insurance_program. Business justification: Individual policies should roll up to the enterprise insurance program. This is a standard hierarchy in insurance management - policies are components of programs. Enables program-level aggregation an

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Insurance policies are subject to state-specific surplus lines eligibility, mandatory coverage requirements, and regulatory filing obligations that vary by jurisdiction. Linking policy to compliance j

attributes.name: owner_id

attributes.name: ownership_structure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to owner.ownership_structure. Business justification: Ownership structures (LLCs, LPs, REITs) are frequently the named insured on blanket portfolio policies. Risk managers must identify which insurance policies cover assets held by a given fund or JV str
