attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total amount the insurer will pay for all covered losses during the policy period, regardless of the number of occurrences. Distinct from per-occurrence coverage limit.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SOX; SEC

attributes.name: annual_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total annual insurance premium payable for this policy, expressed in the policy currency. Used for OPEX budgeting, cost allocation across properties, and insurance cost benchmarking (PSF basis).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX; IVSC

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy is set to automatically renew at expiration without requiring affirmative action. Used to manage renewal workflow and prevent unintended coverage lapses.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy was cancelled, if applicable. Populated only when policy_status is 'cancelled'. Used for coverage gap analysis and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX; SEC

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for policy cancellation. Distinguishes between non-payment, underwriting-driven cancellation, insured-initiated cancellation, property disposition, coverage replacement, or regulatory action.
attributes.references: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC); SOX

attributes.name: certificate_of_insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Insurance (COI) must be issued and maintained for this policy to satisfy tenant lease obligations, lender requirements, or third-party contractual requirements.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842; ALTA

attributes.name: coinsurance_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of the property's insured value that the policyholder must maintain coverage for to avoid a coinsurance penalty at the time of a claim. Typically 80%, 90%, or 100% of replacement cost value.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: coverage_basis
attributes.description: Valuation method used to settle property claims under this policy. Replacement cost (RC) pays to rebuild at current costs; actual cash value (ACV) deducts depreciation; agreed value eliminates coinsurance requirements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: coverage_class
attributes.description: Broad classification of the insured asset class covered by this policy. Indicates whether the policy covers commercial real estate (CRE), residential, mixed-use, an entire portfolio, or corporate-level exposure.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: coverage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for a covered loss under this policy per occurrence or in aggregate, as specified in the policy declarations. Critical for risk gap analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SOX; SEC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this policy record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of loss the insured must absorb before insurance coverage applies per occurrence. Drives self-insured retention (SIR) budgeting and claims reserve calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 450; SOX

attributes.name: deductible_type
attributes.description: Structure of the deductible applied under this policy. Flat deductibles are fixed dollar amounts; percentage deductibles are calculated as a percentage of insured value (common for wind/hail and named storm perils). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flat|percentage|per_occurrence|aggregate|wind_hail|named_storm — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Insurance Services Office (ISO); FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance policy coverage becomes active and binding. Marks the start of the coverage period for premium accrual and claims eligibility.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; IVSC

attributes.name: endorsements_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of material policy endorsements, riders, and amendments that modify the standard policy form. Captures key coverage extensions, exclusions, and special conditions added to the base policy.
attributes.references: Insurance Services Office (ISO); DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance policy coverage terminates. Used for renewal tracking, coverage gap analysis, and compliance reporting. Critical for WALT and WALE-equivalent insurance portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; SOX

attributes.name: flood_zone
attributes.description: FEMA National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) flood zone designation for the insured property (e.g., AE, X, VE). Determines flood insurance requirements, premium rates, and mandatory purchase obligations under HUD/lender requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); EPA; FEMA NFIP

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: Standard policy form number or edition used as the basis for this policy (e.g., ISO CP 00 10, ISO CG 00 01). Identifies the contractual template and coverage breadth (all-risk vs. named-peril).
attributes.references: Insurance Services Office (ISO); National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC)

attributes.name: insured_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the named insured — whether the policy covers a specific legal entity, an individual property asset, an entire portfolio, a joint venture, or a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT).
attributes.references: SEC; FASB ASC 842; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: insured_value
attributes.description: Declared replacement cost or agreed value of the insured property or asset as stated in the policy. Basis for coverage adequacy analysis and coinsurance compliance. Distinct from market value or appraised value.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; FASB ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: lender_additional_insured
attributes.description: Name of the lender or mortgagee listed as an additional insured or loss payee on this policy. Required by lenders as a condition of mortgage financing; critical for Loan-to-Value (LTV) and DSCR covenant compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX; CMBS; ALTA

attributes.name: loss_run_last_requested_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent loss run report was requested from the insurer for this policy. Loss runs document claims history and are required for renewal underwriting and portfolio risk assessments.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SOX

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned unique identifier issued by the insurer for this policy. Used for all correspondence, claims, and regulatory filings. Maps to the policy number field in Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and MRI Software.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the insurance policy. Tracks whether the policy is active, expired, cancelled by insurer or insured, non-renewed at term end, pending issuance, or suspended.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX; SEC

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance policy by coverage category. Distinguishes property, general liability, umbrella, workers compensation, flood, earthquake, terrorism, title, and directors and officers (D&O) policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: property|general_liability|umbrella|workers_comp|flood|earthquake|terrorism|title|directors_and_officers — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Insurance Services Office (ISO); National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: premium_finance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annual premium for this policy is being financed through a premium finance agreement rather than paid directly. Affects cash flow planning and AP scheduling in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: premium_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which insurance premium installments are due and payable to the insurer. Drives accounts payable (AP) scheduling in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the policy must be renewed or replaced to maintain continuous coverage. May differ from expiration date when renewal negotiations begin in advance.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this policy record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and Argus Enterprise.

attributes.name: esg_risk_flag

attributes.name: fema_flood_zone

attributes.name: fire_hazard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fire hazard was identified during the risk assessment. Triggers specific underwriting conditions and premium loading for fire coverage.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system_status
attributes.description: Status of the fire suppression system installed at the property: fully sprinklered, partially sprinklered, standpipe only, or none. Critical underwriting factor for fire coverage pricing.

attributes.name: flood_hazard_flag

attributes.name: hvac_condition

attributes.name: improvement_deadline

attributes.name: insured_replacement_value

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date

attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC)

attributes.name: plumbing_condition

attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: prior_loss_total_amount

attributes.name: protection_class_rating

attributes.references: ISO (Insurance Services Office) Protection Class Program; NFPA

attributes.name: recommended_improvements

attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: risk_grade
attributes.description: Alphabetic risk grade derived from the overall risk score, providing a simplified tier classification for underwriting and portfolio reporting purposes (A = lowest risk, F = highest risk).
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: roof_age_years
attributes.description: Age of the current roof in years at the time of assessment. Older roofs increase risk of water damage claims and may trigger replacement requirements as a condition of coverage.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: roof_condition
attributes.description: Physical condition rating of the property's roof as assessed during the inspection. Roof condition is a primary driver of property insurance pricing and coverage eligibility.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: seismic_hazard_flag

attributes.name: seismic_zone

attributes.name: underwriter_notes

attributes.name: hq_address_line1

attributes.name: last_financial_review_date

attributes.name: legal_name

attributes.name: lines_of_business

attributes.name: min_am_best_rating_required

attributes.name: naic_company_code

attributes.name: naic_group_code

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: preferred_carrier
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has been designated as a preferred carrier for the real estate portfolio, typically reflecting a strategic relationship, competitive pricing, or superior claims service history. attributes.name: primary_contact_email

attributes.name: primary_contact_name

attributes.name: state_admittance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer is admitted (licensed) or non-admitted (surplus lines) in the primary operating state of the real estate portfolio. Drives regulatory filing requirements, surplus lines tax obligations, and guaranty fund eligibility for policyholders.

attributes.name: surplus_lines_eligible

attributes.name: trade_name

attributes.name: underwriting_contact_email

attributes.name: underwriting_contact_name

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: website

products.name: insurance_broker

attributes.name: country_id

attributes.name: account_executive_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the account executive assigned by the broker firm for escalation and strategic account management.

attributes.name: account_executive_name

attributes.name: am_best_rating

attributes.name: background_check_date

attributes.name: binding_authority

attributes.name: broker_status

attributes.name: broker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance broker by market channel and function. attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: eo_policy_number

attributes.name: aggregate_retention_limit

attributes.name: capitalization_amount

attributes.name: captive_account_number

attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: captive_entity_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the captive insurance entity as registered with the domicile jurisdiction regulator. Used for regulatory filings, financial reporting, and fronting carrier arrangements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; SEC Regulation S-K (for publicly traded REITs)

attributes.name: captive_manager_contact
attributes.description: Primary email address of the captive management firm's account manager or relationship contact. Used for regulatory filing coordination, loss fund reporting, and program renewal communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act

attributes.name: captive_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party captive management firm responsible for day-to-day administration, regulatory filings, accounting, and compliance of the captive entity (e.g., Marsh Captive Solutions, Aon Captive & Insurance Management).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; IRMI Captive Management Standards

attributes.name: captive_premium_ceded
attributes.description: Total premium amount ceded by the parent real estate entity to the captive insurance vehicle during the current program period. Represents the self-insurance cost allocation and is a key input to OPEX and insurance cost reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: captive_type
attributes.description: Classification of the captive insurance structure. Single-parent captives are wholly owned by one parent; group captives are owned by multiple unrelated entities; rent-a-captive and cell captives share infrastructure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single-parent|group|rent-a-captive|cell-captive|association|protected-cell — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; International Risk Management Institute (IRMI)

attributes.name: combined_ratio
attributes.description: Sum of the captive's loss ratio and expense ratio, expressed as a decimal. A combined ratio below 1.0 indicates underwriting profitability. Key performance indicator for captive program viability and renewal decisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; FASB ASC 944; IRMI Captive Performance Metrics

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the captive account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: dividend_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total dividends paid by the captive to its parent entity during the current program year, subject to domicile regulatory approval and minimum surplus requirements. Represents return of underwriting profit to the parent.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; FASB ASC 944; SEC Regulation S-K (REIT disclosures)

attributes.name: domicile_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the nation in which the captive is domiciled (e.g., USA, CYM for Cayman Islands, BMU for Bermuda). Required for cross-border regulatory and tax reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; OECD BEPS Pillar Two; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: domicile_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or territory where the captive insurance entity is licensed and domiciled (e.g., Vermont, Cayman Islands, Bermuda, Delaware). Governs regulatory requirements, capitalization minimums, and annual filing obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: fronting_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of gross written premium charged by the fronting carrier for issuing policies on behalf of the captive. Represents a program cost that impacts the captive's net economics.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: Total premium written by the captive across all lines of business before cessions to reinsurers. Used to assess captive underwriting volume and regulatory capital adequacy.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: investment_portfolio_value
attributes.description: Current fair market value of the captive's invested assets (bonds, money market instruments, equities per domicile investment guidelines). Supports solvency monitoring and regulatory capital adequacy assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; FASB ASC 320 (Investments); FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: irs_953d_election_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the captive has made an IRC Section 953(d) election to be treated as a U.S. domestic insurance company for federal tax purposes. Relevant for offshore captives domiciled in Bermuda, Cayman Islands, or other non-U.S. jurisdictions.
attributes.references: IRC Section 953(d); IRS Revenue Ruling 2002-89; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: last_actuarial_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent independent actuarial review of the captive's loss reserves and premium adequacy. Required annually by most domicile regulators and for FASB ASC 944 reserve certification.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; CAS Standards of Practice; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: lines_of_business
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of insurance lines of business written by the captive (e.g., property, general liability, workers compensation, professional liability, environmental). Determines regulatory capital requirements and reinsurance structure.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; ISO Insurance Lines of Business Classification

attributes.name: loss_fund_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of the captive's loss reserve fund, representing funds set aside to pay anticipated and incurred but not reported (IBNR) claims. A critical solvency and liquidity indicator for the captive program.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; FASB ASC 944; Appraisal Institute Loss Reserve Standards

attributes.name: loss_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Actuarially determined reserve for known and estimated future claim payments, including case reserves and IBNR reserves. Distinct from the loss fund balance which reflects actual cash held.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; Casualty Actuarial Society (CAS) Standards of Practice; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: micro_captive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the captive has elected small insurance company tax treatment under IRC Section 831(b), limiting annual premium income to the statutory threshold. Triggers enhanced IRS scrutiny and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: IRC Section 831(b); IRS Notice 2016-66; IRS Notice 2021-78

attributes.name: net_written_premium
attributes.description: Gross written premium less amounts ceded to reinsurers. Represents the captive's actual retained underwriting exposure and is used in loss ratio and combined ratio calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: program_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current captive program term expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null for open-ended programs. Triggers renewal workflow and regulatory re-filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: program_inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the captive insurance program became effective and began writing risk. Marks the start of the captive's binding coverage obligations and regulatory standing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; FASB ASC 944 (Insurance)

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar or fiscal year of the captive program period (e.g., 2024). Used to segregate underwriting results, loss development, and financial reporting by accident year.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the captive's annual regulatory filing was submitted to the domicile jurisdiction insurance department. Used to confirm compliance and calculate any late filing penalties.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the captive's annual regulatory filing must be submitted to the domicile jurisdiction insurance department. Used to trigger compliance workflow and avoid penalties.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the captive's annual regulatory filing with the domicile jurisdiction insurance department. Tracks compliance with mandatory reporting obligations and flags overdue submissions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; State Insurance Department Regulations; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: reinsurance_structure
attributes.description: Type of reinsurance arrangement protecting the captive above its retained limit. Quota-share cedes a fixed percentage; excess-of-loss responds above a per-occurrence threshold; stop-loss caps aggregate losses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: quota-share|excess-of-loss|stop-loss|facultative|proportional|aggregate-stop-loss|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; Reinsurance Association of America (RAA) Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary reinsurance carrier providing excess-of-loss or quota-share protection to the captive. Critical for counterparty credit risk assessment and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Reinsurance Association of America (RAA)

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the captive program's annual renewal, including re-capitalization review, reinsurance renegotiation, and regulatory filing submission.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: retained_limit_per_occurrence
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the captive retains on any single loss occurrence before reinsurance or fronting carrier coverage responds. A key parameter in the captive's risk retention strategy and reinsurance treaty design.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Captive Insurance Act; IRMI Captive Insurance Glossary

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or equivalent tax identification number assigned to the captive insurance entity. Required for IRS reporting, REIT tax compliance, and cross-border tax filings.
attributes.references: IRS Revenue Ruling 2002-89; IRS Revenue Ruling 2002-90; OECD BEPS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: loss_run_as_of_date

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Deductible amount retained by the insured on the underlying claim. Subrogation recovery is typically allocated first to reimburse the insured's deductible before the insurer recovers its paid loss.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount formally demanded from the responsible party or their insurer in the subrogation demand letter. May include loss amount, expenses, and interest.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; Arbitration Forums Inc.

attributes.name: demand_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal subrogation demand letter was issued to the responsible party or their insurer. Anchors negotiation timelines and statute of limitations tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; Arbitration Forums Inc.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subrogation opportunity was identified and the recovery pursuit was formally initiated. Used to measure time-to-identification and assess recovery pipeline aging.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines; ISO Property Claims Services

attributes.name: insurer_subrogation_contact
attributes.description: Name of the subrogation specialist or adjuster at the insurance carrier responsible for managing the recovery effort on the insurer's behalf. Used for coordination and escalation.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: legal_counsel_name
attributes.description: Name of the law firm or attorney engaged to pursue the subrogation recovery on behalf of the insurer or insured. Used for legal spend tracking and outside counsel management.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; Internal Legal Governance

attributes.name: litigation_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which legal action (lawsuit or arbitration) was formally filed against the responsible party to enforce the subrogation right. Null if no litigation has been initiated.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; Applicable Court Rules

attributes.name: litigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of any legal proceedings initiated to enforce the subrogation right. Tracks progression through the litigation lifecycle from filing through judgment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_in_litigation|filed|discovery|mediation|arbitration|trial|judgment|appeal|dismissed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; Arbitration Forums Inc.; OSHA/Legal Compliance

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date on which the original insured loss event occurred. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp for the subrogation record and anchors statute of limitations calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: loss_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of loss that gave rise to the subrogation right. Supports segmentation of recovery efforts by loss category for portfolio analytics and insurer reporting.
attributes.references: ISO Property Claims Services; NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplementary case notes, negotiation history, key correspondence summaries, or other contextual information relevant to the subrogation recovery effort.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standards

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final disposition of the subrogation recovery effort. Recovered indicates full or partial payment received; settled indicates negotiated resolution; waived indicates the insurer voluntarily relinquished the right; uncollectible indicates the responsible party is judgment-proof or insolvent.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: property_asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the real estate asset type where the loss occurred. Supports portfolio-level subrogation analytics segmented by asset class (e.g., commercial vs. residential). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: office|retail|industrial|multifamily|mixed_use|land|hospitality|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Property Classification; ULI Asset Classification

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount recovered from the responsible party or their insurer. Reduces net loss costs and is credited back to the originating claim and policy loss experience.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subrogation recovery payment was received from the responsible party or their insurer. Used for cash flow reporting and recovery accounting entries.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SOX Financial Controls; Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: recovery_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total expenses incurred in pursuing the subrogation recovery, including legal fees, expert witness costs, court filing fees, and investigation costs. Net recovery is calculated as recovery_amount minus recovery_expense_amount.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: recovery_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total demand amount actually recovered, calculated as (recovery_amount / demand_amount) * 100. Stored as a raw business metric for recovery effectiveness reporting and benchmarking against industry norms.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; Internal KPI Framework

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subrogation recovery effort. Tracks progression from initial identification through demand, negotiation, litigation, and final resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|demand_issued|negotiating|litigation|settled|recovered|waived|uncollectible|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines; ISO Property Claims Services

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the subrogation case, used for communication with insurers, legal counsel, and responsible parties. Sourced from the insurer or internal claims management system.
attributes.references: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Claim Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: responsible_party_insurer
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier for the responsible third party, if known. Used to direct demand letters and negotiate recovery directly with the adverse insurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: responsible_party_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number of the responsible third party's carrier. Enables direct insurer-to-insurer subrogation demand and arbitration proceedings.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; Arbitration Forums Inc.

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the responsible third party. Supports segmentation of subrogation recovery by counterparty category for portfolio analytics and vendor risk management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: contractor|vendor|tenant|property_owner|manufacturer|utility|government|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; ULI Best Practices

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date by which legal action must be filed or the subrogation right is extinguished by the applicable statute of limitations. Critical compliance date for recovery management and legal escalation decisions.
attributes.references: Applicable State/Jurisdiction Civil Procedure Statutes; NAIC Subrogation Guidelines

attributes.name: total_loss_amount
attributes.description: Gross total amount of the insured loss paid by the insurer on the underlying claim, representing the maximum theoretical subrogation recovery ceiling before deductible and expense adjustments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subrogation record was most recently modified. Enables change detection, incremental processing in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: waiver_of_subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a waiver of subrogation endorsement or contractual clause (e.g., in a lease or construction contract) was in effect at the time of loss, which may limit or eliminate the subrogation right.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; SNDA Agreement Standards; ASC 842 Lease Accounting

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the subrogation right was waived, such as a pre-existing waiver of subrogation endorsement in the policy, tenant lease clause, or business relationship preservation. Populated only when subrogation_outcome is 'waived'.
attributes.references: NAIC Subrogation Guidelines; insurance.endorsement waiver_of_subrogation_flag

attributes.name: related_subrogation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on subrogation (related_subrogation_id)

products.name: policy_document

attributes.name: building_id

attributes.name: claim_id

attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: document_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.document_type. Business justification: reference.document_type is the authoritative classification for all document types including insurance instruments (policy forms, endorsements, COIs, loss runs). 'document_type' on policy_document is

attributes.name: insurance_program_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: insurer_id
attributes.description: FK to insurance.insurer

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (insured entity) associated with this document. Supports multi-entity REIT structures where policies are held at the entity level.
attributes.references: SEC — for publicly traded REITs; SOX; FASB

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent insurance policy with which this document is associated. Links the document to its governing policy record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: renewal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the renewal record if this document is generated as part of a policy renewal cycle (e.g., renewal binder, renewal quote). Null if not renewal-related.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_policy_document_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer document record that replaced this version. Null if this is the current version. Enables full document version chain traversal.

attributes.name: access_restriction
attributes.description: Description of specific access restrictions applied to this document beyond the standard confidentiality level (e.g., 'Legal and Risk Management only', 'Lender distribution authorized'). Supports need-to-know access control.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to this document governing access controls and distribution restrictions. Aligns with the enterprise data classification framework and GDPR data handling requirements.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: The line of insurance coverage to which this document pertains (e.g., property, general liability, workers compensation, umbrella, flood, earthquake, directors and officers). Enables filtering and reporting by coverage line. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: property|general_liability|workers_compensation|umbrella|flood|earthquake|directors_and_officers|cyber|environmental — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; FASB ASC 842; SEC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this document record was first created in the data platform. Immutable audit field supporting SOX internal controls and GDPR data processing records.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The official date printed on or assigned to the document by the issuing party (insurer, broker, or appraiser). Represents the business event date, distinct from the upload or received date.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number or code assigned to this document by the issuing party (insurer, broker, or internal document management system). Used for cross-referencing with carrier and broker systems.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document within the insurance document management workflow. Controls document visibility, access, and retention actions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_review|active|superseded|expired|cancelled|archived — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the document as it appears on the face of the document or as assigned by the document management system (e.g., 'Commercial Property Policy Form ISO CP 00 10', 'Certificate of Insurance – Tenant ABC Corp').
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ISO 55000

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_reference
attributes.description: Unique envelope identifier assigned by DocuSign CLM for electronically executed documents. Enables direct retrieval of the e-signature audit trail from the DocuSign system of record.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ESIGN Act; UETA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the document becomes legally binding or operationally effective (e.g., binder effective date, endorsement effective date, COI effective date). Aligns with policy or endorsement effective dates where applicable.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was fully executed by all required signatories. Distinct from the document date and effective date. Null if document is not yet executed.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ALTA; NAR

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document ceases to be valid or effective (e.g., binder expiration, certificate of insurance expiry). Drives renewal alerts and compliance monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Format of the stored document file. Governs rendering, archival, and e-signature compatibility requirements.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ISO 55000

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: Original file name of the document as stored in the document management system or cloud storage repository (e.g., 'Policy_Form_CP0010_2024.pdf'). Used for file retrieval and audit trail.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ISO 55000

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the document file in kilobytes. Used for storage management, archival planning, and document integrity verification.

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document record represents the most current active version. False for superseded or prior versions retained for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX

attributes.name: is_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document has been fully executed (signed by all required parties). Particularly relevant for binders, endorsements, and SNDA agreements. Unexecuted documents may not be legally binding.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; NAR; ALTA

attributes.name: issuing_party
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual that produced and issued this document (e.g., insurer, broker, independent appraiser, risk engineering firm, legal counsel). Distinct from the insurer when documents are broker-issued.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; NAR

attributes.name: issuing_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity that issued this document. Used to route documents to the appropriate review team and apply correct retention and compliance rules.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Appraisal Institute; IVSC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, annotations, or instructions related to this document (e.g., 'Pending carrier countersignature', 'Lender copy distributed on 2024-03-15'). Not for structured data.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was received by the real estate organization from the issuing party (insurer, broker, or third-party appraiser). Used for SLA tracking and compliance deadline management.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; NAR

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this document may be purged or archived per the organization's document retention policy. Calculated based on document type, regulatory requirements, and policy expiration. Supports GDPR data minimization and SOX retention compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; HUD; EPA

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was formally reviewed and approved by the responsible team member. Supports internal control and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the employee who reviewed and approved this document for accuracy and completeness. Required for compliance and internal control documentation.
attributes.references: SOX; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this document record was originated or ingested into the data lakehouse. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation.
attributes.value_regex: Yardi Voyager|DocuSign CLM|MRI Software|Procore|Building Engines|Manual Upload
attributes.references: SOX; ISO 55000

attributes.name: source_system_doc_reference
attributes.description: Native document identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi document ID, Procore document number). Enables reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Full path or URI to the document in the enterprise document management system or cloud storage (e.g., SharePoint path, S3 URI, DocuSign envelope URL). Enables direct retrieval of the document.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ISO 55000; SOX

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this document record in the data platform. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: upload_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was uploaded or ingested into the enterprise document repository. Distinct from the document date and received date; used for system audit trail.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX; GDPR

attributes.name: uploaded_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the employee or system that uploaded this document into the repository. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements under SOX and GDPR.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document following a major.minor versioning scheme (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Tracks document revisions and supersession history for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX; GDPR

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on policy_document (superseded_policy_document_id)

products.name: policy_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment or transfer of insurance policies during property sale transactions. It captures the relationship between a property sale and the insurance policies that must be assigned, transferred, or replaced at closing. Each record links one property_sale to one policy with attributes that exist only in the context of the closing transaction, including assignment status, effective dates, proration calculations, and lender notification requirements.. Existence Justification: In real estate transactions, a property sale can involve multiple insurance policies that must be assigned or transferred at closing (e.g., property hazard, title insurance, flood, general liability, umbrella coverage). Conversely, in portfolio sales or bulk transactions, a single master insurance policy can cover multiple properties being sold across different transactions. The assignment of each policy at closing is an operational business process managed by closing coordinators, with specific attributes like assignment status, effective date, proration amount, and lender notification requirements that belong to the relationship itself, not to either the sale or the policy alone.

attributes.name: policy_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each policy assignment record at closing

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the insurance policy being assigned or transferred at closing
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: property_sale_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the property sale transaction during which this policy assignment occurs
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance policy was formally assigned or transferred as part of the property sale closing process

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special conditions, exceptions, or issues related to the policy assignment at closing (e.g., pending endorsements, coverage gaps, lender requirements)

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the insurance policy was handled at closing. Full assignment transfers the entire policy to the buyer; partial assignment may occur in portfolio sales; new policy required indicates buyer must obtain separate coverage; seller retained means seller keeps the policy; buyer replaced means buyer obtained their own coverage.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Certificate of Insurance (COI) reflecting the policy assignment was issued to the buyer or lender as part of closing deliverables

attributes.name: coverage_status_at_closing
attributes.description: Status of the insurance policy coverage at the time of property sale closing. Indicates whether the policy was assigned to the buyer, transferred, replaced with new coverage, cancelled, or continued under existing terms.

attributes.name: lender_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender or mortgagee must be notified of the policy assignment or transfer as a closing requirement. Typically required when the lender is listed as loss payee or additional insured.

attributes.name: lender_notified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lender or mortgagee was formally notified of the policy assignment or transfer, fulfilling closing requirements

attributes.name: proration_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of insurance premium prorated between buyer and seller at closing based on the effective date of policy transfer and the policy period. Positive values indicate buyer credit; negative values indicate seller credit.

products.name: blanket_group
products.description: Master reference table for blanket_group. Referenced by blanket_group_id.

attributes.name: blanket_group_id
attributes.description: Primary key for blanket_group

attributes.name: insurance_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.insurance_broker. Business justification: Blanket groups are placed through an insurance broker. Currently has broker_name (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. Broker_name is redundant once FK exists - can retrieve via JOIN to insurance
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: insurance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.insurance_program. Business justification: Blanket groups are typically part of an enterprise insurance program structure. This links the blanket coverage grouping to the overall program for program-level reporting and management.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: insurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.insurer. Business justification: Blanket groups are provided by an insurer/carrier. Currently has carrier_name and carrier_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. These are redundant once FK exists - can retrieve via JOIN to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.policy. Business justification: Blanket groups reference a master policy. Currently has policy_number (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. The policy_number string is redundant once FK exists - can retrieve via JOIN to policy.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: additional_insured_provisions
attributes.description: Description of any additional insured parties covered under the blanket group policy, such as lenders, lessors, or property managers.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the blanket group policy automatically renews at expiration or requires explicit renewal action.

attributes.name: certificate_holder_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether certificates of insurance must be issued to third parties for properties in the blanket group.

attributes.name: claims_made_basis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether coverage is on a claims-made basis (claim must be filed during policy period) versus occurrence basis (loss must occur during policy period).

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of insured value that must be maintained to avoid coinsurance penalties. Typically 80%, 90%, or 100% of property value.

attributes.name: coverage_endorsements
attributes.description: List of policy endorsements or riders that modify standard coverage terms for the blanket group. Includes special provisions and exclusions.

attributes.name: coverage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount the insurer will pay for all covered losses under the blanket group policy during the policy period.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of assets or properties included in the blanket group. Determines which properties are eligible for coverage under the group policy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the blanket group record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in the blanket group including premiums, limits, and deductibles.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount the insured must pay out-of-pocket before insurance coverage applies to claims under the blanket group policy.

attributes.name: deductible_type
attributes.description: Method by which the deductible is applied to claims. Determines whether deductible applies per incident, per claim, or as an aggregate across all claims.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the blanket insurance group coverage becomes active and binding. Marks the start of the coverage period.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the blanket insurance group coverage terminates. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen policies subject to annual renewal.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of the geographic area covered by the blanket group. May include specific states, regions, or nationwide coverage.

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier code for the blanket insurance group used in policy documentation and claims processing.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the blanket insurance group describing the collection of properties or assets covered under a single policy limit.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the blanket insurance group by coverage category. Determines the type of risk pooling and premium calculation methodology.

attributes.name: last_valuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent property valuation was completed for the blanket group. Used to ensure adequate coverage limits.

attributes.name: loss_history_summary
attributes.description: Summary of historical claims and losses for properties in the blanket group. Used for underwriting and premium calculation.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified the blanket group record. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the blanket group record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to any attribute in the record.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium charged for the blanket group coverage during the policy period. Represents the cost of insurance protection.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premium payments are due for the blanket group policy. Determines billing cycle and cash flow requirements.

attributes.name: property_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual properties or assets covered under the blanket group. Used for premium allocation and exposure analysis.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the blanket group policy is scheduled for renewal. Triggers renewal underwriting and premium renegotiation processes.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Overall risk classification of the blanket group based on loss exposure, property characteristics, and geographic concentration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the blanket insurance group indicating whether it is actively providing coverage or has been terminated.

attributes.name: total_insured_value
attributes.description: Aggregate insured value of all properties and assets covered under the blanket group. Represents the maximum potential loss exposure.

attributes.name: underwriting_notes
attributes.description: Special underwriting considerations, risk factors, or conditions noted during policy issuance for the blanket group.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the insured value of properties in the blanket group. Affects claim settlement calculations.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the blanket group record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: parent_blanket_group_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on blanket_group (parent_blanket_group_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `real_estate_ecm`.`_metrics`.`brokerage_broker_license`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "License compliance and continuing education metrics tracking license status, renewal cycles, CE completion, disciplinary actions, and E&O insurance coverage across jurisdictions."
  source: "`real_estate_ecm`.`brokerage`.`broker_license`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "license_status"
      expr: license_status
      comment: "Current status of the license (e.g., active, inactive, expired, suspended, revoked)"
    - name: "license_type"
      expr: license_type
      comment: "Type of license (e.g., salesperson, broker, managing broker)"
    - name: "license_class"
      expr: license_class
      comment: "Class of license (e.g., residential, commercial, dual)"
    - name: "issuing_state"
      expr: issuing_state
      comment: "State that issued the license"
    - name: "issuing_authority"
      expr: issuing_authority
      comment: "Authority that issued the license"
    - name: "renewal_status"
      expr: renewal_status
      comment: "Current renewal status (e.g., current, pending, overdue)"
    - name: "ce_compliance_status"
      expr: ce_compliance_status

      comment: "Total amount of commission actually disbursed to date"

    - name: "avg_commission_rate"

      comment: "Average commission rate percentage across transactions"
    - name: "avg_agent_split_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(agent_split_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average agent split percentage of gross commission"
    - name: "avg_co_broker_split_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(co_broker_split_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average co-broker split percentage in cooperative deals"
    - name: "commission_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of commission records"
    - name: "co_broker_deal_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_co_broker = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of deals involving co-brokerage arrangements"
    - name: "referral_deal_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_referral = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of deals originating from referrals"
    - name: "paid_commission_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN paid_date IS NOT NULL THEN commission_id END)
      comment: "Number of commissions that have been paid"
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `real_estate_ecm`.`_metrics`.`development_inspection_event`

      comment: "Count of inspections requiring reinspection"

      comment: "Percentage of inspections requiring corrective action - deficiency rate metric"
    - name: "osha_violation_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN osha_violation_noted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of inspections with OSHA violations"
    - name: "osha_violation_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN osha_violation_noted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT inspection_event_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of inspections with OSHA violations - safety compliance metric"
    - name: "coo_inspection_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN coo_related = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of certificate of occupancy related inspections"
    - name: "lender_draw_inspection_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN lender_draw_related = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of lender draw related inspections"
$$
metric_views.description: Construction inspection quality and compliance tracking deficiency rates, reinspection frequency, and OSHA compliance for quality control and safety management

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Common Area Maintenance (CAM) reconciliation KPIs tracking estimated vs actual CAM charges, tenant recoveries, and reconciliation variances for operating expense management"
  source: "`real_estate_ecm`.`lease`.`cam_schedule`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "reconciliation_status"
      expr: reconciliation_status
      comment: "Status of the CAM reconciliation (draft, sent, disputed, finalized, paid)"
    - name: "reconciliation_year"
      expr: reconciliation_year
      comment: "Year of the CAM reconciliation period"
    - name: "cam_cap_type"
      expr: cam_cap_type
      comment: "Type of CAM cap applied (fixed, percentage, cumulative, none)"
    - name: "cam_cap_applied"
      expr: cam_cap_applied
      comment: "Whether a CAM cap was applied to limit tenant exposure"
    - name: "dispute_flag"
      expr: dispute_flag
      comment: "Whether the tenant has disputed the CAM reconciliation"
    - name: "credit_or_charge_type"
      expr: credit_or_charge_type
      comment: "Whether the reconciliation resulted in a credit to tenant or additional charge"
    - name: "reconciliation_quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', reconciliation_period_start)
      comment: "Quarter of the reconciliation period start"
  measures:
    - name: "total_cam_reconciliation_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of CAM reconciliations processed"
    - name: "total_estimated_cam_annual"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_cam_annual AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated CAM charges billed to tenants during the year"
    - name: "total_actual_cam_gross"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cam_gross AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual CAM expenses incurred before gross-up adjustments"
    - name: "total_actual_cam_grossed_up"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cam_grossed_up AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual CAM expenses after gross-up for vacancy, represents recoverable amount"
    - name: "total_tenant_cam_allocated"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tenant_cam_allocated AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total CAM allocated to tenants based on pro-rata share"
    - name: "total_reconciliation_variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reconciliation_variance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total variance between estimated and actual CAM (positive = tenant owes, negative = tenant credit)"
    - name: "total_credit_or_charge_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_or_charge_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net credit or charge amount resulting from reconciliation"
    - name: "total_cam_cap_savings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cam_cap_savings AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total savings to tenants from CAM cap application, represents landlord expense absorption"
    - name: "total_cam_exclusions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cam_exclusions_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total expenses excluded from CAM recovery per lease terms"
    - name: "total_admin_fee_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(admin_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total administrative fees charged on CAM, represents landlord margin"
    - name: "avg_actual_cam_psf"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_cam_psf AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual CAM cost per square foot, key operating expense benchmark"
    - name: "avg_estimated_cam_psf"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_cam_psf AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated CAM cost per square foot billed to tenants"
    - name: "avg_tenant_prorata_share_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tenant_prorata_share AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average tenant pro-rata share for CAM allocation"
    - name: "cam_recovery_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(tenant_cam_allocated AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(actual_cam_grossed_up AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of actual CAM expenses recovered from tenants, key profitability metric"
    - name: "dispute_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN dispute_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of CAM reconciliations disputed by tenants, indicates billing accuracy issues"
    - name: "distinct_tenant_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id)
      comment: "Number of unique tenants with CAM reconciliations"
    - name: "distinct_lease_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT lease_agreement_id)
      comment: "Number of unique leases with CAM reconciliations"
$$
metric_views.description: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) reconciliation KPIs tracking estimated vs actual CAM charges, tenant recoveries, and reconciliation variances for operating expense management

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `real_estate_ecm`.`_metrics`.`lease_agreement`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core lease agreement KPIs including portfolio value, occupancy economics, and lease term analytics for commercial and residential leasing operations"
  source: "`real_estate_ecm`.`lease`.`lease_agreement`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "lease_status"
      expr: lease_status
      comment: "Current status of the lease agreement (active, expired, terminated, pending)"
    - name: "lease_classification"
      expr: lease_classification
      comment: "Accounting classification of the lease (operating, finance, capital) per ASC 842 / IFRS 16"
    - name: "portfolio_type"
      expr: portfolio_type
      comment: "Portfolio segment classification (commercial, residential, retail, industrial, mixed-use)"
    - name: "commencement_year"
      expr: YEAR(commencement_date)
      comment: "Year the lease commenced, used for vintage analysis"
    - name: "commencement_quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', commencement_date)
      comment: "Quarter the lease commenced, used for cohort analysis"
    - name: "expiration_year"
      expr: YEAR(expiration_date)
      comment: "Year the lease expires, used for rollover planning"
    - name: "rent_escalation_type"
      expr: rent_escalation_type
      comment: "Type of rent escalation mechanism (fixed, CPI, percentage, stepped)"
    - name: "has_renewal_option"
      expr: renewal_option_exercised
      comment: "Whether the lease includes a renewal option that has been exercised"
    - name: "has_termination_option"
      expr: CASE WHEN termination_option_date IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
      comment: "Whether the lease includes an early termination option"
    - name: "has_exclusivity_clause"
      expr: exclusivity_clause
      comment: "Whether the lease includes an exclusivity clause restricting competing tenants"
  measures:
    - name: "total_lease_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of lease agreements in the portfolio"
    - name: "total_leased_area_sqft"
      expr: SUM(CAST(leased_area_sqft AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total leased area across all agreements in square feet"
    - name: "total_monthly_base_rent"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_rent_monthly AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total monthly base rent revenue across all leases"
    - name: "total_annual_base_rent"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_rent_monthly AS DOUBLE) * 12)
      comment: "Total annualized base rent revenue across all leases"
    - name: "avg_rent_psf_annual"
      expr: AVG(CAST(base_rent_psf_annual AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average annual rent per square foot across leases, key pricing benchmark"
    - name: "weighted_avg_lease_term_months"
      expr: AVG(CAST(lease_term_months AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average lease term in months, weighted by count, indicates portfolio stability"
    - name: "total_lease_liability"
      expr: SUM(CAST(lease_liability AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total lease liability recognized on balance sheet per ASC 842 / IFRS 16"
    - name: "total_rou_asset_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rou_asset_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total right-of-use asset value recognized on balance sheet"
    - name: "total_security_deposits_held"
      expr: SUM(CAST(security_deposit_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total security deposits held as collateral, represents tenant credit exposure"
    - name: "total_ti_allowance_committed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ti_allowance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tenant improvement allowances committed, represents landlord capital obligation"
    - name: "avg_discount_rate_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discount_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discount rate used for lease liability calculation, reflects cost of capital"
    - name: "avg_rent_escalation_rate_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(rent_escalation_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average rent escalation rate across leases, indicates inflation protection"
    - name: "avg_pro_rata_share_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(pro_rata_share AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average pro-rata share for CAM cost allocation, indicates tenant expense burden"
    - name: "distinct_tenant_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id)
      comment: "Number of unique tenants in the portfolio, measures tenant concentration risk"
    - name: "distinct_asset_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id)
      comment: "Number of unique properties with active leases, measures geographic diversification"
$$
metric_views.description: Core lease agreement KPIs including portfolio value, occupancy economics, and lease term analytics for commercial and residential leasing operations

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `real_estate_ecm`.`_metrics`.`lease_payment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Lease payment KPIs tracking collections, delinquency, and cash flow performance for accounts receivable and treasury management"
  source: "`real_estate_ecm`.`lease`.`payment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Status of the payment (paid, pending, partial, reversed, NSF)"
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Method of payment (ACH, wire, check, credit card, cash)"
    - name: "charge_type"
      expr: charge_type
      comment: "Type of charge being paid (base rent, CAM, percentage rent, late fee, utilities)"
    - name: "is_delinquent"
      expr: is_delinquent
      comment: "Whether the payment is delinquent (past due date)"
    - name: "is_partial_payment"
      expr: is_partial_payment
      comment: "Whether the payment is partial (less than amount due)"
    - name: "nsf_flag"
      expr: nsf_flag
      comment: "Whether the payment was returned for non-sufficient funds"
    - name: "payment_year"
      expr: YEAR(payment_date)
      comment: "Year the payment was received, used for cash flow analysis"
    - name: "payment_quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', payment_date)
      comment: "Quarter the payment was received"
    - name: "payment_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date)
      comment: "Month the payment was received, used for monthly cash flow reporting"
    - name: "due_date_year"
      expr: YEAR(due_date)
      comment: "Year the payment was due, used for aging analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_payment_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of payment transactions processed"
    - name: "total_amount_paid"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_paid AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cash collected across all payments, key treasury metric"
    - name: "total_amount_due"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_due AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount due across all payment records"
    - name: "total_amount_applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_applied AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount applied to tenant accounts, may differ from paid due to timing"
    - name: "total_outstanding_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding balance across all tenant accounts, key AR metric"
    - name: "total_unapplied_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unapplied_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total unapplied cash (prepayments or unallocated payments)"
    - name: "total_late_fees_assessed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(late_fee_assessed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total late fees assessed on delinquent payments, indicates collection issues"
    - name: "avg_days_past_due"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_past_due AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days past due for delinquent payments, measures collection efficiency"
    - name: "collection_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(amount_paid AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(amount_due AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of amounts due that were collected, key performance indicator for AR"
    - name: "delinquency_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_delinquent = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments that are delinquent, measures credit risk"
    - name: "nsf_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN nsf_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments returned for NSF, indicates tenant financial distress"
    - name: "partial_payment_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_partial_payment = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments that are partial, indicates collection challenges"
    - name: "distinct_tenant_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id)
      comment: "Number of unique tenants making payments in the period"
    - name: "distinct_lease_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT lease_agreement_id)
      comment: "Number of unique leases with payment activity"
$$
metric_views.description: Lease payment KPIs tracking collections, delinquency, and cash flow performance for accounts receivable and treasury management
